title.id: Tumis Jagung dan Daging Cincang Vegan

description.zh:
今天分享一道超簡單又超下飯的 純素肉末炒玉米！🌽
颱風天抗漲料理！！！
香甜玉米搭配凍豆腐一起快炒，每一口都有濃郁香氣，不論配白飯、拌麵、便當都超適合，而且只要幾分鐘就能完成，是忙碌上班族、學生和新手都能輕鬆完成的純素家常料理。
description.en:
Today's super simple and rice-friendly vegan mince and corn stir-fry! 🌽
Budget-friendly typhoon-day dish!!
Sweet corn paired with frozen tofu stir-fried quickly, every bite has rich aroma. Perfect with white rice, noodles or bento boxes. Ready in minutes—easy for busy professionals, students and beginners to make this vegan home-style meal.
description.id:
Hari ini berbagi tumis jagung dan daging cincang vegan yang sangat sederhana dan cocok disantap dengan nasi! 🌽
Hidangan hemat untuk hari topan!!
Jagung manis dipadukan dengan tahu beku digoreng cepat, setiap gigitan memiliki aroma kaya. Cocok disajikan dengan nasi putih, mie atau kotak bento. Siap dalam menit—mudah bagi profesional sibuk, mahasiswa dan pemula untuk membuat hidangan rumahan vegan ini.
description.fil:
Ang sobrang simple at rice-friendly vegan mince at corn stir-fry ngayon! 🌽
Budget-friendly typhoon-day dish!!
Matamis na mais na ipinares sa frozen na tofu na mabilis na pinirito, bawat kagat ay may masaganang aroma. Perpekto sa puting bigas, noodles o bento box. Handa sa ilang minuto—madali para sa mga abalang propesyonal, mag-aaral at baguhan na gawin itong vegan na home-style na pagkain.

title.fil: I-thaw at maghanda ng frozen tofu

instruction.zh: 將凍豆腐退冰後擠乾水分，剝成小塊。若沒有凍豆腐，可用板豆腐代替並壓碎炒乾。
instruction.en: Thaw frozen tofu, squeeze out excess water, and break into small pieces. If frozen tofu is unavailable, substitute with firm tofu, crush it, and stir-fry until dry.
instruction.id: Keluarkan es dari tahu beku, peras air berlebihan, dan hancurkan menjadi potongan kecil. Jika tidak ada tahu beku, ganti dengan tahu keras, hancurkan, dan tumis hingga kering.
instruction.fil: I-thaw ang frozen na tofu, pisilin ang labis na tubig, at hatiin sa maliliit na piraso. Kung hindi available ang frozen na tofu, palitan ng matigas na tofu, durugin ito, at iprito hanggang matuyo.

steps.imagePrompt: Editorial food-process photograph, 16:9 landscape, overhead three-quarter view in a warm modern Taiwanese home kitchen: hands squeeze thawed frozen tofu dry and crumble it into small pieces beside finely chopped green water-snowflake stems. title.fil: Maghanda ng puting tubig snowflake stems

instruction.zh: 將水蓮切細，用以取代蔥的口感和顏色。
instruction.en: Chop white water snowflake stems into fine pieces to replace the texture and color of scallions.
instruction.id: Potong batang sayur water snowflake menjadi potongan halus untuk mengganti tekstur dan warna bawang daun.
instruction.fil: Gupitin ang mga puting tangkay ng snowflake ng puting tubig upang mapalitan ang texture at kulay ng scallion.

steps.imagePrompt: Editorial food-process photograph, 16:9 landscape, close overhead view in a warm modern Taiwanese home kitchen: a cook finely chops crisp green water-snowflake stems on a wooden board, with a neat pile of thin green pieces visible. Natural daylight, photorealistic food, no faces, no text, no labels, no watermark.

instruction.zh: 鍋中倒入少許油，將凍豆腐煸至金黃酥脆。
instruction.en: Add a little oil to the pan and fry the frozen tofu until golden and crisp.
instruction.id: Tuangkan sedikit minyak ke wajan lalu tumis tahu beku hingga keemasan dan renyah.
instruction.fil: Lagyan ng kaunting mantika ang kawali at iprito ang frozen tofu hanggang sa maging ginintuang at malutong.

steps.imagePrompt: Editorial food-process photograph, 16:9 landscape, overhead three-quarter view: crumbled frozen tofu is stir-fried in a dark skillet with a small amount of oil until the irregular pieces are visibly golden and crisp at the edges. Warm Taiwanese home kitchen, realistic steam and texture, no people, no text, no watermark.

instruction.zh: 將玉米罐頭的水倒出，倒入鍋中。炒至聞到烤玉米香氣或玉米微焦黃時，下調味料。
instruction.en: Drain water from the canned corn and add to the pan. Stir-fry until you smell roasted corn aroma or corn turns slightly golden.
instruction.id: Tuang air dari kaleng jagung dan tambahkan ke dalam wajan. Tumis hingga tercium aroma jagung bakar atau jagung berwarna keemasan.
instruction.fil: Alisan ng tubig ang de-latang mais at idagdag sa kawali. Haluin hanggang maamoy mo ang aroma ng inihaw na mais o bahagyang maging ginintuang mais.

steps.imagePrompt: Editorial food-process photograph, 16:9 landscape, overhead three-quarter view: drained bright yellow canned corn is being added to a skillet of golden crumbled tofu, with several kernels beginning to toast and brown. Warm modern Taiwanese home kitchen, realistic food and gentle steam, no faces, no text, no watermark.

instruction.zh: 加入醬油、胡椒鹽和咖哩粉，翻炒均勻。
instruction.en: Add soy sauce, pepper salt, and curry powder. Stir-fry until well combined.
instruction.id: Tambahkan kecap asin, garam lada, dan bubuk kari. Tumis hingga rata.
instruction.fil: Magdagdag ng toyo, asin ng paminta, at pulbos ng kari. Haluin hanggang sa maayos na pinagsama.

steps.imagePrompt: Editorial food-process photograph, 16:9 landscape, overhead close view: soy sauce, warm yellow curry powder and seasoned pepper salt are being added to a skillet of toasted corn and crumbled tofu, then folded together with a wooden spatula. Photorealistic Taiwanese home cooking, no packaging, no text, no watermark.

title.en: Add the white water snowflake stems and reduce
title.id: Tambahkan batang water snowflake dan susutkan saus
title.fil: Idagdag ang white water snowflake stems at bawasan

instruction.zh: 倒入少量水，讓凍豆腐吸收醬汁；剩少量水分時加入切碎水蓮，快速翻炒至熟。
instruction.en: Add a small amount of water and let the frozen tofu absorb the sauce. When little liquid remains, add the chopped white water snowflake stems and stir-fry briefly.
instruction.id: Tambahkan sedikit air agar tahu beku menyerap saus. Saat cairan tinggal sedikit, masukkan batang sayur water snowflake yang sudah dicincang lalu tumis sebentar.
instruction.fil: Magdagdag ng kaunting tubig at hayaang masipsip ng frozen tofu ang sarsa. Kapag may kaunting likido na natitira, idagdag ang tinadtad na puting tubig na mga tangkay ng snowflake at iprito saglit.

steps.imagePrompt: Editorial food-process photograph, 16:9 landscape, overhead three-quarter view: finely chopped green water-snowflake stems are tossed into the seasoned corn and golden tofu mixture while the last small amount of sauce reduces and glazes the food. Warm kitchen light, realistic steam and vivid texture, no faces, no text, no watermark.

instruction.zh: 最後淋上香油，大火翻炒後即可起鍋。
instruction.en: Drizzle with sesame oil, stir-fry over high heat until ready to serve.
instruction.id: Siram dengan minyak wijen, tumis dengan api besar hingga siap disajikan.
instruction.fil: Pahiran ng sesame oil, haluin sa mataas na apoy hanggang handa na ihain.

steps.imagePrompt: Editorial food-process photograph, 16:9 landscape, overhead three-quarter view: a thin glossy stream of sesame oil is drizzled over the finished vegan corn, golden crumbled tofu and chopped green stems in a hot skillet just before serving. Appetizing photorealistic Taiwanese home cooking, no faces, no text, no watermark.

title.id: Nasi Terong Satu Panci dengan Rice Cooker

description.zh: 先將香菇、茄子與花椒炒香並以醬油調味，再與白米、黃豆芽一起放進電鍋蒸煮，最後拌入九層塔的全素燜飯。
description.en: A vegan rice-cooker meal where shiitake, eggplant and Sichuan peppercorns are sautéed and seasoned, then cooked with rice and soybean sprouts and finished with basil.
description.id: Hidangan vegan rice cooker: shiitake, terong, dan lada Sichuan ditumis serta dibumbui, lalu dimasak dengan nasi dan kecambah kedelai, kemudian diselesaikan dengan kemangi.
description.fil: Isang vegan rice-cooker meal kung saan ang shiitake, eggplant at Sichuan peppercorns ay ginisa at tinimplahan, pagkatapos ay niluto kasama ng kanin at soybean sprouts at tinapos sa basil.

instruction.zh: 鮮香菇切片，茄子切成粗長條。
instruction.en: Slice the fresh shiitake mushrooms and cut the eggplant into thick long strips.
instruction.id: Iris jamur shiitake segar dan potong terong menjadi batang panjang tebal.
instruction.fil: Hiwain ang sariwang shiitake mushroom at gupitin ang talong sa makapal na mahabang piraso.

steps.imagePrompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: 16:9 recipe tutorial step image. Primary request: overhead preparation photograph of sliced fresh shiitake mushrooms and thick long purple eggplant strips arranged in separate groups on a wooden cutting board. Constraints: strictly vegan; no rice, sprouts, sauce, cooked vegetables, labels, people, text, watermark, or logos. No text.

instruction.zh: 鍋中加油炒香菇至金黃乾香，加入少許花椒與茄子，炒至茄子吸油。
instruction.en: Oil a pan and sauté shiitake until golden and dry-fragrant; add a little Sichuan peppercorn and eggplant, cooking until the eggplant absorbs the oil.
instruction.id: Panaskan minyak dan tumis shiitake hingga keemasan serta harum; tambahkan sedikit lada Sichuan dan terong, masak hingga terong menyerap minyak.
instruction.fil: Langis ng isang kawali at igisa ang shiitake hanggang sa ginintuang at tuyo-mabango; magdagdag ng kaunting Sichuan peppercorn at talong, lutuin hanggang maabsorb ng talong ang mantika.

steps.imagePrompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: 16:9 recipe tutorial step image. Primary request: close food photograph of shiitake slices turning golden and thick eggplant strips softening in a lightly oiled wok with a few Sichuan peppercorns and gentle steam. Constraints: strictly vegan; no rice, soybean sprouts, dark sauce, finished dish, labels, people, text, watermark, or logos. No text.

instruction.zh: 加入醬油、醬油膏與香油，倒水後煮至茄子吸收醬汁、湯汁收乾。
instruction.en: Add soy sauce, soy sauce paste and sesame oil; add water and cook until the eggplant absorbs the sauce and the liquid reduces.
instruction.id: Tambahkan kecap asin, saus kecap kental, dan minyak wijen; tambahkan air lalu masak hingga terong menyerap saus dan cairan menyusut.
instruction.fil: Magdagdag ng toyo, toyo paste at sesame oil; magdagdag ng tubig at lutuin hanggang masipsip ng talong ang sarsa at mabawasan ang likido.

steps.imagePrompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: 16:9 recipe tutorial step image. Primary request: close food photograph of eggplant strips and shiitake mushrooms simmering in a wok as a glossy dark soy-based sauce reduces and is absorbed, nearly no loose liquid remaining. Constraints: strictly vegan; no rice, soybean sprouts, basil, finished bowl, labels, people, text, watermark, or logos. No text.

instruction.zh: 內鍋放入洗好的兩杯白米與兩杯水，鋪上炒料和黃豆芽；外鍋加半杯水後蒸煮。
instruction.en: Put two cups of washed rice and two cups of water in the inner pot, top with the sautéed mixture and soybean sprouts, then cook with half a cup of water in the outer pot.
instruction.id: Masukkan dua cangkir beras yang telah dicuci dan dua cangkir air ke panci dalam, tambahkan tumisan dan kecambah kedelai, lalu masak dengan setengah cangkir air di panci luar.
instruction.fil: Maglagay ng dalawang tasa ng nilabhang kanin at dalawang tasa ng tubig sa inner pot, itaas ang ginisang timpla at soybean sprouts, pagkatapos ay lutuin ng kalahating tasa ng tubig sa panlabas na palayok.

steps.imagePrompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: 16:9 recipe tutorial step image. Primary request: overhead preparation photograph of a rice-cooker inner pot before cooking, with washed white rice under water and an even top layer of glossy seasoned eggplant, shiitake mushrooms and fresh soybean sprouts. Constraints: strictly vegan; no basil yet, no finished rice, labels, people, text, watermark, or logos. No text.

instruction.zh: 跳起後再燜約10分鐘，開蓋拌入九層塔並拌勻。
instruction.en: After the cooker switches off, steam for about 10 minutes, then fold in basil and mix evenly.
instruction.id: Setelah rice cooker selesai, diamkan sekitar 10 menit, lalu masukkan kemangi dan aduk rata.
instruction.fil: Matapos patayin ang kusinilya, pasingawan ng halos 10 minuto, pagkatapos ay tiklupin sa basil at ihalo nang pantay-pantay.

Constraints: strictly vegan; no meat, egg, dairy, labels, people, text, watermark, or logos. No text.

description.zh: 薑末、孜然、十三香、辣椒粉與白芝麻以熱油分次潑香，再拌入煮軟年糕和酸甜醬汁的香辣小食。
description.en: Minced ginger, cumin, thirteen-spice, chili, and sesame are bloomed with hot oil, then tossed with softened rice cakes and a tangy savory sauce.
description.id: Jahe cincang, jintan, bumbu tiga belas, cabai, dan wijen disiram minyak panas lalu diaduk dengan kue beras lembut serta saus gurih asam.
description.fil: Ang tinadtad na luya, kumin, labintatlong pampalasa, sili, at linga ay pinamumulaklak ng mainit na mantika, pagkatapos ay ihahagis ng pinalambot na mga rice cake at isang tangy na malasang sarsa.

title.fil: Pagsamahin ang mga pampalasa para sa pamumulaklak

instruction.zh: 將薑末、孜然粉、十三香、辣椒粉與白芝麻放入耐熱碗中混合，為熱油分次潑香做好準備。
instruction.en: Combine minced ginger, cumin, thirteen-spice, chili powder, and white sesame in a heatproof bowl, ready for hot oil blooming.
instruction.id: Campurkan jahe cincang, bubuk jintan, bumbu tiga belas, bubuk cabai, dan wijen putih dalam mangkuk tahan panas untuk disiram minyak.
instruction.fil: Pagsamahin ang tinadtad na luya, kumin, labintatlong pampalasa, chili powder, at puting linga sa isang mangkok na hindi tinatablan ng init, handa na para sa mainit na pamumulaklak ng langis.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic overhead food photograph of minced ginger, cumin, chili powder and white sesame arranged in a heatproof bowl, no text.

title.en: Bloom the spices with hot oil in batches
title.id: Siram rempah dengan minyak panas bertahap
title.fil: Pamumulaklak ang mga pampalasa na may mainit na mantika sa mga batch

instruction.zh: 將油加熱至160–170°C，分次倒入香料碗中，每次都讓熱油接觸香料後再攪拌，形成香辣油潑醬。
instruction.en: Heat oil to 160–170°C and pour it into the spice bowl in batches, letting each addition bloom the aromatics before stirring into a fragrant chili oil.
instruction.id: Panaskan minyak hingga 160–170°C lalu tuang bertahap ke mangkuk rempah; biarkan tiap tuangan mengeluarkan aroma sebelum diaduk menjadi minyak cabai harum.
instruction.fil: Painitin ang mantika sa 160–170°C at ibuhos ito sa mangkok ng pampalasa sa mga batch, hayaan ang bawat karagdagan na mamukadkad ang mga aromatics bago ihalo sa isang mabangong langis ng sili.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic close food photograph of shimmering hot oil being poured in batches over chili, sesame and spices in a bowl, no text.

title.en: Soften and drain the rice cakes
title.fil: Palambutin at alisan ng tubig ang mga rice cake

instruction.zh: 將年糕放入水中煮到柔軟後瀝乾，讓年糕表面保持溫熱並能吸附後續醬汁。
instruction.en: Cook the rice cakes in water until soft, then drain them so their warm surfaces can absorb the dressing.
instruction.id: Rebus kue beras dalam air hingga lembut, lalu tiriskan agar permukaannya yang hangat dapat menyerap saus.
instruction.fil: Lutuin ang mga rice cake sa tubig hanggang malambot, pagkatapos ay alisan ng tubig ang mga ito upang masipsip ng mainit na ibabaw ng mga ito ang dressing.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic food photograph of soft glossy rice cake slices draining in a metal colander over a pot, steam rising, no text.

title.en: Toss with the tangy spicy sauce
title.fil: Ihagis kasama ang tangy spicy sauce

instruction.zh: 將煮軟年糕加入油潑香料醬，再拌入醬油、味醂、檸檬汁與香菜，翻拌至每片年糕均勻裹上醬汁。
instruction.en: Add softened rice cakes to the bloomed spice oil, then toss with soy sauce, mirin, lemon juice, and cilantro until every piece is coated.
instruction.id: Masukkan kue beras lembut ke minyak rempah, lalu aduk dengan kecap asin, mirin, jus lemon, dan ketumbar hingga semua terlapisi.
instruction.fil: Magdagdag ng pinalambot na mga rice cake sa namumulaklak na langis ng pampalasa, pagkatapos ay ihagis ang toyo, mirin, lemon juice, at cilantro hanggang sa malagyan ang bawat piraso.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic editorial food photograph of glossy spicy oil-splashed rice cakes tossed with cilantro and sesame in a serving bowl, no text.

title.en: Miso Soy-Milk Tofu Meat-Sauce Dipping Noodles
title.id: Mi Celup Saus Miso Susu Kedelai Tahu
title.fil: Miso Soy-Milk Tofu Meat-Sauce Dipping Noodles

description.zh: 凍豆腐炒出金黃嚼勁後，以味噌、豆漿和調味料熬成濃稠肉醬，搭配冷麵沾食的全素料理。
description.en: Golden sautéed frozen tofu is simmered with miso and soy milk into a thick vegan meat sauce for dipping chilled noodles.
description.id: Tahu beku yang ditumis keemasan direbus dengan miso dan susu kedelai menjadi saus daging vegan kental untuk mi dingin.
description.fil: Ang ginintuang sautéed frozen tofu ay hinahalo sa miso at soy milk sa isang makapal na vegan meat sauce para sa paglubog ng pinalamig na pansit.

title.en: Mince ginger and prepare frozen tofu
title.id: Cincang jahe dan siapkan tahu beku
title.fil: Hiwain ang luya at maghanda ng frozen na tofu

instruction.zh: 老薑切成細末；將凍豆腐擠去多餘水分後剝碎，做出接近肉醬的顆粒口感。
instruction.en: Mince the mature ginger; squeeze excess water from frozen tofu and crumble it into small pieces resembling minced meat.
instruction.id: Cincang jahe tua; peras air berlebih dari tahu beku lalu hancurkan menjadi butiran kecil seperti daging cincang.
instruction.fil: Tadtarin ang mature na luya; pisilin ang labis na tubig mula sa frozen tofu at durugin ito sa maliliit na piraso na kahawig ng tinadtad na karne.

instruction.en: Heat oil, sauté the ginger first, then keep stirring the crumbled frozen tofu until moisture evaporates and the pieces turn golden and chewy.
instruction.id: Panaskan minyak, tumis jahe terlebih dahulu, lalu aduk tahu beku hancur sampai air menguap dan butirannya keemasan serta kenyal.
instruction.fil: Mag-init ng mantika, igisa muna ang luya, pagkatapos ay patuloy na haluin ang durog na frozen na tofu hanggang sa sumingaw ang moisture at ang mga piraso ay maging ginintuang at chewy.

title.fil: Pakuluan ang miso at soy milk sa sarsa

instruction.zh: 加入味噌、醬油、味醂、豆漿與水拌勻，小火煮約5分鐘，使醬汁濃稠並讓凍豆腐吸收味噌豆乳風味。
instruction.en: Add miso, soy sauce, mirin, soy milk, and water, then simmer gently about 5 minutes until thick and absorbed by the tofu.
instruction.id: Tambahkan miso, kecap asin, mirin, susu kedelai, dan air, lalu rebus perlahan sekitar 5 menit hingga kental dan meresap.
instruction.fil: Lagyan ng miso, toyo, mirin, soy milk, at tubig, pagkatapos ay pakuluan ng malumanay mga 5 minuto hanggang lumapot at masipsip ng tofu.

instruction.zh: 醬汁濃稠後加入辣椒片拌勻；將煮好的麵條盛盤，讓麵條沾取濃郁味噌豆乳肉醬食用。
instruction.en: Stir in sliced chili once the sauce thickens; plate cooked noodles and dip them into the rich miso soy-milk tofu sauce.
instruction.id: Aduk irisan cabai setelah saus mengental; sajikan mi matang dan celupkan ke saus tahu miso susu kedelai yang kaya.
instruction.fil: Haluin ang hiniwang sili sa sandaling lumapot ang sarsa; noodles na niluto sa plato at isawsaw ito sa masaganang miso soy-milk tofu sauce.

description.en: Soy milk, silken tofu, and peanut butter are blended into a chilled broth, served with crisp frozen-tofu crumble, iced udon, and cucumber.
description.id: Susu kedelai, tahu sutra, dan selai kacang diblender menjadi kuah dingin, disajikan dengan remahan tahu beku, udon dingin, dan mentimun.
description.fil: Ang soy milk, silken tofu, at peanut butter ay hinahalo sa isang pinalamig na sabaw, na inihahain kasama ng malutong na frozen-tofu crumble, iced udon, at cucumber.

name.fil: langis ng sili o sarsa ng sili

title.fil: Haluin ang pinalamig na soy-milk broth

instruction.zh: 將豆漿、半塊嫩豆腐、花生醬與少量鹽打勻，放入冰箱冷藏，讓湯底變得冰涼濃滑。
instruction.en: Blend soy milk, half a block of silken tofu, peanut butter, and a little salt until smooth, then chill the broth in the refrigerator.
instruction.id: Blender susu kedelai, setengah blok tahu sutra, selai kacang, dan sedikit garam hingga halus, lalu dinginkan di kulkas.
instruction.fil: Haluin ang soy milk, kalahating bloke ng silken tofu, peanut butter, at kaunting asin hanggang makinis, pagkatapos ay palamigin ang sabaw sa refrigerator.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic food photograph of creamy pale soy milk broth blending in a glass blender with tofu and peanut butter, no text.

title.zh: 切黃瓜絲並剝碎凍豆腐
title.en: Shred cucumber and crumble frozen tofu
title.id: Serut mentimun dan hancurkan tahu beku
title.fil: Hiwain ang pipino at durugin ang frozen tofu

instruction.zh: 小黃瓜切成細絲；將凍豆腐剝碎成不規則小顆粒，準備炒成帶有肉燥口感的配料。
instruction.en: Cut cucumber into fine shreds and crumble frozen tofu into irregular small pieces for a meat-sauce-like topping.
instruction.id: Iris mentimun tipis dan hancurkan tahu beku menjadi butiran kecil tidak beraturan untuk topping mirip saus daging.
instruction.fil: Gupitin ang pipino sa maliliit na hiwa at durugin ang frozen na tofu sa hindi regular na maliliit na piraso para sa parang karne na sarsa.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic overhead food photograph of fine cucumber shreds and crumbled frozen tofu separated in small bowls, no text.

instruction.zh: 將凍豆腐碎放入鍋中煸炒至金黃酥脆、聽到乾爽沙沙聲，再加入醬油、味醂和少量水。
instruction.en: Sauté the crumbled frozen tofu until golden and crisp with a dry sizzling sound, then add soy sauce, mirin, and a little water.
instruction.id: Tumis tahu beku hancur hingga keemasan dan renyah, lalu tambahkan kecap asin, mirin, dan sedikit air.
instruction.fil: Igisa ang durog na frozen na tofu hanggang sa ginintuang at malutong na may tuyong sizzling sound, pagkatapos ay magdagdag ng toyo, mirin, at kaunting tubig.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic close food photograph of golden crisp frozen tofu crumbles sizzling in a skillet with savory sauce, no text.

title.en: Reduce the sauce into a topping
title.fil: Bawasan ang sauce sa isang topping

instruction.zh: 持續翻炒至鍋中水分收乾，使醬油味醂醬汁被凍豆腐吸收，形成鹹香乾爽的素肉燥。
instruction.en: Keep stirring until the liquid reduces completely and the soy-mirin seasoning is absorbed, forming a savory dry tofu crumble.
instruction.id: Terus aduk hingga cairan menyusut habis dan bumbu kecap-mirin terserap, menjadi remahan tahu gurih yang kering.
instruction.fil: Patuloy na haluin hanggang ang likido ay ganap na bumaba at ang soy-mirin seasoning ay nasisipsip, na bumubuo ng masarap na tuyo na tofu na gumuho.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic food photograph of glossy savory tofu crumble reduced dry in a dark skillet, visible crisp golden edges, no text.

title.fil: Magluto ng udon pagkatapos ay palamigin

instruction.zh: 將烏龍麵放進滾水煮熟後撈出，立刻冰鎮，讓麵條降溫並保持Q彈。
instruction.en: Cook udon in boiling water, drain it, and chill immediately so the noodles cool down and remain springy.
instruction.id: Rebus mi udon dalam air mendidih, tiriskan, lalu dinginkan segera agar mi tetap kenyal.
instruction.fil: Magluto ng udon sa kumukulong tubig, alisan ng tubig, at palamigin kaagad upang lumamig ang noodles at manatiling bukal.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic food photograph of thick udon noodles being chilled in a bowl of ice water, clear cubes and steam fading, no text.

title.fil: Ipunin ang pinalamig na mangkok ng udon

instruction.zh: 碗中放冰鎮烏龍麵，倒入冷藏豆乳湯底，鋪上凍豆腐素肉燥與黃瓜絲，最後依喜好淋辣椒油或辣椒醬。
instruction.en: Place chilled udon in a bowl, pour over the cold soy-milk broth, add tofu crumble and cucumber, then finish with chili oil or sauce to taste.
instruction.id: Masukkan udon dingin ke mangkuk, tuang kuah susu kedelai, tambahkan remahan tahu dan mentimun, lalu beri minyak atau saus cabai secukupnya.
instruction.fil: Ilagay ang pinalamig na udon sa isang mangkok, ibuhos ang malamig na soy-milk broth, ilagay ang tofu crumble at cucumber, pagkatapos ay tapusin ng chili oil o sauce ayon sa panlasa.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic editorial food photograph of iced soy-milk udon topped with golden tofu crumble, cucumber shreds and chili oil, no text.

description.zh: 沖洗浸泡去澱粉的馬鈴薯絲，和酸菜、香菇、薑絲及乾辣椒炒出鹹香爽脆口感。
description.en: Rinsed, soaked potato shreds are stir-fried with pickled mustard greens, shiitake, ginger, and dried chili for a crisp savory dish.
description.id: Kentang serut yang dibilas dan direndam ditumis dengan sawi asin, shiitake, jahe, dan cabai kering hingga gurih renyah.
description.fil: Ang binanlawan, binabad na mga hiwa ng patatas ay pinirito na may adobo na mga gulay ng mustasa, shiitake, luya, at pinatuyong sili para sa isang malutong na malasang ulam.

name.fil: adobo na mga gulay ng mustasa

title.zh: 將酸菜與香菇處理成絲
title.fil: Maghanda ng mga adobo na gulay at shiitake

instruction.zh: 乾香菇泡發後切絲；酸菜稍微洗淨並泡水後切絲，降低鹹度並保留發酵香氣。
instruction.en: Soak dried shiitake and slice it; rinse and briefly soak the pickled mustard greens before slicing to soften their saltiness while keeping their fermented aroma.
instruction.id: Rendam shiitake lalu iris; bilas dan rendam sebentar sawi asin sebelum diiris agar asin berkurang tetapi aroma fermentasi tetap ada.
instruction.fil: Ibabad ang pinatuyong shiitake at hiwain ito; banlawan at ibabad saglit ang adobo na mga gulay ng mustasa bago hiwain upang mapahina ang kanilang alat habang pinapanatili ang kanilang fermented aroma.

title.zh: 刨馬鈴薯絲並洗去澱粉
title.en: Shred potatoes and rinse away starch
title.fil: Hiwain ang patatas at banlawan ang almirol

instruction.zh: 馬鈴薯去皮刨成細絲，沖洗後浸泡10分鐘，洗掉多餘澱粉，讓炒出的口感更爽脆。
instruction.en: Peel and shred potatoes, rinse them, and soak for 10 minutes to remove excess starch for a crisper stir-fry.
instruction.id: Kupas dan serut kentang, bilas lalu rendam 10 menit untuk menghilangkan pati berlebih agar hasil tumisan lebih renyah.
instruction.fil: Balatan at gupitin ang mga patatas, banlawan ang mga ito, at ibabad ng 10 minuto upang maalis ang labis na almirol para sa isang crisper stir-fry.

title.zh: 煸香乾辣椒薑絲與香菇
title.fil: Mag-toast ng sili, luya, at shiitake

instruction.zh: 鍋中加油，放入乾辣椒、薑絲與香菇絲煸香，炒到薑和香菇略乾、帶有酥脆邊緣。
instruction.en: Heat oil and toast dried chili, ginger shreds, and shiitake until fragrant, with the ginger and mushrooms slightly dry and crisp at the edges.
instruction.id: Panaskan minyak lalu tumis cabai kering, jahe serut, dan shiitake hingga harum, agak kering dan renyah di tepi.
instruction.fil: Mag-init ng mantika at mag-toast ng pinatuyong sili, ginger shreds, at shiitake hanggang mabango, na ang luya at mushroom ay bahagyang tuyo at malutong sa mga gilid.

title.zh: 炒出酸菜鹹香與馬鈴薯脆度
title.id: Tumis sawi asin dan kentang serut
title.fil: Magprito ng mga gulay at hiwa ng patatas

instruction.zh: 加入酸菜絲炒到鹹香味散出；瀝乾馬鈴薯絲後入鍋，快速翻炒至均勻受熱且仍保持爽脆。
instruction.en: Add the pickled greens and fry until their savory aroma blooms; drain potato shreds and toss quickly until heated while staying crisp.
instruction.id: Masukkan sawi asin dan tumis hingga harum; tiriskan kentang serut lalu aduk cepat sampai panas namun tetap renyah.
instruction.fil: Idagdag ang mga adobo na gulay at iprito hanggang sa mamukadkad ang kanilang masarap na aroma; alisan ng tubig ang mga hiwa ng patatas at mabilis na ihagis hanggang uminit habang nananatiling malutong.

instruction.zh: 加入少量醬油、胡椒粉、香菇水與香油，再加少許糖平衡酸菜鹹味，拌炒均勻後立即起鍋。
instruction.en: Add a little soy sauce, pepper, shiitake soaking liquid, and sesame oil; add a little sugar to balance the pickled greens, then toss and serve immediately.
instruction.id: Tambahkan sedikit kecap asin, lada, air rendaman shiitake, dan minyak wijen; beri sedikit gula untuk menyeimbangkan sawi asin, lalu sajikan segera.
instruction.fil: Magdagdag ng kaunting toyo, paminta, shiitake soaking liquid, at sesame oil; magdagdag ng kaunting asukal upang balansehin ang mga adobo na gulay, pagkatapos ay ihagis at ihain kaagad.

description.zh: 豆乾煎至微金黃後，與青椒、薑和辣椒拌入預調的甜麵醬醬汁，可收乾或保留少量湯汁。
description.en: Dried tofu is browned, then cooked with green pepper, ginger, and chili in a pre-mixed sweet-bean sauce that may be reduced or left saucy.
description.id: Tahu kering ditumis keemasan lalu dimasak dengan paprika hijau, jahe, dan cabai dalam saus pasta kacang manis yang sudah dicampur.
description.fil: Ang pinatuyong tokwa ay pina-brown, pagkatapos ay niluto na may berdeng paminta, luya, at sili sa isang pre-mixed sweet-bean sauce na maaaring mabawasan o maiwang saucy.

instruction.zh: 豆乾切片；青椒去除蒂頭和籽後切成細長條；老薑與辣椒切片，讓各種食材受熱均勻。
instruction.en: Slice dried tofu; remove the stem and seeds from green pepper and cut it into thin strips; slice ginger and chili for even cooking.
instruction.id: Iris tahu kering; buang tangkai dan biji paprika hijau lalu potong memanjang; iris jahe dan cabai agar matang merata.
instruction.fil: Hiwain ang tuyo na tofu; alisin ang tangkay at buto mula sa berdeng paminta at gupitin ito sa manipis na mga piraso; hiwain ang luya at sili para pantay ang pagluluto.

instruction.en: Add a little oil to the wok and gently toast ginger and chili first; avoid excessive heat so the aromatics do not burn.
instruction.id: Tambahkan sedikit minyak ke wajan dan tumis jahe serta cabai perlahan; jangan gunakan api terlalu besar agar tidak gosong.
instruction.fil: Magdagdag ng kaunting mantika sa kawali at dahan-dahang i-toast muna ang luya at sili; iwasan ang sobrang init para hindi masunog ang mga aromatic.

instruction.fil: Magdagdag ng mga hiwa ng tofu at hayaang maupo ang mga ito sa halip na patuloy na lumiko, bahagyang i-brown ang ibabaw ng kawali bago i-flip para sa init.

title.id: Masukkan paprika dan selesaikan dengan saus

instruction.zh: 放入青椒炒至稍微軟化仍有脆度，倒入預調醬汁後轉大火翻炒；可收乾成濃醬，或保留少量湯汁拌飯。
instruction.en: Add green pepper and cook until slightly soft but still crisp, pour in the sauce and stir over high heat; reduce dry or leave a little sauce for rice.
instruction.id: Masukkan paprika hingga sedikit lunak tetapi tetap renyah, tuang saus lalu tumis api besar; susutkan atau sisakan sedikit kuah untuk nasi.
instruction.fil: Magdagdag ng berdeng paminta at lutuin hanggang bahagyang malambot ngunit malutong pa rin, ibuhos ang sarsa at haluin sa mataas na apoy; bawasan ang tuyo o mag-iwan ng kaunting sarsa para sa kanin.

title.id: Sup Kental Tong Hao dan Tahu

description.zh: 薑末炒香茼蒿後加水煮滾，放入嫩豆腐並以蓮藕粉水勾芡，最後滴香油的暖胃羹湯。
description.en: Garland chrysanthemum is sautéed with ginger, simmered with silken tofu, thickened with lotus-root starch slurry, and finished with sesame oil.
description.id: Tong hao ditumis dengan jahe, direbus bersama tahu sutra, dikentalkan larutan pati akar teratai, lalu diakhiri minyak wijen.
description.fil: Ang garland chrysanthemum ay ginisa sa luya, pinakuluan ng silken tofu, pinalapot ng lotus-root starch slurry, at tinapos ng sesame oil.

title.id: Potong tong hao, jahe, dan tahu
title.fil: Gupitin ang chrysanthemum, luya, at tofu

instruction.zh: 茼蒿洗淨切成段，老薑切細末，嫩豆腐切成入口大小的方塊，分開備用以保持豆腐完整。
instruction.en: Wash and cut garland chrysanthemum into sections, mince ginger, and cut silken tofu into bite-size cubes, keeping tofu separate to prevent breaking.
instruction.id: Cuci dan potong tong hao, cincang jahe, lalu potong tahu sutra menjadi kubus kecil dan sisihkan agar tidak hancur.
instruction.fil: Hugasan at gupitin ang garland chrysanthemum sa mga seksyon, hiwain ang luya, at gupitin ang silken tofu sa mga cube na kasing laki ng kagat, panatilihing hiwalay ang tofu upang hindi masira.

title.fil: Igisa ang chrysanthemum na may luya

instruction.zh: 鍋中加油爆香薑末，再放入茼蒿快速翻炒，讓葉菜略為軟化並散發清新香氣。
instruction.en: Heat oil and bloom minced ginger, then quickly stir-fry garland chrysanthemum until the greens just soften and release their fresh aroma.
instruction.id: Panaskan minyak dan tumis jahe cincang, lalu aduk cepat tong hao sampai sedikit layu dan harum.
instruction.fil: Mag-init ng mantika at pamumulaklak ang tinadtad na luya, pagkatapos ay mabilis na iprito ang garland chrysanthemum hanggang sa lumambot lamang ang mga gulay at lumabas ang kanilang sariwang aroma.

title.en: Simmer water and add silken tofu
title.id: Rebus air lalu masukkan tahu sutra
title.fil: Pakuluan ang tubig at idagdag ang silken tofu

instruction.zh: 倒入200–300、單位未明的水並煮至滾起；輕放嫩豆腐塊，避免大力攪拌使豆腐碎裂。
instruction.en: Pour in the stated 200–300 amount of water with unit unspecified and bring it to a boil; gently add silken tofu cubes without vigorous stirring.
instruction.id: Tuang air sebanyak 200–300 dengan satuan tidak disebutkan lalu didihkan; masukkan kubus tahu sutra dengan lembut tanpa mengaduk keras.
instruction.fil: Ibuhos ang nakasaad na 200–300 na dami ng tubig na hindi natukoy ang yunit at pakuluan ito; dahan-dahang idagdag ang silken tofu cubes nang walang masiglang pagpapakilos.

title.fil: Dahan-dahang lumapot gamit ang lotus starch

instruction.zh: 將蓮藕粉先調成粉水，再分次倒入湯中並輕輕攪拌，直到湯體呈現滑順濃稠的羹狀。
instruction.en: Mix lotus-root starch with water first, then pour it into the soup gradually while stirring gently until the broth becomes silky and thick.
instruction.id: Larutkan pati akar teratai dengan air, lalu tuang bertahap sambil mengaduk perlahan sampai kuah menjadi kental dan lembut.
instruction.fil: Paghaluin muna ang lotus-root starch sa tubig, pagkatapos ay ibuhos ito sa sopas nang unti-unti habang hinahalo nang marahan hanggang sa maging malasutla at malapot ang sabaw.

title.en: Season and finish with sesame oil
title.fil: Timplahan at tapusin ng sesame oil

instruction.zh: 以鹽和黑胡椒粉調整味道，起鍋前滴入香油並輕拌，趁熱盛出。
instruction.en: Season with salt and ground black pepper, drizzle sesame oil just before serving, and ladle the hot thick soup into bowls.

description.en: The video calls the tofu-skin roll dou chang, explaining that it is dou bao (tofu skin). It is browned with oyster mushrooms, coated in homemade spiced steamed-rice powder and sauce, layered over sweet potato, and cooked in an electric cooker for a vegan steamed-meat texture.

title.en: Prepare the Mushrooms and Root Vegetables
title.fil: Ihanda ang mga Mushroom at Root Vegetable

instruction.zh: 乾香菇泡軟後切碎，金針菇、鴻喜菇和豆薯切碎，老薑切末。蓮藕與日本山藥磨成泥，擠去蓮藕泥多餘水分；凍豆腐擠乾後剝碎，娃娃菜和青江菜洗淨備用。
instruction.en: Soak and mince the dried shiitake; finely chop the enoki, shimeji, and jicama, and mince the ginger. Grate the lotus root and Japanese yam, then squeeze excess moisture from the lotus-root pulp. Press the frozen tofu dry and crumble it; wash the baby napa cabbage and bok choy.
instruction.id: Rendam lalu cincang shiitake kering; cincang halus enoki, shimeji, dan bengkuang, serta cincang jahe. Parut akar teratai dan ubi yam Jepang, lalu peras kelebihan air dari parutan akar teratai. Peras tahu beku hingga kering dan hancurkan; cuci sawi putih muda serta pakcoy.
instruction.fil: Ibabad at tadtarin ang pinatuyong shiitake; tadtarin ng makinis ang enoki, shimeji, at jicama, at tadtarin ang luya. Grate ang lotus root at Japanese yam, pagkatapos ay pisilin ang labis na kahalumigmigan mula sa lotus-root pulp. Pindutin ang frozen tofu tuyo at durugin ito; hugasan ang sanggol napa repolyo at bok choy.

Constraints: strictly vegan; raw prepared ingredients only, no seasonings, shaped balls, frying oil, cooked dish, meat, eggs, dairy, seafood, labels, people, watermark, or logos. No text.

title.en: Brown the Mushrooms and Frozen Tofu
title.fil: Brown the Mushrooms at Frozen Tofu

instruction.zh: 鍋中放少量炸油，先把乾香菇、老薑、金針菇和鴻喜菇煸至金黃出香，再加入剝碎凍豆腐，持續炒至水分蒸散、表面金黃。
instruction.en: Heat a little frying oil in a wok. Brown the shiitake, ginger, enoki, and shimeji until fragrant, then add the crumbled frozen tofu and continue cooking until its moisture evaporates and the pieces turn golden.
instruction.id: Panaskan sedikit minyak goreng dalam wajan. Tumis shiitake, jahe, enoki, dan shimeji hingga harum dan keemasan, lalu masukkan tahu beku hancur dan lanjutkan menumis sampai airnya menguap serta permukaannya keemasan.
instruction.fil: Mag-init ng kaunting mantika sa kawali. I-brown ang shiitake, luya, enoki, at shimeji hanggang sa mabango, pagkatapos ay idagdag ang durog na frozen na tofu at ipagpatuloy ang pagluluto hanggang sa sumingaw ang moisture nito at maging ginintuang ang mga piraso.

steps.imagePrompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: 16:9 recipe tutorial step image. Constraints: strictly vegan; no root purées, seasonings, shaped balls, cabbage, finished dish, meat, eggs, dairy, seafood, labels, people, watermark, or logos. No text.

title.fil: Timplahan at Hugis ang mga Meatball

instruction.zh: 把炒香的菇類和凍豆腐倒入蓮藕泥、日本山藥泥與豆薯中，加入獅子頭調味用的醬油、醬油膏、胡椒粉、十三香、香油和玉米粉，拌至產生黏性。分成手掌大小的圓球，輕摔排出內部空氣。
instruction.en: Combine the browned mushrooms and frozen tofu with the lotus-root pulp, Japanese-yam paste, and jicama. Add the meatball-seasoning soy sauce, thick soy sauce, pepper, thirteen-spice, sesame oil, and cornstarch; mix until sticky. Form palm-size balls and gently knock out trapped air.
instruction.id: Campurkan jamur dan tahu beku yang sudah ditumis dengan parutan akar teratai, pasta ubi yam Jepang, dan bengkuang. Tambahkan kecap asin, kecap asin kental, merica, bumbu tiga belas rempah, minyak wijen, dan maizena untuk bumbu bakso; aduk hingga lengket. Bentuk bulatan sebesar telapak tangan lalu hentakkan perlahan untuk mengeluarkan udara.
instruction.fil: Pagsamahin ang browned mushroom at frozen tofu sa lotus-root pulp, Japanese-yam paste, at jicama. Idagdag ang meatball-seasoning soy sauce, makapal na toyo, paminta, labintatlong spice, sesame oil, at cornstarch; haluin hanggang malagkit. Bumuo ng mga bolang kasing laki ng palad at dahan-dahang patumbahin ang nakulong na hangin.

instruction.zh: 炸油加熱至160–170°C，放入獅子頭炸至外層金黃、結實定型後撈起；此時內部毋須完全熟透，稍後會再紅燒。
instruction.en: Heat the frying oil to 160–170°C. Fry the lion's-head balls until the outside is golden and firmly set, then drain; the centres do not need to be fully cooked because they will be braised next.
instruction.id: Panaskan minyak goreng hingga 160–170°C. Goreng bakso kepala singa sampai bagian luar keemasan dan kokoh, lalu tiriskan; bagian tengah belum perlu matang sepenuhnya karena akan direbus lagi.
instruction.fil: Painitin ang mantika sa 160–170°C. Iprito ang lion's-head balls hanggang ang labas ay maging ginintuang at matibay, pagkatapos ay alisan ng tubig; hindi na kailangang lutuin ng buo ang mga sentro dahil sila na ang susunod na iluluto.

Constraints: strictly vegan; no cabbage, braising sauce, serving plate, animal meat, eggs, dairy, seafood, labels, people, watermark, or logos. No text.

title.en: Braise over Cabbage for Twenty Minutes
title.id: Rebus di Atas Sawi Selama Dua Puluh Menit
title.fil: I-braise ang repolyo sa loob ng Dalawampung Minuto

instruction.zh: 深鍋放少量炸油，將花椒與八角煸出香氣，鋪入娃娃菜後放上炸好的獅子頭。倒入燉汁用香菇水、水、醬油、十三香與糖，蓋鍋以小火燉20分鐘至熟透入味。
instruction.en: Heat a little frying oil in a deep pot and bloom the Sichuan peppercorns and star anise. Layer in the baby napa cabbage and set the fried meatballs on top. Add the shiitake water, water, soy sauce, thirteen-spice, and sugar for the braising liquid; cover and simmer gently for 20 minutes until cooked through.
instruction.id: Panaskan sedikit minyak goreng dalam panci dalam, lalu tumis lada Sichuan dan bunga lawang hingga harum. Susun sawi putih muda dan letakkan bakso goreng di atasnya. Tuang air rendaman shiitake, air, kecap asin, bumbu tiga belas rempah, dan gula untuk kuah; tutup dan rebus perlahan selama 20 menit hingga matang dan meresap.
instruction.fil: Mag-init ng kaunting mantika sa isang malalim na palayok at pamumulaklak ang Sichuan peppercorns at star anise. Ilagay ang baby napa repolyo at ilagay ang pritong bola-bola sa ibabaw. Idagdag ang shiitake na tubig, tubig, toyo, labintatlong pampalasa, at asukal para sa braising liquid; takpan at kumulo ng mahina sa loob ng 20 minuto hanggang maluto.

Constraints: strictly vegan; no bok choy garnish, thickened finishing sauce, serving plate, animal meat, eggs, dairy, seafood, labels, people, watermark, or logos. No text.

title.en: Plate and Finish with Thickened Sauce
title.fil: Plate at Tapusin na may Makapal na Sauce

instruction.zh: 青江菜汆燙後圍在盤邊，將燉好的獅子頭放在中央。小鍋加入部分燉汁，再放芡汁用醬油、胡椒粉、蓮藕粉和水煮滾至濃稠，淋在獅子頭上即可。
instruction.en: Blanch the bok choy and arrange it around a serving plate, then place the braised meatballs in the centre. In a small saucepan, combine some braising liquid with the finishing soy sauce, pepper, lotus-root starch, and water; boil until glossy and thick, then pour over the meatballs.
instruction.id: Blansir pakcoy dan susun mengelilingi piring, lalu letakkan bakso rebus di tengah. Dalam panci kecil, campurkan sebagian kuah rebusan dengan kecap asin, merica, tepung akar teratai, dan air untuk saus akhir; didihkan hingga mengilap dan kental, lalu siramkan di atas bakso.
instruction.fil: Paputiin ang bok choy at ayusin ito sa paligid ng serving plate, pagkatapos ay ilagay ang nilagang bola-bola sa gitna. Sa isang maliit na kasirola, pagsamahin ang ilang braising na likido sa pagtatapos ng toyo, paminta, lotus-root starch, at tubig; pakuluan hanggang makintab at malapot, pagkatapos ay ibuhos sa mga bola-bola.

title.fil: Steamed Loofah na may Glass Noodles

description.zh: 粉絲鋪底、絲瓜覆面，配上薑蓉和辣椒以電鍋蒸熟，最後淋醬油及香油，做出清甜滑順的無五辛料理。
description.en: Glass noodles are layered with loofah, ginger and chilli, steamed in a rice cooker, then finished with soy sauce and sesame oil for a light, naturally sweet vegan dish.
description.id: Soun dilapisi oyong, jahe, dan cabai, dikukus dalam penanak nasi, lalu diberi kecap asin serta minyak wijen untuk hidangan vegan yang ringan dan manis alami.
description.fil: Ang mga glass noodles ay nilagyan ng loofah, luya at sili, pinasingaw sa isang rice cooker, pagkatapos ay tinapos ng toyo at sesame oil para sa magaan, natural na matamis na vegan dish.

instruction.zh: 絲瓜去皮後切成均勻長片；薑磨成泥，辣椒切末備用。
instruction.en: Peel the loofah and cut it into even long slices. Grate the ginger into a paste and finely mince the chilli.
instruction.id: Kupas oyong lalu potong memanjang dengan ukuran rata. Parut jahe menjadi pasta dan cincang halus cabai.
instruction.fil: Balatan ang loofah at gupitin sa kahit na mahahabang hiwa. Hiwain ang luya at hiwain ng pino ang sili.

steps.imagePrompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: 16:9 recipe tutorial step image. Primary request: overhead preparation photograph of peeled loofah cut into even long pale-green slices, beside a small mound of grated ginger and finely minced red chilli on a wooden board. Constraints: strictly vegan; no glass noodles, soy sauce, sesame oil, cooked dish, labels, people, text, watermark, or logos. No text.

instruction.zh: 泡軟粉絲並瀝乾，鋪在淺盤底部；放上絲瓜片、薑蓉及辣椒末。電鍋外鍋加入1杯水，蒸至絲瓜熟軟。
instruction.en: Soak the glass noodles until soft and drain, then spread them in a shallow dish. Top with loofah, grated ginger and minced chilli. Add 1 cup water to the rice cooker's outer pot and steam until the loofah is tender.
instruction.id: Rendam soun hingga lunak lalu tiriskan dan ratakan di dasar piring tahan panas. Susun oyong, jahe parut, dan cabai cincang di atasnya. Tambahkan 1 cangkir air ke panci luar penanak nasi dan kukus hingga oyong empuk.
instruction.fil: Ibabad ang glass noodles hanggang lumambot at alisan ng tubig, pagkatapos ay ikalat ang mga ito sa isang mababaw na ulam. Ibabaw na may loofah, gadgad na luya at tinadtad na sili. Magdagdag ng 1 tasang tubig sa panlabas na kaldero ng rice cooker at pasingawan hanggang malambot ang loofah.

steps.imagePrompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: 16:9 recipe tutorial step image. Constraints: strictly vegan; no soy sauce or sesame oil yet, no finished serving bowl, labels, people, text, watermark, or logos. No text.

title.en: Finish with Soy and Sesame Oil
title.id: Selesaikan dengan Kecap dan Minyak Wijen
title.fil: Tapusin gamit ang Soy at Sesame Oil

instruction.zh: 電鍋跳起後開蓋，趁熱均勻淋上醬油和香油，即可上桌。
instruction.en: When the rice cooker switches off, open the lid and drizzle the hot dish evenly with soy sauce and sesame oil before serving.
instruction.id: Setelah penanak nasi selesai, buka tutupnya lalu siram hidangan panas secara merata dengan kecap asin dan minyak wijen sebelum disajikan.
instruction.fil: Kapag naka-off ang rice cooker, buksan ang takip at ibuhos ang mainit na ulam nang pantay-pantay na may toyo at sesame oil bago ihain.

description.zh: 紅蘿蔔、玉米與油麵以黑胡椒醬汁拌炒，配植物蛋。
description.en: Carrot, corn and noodles are stir-fried in black-pepper sauce with a plant-based egg.
description.id: Wortel, jagung, dan mi ditumis dengan saus lada hitam serta telur nabati.
description.fil: Ang karot, mais at noodles ay pinirito sa black-pepper sauce na may plant-based na itlog.

instruction.zh: 植物蛋煎至金黃酥脆後取出。
instruction.en: Fry the plant egg until golden and crisp, then remove.
instruction.id: Goreng telur nabati hingga keemasan dan renyah, lalu angkat.
instruction.fil: Iprito ang itlog ng halaman hanggang maging ginto at malutong, pagkatapos ay tanggalin.

steps.imagePrompt: Golden plant-based fried egg in skillet, no text.

instruction.zh: 紅蘿蔔、玉米與油麵拌炒。
instruction.en: Stir-fry carrot, corn and noodles.
instruction.id: Tumis wortel, jagung, dan mi.
instruction.fil: Magprito ng karot, mais at noodles.

steps.imagePrompt: Noodles and corn sizzling in a pan, no text.

instruction.zh: 加黑胡椒醬汁後勾芡收濃。
instruction.en: Add black-pepper sauce and thicken it.
instruction.id: Tambahkan saus lada hitam lalu kentalkan.
instruction.fil: Magdagdag ng black-pepper sauce at pakapalin ito.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic close-up food photograph of glossy black pepper noodles in a wok, with carrot and corn kernels visible, no text.

description.zh: 手撕杏鮑菇煎至金黃後，以醬油、味醂和楓糖漿收成油亮蜜汁，再拌入青椒與白芝麻。
description.en: Hand-torn king oyster mushrooms are seared golden, reduced in a glossy soy-mirin-maple glaze, then tossed with green pepper and white sesame.
description.id: Jamur king oyster yang disobek tangan dipanggang hingga keemasan, dimasak hingga saus kecap-mirin-maple mengilap, lalu diaduk dengan paprika hijau dan wijen putih.
description.fil: Ang mga king oyster mushroom na napunit sa kamay ay pinunit na ginintuang, binawasan sa isang makintab na soy-mirin-maple glaze, pagkatapos ay itinapon ng berdeng paminta at puting linga.

title.fil: Pilitin at gupitin ang mga sangkap

instruction.zh: 將杏鮑菇從中間手撕成兩半，再切成滾刀塊，保留撕開的粗糙表面；青椒切小片。
instruction.en: Tear the king oyster mushrooms in half from the centre, then cut them into rolling chunks while keeping the torn surface; cut the green pepper into small pieces.
instruction.id: Sobek jamur king oyster menjadi dua dari bagian tengah, lalu potong serong sambil mempertahankan permukaan sobeknya; potong paprika hijau kecil-kecil.
instruction.fil: Hatiin ang king oyster mushroom sa kalahati mula sa gitna, pagkatapos ay gupitin ang mga ito sa rolling chunks habang pinapanatili ang punit na ibabaw; gupitin ang berdeng paminta sa maliliit na piraso.

steps.imagePrompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: 16:9 recipe tutorial step image. Primary request: overhead food photograph of chunky king oyster mushrooms torn lengthwise by hand then cut into irregular rolling chunks with rough fibrous surfaces, plus small pieces of green bell pepper arranged separately on a clean wooden board. Constraints: strictly vegan; only mushrooms and green bell pepper; no sauce, oil, sesame, meat, chicken, eggs, dairy, seafood, labels, people, text, watermark, or logos. No text.

title.fil: Igisa hanggang sa ginto at puro

instruction.zh: 炒鍋倒入食用油，放入杏鮑菇以大火煎至每一面金黃；持續煎至釋出的水分蒸發、菇塊縮小。
instruction.en: Pour cooking oil into a wok and sear the king oyster mushrooms over high heat until golden on every side. Continue until their released moisture evaporates and the pieces shrink.
instruction.id: Tuang minyak goreng ke dalam wajan dan panggang jamur king oyster dengan api besar hingga setiap sisinya keemasan. Lanjutkan sampai air yang keluar menguap dan potongan jamur menyusut.
instruction.fil: Ibuhos ang mantika sa kawali at igisa ang king oyster mushroom sa sobrang init hanggang sa maging ginintuang sa bawat panig. Magpatuloy hanggang ang kanilang inilabas na kahalumigmigan ay sumingaw at ang mga piraso ay lumiit.

steps.imagePrompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: 16:9 recipe tutorial step image. Primary request: close food photograph of irregular hand-torn king oyster mushroom chunks searing over high heat in a lightly oiled wok, every side deeply golden and the pan dry after released moisture has evaporated. Constraints: strictly vegan; only mushroom and cooking oil; no green pepper, sauce, sesame, meat, chicken, eggs, dairy, seafood, labels, people, text, watermark, or logos. No text.

title.en: Reduce the glaze with green pepper
title.fil: Bawasan ang glaze na may berdeng paminta

instruction.zh: 加入醬油、味醂和楓糖漿，不斷翻炒至醬汁收乾並均勻裹住菇塊；加入青椒與白芝麻拌炒，按喜好的熟度起鍋。
instruction.en: Add soy sauce, mirin, and maple syrup, stirring constantly until the glaze reduces and coats the mushrooms evenly. Toss in green pepper and white sesame, then cook to the preferred pepper tenderness.
instruction.id: Tambahkan kecap asin, mirin, dan sirup maple, lalu aduk terus hingga saus menyusut dan melapisi jamur merata. Masukkan paprika hijau serta wijen putih, lalu masak hingga tingkat kematangan paprika yang diinginkan.
instruction.fil: Magdagdag ng toyo, mirin, at maple syrup, patuloy na pagpapakilos hanggang sa bumaba ang glaze at pantay-pantay na natatakpan ang mga kabute. Ihagis sa berdeng paminta at puting linga, pagkatapos ay lutuin sa ginustong lambot ng paminta.

Constraints: strictly vegan; no real chicken, honey, meat, eggs, dairy, seafood, unrelated ingredients, labels, people, text, watermark, or logos. No text.

description.zh: 以炒至金黃的板豆腐模擬蛋香，配菜脯、薑泥、隔夜飯與醬油炒出鍋氣的全素炒飯。
description.en: A vegan fried rice with pan-crisped firm tofu for egg-like richness, stir-fried with preserved radish, ginger, day-old rice, and soy sauce.
description.id: Nasi goreng vegan dengan tahu padat yang digoreng keemasan untuk rasa seperti telur, ditumis bersama lobak asin, jahe, nasi semalam, dan kecap asin.
description.fil: Isang vegan fried rice na may pan-crisped firm tofu para sa mala-itlog na richness, stir-fried with preserved radish, luya, day-old rice, at toyo.

title.fil: Maghanda ng mga aromatics at preserved na labanos

instruction.zh: 老薑磨成薑泥；青椒與紅椒切細圈。菜脯先試味，過鹹則泡水五至十分鐘後沖洗瀝乾。
instruction.en: Grate the mature ginger into a paste and cut the green and red peppers into thin rings. Taste the preserved radish; if it is very salty, soak it for five to ten minutes, rinse, and drain.
instruction.id: Parut jahe tua menjadi pasta dan iris paprika hijau serta merah tipis-tipis. Cicipi lobak asin; jika sangat asin, rendam lima hingga sepuluh menit, bilas, lalu tiriskan.
instruction.fil: Grate ang mature na luya sa isang i-paste at gupitin ang berde at pulang paminta sa manipis na singsing. Tikman ang napreserbang labanos; kung ito ay napakaalat, ibabad ito ng lima hanggang sampung minuto, banlawan, at alisan ng tubig.

steps.imagePrompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: 16:9 recipe tutorial step image. Primary request: overhead food photograph of finely grated mature ginger paste, thin green bell pepper rings, thin red bell pepper rings, and rinsed drained preserved radish arranged separately in small plain bowls on a clean board. Constraints: strictly vegan; only those prepared ingredients; no tofu, rice, sauce, meat, eggs, dairy, seafood, labels, people, text, watermark, or logos. No text.

title.fil: Magprito ng tofu at preserved na labanos

instruction.zh: 炒鍋倒入食用油，將板豆腐壓碎炒散，煎至酥香金黃；加入薑泥與菜脯繼續翻炒，讓豆腐水分收乾並帶出香氣。
instruction.en: Heat cooking oil in a wok, crumble in the firm tofu, and fry it until crisp and golden. Add ginger paste and preserved radish, continuing to stir-fry until the tofu dries and becomes fragrant.
instruction.id: Panaskan minyak goreng dalam wajan, hancurkan tahu padat lalu tumis hingga renyah dan keemasan. Tambahkan pasta jahe serta lobak asin, terus tumis sampai tahu mengering dan harum.
instruction.fil: Mag-init ng mantika sa isang kawali, gumuho sa matigas na tofu, at iprito ito hanggang sa malutong at maging ginintuang. Magdagdag ng ginger paste at preserved na labanos, ipagpatuloy ang pagprito hanggang sa matuyo ang tofu at maging mabango.

steps.imagePrompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: 16:9 recipe tutorial step image. Primary request: close food photograph of crumbled firm tofu fried crisp and golden in a dark seasoned wok with finely grated ginger and small pieces of preserved radish, pan visibly dry after moisture evaporates. Constraints: strictly vegan; no rice, bell peppers, soy sauce, egg, meat, dairy, seafood, labels, people, text, watermark, or logos. No text.

instruction.zh: 加入隔夜白飯炒散，淋入醬油和白胡椒粉，持續翻炒至米粒均勻上色；拌入青紅椒，起鍋前沿鍋邊淋香油後關火。
instruction.en: Add day-old rice and break it apart, then add soy sauce and ground white pepper. Stir-fry until every grain is evenly coloured; toss in the red and green peppers, drizzle sesame oil around the wok edge, and turn off the heat.
instruction.id: Masukkan nasi semalam dan uraikan, lalu tambahkan kecap asin serta lada putih bubuk. Tumis hingga setiap butir nasi berwarna rata; masukkan paprika merah dan hijau, tuang minyak wijen di tepi wajan, lalu matikan api.
instruction.fil: Magdagdag ng day-old rice at hiwa-hiwalayin, pagkatapos ay idagdag ang toyo at giniling na puting paminta. Haluin hanggang ang bawat butil ay pantay na kulay; ihalo ang pula at berdeng paminta, lagyan ng sesame oil ang gilid ng wok, at patayin ang apoy.

description.en: Blanched fried tofu skin is braised with fragrant ginger, soy sauce, soy paste, sesame oil, and sugar, then finished with basil and chilli.
description.id: Kulit tahu goreng yang direbus untuk mengurangi minyak dimasak dengan jahe harum, kecap asin, pasta kecap, minyak wijen, dan gula, lalu diselesaikan dengan kemangi serta cabai.

title.en: Prepare and blanch the tofu skin
title.fil: Ihanda at paputiin ang balat ng tofu

instruction.zh: 老薑切絲、辣椒切斜片，九層塔摘除粗梗。滾水加少許鹽，放入炸豆皮汆燙至軟化後撈出，瀝去多餘油脂。
instruction.en: Cut mature ginger into shreds and chilli on the diagonal, and remove the tough basil stems. Add a little salt to boiling water, blanch the fried tofu skin until softened, then lift it out to drain excess oil.
instruction.id: Iris jahe tua memanjang dan cabai menyerong, lalu buang batang kemangi yang keras. Tambahkan sedikit garam ke air mendidih, rebus kulit tahu goreng hingga lunak, lalu angkat untuk meniriskan minyak berlebih.
instruction.fil: Gupitin ang mature na luya at sili sa dayagonal, at alisin ang matigas na tangkay ng basil. Magdagdag ng kaunting asin sa tubig na kumukulo, paputiin ang balat ng piniritong tofu hanggang lumambot, pagkatapos ay iangat ito upang maubos ang labis na mantika.

instruction.zh: 炒鍋倒入少量食用油，以中小火煸薑絲至捲曲出香；加入汆燙豆皮拌炒，讓豆皮均勻沾上薑油。
instruction.en: Pour a small amount of cooking oil into a wok and fry the ginger shreds over medium-low heat until curled and fragrant. Add the blanched tofu skin and stir-fry so it is evenly coated with ginger oil.
instruction.id: Tuang sedikit minyak goreng ke wajan dan tumis irisan jahe dengan api sedang-kecil hingga melengkung serta harum. Masukkan kulit tahu yang telah direbus dan tumis hingga terlapisi minyak jahe secara merata.
instruction.fil: Ibuhos ang kaunting mantika sa kawali at iprito ang hiwa ng luya sa katamtamang apoy hanggang sa makulubot at mabango. Idagdag ang blanched na balat ng tofu at iprito para pantay na malagyan ng langis ng luya.

title.fil: I-braise, bawasan, at magdagdag ng mga halamang gamot

instruction.zh: 加入醬油、醬油膏、麻油、糖和水拌勻後微煮，讓豆皮吸收醬汁；湯汁略存時可加米酒提香，放入九層塔與辣椒，以大火收汁後起鍋。
instruction.en: Add soy sauce, soy paste, sesame oil, sugar, and water, then simmer so the tofu skin absorbs the sauce. When a little liquid remains, add rice wine for aroma if using, then add basil and chilli and reduce over high heat before serving.
instruction.id: Tambahkan kecap asin, pasta kecap, minyak wijen, gula, dan air, lalu rebus perlahan agar kulit tahu menyerap saus. Saat masih tersisa sedikit cairan, tambahkan arak beras untuk aroma bila digunakan, lalu masukkan kemangi serta cabai dan kentalkan dengan api besar sebelum disajikan.
instruction.fil: Magdagdag ng toyo, toyo, sesame oil, asukal, at tubig, pagkatapos ay kumulo para masipsip ng balat ng tofu ang sarsa. Kapag may natitira pang kaunting likido, magdagdag ng rice wine para sa aroma kung gagamitin, pagkatapos ay magdagdag ng basil at sili at bawasan sa sobrang init bago ihain.

description.zh: 以雪裡紅、馬鈴薯絲、菜脯、薑絲與辣椒炒香，再以少量醬油、糖和胡椒粉調味的全素台式家常菜。
description.en: A vegan Taiwanese home-style stir-fry of pickled mustard greens, shredded potato, preserved radish, ginger, and chili, seasoned with a little soy sauce, sugar, and pepper.
description.id: Tumis rumahan Taiwan vegan dari sawi asin, kentang serut, lobak asin, jahe, dan cabai, dibumbui sedikit kecap asin, gula, dan lada.
description.fil: Isang vegan Taiwanese na home-style stir-fry ng adobo na mustard greens, shredded potato, preserved radish, luya, at sili, na tinimplahan ng kaunting toyo, asukal, at paminta.

name.fil: adobo na mga gulay ng mustasa

title.zh: 洗淨雪裡紅並泡馬鈴薯絲
title.en: Rinse mustard greens and soak potato shreds
title.id: Bilas sawi asin dan rendam kentang serut
title.fil: Banlawan ang mga gulay ng mustasa at ibabad ang mga hiwa ng patatas

instruction.zh: 將現成雪裡紅稍微洗淨後擠乾水分；馬鈴薯去皮刨絲，泡入清水至釋出多餘澱粉，再瀝乾備用。
instruction.en: Lightly rinse the ready-made pickled mustard greens and squeeze them dry. Peel and shred the potatoes, soak them in water until excess starch releases, then drain well.
instruction.id: Bilas ringan sawi asin siap pakai lalu peras hingga kering. Kupas dan serut kentang, rendam dalam air hingga pati berlebih keluar, lalu tiriskan sampai baik.
instruction.fil: Banlawan nang bahagya ang handa na adobo na mga gulay ng mustasa at pisilin ang mga ito nang tuyo. Balatan at gupitin ang mga patatas, ibabad ang mga ito sa tubig hanggang sa lumabas ang sobrang starch, pagkatapos ay alisan ng tubig.

steps.imagePrompt: Overhead food photography of rinsed squeezed pickled mustard greens and pale potato shreds soaking in a bowl of water on a kitchen counter, no text.

title.fil: I-chop ang mga aromatics at garnish

instruction.zh: 將老薑切絲，香菜與辣椒切末；菜脯若很鹹，先泡水約五分鐘後擠乾，鹹度較低者沖洗後擠乾即可。
instruction.en: Julienne the mature ginger and finely chop the cilantro and chili. If the preserved radish is very salty, soak it for about five minutes and squeeze dry; otherwise rinse and squeeze it dry.
instruction.id: Iris tipis jahe tua dan cincang halus daun ketumbar serta cabai. Jika lobak asin sangat asin, rendam sekitar lima menit lalu peras kering; jika tidak, cukup bilas dan peras kering.
instruction.fil: Julienne ang mature na luya at tinadtad ng pino ang cilantro at sili. Kung ang napreserbang labanos ay masyadong maalat, ibabad ito ng mga limang minuto at pisilin ng tuyo; kung hindi man ay banlawan at pisilin ito ng tuyo.

steps.imagePrompt: Food photography of julienned ginger, chopped cilantro, red chili, and squeezed preserved radish arranged in small prep piles, no text.

title.id: Tumis jahe, lobak asin, dan cabai
title.fil: Igisa ang luya, labanos, at sili

instruction.zh: 炒鍋倒入少許油，以中火炒香薑絲、菜脯與辣椒，炒到菜脯微微捲起並散發香氣。
instruction.en: Add a little oil to a wok and sauté the ginger, preserved radish, and chili over medium heat until the radish curls slightly and becomes fragrant.
instruction.id: Tuang sedikit minyak ke wajan dan tumis jahe, lobak asin, serta cabai dengan api sedang hingga lobak sedikit melengkung dan harum.
instruction.fil: Lagyan ng kaunting mantika ang kawali at igisa ang luya, inipreserbang labanos, at sili sa katamtamang apoy hanggang sa bahagyang kulot at mabango ang labanos.

steps.imagePrompt: Close-up wok scene of ginger matchsticks, preserved radish, and red chili sizzling in a little oil, aromatic steam rising, no text.

title.fil: Igisa ang mga hiwa ng patatas hanggang sa transparent

instruction.zh: 放入瀝乾的馬鈴薯絲翻炒，使其均勻沾上香料油；持續翻炒至馬鈴薯絲略帶半透明且仍保有脆度。
instruction.en: Add the drained potato shreds and toss so they are evenly coated in the aromatic oil. Continue stir-frying until the shreds become slightly translucent while retaining some crunch.
instruction.id: Masukkan kentang serut yang telah ditiriskan dan aduk hingga terlapisi minyak aromatik. Lanjutkan menumis sampai serutan agak transparan tetapi masih renyah.
instruction.fil: Idagdag ang tinadtad na hiwa ng patatas at ihagis upang pantay-pantay ang mga ito sa mabangong langis. Ipagpatuloy ang pagprito hanggang sa maging bahagyang translucent ang mga hiwa habang nananatili ang kaunting langutngot.

title.en: Add mustard greens, season, and serve
title.id: Masukkan sawi asin, bumbui, dan sajikan
title.fil: Magdagdag ng mga gulay ng mustasa, timplahan, at ihain

instruction.zh: 加入雪裡紅炒勻，再以少量醬油、糖與胡椒粉調味；最後拌入香菜和白芝麻，略炒後關火盛盤。
instruction.en: Add the pickled mustard greens and toss well, then season with a little soy sauce, sugar, and ground pepper. Fold in cilantro and white sesame seeds, toss briefly, then turn off the heat and plate.
instruction.id: Masukkan sawi asin dan aduk rata, lalu bumbui dengan sedikit kecap asin, gula, dan lada bubuk. Masukkan daun ketumbar serta biji wijen putih, aduk sebentar, lalu matikan api dan sajikan.
instruction.fil: Idagdag ang adobo na mustard green at ihalo nang mabuti, pagkatapos ay timplahan ng kaunting toyo, asukal, at giniling na paminta. I-fold sa cilantro at white sesame seeds, ihagis sandali, pagkatapos ay patayin ang apoy at plato.

title.en: Vegan Ants Climbing a Tree with Tofu
title.fil: Mga Vegan na Langgam na Umakyat sa Puno na may Tofu

description.zh: 以板豆腐、凍豆腐和乾香菇做出肉末口感，搭配先醃上色的粉絲燜煮至吸飽醬汁。
description.en: Firm tofu, frozen tofu, and dried shiitake create a mince-like texture in this vegan glass-noodle dish, with pre-seasoned noodles simmered until they absorb the sauce.
description.id: Tahu padat, tahu beku, dan shiitake kering menciptakan tekstur seperti cincangan dalam hidangan soun vegan ini, dengan soun berbumbu yang dimasak hingga menyerap saus.
description.fil: Ang matigas na tofu, frozen na tofu, at pinatuyong shiitake ay lumilikha ng parang mince na texture sa vegan glass-noodle dish na ito, na may mga pre-seasoned noodles na kumulo hanggang sa masipsip ng mga ito ang sauce.

instruction.zh: 粉絲泡軟後剪短並瀝乾。加入醬油、醬油膏、香油、味醂和白胡椒粉拌勻，靜置讓粉絲先上色並裹上油脂。
instruction.en: Soak the glass noodles until soft, cut them shorter, and drain. Toss with soy sauce, soy paste, sesame oil, mirin, and ground white pepper; let them sit to take on colour and oil.
instruction.id: Rendam soun hingga lunak, gunting lebih pendek, lalu tiriskan. Aduk dengan kecap asin, pasta kecap, minyak wijen, mirin, dan lada putih bubuk; diamkan agar soun berwarna dan terlapisi minyak.
instruction.fil: Ibabad ang glass noodles hanggang lumambot, gupitin nang mas maikli, at alisan ng tubig. Ihagis ang toyo, toyo, sesame oil, mirin, at giniling na puting paminta; hayaan silang umupo upang kumuha ng kulay at langis.

instruction.en: Heat cooking oil in a wok, crumble the firm tofu directly into it, and fry with torn frozen tofu over medium-high heat until golden and crisp. Add drained minced shiitake and minced ginger, then fry until the shiitake is golden.
instruction.id: Panaskan minyak goreng dalam wajan, hancurkan tahu padat langsung di dalamnya, lalu panggang bersama tahu beku yang disobek dengan api sedang-besar hingga keemasan dan renyah. Masukkan shiitake cincang yang sudah ditiriskan serta jahe cincang, lalu tumis sampai shiitake keemasan.
instruction.fil: Mag-init ng mantika sa isang kawali, durog-durog nang direkta ang matigas na tofu dito, at iprito na may punit-punit na frozen na tofu sa katamtamang init hanggang sa maging ginintuang at malutong. title.fil: Gumawa ng lemon dressing at ihagis

instruction.zh: 將辣椒末、醬油、味醂、檸檬汁與素魚露拌成醬汁；擠乾小黃瓜和紅蘿蔔絲，連同米線、香草、生菜、豆腐、番茄、花生和白芝麻倒入，淋醬拌勻。
instruction.en: Mix chopped chili, soy sauce, mirin, lemon juice, and vegan fish sauce into a dressing. Squeeze the cucumber and carrot dry, then combine with noodles, herbs, lettuce, tofu, tomatoes, peanuts, and sesame; pour over dressing and toss.
instruction.id: Campur cabai cincang, kecap asin, mirin, jus lemon, dan saus ikan vegan menjadi saus. Peras mentimun serta wortel hingga kering, lalu gabungkan dengan bihun, herba, selada, tahu, tomat, kacang tanah, dan wijen; tuang saus dan aduk rata.
instruction.fil: Paghaluin ang tinadtad na sili, toyo, mirin, lemon juice, at vegan fish sauce sa isang dressing. Pigain ang pipino at karot na tuyo, pagkatapos ay pagsamahin sa noodles, herbs, lettuce, tofu, kamatis, mani, at linga; ibuhos sa dressing at ihagis.

title.zh: 純素筍粥，讓我想起阿嬤的味道

description.zh: 綠竹筍、菇類與乾絲先煸炒出香，再與生米及香菇水慢煮成料多米少的台式全素筍粥。
description.en: Fresh bamboo shoots, mushrooms, and shredded tofu are sautéed for aroma, then slowly cooked with raw rice and shiitake soaking water into a hearty Taiwanese vegan congee.
description.id: Rebung segar, jamur, dan tahu iris ditumis hingga harum, lalu dimasak perlahan bersama beras mentah serta air rendaman shiitake menjadi bubur Taiwan vegan yang kaya isian.
description.fil: Ang mga sariwang usbong ng kawayan, mushroom, at ginutay-gutay na tofu ay iginisa para sa aroma, pagkatapos ay dahan-dahang niluto kasama ng hilaw na bigas at shiitake na tubig na pambabad sa isang masarap na Taiwanese vegan congee.

title.fil: Hatiin ang mga shoots at sangkap

instruction.zh: 綠竹筍去除外層後切細絲；泡發香菇擠乾切絲，老薑切絲，金針菇與乾絲切小段，芹菜切珠。保留香菇水備用。
instruction.en: Trim the green bamboo shoots and cut them into fine shreds. Squeeze soaked shiitake dry and slice, shred the ginger, cut enoki and shredded tofu into short lengths, and dice the celery. Reserve the shiitake soaking water.
instruction.id: Buang lapisan luar rebung hijau lalu iris halus. Peras shiitake yang direndam dan iris, iris jahe memanjang, potong enoki serta tahu iris pendek-pendek, lalu cincang seledri. Sisihkan air rendaman shiitake.
instruction.fil: Gupitin ang berdeng usbong ng kawayan at gupitin ang mga ito sa maliliit na piraso. Pigain ang babad na shiitake na tuyo at hiwain, gupitin ang luya, gupitin ang enoki at gutay-gutay na tofu sa maikling haba, at hiwain ang kintsay. Ireserba ang shiitake soaking water.

Constraints: strictly vegan; no rice, frying, congee, meat, seafood, eggs, dairy, labels, people, watermark, or logos. No text.

title.en: Sauté tofu strips and bamboo shoots
title.fil: Igisa ang tofu strips at bamboo shoots

instruction.zh: 鍋中倒入食用油，先將乾絲煸至金黃酥香；加入香菇、金針菇和薑絲煸炒至金黃，再放入筍絲炒至聞到鮮甜香氣，必要時補少量油。
instruction.en: Heat cooking oil in a pot and fry the shredded tofu until golden and crisp. Add shiitake, enoki, and ginger shreds and sauté until golden, then add bamboo shoots and cook until their sweet aroma emerges, adding a little more oil if needed.
instruction.id: Panaskan minyak goreng dalam panci dan tumis tahu iris hingga keemasan serta renyah. Tambahkan shiitake, enoki, dan irisan jahe lalu tumis hingga keemasan, kemudian masukkan rebung dan masak sampai aromanya manis keluar; tambahkan sedikit minyak bila perlu.
instruction.fil: Mag-init ng mantika sa kaldero at iprito ang tinadtad na tokwa hanggang sa maging ginintuang at malutong. Magdagdag ng shiitake, enoki, at ginger shreds at igisa hanggang sa ginintuang, pagkatapos ay idagdag ang mga usbong ng kawayan at lutuin hanggang sa lumabas ang kanilang matamis na aroma, magdagdag ng kaunting mantika kung kinakailangan.

title.en: Add rice and simmer into congee
title.id: Tambahkan beras lalu masak jadi bubur
title.fil: Magdagdag ng kanin at kumulo sa congee

instruction.zh: 白米洗淨；如想縮短熬煮時間，可先浸泡30至60分鐘。把生米加入鍋中拌炒，倒入醬油和白胡椒炒出醬香；再加入水與香菇水，米和總液體約按一比九。煮滾後轉小火，期間攪拌避免黏鍋，煮至米粒熟透。
instruction.en: Rinse the white rice; to shorten the simmer, optionally soak it for 30–60 minutes first. Stir the raw rice into the pot, then add soy sauce and ground white pepper and fry until aromatic. Add water and shiitake soaking water at about one part rice to nine parts total liquid. Bring to a boil, reduce to low heat, stir occasionally to prevent sticking, and cook until tender.
instruction.id: Cuci beras putih; agar waktu memasak lebih singkat, beras boleh direndam 30–60 menit terlebih dahulu. Tumis beras mentah dalam panci, lalu tambahkan kecap asin dan lada putih hingga harum. Tuang air serta air rendaman shiitake dengan perbandingan sekitar satu bagian beras dan sembilan bagian total cairan. Didihkan, kecilkan api, aduk sesekali agar tidak lengket, lalu masak sampai lunak.
instruction.fil: Banlawan ang puting bigas; upang paikliin ang kumulo, opsyonal na ibabad ito ng 30–60 minuto muna. Haluin ang hilaw na bigas sa kaldero, pagkatapos ay ilagay ang toyo at giniling na puting paminta at iprito hanggang mabango. Magdagdag ng tubig at shiitake soaking water sa humigit-kumulang isang bahagi ng bigas sa siyam na bahagi ng kabuuang likido. Pakuluan, bawasan sa mahinang apoy, haluin paminsan-minsan para hindi dumikit, at lutuin hanggang lumambot.

instruction.zh: 試吃粥的米粒與鹹度，按需要補鹽；關火前淋少量香油，拌入芹菜珠後盛碗享用。
instruction.en: Taste the congee for rice tenderness and saltiness, adding salt if needed. Before turning off the heat, drizzle in a little sesame oil, fold in the diced celery, and serve in bowls.
instruction.id: Cicipi bubur untuk mengecek kematangan beras dan rasa asin, lalu tambahkan garam bila perlu. Sebelum mematikan api, tuang sedikit minyak wijen, aduk seledri cincang, lalu sajikan dalam mangkuk.
instruction.fil: Tikman ang congee para sa lambot at alat ng kanin, magdagdag ng asin kung kinakailangan. Bago patayin ang apoy, ibuhos sa kaunting sesame oil, tiklupin ang diced celery, at ihain sa mga mangkok.

title.en: Chilled Udon Noodles in Tea Broth
title.fil: Pinalamig na Udon Noodles sa Tea Broth

description.zh: 以濃茶湯加醬油、味醂與香油調味，倒入冰鎮烏龍麵，搭配豆包、蒟蒻、番茄、檸檬與海苔酥的清爽全素冷麵。
description.en: A refreshing vegan chilled udon bowl with a strong tea broth seasoned with soy sauce, mirin, and sesame oil, topped with tofu skin, konjac, tomato, lemon, and seaweed crisps.
description.id: Udon dingin vegan yang menyegarkan dengan kuah teh pekat berbumbu kecap asin, mirin, dan minyak wijen, dilengkapi kulit tahu, konnyaku, tomat, lemon, serta serpihan rumput laut.
description.fil: Isang nakakapreskong vegan na pinalamig na udon bowl na may matapang na sabaw ng tsaa na tinimplahan ng toyo, mirin, at sesame oil, na nilagyan ng balat ng tofu, konjac, kamatis, lemon, at seaweed crisps.

instruction.zh: 小番茄對半切，檸檬切厚片，香菜切末，豆包切絲；蒟蒻依包裝處理並備用。
instruction.en: Halve the cherry tomatoes, cut the lemon into thick slices, chop the cilantro, and shred the tofu skin. Prepare the konjac according to its package and set aside.
instruction.id: Belah dua tomat ceri, iris lemon agak tebal, cincang daun ketumbar, dan potong kulit tahu memanjang. Siapkan konnyaku sesuai petunjuk kemasan lalu sisihkan.
instruction.fil: Hatiin ang mga cherry tomatoes, gupitin ang lemon sa makapal na hiwa, i-chop ang cilantro, at gupitin ang balat ng tofu. Ihanda ang konjac ayon sa pakete nito at itabi.

steps.imagePrompt: Overhead food photography of halved cherry tomatoes, lemon slices, chopped cilantro, tofu skin strips, and konjac prepared for a chilled noodle bowl, no text.

title.en: Brew a strong tea broth and cool it
title.id: Seduh kuah teh pekat lalu dinginkan
title.fil: Gumawa ng isang malakas na sabaw ng tsaa at palamig ito

instruction.zh: 以茶包煮或沖約500毫升茶湯，選烏龍、玄米或麥茶皆可；泡得比平常飲用更濃，試喝後取出茶包並放涼。
instruction.en: Brew or steep about 500 ml of tea using a tea bag; oolong, genmaicha, or barley tea all work. Make it stronger than regular drinking tea, taste it, remove the bag, and let it cool.
instruction.id: Seduh atau rebus sekitar 500 ml teh dengan kantong teh; oolong, genmaicha, atau teh jelai semuanya cocok. Buat lebih pekat daripada teh minum biasa, cicipi, keluarkan kantong teh, lalu biarkan dingin.
instruction.fil: Brew o matarik tungkol sa 500 ML ng tsaa gamit ang isang bag ng tsaa; oolong, genmaicha, o barley tea lahat ay gumagana. Gawin itong mas malakas kaysa sa regular na pag-inom ng tsaa, tikman ito, alisin ang bag, at hayaan itong lumamig.

steps.imagePrompt: Food photography of a clear pot of deeply colored tea broth with a tea bag being lifted out, cooling beside ice, no text.

title.zh: 燙熟豆包蒟蒻與烏龍麵
title.fil: Blanch toppings at magluto ng udon

instruction.zh: 另煮一鍋滾水加少許鹽，將豆包與蒟蒻燙熟，再煮烏龍麵至熟；關火後立刻將烏龍麵放入冰水冰鎮。
instruction.en: Bring a separate pot of water with a little salt to a boil. Blanch the tofu skin and konjac, then cook the udon until tender; turn off the heat and immediately chill the udon in ice water.
instruction.id: Didihkan panci air terpisah dengan sedikit garam. Rebus sebentar kulit tahu dan konnyaku, lalu masak udon hingga matang; matikan api dan segera dinginkan udon dalam air es.
instruction.fil: Pakuluan ang isang hiwalay na palayok ng tubig na may kaunting asin. Paputiin ang balat ng tokwa at konjac, pagkatapos ay lutuin ang udon hanggang malambot; patayin ang apoy at agad na palamigin ang udon sa tubig na yelo.

steps.imagePrompt: Food photography of udon noodles being transferred into a bowl of ice water after cooking, with tofu skin and konjac nearby, no text.

title.fil: Timplahan ang pinalamig na sabaw ng tsaa

instruction.zh: 在放涼的濃茶湯中加入少許醬油、味醂和香油，攪拌均勻；若仍偏溫，加入冰塊使湯底冰涼。
instruction.en: Add a little soy sauce, mirin, and sesame oil to the cooled strong tea broth and stir well. If it is still warm, add ice cubes to chill the broth.
instruction.id: Tambahkan sedikit kecap asin, mirin, dan minyak wijen ke kuah teh pekat yang telah dingin lalu aduk rata. Jika masih hangat, tambahkan es batu untuk mendinginkan kuah.
instruction.fil: Magdagdag ng kaunting toyo, mirin, at sesame oil sa pinalamig na malakas na sabaw ng tsaa at haluing mabuti. Kung ito ay mainit pa, magdagdag ng mga ice cubes upang palamig ang sabaw.

steps.imagePrompt: Close-up food photography of chilled amber tea broth with soy sauce, mirin, sesame oil, and floating ice cubes in a glass bowl, no text.

title.fil: Ipunin ang pinalamig na tea udon

instruction.zh: 冰鎮烏龍麵瀝乾放入碗中，擺上豆包、蒟蒻、番茄與檸檬，倒入茶湯；撒香菜和海苔酥，喜辣可另加七味粉、柚子胡椒或芥末。
instruction.en: Drain the chilled udon into a bowl, arrange tofu skin, konjac, tomato, and lemon on top, then pour in the tea broth. Finish with cilantro and seaweed crisps; add shichimi, yuzu kosho, or wasabi if you like heat.
instruction.id: Tiriskan udon dingin ke dalam mangkuk, susun kulit tahu, konnyaku, tomat, dan lemon di atasnya, lalu tuang kuah teh. Akhiri dengan daun ketumbar dan serpihan rumput laut; tambahkan shichimi, yuzu kosho, atau wasabi bila suka pedas.
instruction.fil: Ibuhos ang pinalamig na udon sa isang mangkok, ayusin ang balat ng tofu, konjac, kamatis, at lemon sa ibabaw, pagkatapos ay ibuhos ang sabaw ng tsaa. Tapusin sa cilantro at seaweed crisps; magdagdag ng shichimi, yuzu kosho, o wasabi kung gusto mo ng init.

steps.imagePrompt: Finished chilled udon in clear tea broth topped with tofu skin, konjac, cherry tomatoes, lemon, cilantro, and seaweed crisps, no text.

title.zh: 純素醬燒豆腐煲 無肉也香

description.zh: 煎香板豆腐以味噌、芝麻醬、醬油和味醂燜煮，再加入粉絲吸收濃郁醬汁的全素豆腐煲。
description.en: Golden-seared firm tofu is braised in a rich miso, sesame paste, soy sauce, and mirin broth, then paired with glass noodles to absorb the savoury sauce.
description.id: Tahu padat yang dipanggang keemasan direbus dalam kuah kaya miso, pasta wijen, kecap asin, dan mirin, lalu dipadukan dengan soun yang menyerap saus gurih.
description.fil: Ang golden-seared firm tofu ay niluluto sa masaganang miso, sesame paste, toyo, at mirin broth, pagkatapos ay ipinares sa mga glass noodles upang masipsip ang malasang sarsa.

instruction.zh: 老薑切末，板豆腐切厚片；粉絲泡軟後瀝乾。鍋中倒入食用油，將豆腐兩面煎至金黃色後先盛起。
instruction.en: Mince the mature ginger and cut the firm tofu into thick slices; soak the glass noodles until soft and drain. Heat cooking oil in a pan, sear both sides of the tofu until golden, and set aside.
instruction.id: Cincang jahe tua dan potong tahu padat tebal-tebal; rendam soun hingga lunak lalu tiriskan. Panaskan minyak goreng dalam wajan, panggang kedua sisi tahu hingga keemasan, kemudian sisihkan.
instruction.fil: I-mince ang mature na luya at gupitin ang firm tofu sa makapal na hiwa; ibabad ang glass noodles hanggang malambot at alisan ng tubig. Mag-init ng mantika sa kawali, igisa ang magkabilang gilid ng tofu hanggang maging ginintuang, at itabi.

instruction.zh: 將醬油、芝麻醬、味醂、味噌和白胡椒粉拌勻成醬汁。原鍋再加少量油，煸炒薑末至邊緣微焦、香氣釋出。
instruction.en: Mix soy sauce, sesame paste, mirin, miso, and ground white pepper into a sauce. Add a little more oil to the same pan and fry the minced ginger until its edges are lightly browned and fragrant.
instruction.id: Aduk kecap asin, pasta wijen, mirin, miso, dan lada putih bubuk menjadi saus. Tambahkan sedikit minyak lagi ke wajan yang sama dan tumis jahe cincang hingga pinggirannya sedikit kecokelatan serta harum.
instruction.fil: Paghaluin ang toyo, sesame paste, mirin, miso, at giniling na puting paminta sa isang sarsa. Lagyan ng kaunting mantika ang parehong kawali at iprito ang tinadtad na luya hanggang sa maging bahagyang kayumanggi at mabango ang mga gilid nito.

title.fil: I-braise ang tofu at glass noodles

instruction.zh: 倒入調好的醬汁和三百毫升水，大火煮滾後放回煎豆腐燜煮。約三分鐘後加入瀝乾粉絲，讓粉絲吸收湯汁至入味。
instruction.en: Pour in the prepared sauce and 300 ml water, bring to a boil over high heat, then return the seared tofu to braise. After about three minutes, add the drained glass noodles and let them absorb the broth.
instruction.id: Tuang saus yang sudah disiapkan dan 300 ml air, didihkan dengan api besar, lalu masukkan kembali tahu panggang untuk direbus. Setelah sekitar tiga menit, tambahkan soun yang ditiriskan dan biarkan menyerap kuah.
instruction.fil: Ibuhos ang inihandang sarsa at 300 ML ng tubig, pakuluan sa mataas na init, pagkatapos ay ibalik ang seared tofu upang maglaga. Pagkatapos ng halos tatlong minuto, idagdag ang pinatuyo na glass noodles at hayaan silang sumipsip ng sabaw.

steps.imagePrompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: 16:9 recipe tutorial step image. instruction.zh: 粉絲吸飽醬汁後加入九層塔，煮出香氣即可關火；起鍋前沿鍋邊淋香油，喜辣可再放辣椒片。
instruction.en: When the noodles have absorbed the sauce, add Thai basil and cook just until fragrant before turning off the heat. Drizzle sesame oil around the pan edge before serving, adding sliced chilli if desired.
instruction.id: Saat soun sudah menyerap saus, masukkan kemangi Thailand dan masak hanya sampai harum sebelum mematikan api. Tuang minyak wijen di tepi wajan sebelum disajikan, lalu tambahkan irisan cabai bila diinginkan.
instruction.fil: Kapag nasipsip na ng noodles ang sauce, ilagay ang Thai basil at lutuin hanggang mabango bago patayin ang apoy. Ibuhos ang sesame oil sa gilid ng kawali bago ihain, magdagdag ng hiniwang sili kung gusto.
