title.zh: 宵夜私房吃法豆豉辣椒拌麵

description.zh: 將豆豉、老薑與辣椒以小火炒成鹹香辣醬，拌入煮熟麵條並撒上香菜的快速全素拌麵。
description.en: A quick vegan noodle dish: fermented black beans, mature ginger, and chili are slowly fried into a savory spicy sauce, then tossed with cooked noodles and cilantro.
description.id: Hidangan mi vegan cepat: kacang hitam fermentasi, jahe tua, dan cabai ditumis perlahan menjadi saus gurih pedas, lalu diaduk dengan mi matang dan daun ketumbar.
description.fil: Isang mabilis na vegan noodle dish: ang mga fermented black beans, mature na luya, at sili ay dahan-dahang piniprito sa isang masarap na maanghang na sarsa, pagkatapos ay ihahagis kasama ng nilutong noodles at cilantro.

title.en: Chop the black beans and prep aromatics
title.id: Cincang kacang hitam dan siapkan aromatik
title.fil: I-chop ang black beans at ihanda ang mga aromatics

instruction.zh: 將一半乾豆豉切碎，另一半保留整顆以增加口感；大辣椒切小段，老薑切末，香菜洗淨備用。
instruction.en: Finely chop half the dried fermented black beans and leave the other half whole for texture. Cut the large chilies into small pieces, mince the mature ginger, and wash the cilantro.
instruction.id: Cincang halus setengah kacang hitam fermentasi kering dan biarkan sisanya utuh untuk tekstur. Potong cabai besar kecil-kecil, cincang jahe tua, lalu cuci daun ketumbar.
instruction.fil: Pinong tumaga ang kalahati ng pinatuyong fermented black beans at iwanan ang kalahating buo para sa texture. Gupitin ang malalaking sili sa maliliit na piraso, tadtarin ang mature na luya, at hugasan ang cilantro.

steps.imagePrompt: Overhead food photography of chopped and whole fermented black beans, chopped red chilies, minced ginger, and cilantro on a prep board, no text.

title.en: Start black beans in cold oil
title.id: Mulai kacang hitam dalam minyak dingin
title.fil: Simulan ang black beans sa malamig na mantika

instruction.zh: 炒鍋倒入較充足的油，冷油即放入豆豉，以小火慢慢煸炒；用木匙將豆豉壓入油中，讓香氣逐漸釋放。
instruction.en: Pour a generous amount of oil into a wok and add the fermented black beans while the oil is still cold. Fry gently over low heat, pressing the beans into the oil with a wooden spoon to slowly release their aroma.
instruction.id: Tuang minyak cukup banyak ke wajan dan masukkan kacang hitam fermentasi saat minyak masih dingin. Tumis perlahan dengan api kecil sambil menekan kacang ke dalam minyak memakai sendok kayu agar aromanya keluar perlahan.
instruction.fil: Ibuhos ang maraming langis sa isang kawali at idagdag ang fermented black beans habang malamig pa ang mantika. Magprito nang malumanay sa mahinang apoy, pinindot ang beans sa mantika gamit ang kahoy na kutsara upang dahan-dahang mailabas ang kanilang aroma.

steps.imagePrompt: Close-up food photography of fermented black beans slowly frying in oil in a wok, a wooden spoon pressing them gently, no text.

instruction.zh: 豆豉部分變得半透明時加入薑末，炒至薑末金黃；再加入辣椒小火炒軟，讓辣椒釋出甜香並慢慢蒸發水分。
instruction.en: When some black beans turn translucent, add minced ginger and fry until golden. Add the chili and cook over low heat until soft, releasing sweetness and slowly evaporating its moisture.
instruction.id: Saat sebagian kacang menjadi agak transparan, tambahkan jahe cincang dan tumis hingga keemasan. Masukkan cabai dan masak dengan api kecil hingga lunak, mengeluarkan rasa manis dan menguapkan kelembapannya perlahan.
instruction.fil: Kapag ang ilang black beans ay naging translucent, magdagdag ng tinadtad na luya at iprito hanggang sa ginintuang. Idagdag ang sili at lutuin sa mahinang apoy hanggang malambot, naglalabas ng tamis at dahan-dahang sumingaw ang kahalumigmigan nito.

steps.imagePrompt: Food photography of ginger, red chili, and black beans sizzling together in fragrant oil, gently softened and golden, no text.

title.en: Season and reduce the chili sauce
title.fil: Timplahan at bawasan ang chili sauce

instruction.zh: 加入醬油、胡椒粉、冰糖與少許鹽，持續小火翻炒至冰糖融化、醬油水分收乾且鍋中只剩濃郁香氣；關火放涼備用。
instruction.en: Add soy sauce, ground pepper, rock sugar, and a little salt. Keep stirring over low heat until the rock sugar dissolves and the soy sauce moisture cooks off, leaving a fragrant concentrated sauce; turn off heat and cool slightly.
instruction.id: Tambahkan kecap asin, lada bubuk, gula batu, dan sedikit garam. Terus aduk dengan api kecil hingga gula batu larut dan kelembapan kecap menguap, menyisakan saus pekat yang harum; matikan api dan dinginkan sebentar.
instruction.fil: Magdagdag ng toyo, giniling na paminta, asukal sa bato, at kaunting asin. Patuloy na haluin sa mahinang apoy hanggang sa matunaw ang asukal sa bato at maluto ang moisture ng toyo, mag-iwan ng mabangong puro sarsa; patayin ang init at palamig ng kaunti.

steps.imagePrompt: Food photography of glossy reduced fermented black bean chili sauce in a wok, rich red-brown oil and no excess liquid, no text.

title.en: Cook noodles and toss with sauce
title.id: Masak mi lalu aduk dengan saus
title.fil: Magluto ng noodles at ihagis sa sauce

instruction.zh: 另煮一鍋滾水加少許鹽，依麵條種類煮熟後瀝乾；盛入碗中，放上豆豉辣椒醬並撒香菜拌勻，喜歡可改用芹菜。
instruction.en: Bring a separate pot of water with a little salt to a boil and cook the noodles according to their type, then drain. Put them in a bowl, top with the fermented black bean chili sauce and cilantro, and toss; celery may replace cilantro if preferred.
instruction.id: Didihkan panci air terpisah dengan sedikit garam dan masak mi sesuai jenisnya, lalu tiriskan. Masukkan ke mangkuk, beri saus cabai kacang hitam fermentasi dan daun ketumbar, lalu aduk; seledri dapat menggantikan daun ketumbar bila diinginkan.
instruction.fil: Pakuluan ang isang hiwalay na palayok ng tubig na may kaunting asin at lutuin ang pansit ayon sa uri nito, pagkatapos ay alisan ng tubig. Ilagay ang mga ito sa isang mangkok, itaas na may fermented black bean chili sauce at cilantro, at ihagis; Maaaring palitan ng kintsay ang cilantro kung gusto.

steps.imagePrompt: Finished fermented black bean chili noodles topped with glossy spicy sauce and fresh cilantro in a bowl, dramatic warm food photography, no text.

description.zh: 將豆包、根莖蔬菜和菇類逐一煎香，以低筋麵粉、植物奶與水煮成濃滑醬汁，最後加入花椰菜燉煮。
description.en: Tofu puffs, root vegetables, and mushrooms are browned in stages, then made into a creamy sauce with low-protein flour, plant milk, and water before finishing with broccoli.
description.id: Tahu puff, sayuran akar, dan jamur dipanggang bertahap, lalu dibuat menjadi saus lembut dengan tepung rendah protein, susu nabati, dan air sebelum diselesaikan dengan brokoli.
description.fil: Ang tofu puffs, root vegetables, at mushroom ay pina-browned sa mga yugto, pagkatapos ay ginawang creamy sauce na may mababang protina na harina, gatas ng halaman, at tubig bago matapos sa broccoli.

instruction.zh: 馬鈴薯和紅蘿蔔去皮切均勻塊；蘑菇切四等份，豆包切塊，花椰菜切成小朵。若花椰菜梗較粗，削去外皮後一併切片使用。
instruction.en: Peel potatoes and carrots and cut into even chunks. Quarter the mushrooms, cut tofu puffs into pieces, and divide broccoli into small florets. If the broccoli stems are thick, peel their outer skin and slice them for the stew.
instruction.id: Kupas kentang dan wortel lalu potong menjadi ukuran seragam. Potong jamur menjadi empat, potong tahu puff, dan pisahkan brokoli menjadi kuntum kecil. Jika batang brokoli tebal, kupas kulit luarnya lalu iris untuk digunakan dalam semur.
instruction.fil: Balatan ang mga patatas at karot at gupitin sa pantay na mga piraso. I-quarter ang mga mushroom, gupitin ang tofu puffs, at hatiin ang broccoli sa maliliit na bulaklak. Kung makapal ang tangkay ng broccoli, balatan ang panlabas na balat at hiwain para sa nilagang.

title.fil: Brown ang mga sangkap sa mga yugto

instruction.zh: 燉鍋倒入食用油，先將豆包煎至金黃酥香後盛起；再煎馬鈴薯、紅蘿蔔和蘑菇，讓各面帶有金黃色的油煎香氣。
instruction.en: Heat cooking oil in a stew pot and first brown the tofu puffs until golden and crisp, then set them aside. Sear the potatoes, carrots, and mushrooms until their surfaces develop golden fried flavour.
instruction.id: Panaskan minyak goreng dalam panci semur dan panggang tahu puff terlebih dahulu hingga keemasan serta renyah, lalu sisihkan. Panggang kentang, wortel, dan jamur sampai permukaannya berwarna keemasan.
instruction.fil: Mag-init ng mantika sa isang nilagang kaldero at i-brown muna ang tofu puffs hanggang maging ginintuang at malutong, pagkatapos ay itabi. Igisa ang mga patatas, karot, at kabute hanggang sa magkaroon ng gintong pritong lasa ang mga ibabaw nito.

instruction.zh: 待蘑菇縮小並釋出水分後，撒入低筋麵粉拌炒；倒入植物奶和水攪勻，加入黑胡椒、鹽和月桂葉調味，煮至湯汁濃滑。
instruction.en: Once the mushrooms have shrunk and released their moisture, sprinkle in low-protein flour and stir. Pour in plant milk and water, season with black pepper, salt, and bay leaf, then cook until the sauce turns creamy.
instruction.id: Setelah jamur menyusut dan mengeluarkan cairan, taburkan tepung rendah protein lalu aduk. Tuang susu nabati dan air, bumbui dengan lada hitam, garam, serta daun salam, lalu masak hingga saus menjadi lembut.
instruction.fil: Kapag ang mga mushroom ay lumiit at naglabas ng kanilang kahalumigmigan, iwisik ang mababang protina na harina at pukawin. Ibuhos ang gatas ng halaman at tubig, timplahan ng black pepper, asin, at bay leaf, pagkatapos ay lutuin hanggang sa maging creamy ang sauce.

title.en: Add broccoli and finish the stew
title.fil: Magdagdag ng broccoli at tapusin ang nilagang

instruction.zh: 放回煎好的豆包，加入花椰菜和毛豆；煮滾後轉小火燉約五分鐘，至花椰菜熟而仍保有口感即可盛出。
instruction.en: Return the browned tofu puffs and add broccoli and edamame. Bring to a boil, then simmer on low for about five minutes, until the broccoli is cooked but still has texture, before serving.
instruction.id: Masukkan kembali tahu puff yang telah dipanggang, lalu tambahkan brokoli dan edamame. Didihkan, kemudian rebus dengan api kecil sekitar lima menit sampai brokoli matang tetapi masih bertekstur, lalu sajikan.
instruction.fil: Ibalik ang browned tofu puffs at idagdag ang broccoli at edamame. Pakuluan, pagkatapos ay kumulo sa mababang init ng halos limang minuto, hanggang sa maluto ang broccoli ngunit may texture pa rin, bago ihain.

description.zh: 以白金針菇與薑片少油煸香，加入薑黃、豆腐、黃豆粉與絲瓜煮成的清爽全素湯品。
description.en: A light vegan soup of loofah and tofu, built by lightly sautéing white beech mushrooms and ginger, then simmering with turmeric and soybean powder.
description.id: Sup vegan ringan dari gambas dan tahu, dibuat dengan menumis ringan jamur beech putih serta jahe, lalu dididihkan bersama kunyit dan bubuk kedelai.
description.fil: Isang magaang vegan na sopas ng loofah at tofu, na ginawa sa pamamagitan ng bahagyang paggisa ng mga puting beech mushroom at luya, pagkatapos ay kumukulo na may turmeric at soybean powder.

title.fil: Maghanda ng mushroom, tofu, at loofah

instruction.zh: 白金針菇撕成細束；老薑切片，豆腐切塊。絲瓜先沖洗再削皮，保留些許綠皮並切滾刀塊。
instruction.en: Pull white beech mushrooms into thin clusters, slice mature ginger, and cube the tofu. Rinse the loofah before peeling, leave a little green skin, and cut into rolling chunks.
instruction.id: Suwir jamur beech putih menjadi rumpun kecil, iris jahe tua, dan potong tahu dadu. Bilas gambas sebelum dikupas, sisakan sedikit kulit hijau, lalu potong serong besar.
instruction.fil: Hilahin ang mga puting beech mushroom sa manipis na kumpol, hiwain ang mature na luya, at i-cube ang tofu. Banlawan ang loofah bago balatan, mag-iwan ng kaunting berdeng balat, at gupitin sa mga rolling chunks.

steps.imagePrompt: Overhead food photography of white beech mushroom clusters, sliced ginger, tofu cubes, and partially peeled loofah chunks on a prep board, no text.

title.fil: Banayad na igisa ang mushroom at luya

instruction.zh: 鍋中加入少許油，以中火煸香白金針菇和薑片，炒至菇類帶金黃香氣。
instruction.en: Add a small amount of oil to a pot and sauté the white beech mushrooms and ginger over medium heat until the mushrooms become fragrant and lightly golden.
instruction.id: Tambahkan sedikit minyak ke panci dan tumis jamur beech putih serta jahe dengan api sedang hingga jamur harum dan agak keemasan.
instruction.fil: Magdagdag ng kaunting mantika sa kaldero at igisa ang mga puting beech mushroom at luya sa katamtamang init hanggang sa maging mabango at bahagyang ginintuang ang mga kabute.

steps.imagePrompt: Close-up food photography of white beech mushrooms and ginger slices gently sautéing in a small amount of oil, no text.

title.en: Bloom turmeric and build the broth
title.fil: Bloom turmeric at bumuo ng sabaw

instruction.zh: 加入少許薑黃粉快速拌炒至沒有粉感，立即倒入1000毫升水；加入豆腐、少許鹽與黃豆粉，攪勻煮滾。
instruction.en: Add a small amount of turmeric powder and stir quickly until no dry powder remains, then immediately pour in 1000 ml water. Add tofu, a little salt, and soybean powder, stir well, and bring to a boil.
instruction.id: Tambahkan sedikit bubuk kunyit dan aduk cepat hingga tidak ada bubuk kering, lalu segera tuang 1000 ml air. Masukkan tahu, sedikit garam, dan bubuk kedelai, aduk rata, lalu didihkan.
instruction.fil: Magdagdag ng isang maliit na halaga ng turmeric powder at haluin nang mabilis hanggang sa walang tuyong pulbos na natitira, pagkatapos ay agad na ibuhos sa 1000 ML ng tubig. Magdagdag ng tofu, kaunting asin, at soybean powder, haluing mabuti, at pakuluan.

steps.imagePrompt: Food photography of golden turmeric broth with tofu cubes and soybean powder being stirred in a soup pot, no text.

title.fil: Magluto ng loofah hanggang malambot lang

instruction.zh: 湯滾後放入絲瓜，煮至內側白色部分剛變軟即可，約兩分鐘；喜歡更軟可稍延長，但避免久煮至纖維變老。
instruction.en: Once the soup boils, add loofah and cook until its pale inner flesh just softens, about two minutes. Cook a little longer if desired, but avoid overcooking until fibrous.
instruction.id: Setelah sup mendidih, masukkan gambas dan masak hingga bagian dalamnya yang pucat baru lunak, sekitar dua menit. Masak sedikit lebih lama bila suka, tetapi hindari terlalu lama hingga berserat.
instruction.fil: Sa sandaling kumulo ang sopas, magdagdag ng loofah at lutuin hanggang sa lumambot lamang ang maputla nitong laman, mga dalawang minuto. Magluto ng kaunti pa kung gusto, ngunit iwasang mag-overcooking hanggang mahibla.

steps.imagePrompt: Food photography of fresh green loofah chunks simmering in clear golden tofu soup, just tender and vibrant, no text.

title.en: Finish with black pepper and serve
title.id: Akhiri dengan lada hitam dan sajikan
title.fil: Tapusin sa black pepper at ihain

instruction.zh: 關火前撒少許黑胡椒粉提香，試味後盛入湯碗，趁熱享用或搭配麵條、粥品食用。
instruction.en: Before turning off the heat, sprinkle in a little ground black pepper for aroma. Taste, ladle into bowls, and serve hot alone or with noodles or porridge.
instruction.id: Menjelang api dimatikan, taburkan sedikit lada hitam bubuk untuk aroma. Cicipi, tuang ke mangkuk, dan sajikan hangat sendiri atau dengan mi maupun bubur.
instruction.fil: Bago patayin ang apoy, budburan ng kaunting giniling na itim na paminta para sa aroma. Tikman, sandok sa mga mangkok, at ihain nang mainit nang mag-isa o kasama ng noodles o sinigang.

steps.imagePrompt: Finished loofah and tofu soup with white beech mushrooms in a simple ceramic bowl, clear golden broth and black pepper, no text.

title.zh: 滷高麗菜神招不用大量醬料也能香到不行
title.en: Fragrant Braised Cabbage with Less Soy Sauce
title.id: Kol Rebus Harum dengan Sedikit Kecap
title.fil: Mabangong Nilagang Repolyo na may Mas Kaunting Soy Sauce

description.zh: 先煎出高麗菜焦香，再以薑、香菇、昆布、香菇水和少量醬油小火滷出清甜風味。
description.en: Cabbage is first seared for deep fragrance, then gently braised with ginger, shiitake, kombu, mushroom soaking water, and a small amount of soy sauce.
description.id: Kol dipanggang terlebih dahulu untuk aroma panggang yang kuat, lalu direbus perlahan dengan jahe, shiitake, kombu, air rendaman jamur, dan sedikit kecap asin.
description.fil: Ang repolyo ay unang sinira para sa malalim na halimuyak, pagkatapos ay malumanay na nilaga na may luya, shiitake, kombu, tubig na pambabad ng kabute, at isang maliit na halaga ng toyo.

title.en: Prepare ingredients and reserve mushroom water
title.id: Siapkan bahan dan simpan air jamur
title.fil: Maghanda ng mga sangkap at magreserba ng tubig ng kabute

instruction.zh: 乾香菇以冷水泡發，保留香菇水；香菇與老薑切絲。紅蘿蔔切半月片，高麗菜保留菜心切成三等份後洗淨。
instruction.en: Soak dried shiitake in cold water and reserve the soaking water; shred the shiitake and mature ginger. Cut the carrot into half-moons, and cut the cabbage into three wedges with the core intact before washing.
instruction.id: Rendam shiitake kering dalam air dingin dan sisihkan air rendamannya; iris memanjang shiitake serta jahe tua. Potong wortel berbentuk setengah bulan, lalu potong kol menjadi tiga bagian sambil menjaga bonggolnya tetap utuh sebelum dicuci.
instruction.fil: Ibabad ang pinatuyong shiitake sa malamig na tubig at ireserba ang tubig na nakababad; himayin ang shiitake at mature na luya. Gupitin ang karot sa kalahating buwan, at gupitin ang repolyo sa tatlong wedge na buo ang core bago hugasan.

title.fil: Igisa ang repolyo para sa halimuyak

instruction.zh: 平底鍋倒入食用油，鋪上高麗菜並撒少量鹽，煎至表面深褐、菜葉出水軟化後取出。
instruction.en: Pour cooking oil into a flat pan, lay in the cabbage, and sprinkle with a little salt. Sear until the surface is deep brown and the leaves release moisture and soften, then remove.
instruction.id: Tuang minyak goreng ke wajan datar, letakkan kol, lalu taburi sedikit garam. Panggang hingga permukaannya cokelat tua dan daun mengeluarkan air serta lunak, kemudian angkat.
instruction.fil: Ibuhos ang mantika sa isang patag na kawali, ilagay sa repolyo, at budburan ng kaunting asin. Haluin hanggang ang ibabaw ay malalim na kayumanggi at ang mga dahon ay naglalabas ng kahalumigmigan at lumambot, pagkatapos ay alisin.

title.fil: Iprito ang aromatics pagkatapos ay i-braise

instruction.zh: 原鍋補少量油，煸炒薑絲、香菇絲和紅蘿蔔至微焦。放回高麗菜，加入昆布、香菇水、水和醬油，讓液體約至高麗菜一半高度並將昆布浸在湯中。
instruction.en: Add a little more oil to the same pan and fry ginger, shiitake, and carrot until lightly browned. Return the cabbage, add kombu, mushroom soaking water, water, and soy sauce, bringing the liquid to about halfway up the cabbage and submerging the kombu.
instruction.id: Tambahkan sedikit minyak lagi ke wajan yang sama dan tumis jahe, shiitake, serta wortel hingga sedikit kecokelatan. Masukkan kembali kol, tambahkan kombu, air rendaman jamur, air, dan kecap asin hingga cairan mencapai kira-kira setengah tinggi kol dan kombu terendam.
instruction.fil: Magdagdag ng kaunting mantika sa parehong kawali at iprito ang luya, shiitake, at karot hanggang sa bahagyang kayumanggi. Ibalik ang repolyo, magdagdag ng kombu, mushroom soaking water, tubig, at toyo, dinadala ang likido sa halos kalahati ng repolyo at ilubog ang kombu.

title.fil: Malumanay na igisa sa loob ng labinlimang minuto

instruction.zh: 蓋鍋煮滾後轉小火滷十五分鐘。開蓋夾出昆布，即可連同清甜湯汁盛盤。
instruction.en: Cover and bring to a boil, then reduce to low heat and braise for fifteen minutes. Uncover, remove the kombu, and plate the cabbage with its lightly sweet broth.
instruction.id: Tutup panci dan didihkan, lalu kecilkan api dan rebus perlahan selama lima belas menit. Buka tutupnya, angkat kombu, lalu sajikan kol bersama kuahnya yang manis ringan.
instruction.fil: Takpan at pakuluan, pagkatapos ay bawasan sa mahinang apoy at pakuluan ng labinlimang minuto. Alisan ng takip, alisin ang kombu, at lagyan ng plato ang repolyo ng medyo matamis na sabaw nito.

description.zh: 將五穀飯與茄子、白花椰菜、紅蘿蔔、黃甜椒和蘆筍分批炒香，加入紫菜、白芝麻與鹽完成的全素能量飯。
description.en: Multigrain rice is stir-fried with eggplant, cauliflower, carrot, yellow bell pepper, and asparagus in stages, then finished with nori, white sesame, and salt.
description.id: Nasi multibijian ditumis bertahap bersama terong, kembang kol, wortel, paprika kuning, dan asparagus, lalu diselesaikan dengan nori, wijen putih, serta garam.
description.fil: Ang multigrain rice ay pinirito na may talong, cauliflower, carrot, yellow bell pepper, at asparagus nang sunud-sunod, pagkatapos ay tinatapos sa nori, white sesame, at asin.

instruction.zh: 將茄子、黃甜椒、紅蘿蔔、白花椰菜和蘆筍全部切成小丁，讓它們受熱均勻；老薑切末，紫菜捏碎備用。
instruction.en: Cut eggplant, yellow bell pepper, carrot, cauliflower, and asparagus into small even pieces for even cooking. Mince the mature ginger and crumble the nori for later.
instruction.id: Potong terong, paprika kuning, wortel, kembang kol, dan asparagus menjadi dadu kecil yang seragam agar matang merata. Cincang jahe tua dan remukkan nori untuk digunakan kemudian.
instruction.fil: Gupitin ang talong, yellow bell pepper, carrot, cauliflower, at asparagus sa maliliit na pantay na piraso para sa pantay na pagluluto. Hiwain ang mature na luya at durugin ang nori para sa ibang pagkakataon.

title.en: Fry ginger and firm vegetables first
title.id: Tumis jahe dan sayur keras terlebih dahulu
title.fil: Magprito muna ng luya at matigas na gulay

instruction.zh: 炒鍋倒入食用油，先煸炒薑末至香氣釋出；加入紅蘿蔔和白花椰菜，炒至表面微黃、帶有煸香。
instruction.en: Heat cooking oil in a wok and fry the minced ginger until fragrant. Add carrot and cauliflower, then stir-fry until their surfaces are lightly golden and aromatic.
instruction.id: Panaskan minyak goreng dalam wajan dan tumis jahe cincang hingga harum. Masukkan wortel serta kembang kol, lalu tumis hingga permukaannya sedikit keemasan dan harum.
instruction.fil: Mag-init ng mantika sa kawali at iprito ang tinadtad na luya hanggang mabango. Magdagdag ng carrot at cauliflower, pagkatapos ay iprito hanggang sa maging bahagyang ginto at mabango ang mga ibabaw nito.

title.fil: Palambutin ang natitirang mga gulay at nori

instruction.zh: 加入茄子、黃甜椒和蘆筍，持續翻炒至茄子變軟、蔬菜熟透。放入捏碎紫菜拌炒，讓海苔香氣融入薑油與蔬菜。
instruction.en: Add eggplant, yellow bell pepper, and asparagus, continuing to stir-fry until the eggplant softens and the vegetables are cooked. Add crumbled nori and toss so its sea aroma combines with the ginger oil and vegetables.
instruction.id: Masukkan terong, paprika kuning, dan asparagus, lalu terus tumis hingga terong lunak serta sayuran matang. Tambahkan nori yang diremukkan dan aduk agar aroma lautnya menyatu dengan minyak jahe serta sayuran.
instruction.fil: Magdagdag ng talong, dilaw na kampanilya paminta, at asparagus, patuloy na magprito hanggang sa lumambot ang talong at maluto ang mga gulay. Magdagdag ng crumbled nori at ihagis para ang sea aroma nito ay magsama sa ginger oil at mga gulay.

title.en: Fold in multigrain rice and season
title.fil: I-fold sa multigrain rice at timplahan

instruction.zh: 加入煮好的五穀飯拌炒至均勻受熱，撒入白芝麻和鹽，炒香後立即盛盤。
instruction.en: Add cooked multigrain rice and stir-fry until evenly heated. Sprinkle in white sesame seeds and salt, toss until fragrant, and plate immediately.
instruction.id: Masukkan nasi multibijian matang dan tumis hingga panas merata. Taburkan biji wijen putih serta garam, aduk hingga harum, lalu segera sajikan.
instruction.fil: Magdagdag ng nilutong multigrain rice at haluin hanggang sa pantay na init. Budburan ng puting linga at asin, haluin hanggang mabango, at lagyan agad ng plato.

title.id: Hidangan Tinggi Protein untuk Defisit Lemak

description.zh: 以汆燙豆包搭配黃甜椒、紅蘿蔔、番茄與九層塔，拌入芥末烏醋醬汁的清爽高蛋白全素涼拌菜。
description.en: A refreshing high-protein vegan salad of blanched tofu skin, yellow bell pepper, carrot, tomato, and Thai basil, tossed in a wasabi-black-vinegar dressing.
description.id: Salad vegan tinggi protein yang menyegarkan dari kulit tahu rebus, paprika kuning, wortel, tomat, dan kemangi Thailand, diaduk dengan saus wasabi cuka hitam.
description.fil: Isang nakakapreskong high-protein vegan salad ng blanched tofu skin, yellow bell pepper, carrot, tomato, at Thai basil, na inihagis sa wasabi-black-vinegar dressing.

title.zh: 切成一致的蔬菜與豆包條
title.en: Cut tofu skin and vegetables into strips
title.id: Potong kulit tahu dan sayuran memanjang
title.fil: Gupitin ang balat ng tofu at mga gulay

instruction.zh: 豆包切成粗條；黃甜椒、紅蘿蔔與九層塔切絲，番茄切小丁，大辣椒切末，讓食材大小容易一起拌勻。
instruction.en: Cut tofu skin into thick strips. Julienne yellow bell pepper, carrot, and Thai basil; dice the tomato and mince the large chili so the ingredients can be tossed evenly.
instruction.id: Potong kulit tahu memanjang agak tebal. Iris tipis paprika kuning, wortel, dan kemangi Thailand; potong tomat dadu kecil dan cincang cabai besar agar bahan mudah diaduk rata.
instruction.fil: Gupitin ang balat ng tofu sa makapal na piraso. Julienne yellow bell pepper, carrot, at Thai basil; hiwain ang kamatis at hiwain ang malalaking sili para pantay-pantay ang paghagis ng mga sangkap.

steps.imagePrompt: Overhead food photography of tofu skin strips, julienned yellow pepper and carrot, Thai basil, diced tomato, and minced chili on a prep board, no text.

title.en: Blanch and chill the tofu skin
title.id: Rebus sebentar dan dinginkan kulit tahu
title.fil: Blanch at palamigin ang balat ng tofu

instruction.zh: 煮一鍋滾水加少許鹽，放入豆包汆燙約30至40秒後撈起；想馬上吃冰涼口感時，將豆包放入冰水冰鎮。
instruction.en: Bring water with a little salt to a boil and blanch the tofu skin for about 30 to 40 seconds, then remove it. For an immediately chilled texture, transfer the tofu skin to ice water.
instruction.id: Didihkan air dengan sedikit garam dan rebus kulit tahu sekitar 30 hingga 40 detik, lalu angkat. Untuk tekstur dingin, pindahkan kulit tahu ke air es.
instruction.fil: Pakuluan ang tubig na may kaunting asin at pakuluan ang balat ng tofu ng mga 30 hanggang 40 segundo, pagkatapos ay alisin ito. Para sa isang agad na pinalamig na texture, ilipat ang balat ng tofu sa tubig ng yelo.

steps.imagePrompt: Food photography of tofu skin strips being lifted from boiling water toward a bowl of ice water, no text.

title.fil: Pagsamahin ang mga sangkap ng salad

instruction.zh: 將汆燙後瀝乾的豆包與黃甜椒、紅蘿蔔、九層塔、番茄丁和辣椒末全部放入大碗。
instruction.en: Place the drained blanched tofu skin, yellow bell pepper, carrot, Thai basil, diced tomato, and minced chili together in a large bowl.
instruction.id: Masukkan kulit tahu rebus yang telah ditiriskan, paprika kuning, wortel, kemangi Thailand, tomat dadu, dan cabai cincang ke dalam mangkuk besar.
instruction.fil: Ilagay ang pinatuyo na blanched tofu skin, yellow bell pepper, carrot, Thai basil, diced tomato, at tinadtad na sili sa isang malaking mangkok.

steps.imagePrompt: Food photography of colorful tofu skin salad ingredients gathered in a large mixing bowl before dressing, no text.

title.fil: Timplahan ng itim na suka ng wasabi

instruction.zh: 加入醬油、烏醋、香油和糖；喜歡微嗆清爽感可加入少許芥末，不吃辣則省略。
instruction.en: Add soy sauce, black vinegar, sesame oil, and sugar. Add a little wasabi for a refreshing pungent note if desired, or omit it if you do not eat spicy foods.
instruction.id: Tambahkan kecap asin, cuka hitam, minyak wijen, dan gula. Tambahkan sedikit wasabi bila ingin rasa segar yang menyengat, atau hilangkan jika tidak makan pedas.
instruction.fil: Magdagdag ng toyo, itim na suka, sesame oil, at asukal. Magdagdag ng kaunting wasabi para sa isang nakakapreskong masangsang na tala kung ninanais, o tanggalin ito kung hindi ka kumakain ng mga maanghang na pagkain.

steps.imagePrompt: Close-up food photography of dark vinegar-soy dressing with sesame oil and a small dab of wasabi being mixed in a bowl, no text.

title.en: Toss thoroughly and chill before serving
title.id: Aduk rata lalu dinginkan sebelum disajikan
title.fil: Ihagis nang maigi at palamigin bago ihain

instruction.zh: 將所有食材與醬汁充分拌勻，讓豆包和蔬菜均勻入味；可立刻享用，或冷藏後再吃以獲得更冰涼開胃的口感。
instruction.en: Toss all ingredients thoroughly with the dressing so the tofu skin and vegetables are evenly seasoned. Serve immediately, or refrigerate before eating for a colder, more appetizing texture.
instruction.id: Aduk semua bahan hingga rata dengan saus agar kulit tahu dan sayuran berbumbu merata. Sajikan segera, atau dinginkan terlebih dahulu untuk tekstur yang lebih dingin dan menggugah selera.
instruction.fil: Ihagis ang lahat ng sangkap nang lubusan sa dressing upang ang balat ng tofu at mga gulay ay pantay na tinimplahan. Ihain kaagad, o palamigin bago kainin para sa isang mas malamig, mas pampagana na texture.

steps.imagePrompt: Finished high-protein tofu skin salad with yellow pepper, carrot, tomato, Thai basil, and glossy dressing in a glass bowl, no text.

description.zh: 以豆包、杏鮑菇和腐皮捲做出植物版雞肉，搭配椰奶薑黃飯與薑蓉、甜醬油、辣椒三款醬料。
description.en: Tofu puffs, king oyster mushrooms, and tofu skin rolls form plant-based chicken, served with coconut turmeric rice and three sauces: ginger, sweet soy, and chilli.
description.id: Tahu puff, jamur king oyster, dan gulungan kulit tahu membentuk ayam nabati, disajikan dengan nasi kunyit santan serta tiga saus: jahe, kecap manis, dan cabai.
description.fil: Ang tofu puff, king oyster mushroom, at tofu skin roll ay bumubuo ng plant-based na manok, na inihahain kasama ng coconut turmeric rice at tatlong sarsa: luya, matamis na toyo, at sili.

name.fil: gata ng niyog para sa marinade
gata ng niyog para sa bigas

instruction.zh: 杏鮑菇切薄片，豆包與腐皮撕成相近大小。與醬油、味醂、胡椒粉和椰漿抓拌均勻，靜置醃約十五分鐘。
instruction.en: Slice king oyster mushrooms thinly and tear tofu puffs and tofu skin into similar-sized pieces. Toss with soy sauce, mirin, ground pepper, and coconut milk, then marinate for about fifteen minutes.
instruction.id: Iris tipis jamur king oyster dan sobek tahu puff serta kulit tahu berukuran serupa. Aduk dengan kecap asin, mirin, lada bubuk, dan santan, lalu marinasi sekitar lima belas menit.
instruction.fil: Hiwain ng manipis ang king oyster mushroom at punitin ang tofu puff at balat ng tofu sa magkaparehong laki. Ihagis ang toyo, mirin, giniling na paminta, at gata ng niyog, pagkatapos ay i-marinate ng humigit-kumulang labinlimang minuto.

instruction.zh: 將兩杯白米加入一點八杯水與零點二杯椰漿，再加入薑黃粉、胡椒粉、香油和鹽拌勻，放入電鍋蒸熟。
instruction.en: Combine two cups of white rice with 1.8 cups water and 0.2 cup coconut milk. Mix in ground turmeric, ground pepper, sesame oil, and salt, then cook in an electric cooker until done.
instruction.id: Campurkan dua cangkir beras putih dengan 1,8 cangkir air dan 0,2 cangkir santan. Aduk kunyit bubuk, lada bubuk, minyak wijen, dan garam, lalu masak dalam penanak listrik hingga matang.
instruction.fil: Pagsamahin ang dalawang tasa ng puting bigas na may 1.8 tasa ng tubig at 0.2 tasa ng gata ng niyog. Paghaluin ang giniling na turmeric, ground pepper, sesame oil, at asin, pagkatapos ay lutuin sa electric cooker hanggang sa maluto.

steps.imagePrompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: 16:9 recipe tutorial step image. title.en: Wrap and pan-fry the plant chicken
title.fil: Balutin at i-pan-fry ang tanim na manok

instruction.zh: 將兩張泡濕米紙疊起，放入醃好的豆包和杏鮑菇捲緊，外層再包腐皮並用醃汁封口。平底鍋加油，以小火慢煎至表面金黃、內餡熟透。
instruction.en: Stack two moistened rice-paper sheets, fill with marinated tofu puffs and king oyster mushrooms, roll tightly, then wrap in tofu skin and seal with marinade. Pan-fry in oil over low heat until the surface is golden and the filling is cooked through.
instruction.id: Tumpuk dua lembar kertas nasi yang dibasahi, isi dengan tahu puff serta jamur king oyster yang dimarinasi, gulung rapat, lalu bungkus dengan kulit tahu dan rekatkan memakai marinade. Panggang dengan minyak di api kecil sampai permukaannya keemasan dan isi matang.
instruction.fil: Isalansan ang dalawang moistened rice-paper sheets, punuin ng marinated tofu puffs at king oyster mushrooms, i-roll nang mahigpit, pagkatapos ay balutin ng tofu skin at selyuhan ng marinade. I-pan-fry sa mantika sa mahinang apoy hanggang sa maging ginintuang ang ibabaw at maluto ang laman.

steps.imagePrompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: 16:9 recipe tutorial step image. Constraints: strictly vegan; rolls remain whole and uncut, no rice, sauce bowls, meat, eggs, dairy, seafood, labels, people, watermark, or logos. No text.

title.fil: Gumawa ng tatlong sarsa at plato

instruction.zh: 薑泥與香菜末用油小火加熱，加胡椒鹽成薑蓉醬。醬油、味醂、香油和胡椒拌成甜醬油；辣椒、蘋果醋、味醂和醬油打碎成辣椒醬。將植物雞切片，配薑黃飯和三款醬上桌。
instruction.en: Gently heat ginger paste and chopped cilantro in oil with pepper salt for ginger sauce. Mix soy sauce, mirin, sesame oil, and pepper for sweet soy sauce; blend chilli, apple cider vinegar, mirin, and soy sauce for chilli sauce. Slice the plant chicken and serve with turmeric rice and all three sauces.
instruction.id: Panaskan perlahan pasta jahe dan daun ketumbar cincang dalam minyak bersama garam lada untuk saus jahe. Campurkan kecap asin, mirin, minyak wijen, dan lada untuk saus kecap manis; haluskan cabai, cuka apel, mirin, serta kecap asin untuk saus cabai. Iris ayam nabati dan sajikan bersama nasi kunyit serta ketiga saus.
instruction.fil: Dahan-dahang painitin ang ginger paste at tinadtad na cilantro sa mantika na may pepper salt para sa ginger sauce. Paghaluin ang toyo, mirin, sesame oil, at paminta para sa matamis na toyo; timpla ng sili, apple cider vinegar, mirin, at toyo para sa chilli sauce. Hiwain ang tanim na manok at ihain kasama ng turmeric rice at lahat ng tatlong sarsa.

description.zh: 以長糯米、紫米與紅藻苔芝麻醬蒸成香Q米糕，切塊後刷醬油膏並沾花生粉、香菜的全素夜市風點心。
description.en: A vegan night-market-style rice cake made by steaming long-grain glutinous rice and purple rice with a red-algae sesame sauce, then brushing with soy sauce paste and coating with peanut powder and cilantro.
description.id: Kue beras gaya jajanan malam vegan yang dibuat dengan mengukus beras ketan panjang dan beras ungu bersama saus alga merah wijen, lalu dioles pasta kecap asin dan dilapisi bubuk kacang serta daun ketumbar.
description.fil: Isang vegan night-market-style rice cake na ginawa sa pamamagitan ng steaming long-grain glutinous rice at purple rice na may red-algae sesame sauce, pagkatapos ay sinisipilyo ng soy sauce paste at pinahiran ng peanut powder at cilantro.

title.en: Soak and combine the two rices
title.id: Rendam dan campurkan dua jenis beras
title.fil: Ibabad at pagsamahin ang dalawang kanin

instruction.zh: 將1杯長糯米和半杯紫米分別洗淨泡水至少4小時，天熱可冷藏浸泡；瀝乾後混合備用。
instruction.en: Wash and soak 1 cup long-grain glutinous rice and 1/2 cup purple rice separately for at least 4 hours; refrigerate while soaking in hot weather. Drain and combine them.
instruction.id: Cuci dan rendam 1 cangkir beras ketan panjang serta 1/2 cangkir beras ungu secara terpisah setidaknya 4 jam; simpan di lemari es saat cuaca panas. Tiriskan lalu campurkan.
instruction.fil: Hugasan at ibabad ang 1 tasang long-grain glutinous rice at 1/2 cup purple rice nang hiwalay nang hindi bababa sa 4 na oras; palamigin habang nakababad sa mainit na panahon. Alisan ng tubig at pagsamahin ang mga ito.

steps.imagePrompt: Overhead food photography of soaked white glutinous rice and purple rice being combined in a bowl, no text.

title.en: Blend the red algae sesame sauce
title.fil: Haluin ang red algae sesame sauce

instruction.zh: 將紅藻苔、芝麻粉和糯米粉放入調理機，加入香油、胡椒鹽、胡椒粉與水，攪打成均勻細緻的醬汁。
instruction.en: Put red algae, sesame powder, and glutinous rice flour in a blender. Add sesame oil, seasoned pepper salt, ground pepper, and water, then blend into a smooth, even sauce.
instruction.id: Masukkan alga merah, bubuk wijen, dan tepung ketan ke blender. Tambahkan minyak wijen, garam lada berbumbu, lada bubuk, dan air, lalu haluskan menjadi saus yang rata serta lembut.
instruction.fil: Ilagay ang red algae, sesame powder, at glutinous rice flour sa isang blender. Magdagdag ng sesame oil, seasoned pepper asin, ground pepper, at tubig, pagkatapos ay timpla sa isang makinis, pantay na sarsa.

steps.imagePrompt: Food photography of a deep purple-red sesame algae sauce blending smooth in a blender, no text.

title.zh: 拌勻米粒並入抹油容器
title.en: Coat rice and fill an oiled container
title.id: Lumuri beras dan masukkan ke wadah berminyak
title.fil: Pahiran ng bigas at punuin ang isang lalagyan na may langis

instruction.zh: 將打好的醬汁倒入瀝乾的兩色米中，充分攪拌讓每粒米都吸收醬汁；耐熱容器抹少許油後，倒入米料並整平。
instruction.en: Pour the blended sauce over the drained mixed rices and stir thoroughly so every grain absorbs it. Lightly oil a heat-safe container, then add the rice mixture and level it.
instruction.id: Tuang saus halus ke dalam campuran beras yang sudah ditiriskan dan aduk rata agar setiap butir menyerap saus. Olesi tipis wadah tahan panas, lalu masukkan campuran beras dan ratakan.
instruction.fil: Ibuhos ang pinaghalo na sarsa sa pinatuyo na pinaghalong kanin at haluing maigi upang masipsip ito ng bawat butil. Bahagyang langisan ang isang lalagyan na ligtas sa init, pagkatapos ay idagdag ang pinaghalong bigas at i-level ito.

steps.imagePrompt: Food photography of purple rice and glutinous rice coated in savory sauce being packed into a lightly oiled heat-safe glass container, no text.

title.en: Steam with two cups of water and rest
title.id: Kukus dengan dua cangkir air lalu diamkan
title.fil: Singaw na may dalawang tasa ng tubig at magpahinga

instruction.zh: 電鍋內放隔熱架和容器，外鍋加入2杯水蒸至跳起；跳起後再燜約10分鐘，取出後讓米糕冷卻並逐漸定型。
instruction.en: Place a trivet and the container in an electric cooker, add 2 cups water to the outer pot, and steam until it switches off. Rest for about 10 more minutes, then remove and let the rice cake cool and firm.
instruction.id: Letakkan tatakan dan wadah di rice cooker listrik, tambahkan 2 cangkir air ke panci luar, lalu kukus hingga alat mati. Diamkan sekitar 10 menit lagi, kemudian keluarkan dan biarkan kue beras mendingin serta mengeras.
instruction.fil: Ilagay ang trivet at ang lalagyan sa isang electric cooker, magdagdag ng 2 tasa ng tubig sa panlabas na palayok, at pasingawan hanggang sa ito ay patayin. Magpahinga ng humigit-kumulang 10 minuto, pagkatapos ay alisin at hayaang lumamig at matigas ang rice cake.

steps.imagePrompt: Food photography of a purple steamed rice cake in a heat-safe container inside an electric cooker with rising steam, no text.

instruction.zh: 米糕表面凝結後，以抹油小刀沿邊脫模，切成三角或喜歡的形狀；刷醬油膏，可加辣椒醬，再沾花生粉並撒香菜享用。
instruction.en: Once the surface has set, run an oiled knife around the edge to unmold and cut into triangles or preferred shapes. Brush with soy sauce paste, add chili sauce if desired, coat with peanut powder, and finish with cilantro.
instruction.id: Setelah permukaan mengeras, gunakan pisau berminyak di sekeliling tepi untuk mengeluarkan kue lalu potong menjadi segitiga atau bentuk pilihan. Oles pasta kecap asin, tambahkan saus cabai bila diinginkan, lapisi bubuk kacang, dan akhiri dengan daun ketumbar.
instruction.fil: Kapag naayos na ang ibabaw, magpatakbo ng may langis na kutsilyo sa gilid upang alisin ang amag at gupitin sa mga tatsulok o gustong hugis. Brush na may soy sauce paste, magdagdag ng chili sauce kung ninanais, balutin ng peanut powder, at tapusin sa cilantro.

steps.imagePrompt: Finished vegan purple rice blood cake triangles brushed with glossy sauce, coated in peanut powder, and topped with cilantro, no text.

description.zh: 以豆腐、百頁豆腐、金針菇、馬蹄和天貝做成扎實內餡，以千張包捲後半煎炸至金黃酥脆。
description.en: A substantial filling of tofu, tofu sheets, enoki, water chestnuts, and tempeh is wrapped in tofu skin and shallow-fried until golden and crisp.
description.id: Isian padat dari tahu, tofu lembaran, enoki, bengkuang air, dan tempeh dibungkus kulit tahu lalu digoreng dangkal hingga keemasan serta renyah.
description.fil: Ang isang malaking palaman ng tofu, tofu sheet, enoki, water chestnut, at tempe ay nakabalot sa balat ng tofu at pinirito hanggang ginto at malutong.

name.fil: mga sheet ng balat ng tofu

title.fil: Ihanda ang mga sangkap ng pagpuno

instruction.zh: 板豆腐先吸乾水分後搗碎；百頁豆腐切小塊。將金針菇、紅蘿蔔、馬蹄、芹菜和香菜全部切碎，天貝切成長條。
instruction.en: Press moisture from firm tofu and crumble it; cut tofu sheets into small pieces. Finely chop enoki, carrot, water chestnuts, celery, and cilantro, then cut tempeh into long strips.
instruction.id: Keringkan tahu padat lalu hancurkan; potong tofu lembaran kecil-kecil. Cincang enoki, wortel, bengkuang air, seledri, dan daun ketumbar, kemudian potong tempeh memanjang.
instruction.fil: Pindutin ang moisture mula sa firm tofu at durugin ito; gupitin ang tofu sheet sa maliliit na piraso. I-chop ang enoki, carrot, water chestnut, celery, at cilantro, pagkatapos ay gupitin ang tempe sa mahabang piraso.

instruction.zh: 平底鍋煎天貝至每面金黃酥脆，撒胡椒鹽後盛起。原鍋炒豆腐和金針菇至水分收乾，再加入百頁豆腐與紅蘿蔔炒至金黃；以醬油、胡椒、香油、糖和鹽調味，拌入芹菜、馬蹄、香菜與玉米粉。
instruction.en: Pan-fry tempeh until golden and crisp on every side, season with pepper salt, and set aside. In the same pan cook tofu and enoki until dry, add tofu sheets and carrot until golden, season with soy sauce, pepper, sesame oil, sugar, and salt, then mix in celery, water chestnuts, cilantro, and cornstarch.
instruction.id: Panggang tempeh sampai keemasan serta renyah di setiap sisi, bumbui garam lada, lalu sisihkan. Di wajan yang sama masak tahu dan enoki sampai kering, tambahkan tofu lembaran serta wortel hingga keemasan, bumbui kecap asin, lada, minyak wijen, gula, serta garam, lalu campurkan seledri, bengkuang air, daun ketumbar, dan tepung maizena.
instruction.fil: I-pan-fry ang tempe hanggang sa maging ginintuang at malutong sa bawat panig, timplahan ng asin paminta, at itabi. Sa parehong kawali lutuin ang tofu at enoki hanggang matuyo, ilagay ang tofu sheet at carrot hanggang sa ginintuang, timplahan ng toyo, paminta, sesame oil, asukal, at asin, pagkatapos ay ihalo sa celery, water chestnuts, cilantro, at cornstarch.

title.fil: Balutin ang mga rolyo ng manok

instruction.zh: 麵粉加水和少量鹽調成可黏合的麵粉糊。千張抹上麵粉糊，鋪餡料並在中間放兩條天貝，兩側各預留約十公分；捲緊後封口，將兩端扭緊回收。
instruction.en: Mix flour with water and a little salt into a sticky paste. Brush tofu skin with paste, spread on filling, and place two tempeh strips in the centre, leaving about ten centimetres at both sides; roll tightly, seal, and twist the ends inward.
instruction.id: Campurkan tepung, air, dan sedikit garam menjadi pasta perekat. Oleskan pada kulit tahu, ratakan isian, lalu taruh dua strip tempeh di tengah dan sisakan sekitar sepuluh sentimeter di kedua sisi; gulung rapat, rekatkan, lalu putar ujungnya ke dalam.
instruction.fil: Paghaluin ang harina na may tubig at kaunting asin sa isang malagkit na paste. I-brush ang balat ng tofu na may paste, ikalat sa pagpuno, at ilagay ang dalawang piraso ng tempeh sa gitna, mag-iwan ng halos sampung sentimetro sa magkabilang gilid; gumulong nang mahigpit, i-seal, at i-twist ang mga dulo papasok.

title.fil: Mababaw na iprito hanggang sa ginto

instruction.zh: 平底鍋倒入約半鍋高度的油，加熱至約一百四十至一百五十度。放入雞捲以中低溫慢慢半煎炸，至千張外皮金黃酥脆後撈出切片。
instruction.en: Fill a flat pan with oil to about halfway and heat to roughly 140–150°C. Shallow-fry the rolls slowly over medium-low heat until the tofu-skin exterior is golden and crisp, then lift out and slice.
instruction.id: Isi wajan datar dengan minyak hingga kira-kira setengah tinggi dan panaskan sekitar 140–150°C. Goreng dangkal gulungan perlahan dengan api sedang-kecil sampai kulit tahu berwarna keemasan serta renyah, lalu angkat dan iris.
instruction.fil: Punan ang isang patag na kawali ng mantika sa halos kalahati at init sa humigit-kumulang 140–150°C. Iprito ang mga rolyo nang dahan-dahan sa katamtamang apoy hanggang sa maging ginintuang at malutong ang panlabas na balat ng tofu, pagkatapos ay iangat at hiwain.

title.zh: 全素海鮮什錦炒麵，簡單快炒出餐廳級美味
title.en: One-Pan Vegan Seafood-Style Mixed Fried Noodles
title.id: Mi Goreng Campur Gaya Seafood Vegan Satu Wajan
title.fil: One-Pan Vegan Seafood-Style Mixed Fried Noodles

description.zh: 以香菇、杏鮑菇、豆乾片和多種蔬菜模擬海鮮外觀口感，與油麵一鍋快炒的全素什錦炒麵。
description.en: A one-pan vegan seafood-style mixed fried noodle dish using mushrooms, king oyster mushrooms, tofu sheets, and vegetables to mimic seafood looks and textures.
description.id: Mi goreng campur gaya seafood vegan satu wajan yang memakai jamur, jamur tiram raja, lembaran tahu, dan sayuran untuk meniru tampilan serta tekstur seafood.
description.fil: Isang one-pan vegan seafood-style mixed fried noodle dish gamit ang mushroom, king oyster mushroom, tofu sheet, at gulay para gayahin ang hitsura at texture ng seafood.

title.zh: 切配海鮮感蔬菜與菇類
title.id: Siapkan sayuran dan jamur gaya seafood
title.fil: Maghanda ng mga gulay at seafood-style mushroom

instruction.zh: 香菇切片，木耳和紅蘿蔔切絲，高麗菜切寬絲，芹菜去葉切段；杏鮑菇切片後挖去中央，做成圈狀口感。
instruction.en: Slice the shiitake mushrooms; julienne the wood ear mushrooms and carrot; cut cabbage into wide shreds; remove celery leaves and cut stems into segments. Slice king oyster mushrooms and remove their centers to make ring-like pieces.
instruction.id: Iris jamur shiitake; iris tipis jamur kuping dan wortel; potong kol menjadi irisan lebar; buang daun seledri dan potong batangnya. Iris jamur tiram raja lalu keluarkan bagian tengahnya agar berbentuk cincin.
instruction.fil: Hiwain ang shiitake mushroom; julienne ang wood ear mushroom at carrot; gupitin ang repolyo sa malawak na hiwa; alisin ang mga dahon ng kintsay at gupitin ang mga tangkay sa mga segment. Hiwain ang mga king oyster mushroom at tanggalin ang kanilang mga sentro upang makagawa ng mga pirasong parang singsing.

steps.imagePrompt: Overhead food photography of sliced shiitake, shredded vegetables, celery stems, and ring-shaped king oyster mushrooms prepared for vegan seafood-style noodles, no text.

title.en: Cut tofu sheets into squid-style strips
title.fil: Gupitin ang tofu sheet sa mga guhit na istilong pusit

instruction.zh: 豆乾片切成較寬的長條，保留些許厚度，讓快炒後有類似魷魚條的咀嚼感；杏鮑菇挖出的中心也保留使用。
instruction.en: Cut tofu sheets into fairly wide strips, keeping some thickness so they develop a squid-strip-like chew when stir-fried. Reserve the removed king oyster mushroom centers as well.
instruction.id: Potong lembaran tahu menjadi potongan memanjang cukup lebar dan agak tebal agar setelah ditumis terasa kenyal seperti potongan cumi. Simpan juga bagian tengah jamur tiram raja yang dikeluarkan.
instruction.fil: Gupitin ang tofu sheet sa medyo malalapad na piraso, pinapanatili ang kaunting kapal upang magkaroon sila ng parang pusit na ngumunguya kapag pinirito. Ireserba rin ang mga natanggal na king oyster mushroom centers.

steps.imagePrompt: Food photography of wide tofu sheet strips and king oyster mushroom centers arranged as vegan seafood-style components, no text.

title.id: Tumis shiitake dan bagian tengah jamur

instruction.zh: 炒鍋倒入少許油，放入鮮香菇與杏鮑菇中心煸炒至金黃香氣出來，作為炒麵的鮮味基底。
instruction.en: Add a little oil to a wok and sauté the fresh shiitake and king oyster mushroom centers until golden and fragrant to build the savory base for the noodles.
instruction.id: Tuang sedikit minyak ke wajan dan tumis shiitake segar serta bagian tengah jamur tiram raja hingga keemasan dan harum sebagai dasar gurih mi.
instruction.fil: Magdagdag ng kaunting mantika sa kawali at igisa ang sariwang shiitake at king oyster mushroom centers hanggang maging ginintuang at mabango upang mabuo ang malasang base para sa noodles.

steps.imagePrompt: Close-up food photography of shiitake mushrooms and king oyster mushroom centers browning in a wok with a little oil, no text.

title.zh: 分批炒軟蔬菜與素海鮮配料
title.en: Stir-fry vegetables and vegan seafood components
title.id: Tumis sayuran dan komponen seafood vegan
title.fil: Magprito ng mga gulay at vegan na seafood na bahagi

instruction.zh: 先加入紅蘿蔔絲與豆乾片炒至紅蘿蔔變軟，再加入高麗菜、木耳與杏鮑菇圈翻炒至蔬菜軟化但仍保有口感。
instruction.en: First add carrot shreds and tofu sheet strips and stir-fry until the carrot softens. Then add cabbage, wood ear mushrooms, and king oyster mushroom rings, tossing until tender while retaining texture.
instruction.id: Masukkan terlebih dahulu wortel serut dan potongan lembaran tahu, lalu tumis hingga wortel lunak. Tambahkan kol, jamur kuping, dan cincin jamur tiram raja, lalu aduk hingga lunak tetapi tetap bertekstur.
instruction.fil: Ilagay muna ang carrot shreds at tofu sheet strips at iprito hanggang lumambot ang carrot. Pagkatapos ay idagdag ang repolyo, wood ear mushroom, at king oyster mushroom rings, ihagis hanggang malambot habang pinapanatili ang texture.

steps.imagePrompt: Food photography of colorful vegetables, tofu sheet strips, and king oyster mushroom rings stir-frying together in a wok, no text.

title.en: Add oil noodles and stir-fry until absorbed
title.id: Masukkan mi minyak dan tumis hingga meresap
title.fil: Lagyan ng oil noodles at igisa hanggang maabsorb

instruction.zh: 加入油麵與芹菜段翻炒，視鍋中乾濕度加入少量水，持續拌炒至麵條均勻吸附鍋中香氣並熱透後盛盤。
instruction.en: Add the oil noodles and celery segments and stir-fry. Add a small amount of water if the pan is dry, then keep tossing until the noodles evenly absorb the wok flavors and are heated through before plating.
instruction.id: Masukkan mi minyak dan potongan seledri lalu tumis. Tambahkan sedikit air jika wajan kering, kemudian terus aduk hingga mi menyerap rasa dari wajan secara merata dan panas sebelum disajikan.
instruction.fil: Idagdag ang oil noodles at celery segment at ihalo. Magdagdag ng kaunting tubig kung tuyo ang kawali, pagkatapos ay patuloy na ihagis hanggang sa pantay-pantay na masipsip ng noodles ang lasa ng wok at uminit bago lagyan ng plato.

steps.imagePrompt: Finished one-pan vegan seafood-style mixed fried noodles with tofu strips, mushroom rings, vegetables, and celery in a deep plate, no text.

title.zh: 純素羹湯口感一模一樣
title.id: Sup Sirip Hiu Gaya Taiwan Vegan

description.zh: 乾香菇、乾絲與紅蘿蔔煸香後，加入粉絲、木耳和金針菇煮成濃郁滑順的全素羹湯。
description.en: Dried shiitake, shredded tofu, and carrot are sautéed before glass noodles, wood ear, and enoki become a rich, silky vegan Taiwanese soup.
description.id: Shiitake kering, tahu iris, dan wortel ditumis sebelum soun, jamur kuping, dan enoki menjadi sup Taiwan vegan yang kaya serta lembut.
description.fil: Ang pinatuyong shiitake, ginutay-gutay na tofu, at karot ay iginisa bago maging mayaman, malasutla na vegan Taiwanese na sopas ang mga glass noodles, wood ear, at enoki.

title.fil: Ibabad at ihanda ang mga sangkap

instruction.zh: 乾香菇和粉絲泡水，保留香菇水；香菇擠乾後與木耳、紅蘿蔔切絲，香菜切末。
instruction.en: Soak dried shiitake and glass noodles, reserving the shiitake soaking water. Squeeze the shiitake dry, then shred it with wood ear and carrot; chop the cilantro.
instruction.id: Rendam shiitake kering dan soun, sisihkan air rendaman shiitake. Peras shiitake hingga kering, lalu iris bersama jamur kuping dan wortel; cincang daun ketumbar.
instruction.fil: Ibabad ang pinatuyong shiitake at glass noodles, ireserba ang shiitake soaking water. Pigain ang shiitake na tuyo, pagkatapos ay gutayin ito ng kahoy na tainga at karot; i-chop ang cilantro.

instruction.zh: 湯鍋倒油，先煸香香菇、紅蘿蔔和乾絲。加入香菇水、水、木耳、金針菇與粉絲，蓋鍋煮滾。
instruction.en: Heat oil in a soup pot and sauté shiitake, carrot, and shredded tofu until fragrant. Add shiitake soaking water, water, wood ear, enoki, and glass noodles, then cover and bring to a boil.
instruction.id: Panaskan minyak dalam panci sup dan tumis shiitake, wortel, serta tahu iris hingga harum. Tambahkan air rendaman shiitake, air, jamur kuping, enoki, dan soun, lalu tutup serta didihkan.
instruction.fil: Mag-init ng mantika sa isang sopas pot at igisa ang shiitake, carrot, at tinadtad na tofu hanggang mabango. Magdagdag ng shiitake soaking water, tubig, wood ear, enoki, at glass noodles, pagkatapos ay takpan at pakuluan.

instruction.zh: 蓮藕粉與勾芡用水調勻，湯滾後慢慢倒入並持續攪拌至滑順濃稠。加入醬油、醬油膏、胡椒、香油、烏醋、香菜與少量鹽，拌勻盛碗。
instruction.en: Mix lotus root starch with slurry water; once the soup boils, pour it in slowly while stirring until silky and thick. Add soy sauce, soy paste, pepper, sesame oil, black vinegar, cilantro, and a little salt, then serve.
instruction.id: Campurkan tepung akar teratai dengan air larutan; setelah sup mendidih, tuang perlahan sambil diaduk hingga lembut serta kental. Tambahkan kecap asin, pasta kecap, lada, minyak wijen, cuka hitam, daun ketumbar, dan sedikit garam, lalu sajikan.
instruction.fil: Paghaluin ang lotus root starch na may slurry na tubig; kapag kumulo na ang sabaw, dahan-dahang ibuhos habang hinahalo hanggang malasutla at malapot. Lagyan ng toyo, toyo, paminta, sesame oil, black vinegar, cilantro, at kaunting asin, pagkatapos ay ihain.

description.zh: 以豆捲模擬牛肉、白木耳模擬牛筋，搭配番茄和辛香中藥材熬成的全素番茄紅燒牛肉麵。
description.en: A vegan tomato braised beef noodle soup using tofu rolls to mimic beef and white wood ear mushrooms to mimic tendon, simmered with tomatoes and aromatic spices.
description.id: Mi kuah daging sapi vegan braise tomat yang memakai gulungan tahu untuk meniru daging sapi dan jamur kuping putih untuk meniru urat, dididihkan bersama tomat serta rempah aromatik.
description.fil: Isang vegan tomato braised beef noodle soup gamit ang tofu rolls para gayahin ang beef at white wood ear mushroom para gayahin ang tendon, na niluluto ng mga kamatis at mabangong pampalasa.

title.en: Tear tofu rolls and white wood ear
title.id: Sobek gulungan tahu dan jamur kuping putih
title.fil: Mapunit ang tofu roll at puting kahoy na tainga

instruction.zh: 豆捲用手撕成大小不規則的塊狀，保留纖維紋理；新鮮白木耳也撕成與豆捲相近的塊狀。
instruction.en: Tear tofu rolls by hand into irregular pieces while preserving their fibrous texture. Tear fresh white wood ear mushrooms into pieces similar in size to the tofu rolls.
instruction.id: Sobek gulungan tahu dengan tangan menjadi potongan tidak beraturan sambil mempertahankan tekstur berseratnya. Sobek jamur kuping putih segar menjadi ukuran yang mirip dengan gulungan tahu.
instruction.fil: Gupitin ang tofu roll sa pamamagitan ng kamay sa mga hindi regular na piraso habang pinapanatili ang kanilang fibrous texture. Hatiin ang sariwang puting kahoy na kabute sa tainga sa mga piraso na katulad ng laki ng tofu roll.

steps.imagePrompt: Overhead food photography of irregular hand-torn tofu rolls and white wood ear mushrooms prepared as vegan beef and tendon, no text.

title.fil: Gupitin ang mga kamatis, mushroom, at aromatics

instruction.zh: 香菇和老薑切片，香菜切末，番茄切滾刀塊；乾辣椒切段，將八角、月桂葉、桂皮與白豆蔻備好。
instruction.en: Slice the shiitake mushrooms and mature ginger, chop the cilantro, and cut tomatoes into rolling chunks. Cut dried chili into pieces and prepare star anise, bay leaves, cinnamon bark, and white cardamom.
instruction.id: Iris jamur shiitake dan jahe tua, cincang daun ketumbar, lalu potong tomat besar-besar. Potong cabai kering dan siapkan bunga lawang, daun salam, kulit kayu manis, serta kapulaga putih.
instruction.fil: Hiwain ang shiitake mushroom at mature na luya, i-chop ang cilantro, at gupitin ang mga kamatis sa rolling chunks. Gupitin ang pinatuyong sili at maghanda ng star anise, dahon ng bay, balat ng kanela, at puting cardamom.

steps.imagePrompt: Food photography of tomatoes, sliced shiitake and ginger, dried chilies, and whole braising spices arranged on a cutting board, no text.

title.zh: 煎香豆捲菇類與白木耳
title.en: Brown tofu rolls, mushrooms, and wood ear
title.id: Tumis hingga cokelat gulungan tahu, jamur, dan kuping putih
title.fil: Brown tofu roll, mushroom, at wood ear

instruction.zh: 湯鍋倒少許油，先將豆捲煎至金黃酥脆；加入香菇和白木耳繼續煸至金黃，白木耳邊緣略帶焦色。
instruction.en: Add a little oil to a soup pot and first fry tofu rolls until golden and crisp. Add shiitake and white wood ear mushrooms and continue browning until golden, with lightly charred edges on the wood ear.
instruction.id: Tuang sedikit minyak ke panci sup dan goreng gulungan tahu hingga keemasan serta renyah. Tambahkan shiitake dan jamur kuping putih, lalu lanjutkan menumis hingga keemasan dengan pinggiran kuping putih sedikit kecokelatan.
instruction.fil: Lagyan ng kaunting mantika ang kaldero at iprito muna ang tofu roll hanggang maging ginintuang at malutong. Magdagdag ng shiitake at white wood ear mushroom at ipagpatuloy ang pag-browning hanggang sa ginintuang, na may bahagyang nasunog na mga gilid sa kahoy na tainga.

steps.imagePrompt: Close-up food photography of tofu rolls, shiitake, and white wood ear mushrooms browning in a soup pot, no text.

title.zh: 炒香辛香料番茄並紅燒
title.en: Bloom spices and tomato, then braise
title.id: Tumis rempah dan tomat, lalu braise
title.fil: Pamumulaklak ng mga pampalasa at kamatis, pagkatapos ay i-braise

instruction.zh: 加入老薑、八角、月桂葉、桂皮、白豆蔻與乾辣椒炒香，再放番茄炒軟；加入醬油、辣豆瓣醬、糖和胡椒粉炒勻，加水蓋過食材後熬煮約20分鐘。
instruction.en: Add mature ginger, star anise, bay leaves, cinnamon bark, white cardamom, and dried chili and sauté until fragrant, then soften the tomatoes. Add soy sauce, spicy doubanjiang, sugar, and ground pepper; add enough water to cover and simmer for about 20 minutes.
instruction.id: Masukkan jahe tua, bunga lawang, daun salam, kulit kayu manis, kapulaga putih, dan cabai kering lalu tumis hingga harum, kemudian masak tomat hingga lunak. Tambahkan kecap asin, doubanjiang pedas, gula, dan lada bubuk; tuang air hingga menutupi bahan lalu didihkan sekitar 20 menit.
instruction.fil: Lagyan ng mature na luya, star anise, bay leaves, balat ng kanela, puting cardamom, at pinatuyong sili at igisa hanggang mabango, pagkatapos ay lumambot ang mga kamatis. Magdagdag ng toyo, maanghang na doubanjiang, asukal, at giniling na paminta; magdagdag ng sapat na tubig upang masakop at kumulo ng halos 20 minuto.

steps.imagePrompt: Food photography of rich tomato-red vegan braising broth with tofu rolls, mushrooms, whole spices, and steam in a pot, no text.

title.en: Cook noodles, blanch bok choy, and assemble
title.id: Masak mi, rebus pakcoy, dan susun mangkuk
title.fil: Magluto ng pansit, blanch bok choy, at tipunin

instruction.zh: 另煮一鍋滾水加少許鹽，煮熟拉麵並燙熟青江菜；將麵與青菜放入碗中，倒入紅燒湯和配料，最後撒香菜。
instruction.en: Bring a separate pot of water with a little salt to a boil, cook ramen noodles, and blanch bok choy. Put noodles and bok choy in bowls, ladle over the braised broth and toppings, and finish with cilantro.
instruction.id: Didihkan panci air terpisah dengan sedikit garam, masak mi ramen dan rebus pakcoy sebentar. Masukkan mi serta pakcoy ke mangkuk, tuang kuah braise dan pelengkap, lalu akhiri dengan daun ketumbar.
instruction.fil: Pakuluan ang isang hiwalay na palayok ng tubig na may kaunting asin, magluto ng ramen noodles, at i-blanch ang bok choy. Ilagay ang noodles at bok choy sa mga mangkok, sandok sa ibabaw ng nilagang sabaw at mga toppings, at tapusin sa cilantro.

steps.imagePrompt: Finished vegan tomato braised beef noodle soup with tofu rolls, white wood ear mushrooms, bok choy, and cilantro in a deep bowl, no text.

title.zh: 這招讓全素麻油雞炒飯香到尖叫
title.id: Nasi Goreng Vegan Gaya Ayam Minyak Wijen dan Jahe

description.zh: 以手撕切塊的杏鮑菇和香菇取代雞肉，配麻油煸香薑泥，再與白飯、枸杞和香菜炒成粒粒分明的純素麻油雞風味炒飯。
description.en: Hand-torn, cut king oyster mushrooms and shiitake replace chicken in this vegan sesame-ginger fried rice, finished with rice, goji berries, and cilantro for distinct, fluffy grains.
description.id: Jamur king oyster yang disuwir dan dipotong serta shiitake menggantikan ayam dalam nasi goreng vegan minyak wijen dan jahe ini, lalu ditumis bersama nasi, goji, dan ketumbar agar butirannya terpisah dan pulen.
description.fil: Pinapalitan ng mga king oyster mushroom at shiitake na pinunit ng kamay ang manok sa vegan na sesame-ginger fried rice na ito, na tinapos ng kanin, goji berries, at cilantro para sa kakaiba at malalambot na butil.

instruction.zh: 可用白飯、五穀飯或糙米飯。影片建議以比平日略少的水煮飯，煮好後再燜10至15分鐘，讓米飯鬆散、Q彈且適合拌炒。
instruction.en: Use white, multigrain, or brown rice. The video advises using slightly less water than usual, then resting the cooked rice for 10 to 15 minutes so the grains are loose, springy, and suited to stir-frying.
instruction.id: Gunakan nasi putih, nasi multibiji-bijian, atau nasi merah. Video menyarankan memasak dengan air sedikit lebih sedikit dari biasanya, lalu mendiamkan nasi matang selama 10 hingga 15 menit agar butirannya terpisah, kenyal, dan cocok ditumis.
instruction.fil: Gumamit ng white, multigrain, o brown rice. Ang video ay nagpapayo na gumamit ng bahagyang mas kaunting tubig kaysa karaniwan, pagkatapos ay ipahinga ang nilutong kanin sa loob ng 10 hanggang 15 minuto upang ang mga butil ay maluwag, mabulaklak, at angkop sa pagprito.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic 16:9 vegan recipe tutorial image of freshly cooked rice resting in an open rice cooker, fluffy distinct grains with no egg or meat, no text, no watermark, no logo.

title.en: Prepare the mushrooms, ginger, and garnishes
title.fil: Ihanda ang mga mushroom, luya, at mga palamuti

instruction.zh: 老薑去皮磨成泥；香菇切片。先用手把杏鮑菇撕開，再切成滾刀塊，保留不規則切面。香菜切末；乾枸杞先略泡水。
instruction.en: Peel and grate the mature ginger; slice the shiitake. Tear the king oyster mushrooms by hand first, then cut into rolling chunks, retaining irregular surfaces. Chop the cilantro and briefly soak dried goji berries.
instruction.id: Kupas dan parut jahe tua; iris shiitake. Suwir dahulu jamur king oyster dengan tangan, lalu potong serong dengan permukaan tidak beraturan. Cincang ketumbar dan rendam sebentar goji kering.
instruction.fil: Balatan at lagyan ng rehas ang mature na luya; hiwain ang shiitake. Pilitin muna ang king oyster mushroom sa pamamagitan ng kamay, pagkatapos ay gupitin sa mga rolling chunks, na pinapanatili ang hindi regular na ibabaw. I-chop ang cilantro at ibabad sandali ang mga pinatuyong goji berries.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic overhead 16:9 vegan prep image of hand-torn king oyster mushroom chunks, sliced shiitake, grated ginger, soaked goji berries, and chopped cilantro, no text, no watermark, no logo.

title.id: Tumis kedua jenis jamur hingga harum
title.fil: Kayumanggi ang parehong uri ng kabute

instruction.zh: 炒鍋加入少量植物油，放入杏鮑菇和香菇煸炒至金黃，先盛出備用。
instruction.en: Add a little vegetable oil to a wok and fry the king oyster mushrooms and shiitake until golden, then remove and set aside.
instruction.id: Tambahkan sedikit minyak nabati ke wajan lalu tumis jamur king oyster dan shiitake hingga keemasan, kemudian angkat dan sisihkan.
instruction.fil: Magdagdag ng kaunting vegetable oil sa isang kawali at iprito ang king oyster mushroom at shiitake hanggang sa ginintuang, pagkatapos ay alisin at itabi.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic 16:9 vegan wok image of golden-browned king oyster mushrooms and shiitake being stir-fried in a small amount of vegetable oil, no text, no watermark, no logo.

title.en: Fry the ginger paste in sesame oil
title.id: Tumis pasta jahe dalam minyak wijen
title.fil: Iprito ang ginger paste sa sesame oil

instruction.zh: 原鍋倒入麻油，以小火煸薑泥至顏色變深、乾爽且水分收乾；小火可避免麻油焦苦。
instruction.en: Pour sesame oil into the same wok and gently fry the ginger paste over low heat until darker, dry, and free of moisture. Low heat keeps the sesame oil from scorching and turning bitter.
instruction.id: Tuangkan minyak wijen ke wajan yang sama lalu tumis pasta jahe dengan api kecil hingga warnanya lebih gelap, kering, dan kadar airnya habis. Api kecil mencegah minyak wijen gosong dan pahit.
instruction.fil: Ibuhos ang sesame oil sa parehong kawali at dahan-dahang iprito ang ginger paste sa mahinang apoy hanggang sa mas madilim, matuyo, at walang moisture. Ang mababang init ay nagpapanatili sa sesame oil mula sa pagkapaso at pagiging mapait.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic close-up 16:9 vegan cooking image of aromatic ginger paste gently frying in sesame oil over low heat in a wok, no text, no watermark, no logo.

instruction.zh: 把煸好的菇類回鍋稍炒，加入醬油、鹽、胡椒粉和米酒調味；不使用米酒時可改加水。打開燜好的飯，加入鍋中拌炒均勻。
instruction.en: Return the browned mushrooms to the wok and toss briefly. Season with soy sauce, salt, ground pepper, and rice wine; use water instead if not using rice wine. Open the rested rice and stir-fry it evenly in the wok.
instruction.id: Masukkan kembali jamur yang telah ditumis ke wajan dan aduk sebentar. Bumbui dengan kecap asin, garam, lada bubuk, dan arak beras; gunakan air bila tidak memakai arak beras. Masukkan nasi yang telah didiamkan lalu tumis hingga rata.
instruction.fil: Ibalik ang browned mushroom sa kawali at ihagis sandali. Timplahan ng toyo, asin, giniling na paminta, at rice wine; gumamit ng tubig sa halip kung hindi gumagamit ng rice wine. Buksan ang natirang kanin at iprito ito nang pantay-pantay sa kawali.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic 16:9 vegan fried rice wok image of distinct rice grains tossed with browned mushrooms and sesame-ginger seasoning, no egg, no meat, no text, no watermark, no logo.

title.zh: 加入枸杞並以香菜完成
title.en: Add goji and finish with cilantro
title.id: Tambahkan goji dan akhiri dengan ketumbar
title.fil: Magdagdag ng goji at tapusin sa cilantro

instruction.zh: 炒飯拌勻後加入泡過的枸杞略炒，盛盤後撒上香菜末即可。
instruction.en: Once the fried rice is evenly mixed, add the soaked goji berries and toss briefly. Plate and scatter over chopped cilantro.
instruction.id: Setelah nasi goreng tercampur rata, masukkan goji yang telah direndam dan aduk sebentar. Sajikan lalu taburi ketumbar cincang.
instruction.fil: Kapag ang sinangag ay pantay na nahalo, ilagay ang mga babad na goji berries at ihagis sandali. Plate at ikalat sa tinadtad na cilantro.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic 16:9 finished vegan sesame-ginger fried rice with browned king oyster mushrooms, shiitake, goji berries, and fresh cilantro, no egg, no meat, no text, no watermark, no logo.

description.zh: 以昆布、香菇水與白木耳慢滷的全素白蘿蔔。
description.en: Vegan daikon slowly braised with kombu, mushroom soaking liquid, and white wood ear mushrooms.
description.id: Lobak putih vegan direbus perlahan dengan kombu, air rendaman jamur, dan jamur kuping putih.
description.fil: Dahan-dahang niluto ang Vegan daikon na may kombu, mushroom soaking liquid, at white wood ear mushroom.

title.fil: Ibabad at ihanda ang mga sangkap

instruction.zh: 將乾香菇與乾白木耳泡水至完全變軟；老薑切片，白蘿蔔去皮切成約 1.5 至 2 公分厚片，並在一面劃十字刀。
instruction.en: Soak dried shiitake and white wood ear mushrooms until soft. Slice ginger, peel daikon into 1.5–2 cm slices, and score one side with a crosshatch.
instruction.id: Rendam shiitake dan jamur kuping putih hingga lunak. Iris jahe, kupas lobak putih menjadi irisan 1,5–2 cm, lalu buat sayatan silang pada satu sisi.
instruction.fil: Ibabad ang tuyo na shiitake at white wood ear mushroom hanggang malambot. Hiwain ang luya, balatan ang daikon sa mga hiwa na 1.5–2 cm, at lagyan ng crosshatch ang isang gilid.

steps.imagePrompt: Overhead food photography of scored daikon rounds, sliced ginger, softened shiitake, and white wood ear mushrooms on a board, no text.

instruction.zh: 滾水加入冰糖，放入白蘿蔔煮約 3 分鐘去除苦澀味後撈起。
instruction.en: Add rock sugar to boiling water, cook daikon for about three minutes to remove bitterness, then lift it out.
instruction.id: Tambahkan gula batu ke air mendidih, masak lobak sekitar tiga menit untuk menghilangkan pahit, lalu angkat.
instruction.fil: Magdagdag ng asukal sa bato sa kumukulong tubig, magluto ng daikon ng halos tatlong minuto upang alisin ang kapaitan, pagkatapos ay iangat ito.

steps.imagePrompt: Food photograph of scored daikon rounds blanching in a pot of clear boiling water with rock sugar, no text.

title.en: Sear ginger, bay leaves, and daikon
title.id: Tumis jahe, daun salam, dan lobak
title.fil: Igisa ang luya, dahon ng bay, at daikon

instruction.zh: 熱鍋加植物油，放入老薑片與月桂葉煸香，再放入汆燙過的白蘿蔔煎至表面微黃。
instruction.en: Heat vegetable oil, fry ginger and bay leaves until fragrant, then sear the blanched daikon until lightly golden.
instruction.id: Panaskan minyak sayur, tumis jahe dan daun salam hingga harum, lalu panggang lobak yang telah direbus hingga agak keemasan.
instruction.fil: Painitin ang mantika ng gulay, iprito ang luya at bay leaves hanggang mabango, pagkatapos ay igisa ang blanched daikon hanggang sa bahagyang ginintuang.

steps.imagePrompt: Close food photography of scored daikon rounds lightly golden with ginger slices and bay leaves in a wok, no text.

title.en: Add mushrooms, sauces, and braising liquid
title.id: Masukkan jamur, saus, dan cairan rebus
title.fil: Magdagdag ng mushroom, sauces, at braising liquid

instruction.zh: 泡軟香菇擠乾並保留香菇水，將香菇炒香；加入醬油與醬油膏拌炒，再倒入水與香菇水，加入白木耳、切成三大段的昆布並以鹽調味。
instruction.en: Squeeze soaked shiitake dry and reserve its liquid, then fry it. Stir in soy sauce and soy paste, add water and mushroom liquid, white wood ear mushrooms, three large kombu pieces, and salt.
instruction.id: Peras shiitake rendaman dan simpan cairannya lalu tumis. Aduk kecap asin dan saus kecap, tambahkan air, cairan jamur, jamur kuping putih, tiga potong kombu besar, dan garam.
instruction.fil: Pigain ang nabasang shiitake na tuyo at ireserba ang likido nito, pagkatapos ay iprito. Haluin ang toyo at toyo, magdagdag ng tubig at mushroom liquid, white wood ear mushroom, tatlong malalaking piraso ng kombu, at asin.

steps.imagePrompt: Food photography of vegan daikon braising liquid with shiitake, white wood ear mushrooms, kombu, and dark soy seasoning in a pot, no text.

instruction.zh: 蓋鍋煮滾後轉小火熬滷 30 分鐘；撈起昆布與月桂葉，再煮 10 分鐘至蘿蔔完全透亮。
instruction.en: Cover, bring to a boil, then braise on low for 30 minutes. Remove kombu and bay leaves, then cook 10 more minutes until daikon is fully translucent.
instruction.id: Tutup, didihkan, lalu rebus api kecil 30 menit. Angkat kombu dan daun salam, lalu masak 10 menit lagi hingga lobak bening.
instruction.fil: Takpan, pakuluan, pagkatapos ay i-braise sa mababang loob ng 30 minuto. Alisin ang mga dahon ng kombu at bay, pagkatapos ay lutuin ng 10 minuto pa hanggang sa maging ganap na translucent ang daikon.

steps.imagePrompt: Close food photography of translucent braised daikon with shiitake and white wood ear mushrooms in savory broth, no text.

instruction.zh: 盛盤後依喜好撒上香菜或芹菜。
instruction.en: Plate and garnish with cilantro or celery if desired.
instruction.id: Sajikan lalu beri daun ketumbar atau seledri sesuai selera.
instruction.fil: Plate at palamutihan ng cilantro o celery kung gusto.

steps.imagePrompt: Editorial food photograph of vegan braised daikon with mushrooms in a shallow bowl, garnished with cilantro or celery, no text.

description.zh: 以水餃皮包入蔬菜豆腐餡，煎至金黃焦脆的全素水煎包。
description.en: Vegan pan-fried buns made with dumpling wrappers and a vegetable-tofu filling.
description.id: Bakpao goreng vegan dari kulit pangsit dengan isian sayur dan tahu.
description.fil: Vegan pan-fried bun na gawa sa dumpling wrapper at vegetable-tofu filling.

title.fil: Hiwain ang mga sangkap at ibabad ang noodles

instruction.zh: 手切高麗菜、青江菜、木耳與豆包，冬粉泡軟後切碎。
instruction.en: Hand-chop cabbage, bok choy, wood ear, and tofu skin; soak glass noodles until soft and chop them.
instruction.id: Cincang kubis, pakcoy, jamur kuping, dan kulit tahu; rendam soun hingga lunak lalu cincang.
instruction.fil: Hand-chop na repolyo, bok choy, tainga ng kahoy, at balat ng tofu; ibabad ang glass noodles hanggang lumambot at i-chop ang mga ito.

steps.imagePrompt: Overhead photorealistic food photograph of finely hand-chopped cabbage, bok choy, wood ear mushroom, tofu skin, and softened chopped glass noodles arranged separately on a clean board, no text.

title.fil: Mga gulay na asin at iprito ang tofu

instruction.zh: 高麗菜與青江菜加鹽出水後徹底擠乾；熱鍋下油炒壓碎豆腐與豆包碎至金黃。
instruction.en: Salt cabbage and bok choy, drain and squeeze dry; fry crumbled tofu and tofu skin in oil until golden.
instruction.id: Garam kubis dan pakcoy, tiriskan lalu peras; tumis tahu hancur dan kulit tahu hingga keemasan.
instruction.fil: Salt repolyo at bok choy, patuyuin at pisilin; iprito sa mantika ang durog na tokwa at balat ng tokwa hanggang sa ginto.

steps.imagePrompt: Close photorealistic wok food photograph of golden crumbled tofu and tofu skin frying in vegetable oil beside squeezed dry chopped greens, all clearly plant-based, no text.

instruction.zh: 加入木耳、菜脯和冬粉拌炒，再加入醬油、醬油膏、糖、五香粉與胡椒粉炒香後關火。
instruction.en: Stir-fry wood ear, preserved radish, and glass noodles, then add soy sauce, soy paste, sugar, five-spice, and pepper before turning off heat.
instruction.id: Tumis jamur kuping, lobak asin, dan soun; tambahkan kecap asin, saus kecap, gula, lima rempah, dan lada lalu matikan api.
instruction.fil: Igisa ang kahoy na tainga, inipreserbang labanos, at glass noodles, pagkatapos ay idagdag ang toyo, toyo, asukal, limang pampalasa, at paminta bago patayin ang apoy.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic close-up of a vegan wok filling with tofu, tofu skin, wood ear, preserved radish, glass noodles, and glossy soy seasoning, no text.

title.fil: Paghaluin at balutin ang mga buns

instruction.zh: 將擠乾蔬菜拌入炒料，磨入山藥泥增加黏性；拉大水餃皮，放入餡料，邊緣抹水捏出皺褶。
instruction.en: Mix squeezed greens with the filling and grated yam; stretch dumpling wrappers, fill, wet the edges, and pleat into small buns.
instruction.id: Aduk sayur peras dengan isian dan yam parut; lebarkan kulit pangsit, isi, basahi tepi, lalu lipat menjadi bakpao kecil.
instruction.fil: Paghaluin ang kinatas na mga gulay na may palaman at gadgad na nami; iunat ang mga balot ng dumpling, punuin, basain ang mga gilid, at pira-pirasuhin ang maliliit na buns.

steps.imagePrompt: Overhead photorealistic preparation scene of vegan vegetable-tofu filling and dumpling wrappers being pleated into small round buns, no hands, no text.

instruction.zh: 平底鍋下油煎小包子至底部微金黃；將 1 匙麵粉與水調成麵粉水倒入，蓋鍋中大火煮約 5 分鐘收乾，撒黑芝麻後煎至底部焦脆。
instruction.en: Pan-fry buns in oil until lightly golden. Add a slurry of one spoon flour and water, cover and cook about five minutes until dry, then add black sesame and crisp the bottoms.
instruction.id: Goreng bakpao hingga agak keemasan. Tambahkan larutan satu sendok tepung dan air, tutup sekitar lima menit hingga kering, lalu beri wijen hitam dan renyahkan bagian bawah.
instruction.fil: Pan-fry buns sa mantika hanggang sa bahagyang ginintuang. Magdagdag ng isang slurry ng isang kutsarang harina at tubig, takpan at lutuin ng mga limang minuto hanggang matuyo, pagkatapos ay magdagdag ng itim na linga at malutong ang ilalim.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic editorial food photograph of golden crisp-bottomed vegan pan-fried dumpling-skin buns with black sesame in a skillet, no text.

description.zh: 以多種菇類、山藥、薑與藥膳包慢燉的全素胡椒湯。
description.en: A vegan pepper soup slowly simmered with mushrooms, yam, ginger, and an herbal sachet.
description.id: Sup lada vegan yang direbus perlahan dengan jamur, yam, jahe, dan kantong herbal.
description.fil: Ang isang vegan pepper na sopas ay dahan-dahang kumulo na may mga mushroom, yam, luya, at isang herbal na sachet.

name.zh: 白胡椒粉或搗碎白胡椒粒
name.en: white pepper powder or crushed white peppercorns
name.id: lada putih bubuk atau butiran lada putih tumbuk
name.fil: puting paminta pulbos o durog na puting paminta

title.fil: Maghanda ng mga mushroom at ugat

instruction.zh: 黑美人菇去蒂撥開，袖珍菇撕半，白精靈菇過長則對半切；薑切片、山藥去皮切長滾刀塊。
instruction.en: Trim and separate black beauty mushrooms, halve oyster mushrooms, cut long white beech mushrooms, slice ginger, and cut peeled yam into long chunks.
instruction.id: Buang pangkal jamur, belah jamur tiram, potong jamur beech panjang, iris jahe, dan potong yam kupas.
instruction.fil: Putulin at paghiwalayin ang mga black beauty mushroom, hatiin ang mga oyster mushroom, gupitin ang mahabang puting beech mushroom, hiwain ang luya, at gupitin ang binalatan na yam sa mahabang tipak.

steps.imagePrompt: Overhead photorealistic food preparation photograph of three prepared mushroom varieties, sliced mature ginger, and peeled yam chunks arranged on a clean board, no text.

instruction.zh: 預熱炒鍋加少量植物油，將所有菇類煸炒至水分全乾、表面金黃。
instruction.en: Heat a wok with vegetable oil and fry all mushrooms until dry and golden.
instruction.id: Panaskan wajan dengan minyak sayur lalu tumis semua jamur hingga kering dan keemasan.
instruction.fil: Init ang isang kawali na may langis ng gulay at iprito ang lahat ng mga kabute hanggang sa matuyo at maging ginintuang.

steps.imagePrompt: Close photorealistic wok photograph of mixed vegan mushrooms sizzling in a little vegetable oil until their moisture evaporates and edges turn golden, no text.

title.fil: Pamumulaklak ng luya, yam, at paminta

instruction.zh: 加入薑片與山藥煸香，再加入白胡椒粉或搗碎白胡椒粒拌炒釋放香氣。
instruction.en: Add ginger and yam, then stir-fry white pepper powder or crushed peppercorns until fragrant.
instruction.id: Tambahkan jahe dan yam, lalu tumis lada putih hingga harum.
instruction.fil: Magdagdag ng luya at yam, pagkatapos ay iprito ang puting paminta na pulbos o dinurog na peppercorn hanggang mabango.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic close-up of golden mushrooms, ginger slices, yam chunks, and aromatic white pepper being tossed in a wok, entirely vegan, no text.

title.en: Boil and transfer to clay pot
title.id: Didihkan lalu pindahkan ke panci tanah liat
title.fil: Pakuluan at ilipat sa clay pot

instruction.zh: 倒入水煮至沸騰，將食材移至陶鍋並補水至約八分滿。
instruction.en: Add water and boil, then transfer ingredients to a clay pot and fill it about eight-tenths full.
instruction.id: Tambahkan air dan didihkan, lalu pindahkan ke panci tanah liat dan isi sekitar delapan persepuluh.
instruction.fil: Magdagdag ng tubig at pakuluan, pagkatapos ay ilipat ang mga sangkap sa isang palayok na luad at punan ito ng halos walong-ikasampu ng puno.

steps.imagePrompt: Editorial photorealistic food photograph of a clay pot filled with mushroom soup ingredients and clear simmering broth, with gentle steam rising, no text.

title.fil: Pakuluan ang mga damo at asin

instruction.zh: 加入燒酒雞中藥包，再次煮滾後轉小火慢燉 40 分鐘，最後加少量鹽提鮮。
instruction.en: Add the herbal soup sachet, boil again, simmer on low for 40 minutes, then season with salt.
instruction.id: Tambahkan kantong herbal, didihkan lagi, rebus api kecil 40 menit, lalu bumbui garam.
instruction.fil: Idagdag ang herbal soup sachet, pakuluan muli, kumulo sa mababang loob ng 40 minuto, pagkatapos ay timplahan ng asin.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic finished vegan pepper herbal mushroom soup in a clay pot, with yam pieces and mushroom varieties in clear broth, gently steaming, no text.

title.en: Layered Napa Cabbage and Tofu-Skin Hot Pot
title.id: Hot Pot Sawi Putih dan Kulit Tahu Berlapis
title.fil: Layered Napa Cabbage at Tofu-Skin Hot Pot

description.zh: 把白菜、豆包與汆燙後切開的炸素料層層堆疊，加入燕麥奶、醬油與薑泥調成的湯汁，煮成適合圍爐分享的一鍋純素料理。
description.en: Napa cabbage, tofu skin, and a blanched sliced fried vegan ingredient are layered in a pot, then simmered in an oat-milk, soy-sauce, and ginger broth for a shareable vegan hot pot.
description.id: Sawi putih, kulit tahu, dan bahan vegan goreng yang direbus lalu diiris disusun berlapis dalam panci, kemudian dimasak perlahan dalam kuah susu oat, kecap asin, dan jahe untuk hot pot vegan yang dapat disantap bersama.
description.fil: Ang napa repolyo, balat ng tofu, at isang blanched sliced ​​fried vegan ingredient ay nilalagay sa isang kaldero, pagkatapos ay niluluto sa isang oat-milk, soy-sauce, at ginger broth para sa maibabahaging vegan hot pot.

name.zh: 炸素料（語音轉錄為「角蘿」）

title.en: Blanch and split the fried vegan ingredient
title.id: Rebus sebentar dan belah bahan vegan goreng
title.fil: Blanch at hatiin ang pritong vegan ingredient

instruction.zh: 把影片中稱為「角蘿」的炸素料放入滾水汆燙至軟化，讓表面多餘油脂浮起；取出後從中間剪開並攤成長條，作為白菜夾層。
instruction.en: Blanch the fried vegan ingredient that the transcript calls 'jiao luo' in boiling water until soft so excess oil rises to the surface. Remove it, cut it open through the middle, and flatten it into long strips for the cabbage layers.
instruction.id: Rebus sebentar bahan vegan goreng yang dalam transkrip disebut 'jiao luo' dalam air mendidih hingga lunak agar minyak berlebih naik ke permukaan. Angkat, belah di bagian tengah, lalu ratakan menjadi potongan panjang untuk lapisan sawi.
instruction.fil: Paputiin ang piniritong vegan ingredient na tinatawag ng transcript na 'jiao luo' sa kumukulong tubig hanggang lumambot para tumaas ang labis na mantika sa ibabaw. Alisin ito, gupitin ito sa gitna, at patagin ito sa mahabang piraso para sa mga layer ng repolyo.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic 16:9 vegan cooking tutorial image of a fried plant-based ingredient being blanched in clear boiling water, then opened into flat strips on a tray; no animal meat, no text, no watermark, no logo.

title.en: Prepare the vegetables and tofu skin
title.fil: Ihanda ang mga gulay at balat ng tofu

instruction.zh: 紅蘿蔔切片，老薑磨成薑泥，青龍椒切細圈留作最後點綴。把生豆包攤開、裁成長條，再依白菜葉的長度切成合適大小。
instruction.en: Slice the carrot, grate mature ginger into a paste, and cut the green dragon pepper into thin rings for the finish. Open the fresh tofu skin, cut it into long strips, then trim it to match the length of the cabbage leaves.
instruction.id: Iris wortel, parut jahe tua menjadi pasta, dan potong cabai hijau naga menjadi cincin tipis untuk taburan akhir. Bentangkan kulit tahu segar, potong memanjang, lalu sesuaikan panjangnya dengan daun sawi.
instruction.fil: Hiwain ang karot, lagyan ng paste ang mature na luya, at gupitin ang berdeng dragon pepper sa manipis na singsing para sa pagtatapos. Buksan ang sariwang balat ng tofu, gupitin ito sa mahabang piraso, pagkatapos ay putulin ito upang tumugma sa haba ng mga dahon ng repolyo.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic overhead vegan prep scene with sliced carrots, grated ginger, thin green pepper rings, and fresh tofu skin cut into neat strips beside napa cabbage leaves; no text, no watermark, no logo.

title.en: Layer and cut the cabbage stack
title.fil: Layer at gupitin ang salansan ng repolyo

instruction.zh: 選大小相近的三片白菜葉，依序放上白菜、豆包與汆燙後的炸素料，再重複堆疊。完成後把整疊切成三等份，形成直立排列的千層夾層。
