instruction.en: Choose three similarly sized cabbage leaves. Layer cabbage, tofu skin, and the blanched fried vegan ingredient in sequence, then repeat the layers. Cut the stack into three equal portions to make upright layered pieces.
instruction.id: Pilih tiga daun sawi berukuran serupa. Susun sawi, kulit tahu, dan bahan vegan goreng yang telah direbus secara berurutan, lalu ulangi lapisannya. Potong tumpukan menjadi tiga bagian sama besar untuk membentuk potongan berlapis yang dapat berdiri.
instruction.fil: Pumili ng tatlong katulad na laki ng dahon ng repolyo. Layer ng repolyo, balat ng tofu, at ang blanched fried vegan ingredient sa pagkakasunud-sunod, pagkatapos ay ulitin ang mga layer. Gupitin ang stack sa tatlong pantay na bahagi upang makagawa ng mga tuwid na layered na piraso.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic 16:9 food preparation image of napa cabbage leaves layered with fresh tofu skin and flat plant-based strips, neatly cut into three upright layered portions; strictly vegan, no text, no watermark, no logo.

title.zh: 在寬口鍋中排入千層白菜
title.en: Arrange the layers in a wide pot
title.fil: Ayusin ang mga layer sa isang malawak na palayok

instruction.zh: 把修下的白菜碎葉與較小的部位鋪在寬口鍋底，再將切好的千層白菜直立排滿鍋中；把紅蘿蔔與豆包填入中間空隙。
instruction.en: Line the base of a wide pot with cabbage trimmings and smaller pieces, then stand the cut cabbage layers upright until the pot is full. Fill the central gaps with carrot and tofu skin.
instruction.id: Lapisi dasar panci lebar dengan potongan sisa sawi dan bagian yang kecil, lalu tata potongan sawi berlapis secara tegak hingga panci penuh. Isi celah di tengah dengan wortel dan kulit tahu.
instruction.fil: Iguhit ang base ng isang malawak na palayok na may mga trim ng repolyo at mas maliliit na piraso, pagkatapos ay patayo ang mga naputol na layer ng repolyo hanggang sa mapuno ang palayok. Punan ang mga gitnang puwang ng balat ng karot at tofu.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic overhead 16:9 vegan hot pot preparation image showing upright layered napa cabbage and tofu-skin bundles packed neatly in a wide pot, with carrot slices in the gaps; no text, no watermark, no logo.

title.en: Add a little water and soften the cabbage
title.id: Tambahkan sedikit air dan lunakkan sawi
title.fil: Magdagdag ng kaunting tubig at palambutin ang repolyo

instruction.zh: 沿鍋邊加入少量水，因白菜會再釋出水分；蓋上鍋蓋煮至白菜軟化，同時準備湯汁。
instruction.en: Add a small amount of water around the pot because the cabbage will release more liquid. Cover and cook until the cabbage softens while preparing the broth.
instruction.id: Tambahkan sedikit air di sekeliling panci karena sawi akan mengeluarkan lebih banyak cairan. Tutup panci dan masak hingga sawi lunak sambil menyiapkan kuah.
instruction.fil: Magdagdag ng kaunting tubig sa paligid ng palayok dahil mas maraming likido ang ilalabas ng repolyo. Takpan at lutuin hanggang lumambot ang repolyo habang inihahanda ang sabaw.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic 16:9 vegan cooking image of a wide lidded pot gently steaming with upright layered napa cabbage and tofu skin, a small amount of clear broth visible; no text, no watermark, no logo.

title.zh: 調入燕麥奶薑汁並煮沸
title.en: Add the oat-milk ginger broth and simmer
title.id: Tambahkan kuah susu oat jahe lalu didihkan
title.fil: Idagdag ang oat-milk ginger broth at kumulo

instruction.zh: 將燕麥奶、醬油、薑泥與少量鹽調成湯汁；白菜鍋冒熱氣後開蓋倒入，重新蓋好微煮至滾沸。
instruction.en: Mix oat milk, soy sauce, ginger paste, and a little salt into a broth. When steam rises from the cabbage pot, uncover and pour it in, then cover again and simmer until boiling.
instruction.id: Campurkan susu oat, kecap asin, pasta jahe, dan sedikit garam menjadi kuah. Saat uap muncul dari panci sawi, buka tutupnya dan tuangkan kuah, lalu tutup kembali dan masak perlahan hingga mendidih.
instruction.fil: Paghaluin ang oat milk, toyo, ginger paste, at kaunting asin sa isang sabaw. Kapag tumaas ang singaw mula sa kaldero ng repolyo, alisan ng takip at ibuhos ito, pagkatapos ay takpan muli at kumulo hanggang kumulo.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic 16:9 vegan tutorial image of creamy pale oat-milk ginger broth being poured into a steaming pot of layered napa cabbage and tofu skin; no dairy, no meat, no text, no watermark, no logo.

title.zh: 確認熟度並以青龍椒完成
title.en: Check doneness and finish with green pepper
title.id: Periksa kematangan dan akhiri dengan cabai hijau
title.fil: Suriin ang pagiging handa at tapusin na may berdeng paminta

instruction.zh: 打開鍋蓋確認白菜已軟，並試吃較厚的紅蘿蔔；撒上青龍椒圈後再稍微燉煮即可上桌。喜歡辣味可另加辣椒。
instruction.en: Uncover and check that the cabbage is soft; taste a thicker carrot slice to confirm it is tender. Scatter over the green pepper rings, simmer briefly, and serve. Add extra chili separately if desired.
instruction.id: Buka tutup panci dan pastikan sawi telah lunak; cicipi sepotong wortel yang lebih tebal untuk memastikan sudah empuk. Taburkan cincin cabai hijau, masak perlahan sebentar, lalu sajikan. Tambahkan cabai ekstra secara terpisah bila suka pedas.
instruction.fil: Alisan ng takip at suriin na ang repolyo ay malambot; tikman ang isang mas makapal na hiwa ng karot upang makumpirma na ito ay malambot. Ikalat ang berdeng paminta, kumulo sandali, at ihain. Magdagdag ng dagdag na sili nang hiwalay kung ninanais.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic 16:9 finished vegan layered napa cabbage hot pot in a wide pot, tender cabbage and tofu skin in pale ginger broth topped with thin green pepper rings, no animal products, no text, no watermark, no logo.

title.zh: 家傳配方的茼萵年糕湯
title.en: One-Pot Crown Daisy Rice Cake Soup
title.id: Sup Kue Beras Tong Ho Satu Panci
title.fil: One-Pot Crown Daisy Rice Cake Soup

description.zh: 以酥煎凍豆腐、菇類、植物奶與茼蒿煮成的濃香全素年糕湯。
description.en: A rich vegan rice cake soup with crisp frozen tofu, mushrooms, plant milk, and crown daisy.
description.id: Sup kue beras vegan kaya rasa dengan tahu beku renyah, jamur, susu nabati, dan tong ho.
description.fil: Isang masaganang vegan rice cake na sopas na may malutong na frozen na tofu, mushroom, gatas ng halaman, at crown daisy.

name.en: unsweetened plant milk or soy milk
name.id: susu nabati atau susu kedelai tanpa gula
name.fil: gatas ng halaman na walang tamis o gatas ng toyo

title.fil: Ihanda ang mga gulay at tofu

instruction.zh: 老薑與泡軟乾香菇切絲；金針菇切小段；茼蒿洗淨去蒂；凍豆腐擠乾後用手剝成小碎塊。
instruction.en: Shred the ginger and soaked shiitake, cut enoki into short pieces, wash and trim the crown daisy, then squeeze frozen tofu dry and tear it into small pieces.
instruction.id: Iris jahe dan shiitake rendaman, potong enoki pendek, cuci serta buang pangkal tong ho, lalu peras tahu beku dan sobek kecil-kecil.
instruction.fil: Hiwain ang luya at ibinabad na shiitake, gupitin ang enoki sa maiikling piraso, hugasan at gupitin ang koronang daisy, pagkatapos ay pisilin ang frozen tofu na tuyo at punitin ito sa maliliit na piraso.

steps.imagePrompt: Overhead photorealistic food preparation photograph of shredded ginger and soaked shiitake, short enoki sections, trimmed crown daisy, and torn dry frozen tofu arranged separately, no text.

instruction.zh: 熱鍋加入少量植物油，放入凍豆腐碎煎至金黃酥脆。
instruction.en: Heat a little vegetable oil in a wok and fry the frozen tofu pieces until golden and crisp.
instruction.id: Panaskan sedikit minyak sayur lalu goreng potongan tahu beku hingga keemasan dan renyah.
instruction.fil: Mag-init ng kaunting mantika ng gulay sa isang kawali at iprito ang mga piraso ng frozen na tofu hanggang maging ginintuang at malutong.

steps.imagePrompt: Close photorealistic food photograph of small torn frozen tofu pieces frying until crisp and golden in a lightly oiled wok, strictly vegan, no text.

instruction.zh: 加入薑絲、香菇絲及金針菇段，持續翻炒至金黃乾爽並發出刷刷聲。
instruction.en: Add shredded ginger, shiitake, and enoki, and keep stir-frying until golden and dry enough to make a rustling sound.
instruction.id: Masukkan jahe iris, shiitake, dan enoki, lalu terus tumis hingga keemasan dan kering.
instruction.fil: Magdagdag ng ginutay-gutay na luya, shiitake, at enoki, at patuloy na magprito hanggang sa maging ginintuang at sapat na tuyo upang makagawa ng kaluskos.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic close food photograph of crisp frozen tofu with shredded ginger, shiitake, and short enoki pieces stir-fried until golden and dry in a wok, no text.

instruction.zh: 加入醬油、醬油膏、胡椒粉、五香粉與少量糖；轉小火拌炒出醬香，避免醬料焦糊。
instruction.en: Add soy sauce, soy paste, ground pepper, five-spice, and a little sugar. Lower the heat and stir until aromatic without scorching.
instruction.id: Tambahkan kecap asin, saus kecap, lada, bubuk lima rempah, dan sedikit gula. Kecilkan api lalu aduk hingga harum tanpa gosong.
instruction.fil: Magdagdag ng toyo, toyo, paminta, limang pampalasa, at kaunting asukal. Ibaba ang apoy at haluin hanggang mabango nang hindi nakakapaso.

steps.imagePrompt: Close photorealistic wok photograph of golden vegan tofu and mushrooms coated in glossy dark soy seasoning with visible ground spices, no text.

title.en: Add plant milk and make the broth
title.fil: Magdagdag ng gatas ng halaman at gawin ang sabaw

instruction.zh: 倒入無糖植物奶或豆奶、水及預留香菇水，拌勻後煮至沸騰。
instruction.en: Pour in unsweetened plant milk or soy milk, water, and the reserved shiitake soaking liquid, stir, and bring to a boil.
instruction.id: Tuang susu nabati atau susu kedelai tanpa gula, air, dan air rendaman shiitake, aduk lalu didihkan.
instruction.fil: Ibuhos sa unsweetened plant milk o soy milk, tubig, at ang nakareserbang shiitake soaking liquid, haluin, at pakuluan.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic food photograph of a creamy pale vegan plant-milk broth coming to a boil around golden tofu, shiitake, and enoki in a deep pot, no text.

title.en: Cook the rice cakes by thickness
title.fil: Lutuin ang mga rice cake ayon sa kapal

instruction.zh: 加入年糕；較厚、圓形或長條年糕先煮至稍軟，較薄年糕則可留待與茼蒿同時下鍋。
instruction.en: Add the rice cakes. Cook thick, round, or long pieces until slightly soft first; thin slices may be added together with the crown daisy.
instruction.id: Masukkan kue beras. Masak yang tebal, bulat, atau panjang hingga agak lunak; irisan tipis dapat dimasukkan bersama tong ho.
instruction.fil: Idagdag ang mga rice cake. Magluto ng makapal, bilog, o mahabang piraso hanggang sa bahagyang malambot muna; ang mga manipis na hiwa ay maaaring idagdag kasama ng korona daisy.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic close food photograph of white rice cakes simmering and softening in a creamy vegan mushroom and tofu broth, no greens yet, no text.

instruction.zh: 最後加入茼蒿；若使用薄年糕亦於此時加入。待湯再次煮滾後立即起鍋。
instruction.en: Add the crown daisy last, together with thin rice cakes if using. Once the soup returns to a boil, remove it from the heat and serve.
instruction.id: Masukkan tong ho terakhir, bersama kue beras tipis bila digunakan. Setelah sup mendidih kembali, segera angkat dan sajikan.
instruction.fil: Idagdag ang korona daisy sa huli, kasama ng mga manipis na rice cake kung gagamitin. Sa sandaling bumalik sa pigsa ang sopas, alisin ito sa apoy at ihain.

steps.imagePrompt: Editorial photorealistic food photograph of creamy vegan crown daisy rice cake soup with golden frozen tofu and mushrooms in a warm bowl, no text.

title.zh: 純素肉末咖哩孩子吃光光
title.id: Kari Sayur Gaya Daging Cincang Vegan

description.zh: 把茄子、青椒、紅蘿蔔、番茄和杏鮑菇切成細丁，搭配煸脆的豆腐與凍豆腐，先以咖哩粉炒香、再用植物奶和咖哩塊煮成濃郁的純素肉末風味咖哩。
description.en: Eggplant, green pepper, carrot, tomato, and king oyster mushrooms are diced finely and paired with crisped tofu and frozen tofu. Curry powder, plant milk, and curry roux turn them into a rich vegan minced-style curry.
description.id: Terong, paprika hijau, wortel, tomat, dan jamur king oyster dipotong dadu kecil lalu dipadukan dengan tahu serta tahu beku yang ditumis renyah. Bubuk kari, susu nabati, dan roux kari menjadikannya kari vegan gaya daging cincang yang kaya rasa.
description.fil: Ang talong, berdeng paminta, karot, kamatis, at king oyster mushroom ay hinihiwa nang pino at ipinares sa crisped tofu at frozen tofu. Ang curry powder, plant milk, at curry roux ay ginagawa silang isang rich vegan minced-style curry.

title.fil: Hiwain ng pino ang mga gulay

instruction.zh: 將茄子、青椒、紅蘿蔔、番茄和杏鮑菇全部切成小丁，讓不喜歡明顯蔬菜口感的人也較容易入口。
instruction.en: Dice the eggplant, green pepper, carrot, tomato, and king oyster mushrooms into small pieces so the vegetables are less noticeable for people who dislike their distinct texture.
instruction.id: Potong terong, paprika hijau, wortel, tomat, dan jamur king oyster menjadi dadu kecil agar sayuran tidak terlalu terasa bagi yang kurang menyukai teksturnya.
instruction.fil: Hatiin ang talong, berdeng paminta, karot, kamatis, at king oyster mushroom sa maliliit na piraso upang hindi gaanong mahahalata ang mga gulay para sa mga taong hindi gusto ang kanilang natatanging texture.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic overhead 16:9 vegan cooking prep image of finely diced eggplant, green pepper, carrot, tomato, and king oyster mushrooms in separate piles, no text, no watermark, no logo.

title.en: Crisp the tofu and frozen tofu
title.fil: Crisp ang tofu at frozen tofu

instruction.zh: 凍豆腐剝成小塊；鍋中加少量油，將豆腐壓碎或捏碎後與凍豆腐慢慢煸炒，讓水分逐漸蒸發並炒至金黃酥脆，形成近似肉末的口感。
instruction.en: Tear the frozen tofu into small pieces. Add a little oil to a wok, crumble the tofu in the pan or by hand, and slowly fry it with the frozen tofu until moisture evaporates and both are golden and crisp for a minced-meat-like texture.
instruction.id: Sobek tahu beku menjadi potongan kecil. Tambahkan sedikit minyak ke wajan, hancurkan tahu di wajan atau dengan tangan, lalu tumis perlahan bersama tahu beku hingga airnya menguap dan keduanya keemasan serta renyah sehingga menyerupai daging cincang.
instruction.fil: Hatiin ang frozen tofu sa maliliit na piraso. Magdagdag ng kaunting mantika sa isang kawali, durugin ang tofu sa kawali o sa pamamagitan ng kamay, at dahan-dahang iprito ito kasama ng frozen na tofu hanggang sa sumingaw ang kahalumigmigan at pareho silang maging ginintuang at malutong para sa parang tinadtad na karne.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic 16:9 vegan wok image of crumbled tofu and torn frozen tofu slowly browning to crisp golden bits, no meat, no text, no watermark, no logo.

title.id: Tumis jamur dan wortel hingga harum

instruction.zh: 豆腐金黃酥脆後，加入杏鮑菇與紅蘿蔔丁，繼續炒至金黃。
instruction.en: Once the tofu is golden and crisp, add the diced king oyster mushrooms and carrot, continuing to stir-fry until golden.
instruction.id: Setelah tahu keemasan dan renyah, masukkan jamur king oyster dan wortel yang telah dipotong dadu, lalu lanjutkan menumis hingga keemasan.
instruction.fil: Kapag ang tokwa ay ginintuang at malutong, idagdag ang diced king oyster mushroom at carrot, ipagpatuloy ang pagprito hanggang sa ginintuang.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic 16:9 vegan stir-fry image of crisp tofu crumbles with diced king oyster mushrooms and carrots browning in a wok, no text, no watermark, no logo.

title.zh: 炒軟其餘蔬菜並加入咖哩粉
title.en: Soften the remaining vegetables and add curry powder
title.id: Lunakkan sayuran lain dan tambahkan bubuk kari
title.fil: Palambutin ang natitirang mga gulay at magdagdag ng curry powder

instruction.zh: 加入青椒、茄子和番茄丁，炒至變軟。放入咖哩粉拌炒出香氣，但不要炒太久，以免變苦。
instruction.en: Add the diced green pepper, eggplant, and tomato and cook until softened. Stir in curry powder just until fragrant, without frying it too long so it does not turn bitter.
instruction.id: Masukkan paprika hijau, terong, dan tomat yang telah dipotong dadu lalu masak hingga lunak. Tambahkan bubuk kari dan tumis hingga harum, tetapi jangan terlalu lama agar tidak pahit.
instruction.fil: Idagdag ang diced green pepper, talong, at kamatis at lutuin hanggang lumambot. Haluin ang curry powder hanggang sa mabango, nang hindi piniprito ng masyadong mahaba para hindi maging mapait.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic 16:9 vegan curry preparation image of softened diced vegetables and golden tofu crumbles being tossed with fragrant curry powder in a wok, no text, no watermark, no logo.

title.en: Simmer with plant milk for curry aroma
title.id: Masak dengan susu nabati untuk aroma kari
title.fil: Pakuluan ang gatas ng halaman para sa aroma ng kari

instruction.zh: 倒入植物奶；影片舉例燕麥奶或椰奶。讓食材在植物奶中稍微滾煮，使蔬菜的味道與咖哩香氣融合。
instruction.en: Pour in plant milk; the video gives oat milk or coconut milk as examples. Let the ingredients simmer briefly in the plant milk so the vegetable flavors meld with the curry aroma.
instruction.id: Tuangkan susu nabati; video memberi contoh susu oat atau santan. Biarkan bahan mendidih perlahan sebentar dalam susu nabati agar rasa sayuran menyatu dengan aroma kari.
instruction.fil: Ibuhos sa gatas ng halaman; ang video ay nagbibigay ng oat milk o gata ng niyog bilang mga halimbawa. Hayaang kumulo sandali ang mga sangkap sa gatas ng halaman upang ang lasa ng gulay ay maghalo sa aroma ng kari.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic 16:9 vegan curry wok image of a creamy plant-milk sauce simmering around diced vegetables and tofu crumbles, no dairy, no meat, no text, no watermark, no logo.

title.zh: 加入水與咖哩塊煮至融合
title.en: Add water and curry roux until combined
title.id: Tambahkan air dan roux kari hingga menyatu
title.fil: Magdagdag ng tubig at curry roux hanggang sa pinagsama

instruction.zh: 植物奶逐漸被蔬菜吸收後，加入水和咖哩塊，持續煮至咖哩塊融化、醬汁濃郁並均勻包覆食材，即可盛盤。
instruction.en: When the plant milk has gradually been absorbed by the vegetables, add water and curry roux blocks. Cook until the roux melts and the curry is rich and evenly coats the ingredients, then serve.
instruction.id: Saat susu nabati perlahan terserap oleh sayuran, tambahkan air dan blok roux kari. Masak hingga roux meleleh dan kari menjadi kental serta melapisi semua bahan secara merata, lalu sajikan.
instruction.fil: Kapag ang gatas ng halaman ay unti-unting nasisipsip ng mga gulay, magdagdag ng tubig at curry roux blocks. Lutuin hanggang matunaw ang roux at mayaman ang curry at pantay-pantay ang mga sangkap, pagkatapos ay ihain.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic 16:9 finished vegan minced-style vegetable curry in a bowl, rich golden sauce with tiny diced vegetables and tofu crumbles, no animal products, no text, no watermark, no logo.

description.zh: 以煸香金針菇與紅蘿蔔泥模擬櫻花蝦風味，配搭嫩脆絲瓜的全素家常菜。
description.en: A vegan loofah dish topped with browned enoki and carrot that mimic the color and savoriness of sakura shrimp.
description.id: Hidangan oyong vegan dengan topping enoki dan wortel kecokelatan yang meniru warna serta rasa gurih udang sakura.
description.fil: Isang vegan loofah dish na nilagyan ng browned enoki at carrot na gayahin ang kulay at sarap ng sakura shrimp.

instruction.zh: 絲瓜去頭尾、削皮後切成約 2 至 3 公分厚塊；紅蘿蔔削皮磨泥，金針菇切成約 4 至 5 公分長段。
instruction.en: Trim and peel the loofah, then cut it into 2–3 cm chunks. Peel and grate the carrot, and cut enoki into 4–5 cm lengths.
instruction.id: Potong ujung dan kupas oyong, lalu potong setebal 2–3 cm. Kupas dan parut wortel, kemudian potong enoki sepanjang 4–5 cm.
instruction.fil: Gupitin at alisan ng balat ang loofah, pagkatapos ay gupitin ito sa 2-3 cm na mga tipak. Balatan at lagyan ng rehas ang karot, at gupitin ang enoki sa haba na 4-5 cm.

steps.imagePrompt: Overhead photorealistic preparation photograph of peeled loofah chunks, finely grated carrot, and short enoki mushroom sections arranged separately on a clean wooden board, no text.

instruction.zh: 熱鍋加入少量植物油，放入金針菇煸炒至表面微焦金黃。
instruction.en: Heat a little vegetable oil in a wok and stir-fry the enoki until lightly charred and golden.
instruction.id: Panaskan sedikit minyak sayur dalam wajan lalu tumis enoki hingga agak gosong dan keemasan.
instruction.fil: Mag-init ng kaunting vegetable oil sa isang kawali at iprito ang enoki hanggang sa bahagyang masunog at maging ginintuang.

steps.imagePrompt: Close photorealistic food photograph of short enoki mushroom strands browning at the edges in a lightly oiled wok, entirely vegan, no text.

instruction.zh: 加入紅蘿蔔泥，與金針菇拌炒至均勻上色並釋出甜味；加少量胡椒鹽調味後盛起，鍋內保留底油。
instruction.en: Add the grated carrot and stir-fry with the enoki until evenly colored and sweet. Season lightly with pepper salt, remove the topping, and leave the oil in the wok.
instruction.id: Masukkan wortel parut dan tumis bersama enoki hingga warnanya merata dan terasa manis. Bumbui sedikit garam lada, angkat topping, lalu sisakan minyak di wajan.
instruction.fil: Ilagay ang grated carrot at igisa kasama ang enoki hanggang sa maging pantay ang kulay at matamis. Timplahan ng kaunting asin ng paminta, alisin ang topping, at iwanan ang mantika sa kawali.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic close food photograph of grated carrot coating browned enoki mushrooms in a wok to form an orange vegan sakura-shrimp-style topping, no text.

instruction.zh: 利用原鍋底油加入絲瓜塊煎炒，直至絲瓜開始出水並軟化。
instruction.en: Add the loofah chunks to the reserved oil and stir-fry until they begin releasing moisture and soften.
instruction.id: Masukkan potongan oyong ke minyak sisa lalu tumis hingga mulai mengeluarkan air dan melunak.
instruction.fil: Idagdag ang loofah chunks sa nakareserbang mantika at iprito hanggang sa magsimula silang maglabas ng moisture at lumambot.

steps.imagePrompt: Close photorealistic food photograph of peeled green loofah chunks softening and releasing moisture in a clean wok with a little vegetable oil, no text.

instruction.zh: 加入鹽與 2 大匙米酒；不飲酒可改加少量水。不要蓋鍋，持續翻炒至絲瓜熟透，令外層保持脆口、內裡綿軟。
instruction.en: Add salt and 2 tablespoons rice wine; substitute a little water if avoiding alcohol. Keep the wok uncovered and stir-fry until the loofah is tender inside while retaining a lightly crisp exterior.
instruction.id: Tambahkan garam dan 2 sendok makan arak beras; gunakan sedikit air bila menghindari alkohol. Masak tanpa tutup sambil terus diaduk hingga oyong lembut di dalam namun tetap agak renyah di luar.
instruction.fil: Magdagdag ng asin at 2 kutsarang rice wine; palitan ng kaunting tubig kung umiiwas sa alkohol. Panatilihing walang takip ang kawali at iprito hanggang sa malambot ang loofah sa loob habang nananatili ang bahagyang malutong na panlabas.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic close food photograph of glossy tender green loofah chunks cooking uncovered in a wok with a small amount of clear seasoning liquid, fully vegan, no text.

instruction.zh: 將絲瓜盛盤，最後鋪上預先炒好的金針菇紅蘿蔔配料即可。
instruction.en: Plate the loofah and finish with the browned enoki-and-carrot topping.
instruction.id: Sajikan oyong lalu beri topping enoki dan wortel yang telah ditumis.
instruction.fil: I-plate ang loofah at tapusin ang browned enoki-and-carrot topping.

steps.imagePrompt: Editorial photorealistic food photograph of tender green loofah plated with a browned orange enoki-and-carrot vegan sakura-shrimp-style topping, no text.

title.zh: 純素三杯雞麻油薑杏鮑菇
title.id: Jamur King Oyster Tiga Cawan Vegan

description.zh: 以杏鮑菇取代肉類，先用植物油煸香老薑與菇塊，再以冰糖、醬油、醬油膏、麻油、水與米酒收成濃郁醬汁，最後拌入辣椒和九層塔的純素三杯風味料理。
description.en: King oyster mushrooms replace meat in this vegan three-cup-style dish: ginger and mushrooms are browned in vegetable oil, then reduced with rock sugar, soy sauce, soy paste, sesame oil, water, and rice wine before chili and basil are stirred in.
description.id: Jamur king oyster menggantikan daging dalam hidangan gaya tiga cawan vegan ini: jahe dan jamur ditumis hingga kecokelatan dalam minyak nabati, lalu dimasak hingga menyusut bersama gula batu, kecap asin, pasta kecap asin, minyak wijen, air, dan arak beras sebelum cabai serta kemangi dimasukkan.
description.fil: Pinapalitan ng mga King oyster mushroom ang karne sa vegan na three-cup-style na dish na ito: ang luya at mushroom ay pini-brown sa vegetable oil, pagkatapos ay binabawasan ng rock sugar, toyo, soy paste, sesame oil, tubig, at rice wine bago ihalo ang sili at basil.

title.fil: Gupitin ang mga mushroom at aromatics

instruction.zh: 杏鮑菇切成滾刀塊；老薑切成盡量薄的片，辣椒切斜片；去掉九層塔較粗的梗，只保留葉子。
instruction.en: Cut the king oyster mushrooms into rolling-cut chunks. Slice the mature ginger as thinly as possible, cut the chili on the diagonal, and remove the coarse Thai basil stems, keeping the leaves.
instruction.id: Potong jamur king oyster menjadi potongan serong. Iris jahe tua setipis mungkin, potong cabai secara diagonal, lalu buang batang kemangi Thailand yang kasar dan sisakan daunnya.
instruction.fil: Gupitin ang mga king oyster mushroom sa rolling-cut chunks. Hiwain ang mature na luya nang manipis hangga't maaari, gupitin ang sili sa dayagonal, at alisin ang magaspang na tangkay ng Thai basil, pinapanatili ang mga dahon.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic 16:9 vegan cooking prep image with king oyster mushroom chunks, paper-thin ginger slices, diagonal chili slices, and picked Thai basil leaves arranged on a cutting board; no text, no watermark, no logo.

title.en: Fry the ginger in vegetable oil
title.fil: Iprito ang luya sa langis ng gulay

instruction.zh: 炒鍋加入少量植物油，先下老薑片煸炒至略微捲曲。影片說明先用植物油可避免麻油在高溫下變苦，麻油留待後段加入。
instruction.en: Add a little vegetable oil to a wok and fry the ginger slices until they curl slightly. The video uses vegetable oil first to keep sesame oil from turning bitter at high heat; add the sesame oil later.
instruction.id: Masukkan sedikit minyak nabati ke wajan lalu tumis irisan jahe hingga sedikit melengkung. Video memakai minyak nabati terlebih dahulu agar minyak wijen tidak pahit pada suhu tinggi; minyak wijen ditambahkan belakangan.
instruction.fil: Magdagdag ng kaunting langis ng gulay sa isang kawali at iprito ang mga hiwa ng luya hanggang sa bahagyang mabaluktot. Gumagamit muna ang video ng vegetable oil para hindi maging mapait ang sesame oil sa sobrang init; idagdag ang sesame oil mamaya.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic close-up 16:9 vegan wok scene of thin ginger slices gently frying and beginning to curl in a small amount of vegetable oil; no meat, no text, no watermark, no logo.

title.id: Tumis jamur king oyster hingga keemasan

instruction.zh: 加入杏鮑菇與薑片一起煸炒，耐心煸至表面呈金黃焦色；這一步讓菇類出水並吸收香氣。
instruction.en: Add the king oyster mushrooms with the ginger and patiently fry until their surfaces are golden and lightly browned. This lets the mushrooms release moisture and take on aroma.
instruction.id: Masukkan jamur king oyster bersama jahe lalu tumis dengan sabar hingga permukaannya berwarna keemasan dan agak kecokelatan. Langkah ini membuat jamur mengeluarkan cairan dan menyerap aroma.
instruction.fil: Idagdag ang king oyster mushroom na may luya at matiyagang iprito hanggang sa maging ginintuang kulay at bahagyang kayumanggi ang ibabaw nito. Hinahayaan nito ang mga mushroom na maglabas ng moisture at magkaroon ng aroma.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic 16:9 vegan stir-fry image of browned king oyster mushroom chunks and curled ginger slices in a wok, deeply golden edges but no animal ingredients, no text, no watermark, no logo.

title.en: Add sugar and the three-cup-style seasonings
title.id: Tambahkan gula dan bumbu gaya tiga cawan
title.fil: Magdagdag ng asukal at ang three-cup-style seasonings

instruction.zh: 加入冰糖炒至融化、讓杏鮑菇帶上油亮焦糖色；接著加入醬油、醬油膏與麻油拌炒上色。
instruction.en: Add rock sugar and cook until melted so the mushrooms take on a glossy caramel color. Then add soy sauce, soy paste, and sesame oil, stirring to coat and color them.
instruction.id: Masukkan gula batu dan masak hingga meleleh agar jamur berwarna karamel mengilap. Kemudian tambahkan kecap asin, pasta kecap asin, dan minyak wijen sambil diaduk hingga terlapisi dan berwarna.
instruction.fil: Magdagdag ng asukal sa bato at lutuin hanggang matunaw upang ang mga mushroom ay kumuha ng isang makintab na kulay ng karamelo. Pagkatapos ay idagdag ang toyo, soy paste, at sesame oil, haluin para malagyan at kulayan ang mga ito.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic 16:9 vegan cooking image of rock sugar melting into glossy browned king oyster mushrooms while soy sauce and sesame oil coat the wok contents; no text, no watermark, no logo.

title.en: Add water and rice wine, then reduce
title.id: Tambahkan air dan arak beras lalu susutkan saus
title.fil: Magdagdag ng tubig at rice wine, pagkatapos ay bawasan

instruction.zh: 加入少量水和米酒；不使用料理米酒時只加水即可。繼續煮至醬汁濃稠，但鍋中仍保留一些醬汁。
instruction.en: Add a little water and rice wine; use only water if you do not use cooking rice wine. Continue cooking until the sauce is thick while some sauce still remains in the wok.
instruction.id: Tambahkan sedikit air dan arak beras; gunakan air saja bila tidak memakai arak masak. Lanjutkan memasak hingga saus mengental namun masih tersisa sedikit saus di wajan.
instruction.fil: Magdagdag ng kaunting tubig at rice wine; gumamit lamang ng tubig kung hindi ka gumagamit ng rice wine sa pagluluto. Ipagpatuloy ang pagluluto hanggang sa makapal ang sarsa habang nananatili pa rin ang ilang sarsa sa kawali.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic 16:9 vegan wok image of glossy king oyster mushrooms simmering in a thick dark three-cup-style sauce with a little liquid still visible; no text, no watermark, no logo.

title.zh: 以辣椒和九層塔大火快炒
title.id: Tumis cepat dengan cabai dan kemangi
title.fil: Flash-stir-fry na may sili at basil

instruction.zh: 醬汁濃稠但未完全收乾時，加入九層塔葉與辣椒片，用大火快速拌炒後即可盛盤；可配白飯享用。
instruction.en: When the sauce is thick but not completely dry, add the Thai basil leaves and chili slices. Flash-stir-fry over high heat, plate, and serve with rice if desired.
instruction.id: Saat saus telah mengental tetapi belum kering seluruhnya, masukkan daun kemangi Thailand dan irisan cabai. Tumis cepat dengan api besar, sajikan, dan nikmati dengan nasi bila diinginkan.
instruction.fil: Kapag malapot na ang sauce ngunit hindi pa ganap na tuyo, ilagay ang Thai basil leaves at chili slices. Flash-stir-fry sa mataas na init, plato, at ihain kasama ng kanin kung gusto.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic 16:9 finished vegan three-cup king oyster mushrooms in a wok, glossy brown mushrooms tossed with fresh Thai basil and red chili slices, strictly no meat, no text, no watermark, no logo.

title.zh: 純素豆腐鑲肉黑白大廚豆腐地獄讓我們也出一道
title.en: Vegan Stuffed Tofu with Plant-Based Filling
title.id: Tahu Isi Vegan dengan Isian Nabati
title.fil: Vegan Stuffed Tofu na may Plant-Based Filling

description.zh: 挖空板豆腐後，填入以板豆腐、凍豆腐、香菇、茄子和老薑製成的純素肉感餡料，煎至金黃再以醬油、味醂和五香粉滷製。
description.en: Firm tofu is hollowed and filled with a vegan meat-like mixture of tofu, frozen tofu, shiitake, eggplant, and ginger, pan-fried golden, then braised with soy sauce, mirin, and five-spice.
description.id: Tahu padat dilubangi lalu diisi adonan bercita rasa daging dari tahu, tahu beku, shiitake, terong, dan jahe; kemudian digoreng hingga keemasan dan diungkep dengan kecap asin, mirin, serta lima rempah.
description.fil: Ang matigas na tofu ay may hollowed at puno ng isang vegan na parang karne na pinaghalong tofu, frozen na tofu, shiitake, talong, at luya, piniritong ginto, pagkatapos ay nilaga ng toyo, mirin, at limang pampalasa.

title.zh: 挖出板豆腐的填餡空間
title.en: Hollow the firm tofu for filling
title.fil: Guwangin ang matibay na tofu para sa pagpuno

instruction.zh: 把板豆腐切成四等份，在每塊中央挖出凹槽，但不要挖到底以免填餡時破裂。可先用剪刀勾出輪廓，再用湯匙挖取豆腐。
instruction.en: Cut the firm tofu into four portions and hollow a cavity in the center of each without cutting through the base, so it will not break when filled. The video suggests outlining it with scissors before scooping with a spoon.
instruction.id: Potong tahu padat menjadi empat bagian dan buat cekungan di tengah tiap bagian tanpa menembus dasarnya agar tidak pecah saat diisi. Video menyarankan membuat garis dengan gunting terlebih dahulu lalu mengeruknya dengan sendok.
instruction.fil: Gupitin ang matibay na tofu sa apat na bahagi at guwangin ang isang lukab sa gitna ng bawat isa nang hindi pinuputol ang base, upang hindi ito masira kapag napuno. Iminumungkahi ng video na i-outline ito gamit ang gunting bago i-scoop gamit ang isang kutsara.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic 16:9 vegan recipe tutorial image of firm tofu portions being carefully hollowed with a spoon into sturdy tofu cups, no meat, no text, no watermark, no logo.

title.en: Chop and brown the vegan filling
title.fil: I-chop at kayumanggi ang vegan filling

instruction.zh: 把挖出的板豆腐、剝成小塊的凍豆腐，以及切末的鮮香菇、茄子和老薑混合。將餡料下鍋炒至金黃，再加入醬油、糖和胡椒粉炒香。
instruction.en: Combine the scooped firm tofu, frozen tofu torn into small pieces, and finely chopped fresh shiitake, eggplant, and mature ginger. Fry the filling until golden, then season with soy sauce, sugar, and ground pepper until fragrant.
instruction.id: Campurkan tahu padat yang dikeruk, tahu beku yang disobek kecil-kecil, serta shiitake segar, terong, dan jahe tua yang dicincang halus. Tumis isian hingga keemasan, lalu bumbui dengan kecap asin, gula, dan lada bubuk hingga harum.
instruction.fil: Pagsamahin ang scooped firm tofu, frozen tofu na pinunit sa maliliit na piraso, at pinong tinadtad na sariwang shiitake, talong, at mature na luya. Iprito ang palaman hanggang sa maging ginintuang, pagkatapos ay timplahan ng toyo, asukal, at giniling na paminta hanggang mabango.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic 16:9 vegan wok scene of crumbled tofu, frozen tofu, chopped shiitake, eggplant and ginger turning golden, no animal products, no text, no watermark, no logo.

title.en: Bind the filling with potato-starch slurry
title.id: Ikat isian dengan larutan pati kentang
title.fil: Itali ang pagpuno ng potato-starch slurry

instruction.zh: 把炒好的餡料盛出，加入太白粉和水拌勻至濃稠。影片說明可用蓮藕粉或玉米粉取代太白粉。
instruction.en: Transfer the browned filling to a bowl and mix in potato starch and water until thick. The video notes that lotus-root starch or cornstarch can replace the potato starch.
instruction.id: Pindahkan isian yang telah ditumis ke mangkuk lalu campurkan pati kentang dan air hingga mengental. Video menyebut pati akar teratai atau pati jagung dapat menggantikan pati kentang.
instruction.fil: Ilipat ang browned filling sa isang mangkok at ihalo sa potato starch at tubig hanggang lumapot. Ang video ay nagsasaad na ang lotus-root starch o cornstarch ay maaaring palitan ang potato starch.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic overhead 16:9 vegan prep image of a thick savory tofu-and-vegetable filling being mixed with a clear starch slurry in a bowl, no text, no watermark, no logo.

title.en: Fill the tofu tightly and pan-fry golden
title.id: Isi tahu rapat lalu goreng hingga keemasan
title.fil: Punan ng mahigpit ang tofu at iprito ng ginto

instruction.zh: 先在挖空的豆腐內側抹一點太白粉，再把餡料緊緊填入，頂部可略微隆起但避免壓破豆腐。平底鍋加少量植物油，將每一面煎至金黃；煎有餡的一面時可貼鍋邊並以筷子輕壓防止掉餡。
instruction.en: Dust the inside of each hollowed tofu piece with a little potato starch, then pack in the filling firmly. Let it mound slightly without breaking the tofu. Add a little vegetable oil to a skillet and fry every side golden; when frying the filled side, brace it at the pan edge and press gently with chopsticks to keep the filling in place.
instruction.id: Olesi bagian dalam tahu yang telah dilubangi dengan sedikit pati kentang, lalu padatkan isian di dalamnya. Biarkan sedikit menonjol tanpa memecahkan tahu. Tambahkan sedikit minyak nabati ke wajan dan goreng tiap sisi hingga keemasan; saat menggoreng sisi berisi, sangga di tepi wajan dan tekan lembut dengan sumpit agar isian tidak lepas.
instruction.fil: Alikabok ang loob ng bawat hollowed tofu piraso ng isang maliit na patatas na almirol, pagkatapos ay pack sa pagpuno matatag. Hayaang bumagsak nang bahagya nang hindi masira ang tofu. Magdagdag ng kaunting langis ng gulay sa isang kawali at iprito ang bawat panig na ginintuang; kapag piniprito ang napunong bahagi, itali ito sa gilid ng kawali at dahan-dahang pindutin ng chopsticks upang panatilihing nasa lugar ang laman.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic 16:9 vegan pan-frying image of stuffed tofu cups with browned plant-based filling, each side turning golden in a nonstick skillet, no meat, no text, no watermark, no logo.

title.en: Make the braising sauce and braise for 10 minutes
title.id: Buat kuah ungkep dan masak tertutup 10 menit
title.fil: Gawin ang braising sauce at ilaga ng 10 minuto

instruction.zh: 小湯鍋加入醬油、味醂、五香粉和水煮滾，放入煎好的豆腐，加蓋滷10分鐘。
instruction.en: Bring soy sauce, mirin, five-spice powder, and water to a boil in a small pot. Add the fried stuffed tofu, cover, and braise for 10 minutes.
instruction.id: Didihkan kecap asin, mirin, bubuk lima rempah, dan air dalam panci kecil. Masukkan tahu isi yang telah digoreng, tutup, lalu ungkep selama 10 menit.
instruction.fil: Pakuluan ang toyo, mirin, five-spice powder, at tubig sa isang maliit na palayok. Idagdag ang piniritong pinalamanan na tofu, takpan, at i-braise ng 10 minuto.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic 16:9 vegan braising image of golden stuffed tofu simmering in a small pot of dark soy-mirin five-spice sauce under a glass lid, no text, no watermark, no logo.

title.zh: 中火收汁並以香菜完成
title.en: Reduce over medium heat and finish with cilantro
title.id: Susutkan dengan api sedang dan akhiri dengan ketumbar
title.fil: Bawasan sa katamtamang init at tapusin sa cilantro

instruction.zh: 滷10分鐘後開蓋轉中火，將湯汁略收至色澤更濃亮；關火盛盤，撒上香菜即可。
instruction.en: After 10 minutes, uncover and turn the heat to medium, reducing the sauce slightly until darker and glossier. Turn off the heat, plate, and scatter with cilantro.
instruction.id: Setelah 10 menit, buka tutup dan naikkan ke api sedang, lalu susutkan saus sedikit hingga lebih gelap dan mengilap. Matikan api, sajikan, dan taburi ketumbar.
instruction.fil: Pagkatapos ng 10 minuto, alisan ng takip at gawing katamtaman ang init, bahagyang bawasan ang sarsa hanggang sa mas madilim at makintab. Patayin ang apoy, plato, at lagyan ng cilantro.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic 16:9 finished vegan stuffed tofu plated in glossy dark braising sauce and topped with fresh cilantro, no animal products, no text, no watermark, no logo.

title.zh: 純素蒼蠅頭差點變成毛毛蟲大餐 實地採收XX大公開
title.id: Cang Ying Tou Vegan dengan Asparagus
title.fil: Vegan Fly Heads na may Asparagus

description.zh: 以細綠蘆筍取代韭菜、油豆腐與凍豆腐碎取代絞肉，搭配黑豆豉、辣椒與香料快炒的無韭菜、無肉純素蒼蠅頭。
description.en: Thin green asparagus replaces chives and crumbled fried tofu with frozen tofu replaces minced meat in this vegan fly-heads-style stir-fry with fermented black beans, chili, and spices.
description.id: Asparagus hijau tipis menggantikan kucai, sedangkan tahu goreng dan tahu beku yang dihancurkan menggantikan daging cincang dalam tumis gaya cang ying tou vegan dengan tauco hitam fermentasi, cabai, dan rempah.
description.fil: Pinapalitan ng manipis na berdeng asparagus ang chives at pinapalitan ng crumbled fried tofu na may frozen tofu ang minced meat sa vegan fly-heads-style stir-fry na may fermented black beans, chili, at spices.

instruction.zh: 把油豆腐和凍豆腐撥成細碎，作為取代絞肉的口感基底，先放在一旁備用。
instruction.en: Crumble the fried tofu and frozen tofu finely to create a texture that replaces minced meat, then set it aside.
instruction.id: Hancurkan tahu goreng dan tahu beku hingga halus untuk menciptakan tekstur pengganti daging cincang, lalu sisihkan.
instruction.fil: Durog-durog nang pino ang piniritong tofu at frozen tofu para makagawa ng texture na pumapalit sa tinadtad na karne, pagkatapos ay itabi ito.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic 16:9 vegan preparation image of fried tofu and frozen tofu being crumbled into a fine plant-based mince on a clean board, no meat, no text, no watermark, no logo.

title.en: Chop the asparagus and black beans
title.fil: I-chop ang asparagus at black beans

instruction.zh: 選較細的綠蘆筍切成末，讓外觀與口感近似韭菜；黑豆豉也略切碎，部分可保留整粒以增加口感。
instruction.en: Choose thin green asparagus and chop it finely so its appearance and texture resemble chives. Roughly chop the fermented black beans too, leaving some whole if desired for texture.
instruction.id: Pilih asparagus hijau yang tipis lalu cincang halus agar tampilan dan teksturnya menyerupai kucai. Cincang kasar juga tauco hitam fermentasi, dan sisakan sebagian utuh bila diinginkan untuk tekstur.
instruction.fil: Pumili ng manipis na berdeng asparagus at i-chop ito ng pino upang ang hitsura at texture nito ay maging katulad ng chives. I-chop din ang fermented black beans, mag-iwan ng buo kung gusto para sa texture.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic overhead 16:9 vegan prep image of finely chopped thin green asparagus and roughly chopped fermented black beans in separate small bowls, no text, no watermark, no logo.

title.en: Crisp the tofu crumble and fry the black beans
title.id: Renyahkan remahan tahu dan tumis tauco hitam
title.fil: Crisp ang tofu crumble at iprito ang black beans

instruction.zh: 熱鍋先炒油豆腐與凍豆腐碎，煎炒至酥脆；加入黑豆豉繼續煸炒至香氣釋出。
instruction.en: Heat a wok and fry the crumbled fried tofu and frozen tofu until crisp. Add the fermented black beans and continue frying until fragrant.
instruction.id: Panaskan wajan lalu tumis remahan tahu goreng dan tahu beku hingga renyah. Tambahkan tauco hitam fermentasi dan lanjutkan menumis hingga harum.
instruction.fil: Mag-init ng kawali at iprito ang piniritong tofu at frozen tofu hanggang malutong. Idagdag ang fermented black beans at ipagpatuloy ang pagprito hanggang sa mabango.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic 16:9 vegan wok scene of crisp crumbled fried tofu and frozen tofu with fragrant fermented black beans, no animal products, no text, no watermark, no logo.

title.en: Season and let the tofu absorb the sauce
title.id: Bumbui dan biarkan tahu menyerap saus
title.fil: Timplahan at hayaang masipsip ng tofu ang sarsa

instruction.zh: 加入醬油、胡椒粉與五香粉拌炒，再倒入少量水，讓凍豆腐與油豆腐吸收醬汁；略為收汁即可。
instruction.en: Stir-fry with soy sauce, ground pepper, and five-spice powder, then add a little water so the frozen and fried tofu absorb the sauce. Reduce briefly.
instruction.id: Tumis dengan kecap asin, lada bubuk, dan bubuk lima rempah, lalu tambahkan sedikit air agar tahu beku dan tahu goreng menyerap saus. Susutkan sebentar.
instruction.fil: Igisa na may toyo, giniling na paminta, at limang pampalasa na pulbos, pagkatapos ay magdagdag ng kaunting tubig upang ang frozen at pritong tofu ay sumipsip ng sarsa. Bawasan sandali.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic 16:9 vegan cooking image of tofu crumble absorbing a savory dark sauce in a wok with a small amount of liquid reducing, no text, no watermark, no logo.

instruction.zh: 醬汁略收、仍留少量湯汁時加入辣椒和切末蘆筍，大火快速拌炒。細蘆筍很快熟，起鍋前淋少量香油增添香氣。
instruction.en: When the sauce has reduced but a little liquid remains, add chili and the chopped asparagus, then flash-stir-fry over high heat. Thin asparagus cooks quickly; drizzle with a little sesame oil before serving for aroma.
instruction.id: Saat saus telah agak menyusut tetapi masih tersisa sedikit cairan, masukkan cabai dan asparagus cincang lalu tumis cepat dengan api besar. Asparagus tipis cepat matang; gerimis dengan sedikit minyak wijen sebelum disajikan untuk aroma.
instruction.fil: Kapag nabawasan na ang sarsa pero may natitira pang likido, ilagay ang sili at tinadtad na asparagus, pagkatapos ay i-flash-stir-fry sa sobrang init. Mabilis na niluto ang manipis na asparagus; pahiran ng kaunting sesame oil bago ihain para sa aroma.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic 16:9 finished vegan fly-heads-style stir-fry of crispy tofu crumble, thin green asparagus, fermented black beans, and red chili in a wok, no meat, no text, no watermark, no logo.

description.zh: 蒸熟後略煎的饅頭夾入檸檬橄欖油酪梨泥、番茄片與綿密的嫩豆腐鷹嘴豆芝麻醬，是快速的純素早午餐。
description.en: Steamed, lightly pan-crisped mantou is filled with lemon-olive-oil avocado mash, tomato slices, and a smooth soft-tofu chickpea tahini spread for a quick vegan brunch.
description.id: Mantou yang dikukus lalu dipanggang sebentar diisi dengan alpukat lumat berisi lemon dan minyak zaitun, irisan tomat, serta olesan halus tahu sutra, buncis, dan tahini untuk brunch vegan cepat.
description.fil: Ang steamed, lightly pan-crisped mantou ay puno ng lemon-olive-oil avocado mash, mga hiwa ng kamatis, at isang makinis na soft-tofu chickpea tahini na kumalat para sa isang mabilis na vegan brunch.

title.zh: 蒸熱饅頭並切配番茄檸檬
title.en: Steam the mantou and prepare tomato and lemon
title.id: Kukus mantou dan siapkan tomat serta lemon
title.fil: I-steam ang mantou at maghanda ng kamatis at lemon

instruction.zh: 把市售饅頭蒸熟蒸熱；影片使用電鍋，外鍋加一杯水。番茄切片，檸檬擠成汁。
instruction.en: Steam store-bought mantou until hot and cooked through; the video uses one cup of water in the outer pot of an electric cooker. Slice the tomato and squeeze the lemon into juice.
instruction.id: Kukus mantou siap beli hingga panas dan matang; video menggunakan satu cangkir air di panci luar rice cooker listrik. Iris tomat dan peras lemon menjadi jus.
instruction.fil: Singaw na binili ng mantou sa tindahan hanggang sa mainit at maluto; ang video ay gumagamit ng isang tasa ng tubig sa panlabas na palayok ng isang electric cooker. Hiwain ang kamatis at pisilin ang lemon sa katas.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic 16:9 vegan recipe preparation image of steamed plain mantou beside tomato slices and a freshly squeezed lemon, no text, no watermark, no logo.

instruction.zh: 把熟透酪梨去核取肉，先加入橄欖油和檸檬汁，再以湯匙壓成喜歡的細緻度；影片先加入酸與油以減少氧化變黑。
instruction.en: Pit the ripe avocado and scoop out the flesh. Add olive oil and lemon juice first, then mash with a spoon to your preferred texture; the video adds acid and oil early to limit browning.
instruction.id: Buang biji alpukat matang lalu keruk dagingnya. Tambahkan minyak zaitun dan jus lemon terlebih dahulu, kemudian lumatkan dengan sendok sesuai tekstur yang diinginkan; video menambahkan asam dan minyak sejak awal untuk mengurangi penghitaman.
instruction.fil: I-pit ang hinog na abukado at i-scop out ang laman. Magdagdag ng langis ng oliba at lemon juice muna, pagkatapos ay i-mash gamit ang isang kutsara sa iyong ginustong texture; ang video ay nagdaragdag ng acid at langis nang maaga upang limitahan ang browning.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic overhead 16:9 vegan prep image of ripe avocado being mashed with lemon juice and olive oil in a bowl, creamy with a few small chunks, no text, no watermark, no logo.

instruction.zh: 把三分之一塊嫩豆腐和罐頭鷹嘴豆放入調理機，加入芝麻醬、檸檬汁、鹽和黑胡椒，攪打至綿密細緻。
instruction.en: Put one-third block of soft tofu and canned chickpeas in a blender. Add tahini, lemon juice, salt, and black pepper, then blend until smooth and creamy.
instruction.id: Masukkan sepertiga blok tahu sutra dan buncis kalengan ke blender. Tambahkan tahini, jus lemon, garam, dan lada hitam, lalu haluskan hingga lembut dan creamy.
instruction.fil: Ilagay ang isang-ikatlong bloke ng malambot na tofu at mga de-latang chickpeas sa isang blender. Magdagdag ng tahini, lemon juice, asin, at itim na paminta, pagkatapos ay timpla hanggang makinis at mag-atas.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic 16:9 vegan food preparation image of a blender jar filled with smooth pale tofu chickpea tahini spread and lemon, no text, no watermark, no logo.

title.id: Belah dan panggang mantou hingga renyah

instruction.zh: 將蒸好的饅頭對半剖開。平底鍋加少量植物油，把切面煎至金黃微脆；不想煎也可直接組合。
instruction.en: Split the steamed mantou in half. Add a little vegetable oil to a skillet and pan-fry the cut faces until golden and lightly crisp; assemble directly instead if you prefer not to fry it.
instruction.id: Belah mantou kukus menjadi dua. Tambahkan sedikit minyak nabati ke wajan lalu panggang sisi potongnya hingga keemasan dan sedikit renyah; bila tidak ingin memanggangnya, langsung saja dirakit.
instruction.fil: Hatiin ang steamed mantou sa kalahati. Magdagdag ng kaunting langis ng gulay sa isang kawali at i-pan-fry ang mga hiwa ng mukha hanggang sa ginintuang at bahagyang malutong; mag-ipon nang direkta sa halip kung mas gusto mong hindi iprito ito.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic 16:9 vegan skillet image of halved plain mantou turning golden and crisp on the cut sides in a lightly oiled pan, no text, no watermark, no logo.

instruction.zh: 在一半饅頭上依序放入酪梨泥、豆腐鷹嘴豆醬和番茄片；可加香菜，蓋上另一半饅頭即可享用。
instruction.en: Layer avocado mash, tofu chickpea spread, and tomato slices on one mantou half. Add cilantro if desired, then close with the other half and serve.
instruction.id: Susun alpukat lumat, olesan tahu buncis, dan irisan tomat di atas satu belahan mantou. Tambahkan daun ketumbar bila suka, tutup dengan belahan lainnya, lalu sajikan.
instruction.fil: Layer ng avocado mash, tofu chickpea spread, at mga hiwa ng kamatis sa kalahating mantou. Magdagdag ng cilantro kung ninanais, pagkatapos ay isara sa isa pang kalahati at ihain.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic 16:9 finished vegan mantou sandwich overflowing with avocado mash, creamy tofu chickpea spread and tomato slices, optional cilantro, no text, no watermark, no logo.

description.zh:
三款涼拌小黃瓜的清爽食譜，開胃解暑的夏日小菜
涼拌小黃瓜，是許多人夏日餐桌上的常客。這道清爽開胃的小菜，不僅口感脆嫩，多變的調味更是令人回味無窮。如果你也想為日常餐點增添一些變化，不妨跟著我們一起在家動手做吧！
我們將為您介紹三種不同風味的涼拌小黃瓜，每種都有其獨特的魅力。
description.en: Three refreshing cucumber salads for summer, with Taiwanese, Japanese, and Korean-style flavors.
description.id: Tiga salad timun segar untuk musim panas, dengan rasa gaya Taiwan, Jepang, dan Korea.
description.fil: Tatlong nakakapreskong cucumber salad para sa tag-araw, na may Taiwanese, Japanese, at Korean-style na lasa.

title.fil: Gupitin ang mga pipino para sa tatlong estilo

instruction.zh: 每款使用2條小黃瓜：台式切段拍扁，日式切圓薄片，韓式切段後在頂部劃十字刀但不切斷，刀口約2至3公分。
instruction.en: Use 2 cucumbers per variation: cut and smash for Taiwanese style, slice into thin rounds for Japanese style, and cut into sections then make an uncut 2–3 cm cross at the top for Korean style.
instruction.id: Gunakan 2 timun per variasi: potong dan geprek untuk gaya Taiwan, iris tipis bulat untuk gaya Jepang, dan potong lalu buat sayatan silang 2–3 cm yang tidak putus di bagian atas untuk gaya Korea.
instruction.fil: Gumamit ng 2 cucumber bawat variation: gupitin at durugin para sa Taiwanese style, hiwain ng manipis na bilog para sa Japanese style, at gupitin sa mga seksyon pagkatapos ay gumawa ng hindi pinutol na 2–3 cm na krus sa itaas para sa Korean style.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Cut cucumbers for three styles”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

instruction.zh: 每款加入1大匙糖與1小匙鹽，略抓拌後醃30分鐘。
instruction.en: Add 1 tablespoon sugar and 1 teaspoon salt to each variation, toss lightly, and cure for 30 minutes.
instruction.id: Tambahkan 1 sdm gula dan 1 sdt garam ke setiap variasi, aduk ringan, lalu marinasi 30 menit.
instruction.fil: Magdagdag ng 1 kutsarang asukal at 1 kutsarita ng asin sa bawat variation, ihalo nang bahagya, at pagalingin sa loob ng 30 minuto.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Salt and sugar cure”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

instruction.zh: 老薑和辣椒切末，加入味醂、醋和少量香油拌勻。
instruction.en: Mince mature ginger and chili, then mix with mirin, vinegar, and a little sesame oil.
instruction.id: Cincang jahe tua dan cabai, lalu campurkan dengan mirin, cuka, dan sedikit minyak wijen.
instruction.fil: Hiwain ang mature na luya at sili, pagkatapos ay ihalo sa mirin, suka, at kaunting sesame oil.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Make Taiwanese-style sauce”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

instruction.zh: 將味噌、白芝麻、少量日式醬油和水攪拌至味噌散開。
instruction.en: Mix miso, white sesame, a little Japanese soy sauce, and water until the miso dissolves.
instruction.id: Aduk miso, wijen putih, sedikit kecap asin Jepang, dan air hingga miso larut.
instruction.fil: Paghaluin ang miso, puting linga, kaunting Japanese toyo, at tubig hanggang sa matunaw ang miso.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Make Japanese-style sauce”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

instruction.zh: 紅蘿蔔和蘋果切絲；將味噌、韓式辣椒粉、香油和少量蘋果醋拌勻，再拌入紅蘿蔔絲和蘋果絲。
instruction.en: Shred carrot and apple. Mix miso, Korean chili powder, sesame oil, and a little apple cider vinegar, then mix in the carrot and apple shreds.
instruction.id: Serut wortel dan apel. Campurkan miso, bubuk cabai Korea, minyak wijen, dan sedikit cuka apel, lalu campurkan serutan wortel dan apel.
instruction.fil: Hiwain ang karot at mansanas. Paghaluin ang miso, Korean chili powder, sesame oil, at kaunting apple cider vinegar, pagkatapos ay ihalo ang carrot at apple shreds.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Make Korean-style sauce”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

instruction.zh: 小黃瓜醃好後沖洗約2遍，擠出多餘水分，分別拌入對應醬汁。韓式款將紅蘿蔔絲和蘋果絲塞入十字切口；冷藏至少1小時後食用。
instruction.en: After curing, rinse cucumbers about twice, squeeze out excess water, and toss with their matching sauces. For Korean style, tuck carrot and apple shreds into the cross cuts; chill at least 1 hour before serving.
instruction.id: Setelah dimarinasi, bilas timun sekitar dua kali, peras air berlebih, lalu campurkan dengan saus yang sesuai. Untuk gaya Korea, masukkan serutan wortel dan apel ke sayatan silang; dinginkan minimal 1 jam sebelum disajikan.
instruction.fil: Pagkatapos ng paggamot, banlawan ang mga pipino nang halos dalawang beses, pisilin ang labis na tubig, at ihagis sa kanilang mga katugmang sarsa. Para sa istilong Koreano, isuksok ang mga hiwa ng karot at mansanas sa mga cross cut; palamigin ng hindi bababa sa 1 oras bago ihain.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Rinse, dress, and chill”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

title.zh: 泰式打拋豬沒有豬的打拋豬

description.zh:
全素泰式打拋豬，美味素食新潮流！
全素泰式打拋豬，那獨特的風味是無數人舌尖上的驚喜。這道充滿創意的素食料理，不僅口感豐富，香氣四溢，更是為素食愛好者們帶來了全新的味覺體驗。
description.en: A creative vegan Thai basil 'pork' dish with rich texture and aroma.
description.id: Hidangan 'daging babi' kemangi Thailand vegan yang kreatif dengan tekstur dan aroma kaya.
description.fil: Isang malikhaing vegan Thai basil 'pork' dish na may masaganang texture at aroma.

instruction.zh: 油豆腐剝成小塊；四季豆去頭尾後切小丁，茄子去頭後切小丁。
instruction.en: Tear fried tofu into small pieces. Trim and dice green beans; remove the top of eggplant and dice it.
instruction.id: Suwir tahu goreng menjadi potongan kecil. Buang ujung buncis lalu potong dadu; buang bagian atas terong lalu potong dadu.
instruction.fil: Hatiin ang piniritong tofu sa maliliit na piraso. Gupitin at gupitin ang berdeng beans; tanggalin ang tuktok ng talong at hiwain ito.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Prepare tofu and vegetables”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

instruction.zh: 老薑切末，大辣椒切斜片；檸檬擠汁，九層塔摘下葉片。
instruction.en: Mince mature ginger and slice large chili diagonally; squeeze lemon juice and pick Thai basil leaves.
instruction.id: Cincang jahe tua dan iris cabai besar secara diagonal; peras lemon dan petik daun kemangi Thailand.
instruction.fil: Tadtarin ang mature na luya at hiwain ang malalaking sili nang pahilis; pisilin ang lemon juice at pumili ng dahon ng basil ng Thai.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Prepare aromatics”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

instruction.zh: 炒鍋倒少量植物油，將板豆腐直接放入鍋中剁碎，與油豆腐一起煸至金黃。
instruction.en: Add a little vegetable oil to a wok. Crumble firm tofu directly in the wok and brown it together with the fried tofu until golden.
instruction.id: Tambahkan sedikit minyak nabati ke wajan. Hancurkan tahu padat langsung di wajan dan tumis bersama tahu goreng hingga keemasan.
instruction.fil: Magdagdag ng kaunting langis ng gulay sa isang kawali. Dumurog nang direkta sa matigas na tofu sa wok at i-brown ito kasama ng pritong tofu hanggang sa ginintuang.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Brown the tofu”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

title.zh: 冰鎮滷味：5個步驟做好快速冰涼開胃

description.zh: 豆包、豆乾、百葉豆腐、素雞、杏鮑菇、米血、海帶與玉米筍加入薑和香料滷30分鐘，放涼後連同滷汁冷藏一天，做成清爽入味的全素冰鎮滷味。
description.en: Tofu skin, tofu, thousand-layer tofu, vegan chicken, king oyster mushrooms, vegan rice cake, kelp, and baby corn are braised with ginger and spices for 30 minutes, then cooled and chilled in their broth for a day for refreshing vegan braised snacks.
description.id: Kulit tahu, tahu, tahu berlapis, ayam vegan, jamur king oyster, kue beras vegan, kelp, dan jagung muda direbus dengan jahe serta rempah selama 30 menit, lalu didinginkan dan disimpan bersama kuahnya selama sehari untuk camilan rebus vegan yang segar.
description.fil: Ang balat ng tofu, tofu, thousand-layer tofu, vegan chicken, king oyster mushroom, vegan rice cake, kelp, at baby corn ay niluluto na may luya at pampalasa sa loob ng 30 minuto, pagkatapos ay pinalamig at pinalamig sa kanilang sabaw sa loob ng isang araw para sa nakakapreskong vegan braised na meryenda.

title.en: Cut the braising ingredients that need prep
title.id: Potong bahan rebusan yang perlu disiapkan
title.fil: Gupitin ang mga sangkap ng braising na nangangailangan ng paghahanda

instruction.zh: 將豆乾、豆包、百葉豆腐、杏鮑菇和素米血切成塊狀；海帶、玉米筍和辣椒只需清洗。
instruction.en: Cut the firm tofu, tofu skin, thousand-layer tofu, king oyster mushrooms, and vegan rice cake into chunks. Only wash the kelp, baby corn, and chili.
instruction.id: Potong tahu padat, kulit tahu, tahu berlapis, jamur king oyster, dan kue beras vegan menjadi potongan. Kelp, jagung muda, dan cabai cukup dicuci.
instruction.fil: Gupitin ang matigas na tofu, balat ng tofu, thousand-layer na tofu, king oyster mushroom, at vegan rice cake sa mga piraso. Hugasan lamang ang kelp, baby corn, at sili.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic overhead 16:9 vegan recipe prep image of assorted tofu products, king oyster mushrooms and vegan rice cake cut into chunks with washed kelp, baby corn and chili, no text, no watermark, no logo.

title.zh: 以薑爆香並炒過主要滷料
title.en: Fragrance the ginger and briefly fry the main ingredients
title.id: Tumis jahe hingga harum dan tumis bahan utama sebentar
title.fil: Haluin ang luya at iprito saglit ang mga pangunahing sangkap

instruction.zh: 滷鍋加入少量植物油，先煸老薑至香氣釋出並略微捲曲；加入豆包、豆乾、杏鮑菇和素雞稍微拌炒。
instruction.en: Add a little vegetable oil to a braising pot and fry the mature ginger until fragrant and slightly curled. Add the tofu skin, firm tofu, king oyster mushrooms, and vegan chicken and toss briefly.
instruction.id: Tambahkan sedikit minyak nabati ke panci rebusan lalu tumis jahe tua hingga harum dan sedikit melengkung. Masukkan kulit tahu, tahu padat, jamur king oyster, dan ayam vegan lalu aduk sebentar.
instruction.fil: Magdagdag ng kaunting vegetable oil sa isang braising pot at iprito ang hinog na luya hanggang sa mabango at bahagyang kulot. Idagdag ang balat ng tofu, matigas na tofu, king oyster mushroom, at vegan na manok at ihagis sandali.

instruction.zh: 將 150 克樹薯粉與 200 克水攪拌至完全均勻、沒有粉粒。

title.fil: Gumawa ng mapo tofu fried rice

instruction.zh: 將處理好的麻婆豆腐蔬菜與熟飯拌炒，作為麻婆豆腐炒飯食用。
instruction.en: Stir-fry the prepared mapo tofu vegetables with cooked rice to serve as mapo tofu fried rice.
instruction.id: Tumis campuran sayuran mapo tofu yang telah disiapkan bersama nasi matang untuk disajikan sebagai nasi goreng mapo tofu.
instruction.fil: Igisa ang inihandang mapo tofu na gulay na may lutong kanin para magsilbing mapo tofu fried rice.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Make mapo tofu fried rice”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

title.en: One-Pot Vegan Taro and “Lean Meat” Congee
title.id: Bubur Talas dan “Daging” Vegan Satu Panci
title.fil: One-Pot Vegan Taro at "Lean Meat" Congee

description.zh: 以冷凍豆腐做出純素瘦肉口感，配上芋頭、金針菇、老薑及1:8米水比例，一鍋煮成濃郁暖胃的古早味粥品。
description.en: Frozen tofu supplies the vegan “lean meat” texture in this warming taro congee, cooked with enoki, ginger and a 1:8 rice-to-water ratio.
description.id: Tahu beku memberi tekstur “daging” vegan pada bubur talas yang hangat ini, dimasak bersama enoki, jahe, serta perbandingan beras dan air 1:8.
description.fil: Ang frozen na tofu ay nagbibigay ng vegan na "lean meat" na texture sa nakakainit na taro congee na ito, na niluto na may enoki, luya at 1:8 rice-to-water ratio.

title.zh: 炒香純素瘦肉與金針菇
title.fil: Brown ang Vegan na "Meat" at Enoki

instruction.zh: 把冷凍豆腐切成小塊，以少量植物油炒至表面乾身酥香，做出純素瘦肉口感；金針菇另炒至金黃，做出類似油蔥酥的香氣。
instruction.en: Cut the frozen tofu into small pieces and sauté in a little vegetable oil until dry and crisp on the outside, creating a vegan lean-meat texture. Separately brown the enoki until fragrant like fried shallots.
instruction.id: Potong tahu beku kecil-kecil lalu tumis dengan sedikit minyak nabati hingga permukaannya kering dan renyah untuk memberi tekstur seperti daging. Tumis enoki secara terpisah hingga kecokelatan dan harum seperti bawang goreng.
instruction.fil: Gupitin ang frozen na tofu sa maliliit na piraso at igisa sa isang maliit na langis ng gulay hanggang sa matuyo at malutong sa labas, na lumilikha ng vegan lean-meat texture. Hiwalay na kayumanggi ang enoki hanggang sa mabango tulad ng piniritong shallots.

steps.imagePrompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: 16:9 recipe tutorial step image. Primary request: close food photograph of small frozen-tofu pieces sautéed until dry, crisp and golden in one side of a pan, with finely separated enoki mushrooms browned deeply on the other side. Constraints: strictly vegan; no taro, rice, water, congee, labels, people, text, watermark, or logos. No text.

instruction.zh: 加入芋頭、老薑、醬油及五香粉炒香，再倒入1杯洗淨白米略炒；加入8杯水拌勻煮滾。
instruction.en: Sauté the taro and mature ginger with soy sauce and five-spice until fragrant. Add 1 cup washed rice and stir briefly, then pour in 8 cups water and bring to a boil.
instruction.id: Tumis talas dan jahe tua bersama kecap asin serta bubuk lima rempah hingga harum. Masukkan 1 cangkir beras yang sudah dicuci dan aduk sebentar, lalu tuang 8 cangkir air dan didihkan.
instruction.fil: Igisa ang taro at mature na luya na may toyo at limang pampalasa hanggang sa mabango. Magdagdag ng 1 tasang binagang bigas at haluin sandali, pagkatapos ay ibuhos ang 8 tasa ng tubig at pakuluan.

steps.imagePrompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: 16:9 recipe tutorial step image. Primary request: close preparation photograph of cubed taro, ginger and white rice being briefly stir-fried in a deep pot with a light soy-and-five-spice coating just before water is added. Constraints: strictly vegan; no tofu, enoki, finished congee, garnish, labels, people, text, watermark, or logos. No text.

instruction.zh: 以小火煮20分鐘並間中攪拌，待米粒開花、芋頭軟化及粥身濃稠後，加入炒香的豆腐和金針菇，撒上芹菜粉及胡椒粉。
instruction.en: Simmer over low heat for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the rice blooms, the taro is tender and the congee is thick. Fold in the browned tofu and enoki, then finish with celery powder and ground pepper.
instruction.id: Masak dengan api kecil selama 20 menit sambil sesekali diaduk hingga beras mengembang, talas lunak, dan bubur mengental. Masukkan tahu serta enoki yang telah ditumis, lalu taburi bubuk seledri dan lada.
instruction.fil: Pakuluan sa mahinang apoy sa loob ng 20 minuto, hinahalo paminsan-minsan, hanggang sa mamukadkad ang kanin, malambot ang taro at malapot ang congee. I-fold ang browned tofu at enoki, pagkatapos ay tapusin ng celery powder at ground pepper.

steps.imagePrompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: 16:9 recipe tutorial step image. Primary request: warm editorial close food photograph of thick Taiwanese taro congee in a ceramic bowl, with tender purple-speckled taro cubes, crisp golden tofu morsels and browned enoki on top, lightly dusted with celery and pepper. Constraints: strictly vegan; no meat, egg, dairy, labels, people, text, watermark, or logos. No text.

description.zh: 花椰菜先炒至微焦，再與金黃豆干、香菇、辣豆瓣醬及辛香料大火炒出鍋氣。
description.en: Cauliflower is browned first, then wok-fried over high heat with golden dried tofu, shiitake, spicy bean paste, and aromatics.
description.id: Kembang kol ditumis kecokelatan lalu dimasak api besar bersama tahu kering, shiitake, pasta kacang pedas, dan bumbu aromatik.
description.fil: Ang cauliflower ay unang pinirito, pagkatapos ay pinirito sa wok sa sobrang init na may ginintuang tuyo na tofu, shiitake, spicy bean paste, at aromatics.

instruction.zh: 花椰菜切成小朵，以植物油和鹽炒至邊緣微焦後先盛起。
instruction.en: Cut cauliflower into florets and stir-fry with vegetable oil and salt until lightly browned at the edges, then set aside.
instruction.id: Potong kembang kol menjadi kuntum lalu tumis dengan minyak sayur dan garam hingga tepinya kecokelatan, kemudian sisihkan.
instruction.fil: Gupitin ang cauliflower sa mga florets at iprito na may langis ng gulay at asin hanggang sa bahagyang kayumanggi sa mga gilid, pagkatapos ay itabi.

steps.imagePrompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: 16:9 recipe tutorial step image. Primary request: close food photograph of white cauliflower florets stir-frying in a lightly oiled dark wok with a pinch of salt, edges visibly browned and slightly charred. Constraints: strictly vegan; no tofu, mushrooms, ginger, chili, sauce, meat, eggs, dairy, seafood, labels, people, text, watermark, or logos. No text.

title.en: Fry tofu, mushrooms, and spicy paste
title.id: Tumis tahu, jamur, dan pasta pedas
title.fil: Magprito ng tofu, mushroom, at spicy paste

instruction.zh: 豆干與鮮香菇炒至金黃，再加入老薑、紅辣椒和辣豆瓣醬炒出香氣。
instruction.en: Sauté dried tofu and shiitake until golden, then add ginger, red chili, and spicy bean paste and fry until fragrant.
instruction.id: Tumis tahu kering dan shiitake hingga keemasan, lalu masukkan jahe, cabai merah, dan pasta kacang pedas hingga harum.
instruction.fil: Igisa ang tuyo na tokwa at shiitake hanggang sa ginintuang, pagkatapos ay ilagay ang luya, pulang sili, at spicy bean paste at iprito hanggang mabango.

steps.imagePrompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: 16:9 recipe tutorial step image. Primary request: close food photograph of golden dried tofu strips and sliced fresh shiitake sizzling in a wok with mature ginger, red chili and glossy spicy bean paste. Constraints: strictly vegan; no cauliflower, soy sauce, sugar, meat, eggs, dairy, seafood, labels, people, text, watermark, or logos. No text.

title.en: Return and wok-fry over high heat
title.id: Masukkan kembali dan tumis api besar
title.fil: Ibalik at iprito sa mataas na init

instruction.zh: 花椰菜回鍋，加入醬油、糖與白胡椒粉，以大火快速翻炒至醬汁收乾並帶焦香鍋氣。
instruction.en: Return the cauliflower, add soy sauce, sugar, and white pepper, and toss over high heat until the sauce reduces and develops wok aroma.
instruction.id: Masukkan kembali kembang kol, tambahkan kecap asin, gula, dan lada putih, lalu tumis api besar hingga saus menyusut dan harum wok.
instruction.fil: Ibalik ang cauliflower, magdagdag ng toyo, asukal, at puting paminta, at ihagis sa mataas na apoy hanggang sa mabawasan ang sarsa at magkaroon ng aroma ng wok.

steps.imagePrompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: 16:9 recipe tutorial step image. Primary request: finished vegan dry-pot cauliflower in a dark wok, browned cauliflower florets tossed with golden dried tofu, shiitake, red chili, ginger and a reduced glossy spicy soy sauce, visible wok char. Constraints: strictly vegan; no meat, eggs, dairy, seafood, unrelated ingredients, labels, people, text, watermark, or logos. No text.

description.zh: 用現成五穀飯吸收高麗菜、菇類、菜脯與豆腐炒出的鮮甜湯汁；金針菇帶出近似櫻花蝦的香氣，做成古早味的低脂純素高麗菜飯。
description.en: Cooked multigrain rice absorbs the sweet savory juices from cabbage, mushrooms, preserved radish, and tofu. Enoki provides an aroma reminiscent of dried sakura shrimp in this low-fat, old-fashioned vegan cabbage rice.
description.id: Nasi multibiji-bijian matang menyerap kuah gurih-manis dari kol, jamur, lobak asin, dan tahu. Enoki memberi aroma yang mengingatkan pada udang sakura kering dalam nasi kol vegan rendah lemak bergaya tradisional ini.
description.fil: Ang lutong multigrain rice ay sumisipsip ng matamis na malasang katas mula sa repolyo, mushroom, preserved na labanos, at tofu. Nagbibigay ang Enoki ng aroma na nakapagpapaalaala sa pinatuyong sakura shrimp sa low-fat, makalumang vegan cabbage rice na ito.

instruction.zh: 準備已煮好的五穀飯；影片說明也可改用糙米、紫米或白米。這樣可避免用生米時水量難抓，也讓蔬菜保留脆口。
instruction.en: Prepare cooked multigrain rice; the video says brown rice, purple rice, or white rice can be used instead. Using cooked rice avoids guessing the water for raw rice and helps the vegetables retain a crisp bite.
instruction.id: Siapkan nasi multibiji-bijian yang sudah matang; video menyebut nasi merah, nasi ungu, atau nasi putih juga dapat digunakan. Nasi matang menghindari kesulitan menakar air untuk beras mentah dan membantu sayuran tetap renyah.
instruction.fil: Maghanda ng lutong multigrain rice; ang sabi sa video ay maaaring gamitin ang brown rice, purple rice, o white rice. Ang paggamit ng nilutong bigas ay nag-iwas sa paghula ng tubig para sa hilaw na bigas at tumutulong sa mga gulay na mapanatili ang isang malutong na kagat.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic overhead 16:9 vegan recipe image of fluffy cooked multigrain rice in a bowl beside fresh cabbage and vegetables, no text, no watermark, no logo.

title.en: Prepare the vegetables, mushrooms, and preserved radish
title.id: Siapkan sayuran, jamur, dan lobak asin
title.fil: Ihanda ang mga gulay, mushroom, at preserved na labanos

instruction.zh: 高麗菜洗淨切條，紅蘿蔔切絲，鮮香菇切片，金針菇切小段，老薑切末。菜脯若偏鹹可先泡水約3分鐘；非常鹹則泡約10分鐘，不鹹只需沖洗。
instruction.en: Wash and shred the cabbage, julienne the carrot, slice the fresh shiitake, cut the enoki into short lengths, and mince the mature ginger. If the preserved radish is salty, soak it for about 3 minutes; if very salty, soak about 10 minutes; if not salty, simply rinse it.
instruction.id: Cuci lalu iris kol memanjang, potong wortel korek api, iris shiitake segar, potong enoki pendek-pendek, dan cincang jahe tua. Jika lobak asin terasa asin, rendam sekitar 3 menit; jika sangat asin, rendam sekitar 10 menit; jika tidak asin, cukup bilas.
instruction.fil: Hugasan at gutay-gutayin ang repolyo, julienne ang carrot, hiwain ang sariwang shiitake, gupitin ang enoki sa maikling haba, at tadtarin ang mature na luya. Kung ang napreserbang labanos ay maalat, ibabad ito ng mga 3 minuto; kung masyadong maalat, magbabad ng mga 10 minuto; kung hindi maalat, banlawan lang.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic overhead 16:9 vegan preparation image of shredded cabbage, julienned carrot, sliced shiitake, short enoki pieces, minced ginger and rinsed preserved radish, no text, no watermark, no logo.

title.en: Crumble and brown the firm tofu
title.id: Hancurkan dan tumis tahu padat hingga keemasan
title.fil: Durog at kayumanggi ang matibay na tofu

instruction.zh: 鍋中加少量植物油，將板豆腐直接捏碎或壓碎入鍋，炒成類似散蛋的碎粒並煸至金黃。影片指出也可依喜好改用豆乾。
instruction.en: Add a little vegetable oil to a pot, crumble or press the firm tofu directly into it, and fry it into egg-like crumbs until golden. The video notes that firm dried tofu can be substituted according to preference.
instruction.id: Tambahkan sedikit minyak nabati ke panci, hancurkan atau tekan tahu padat langsung ke dalam panci, lalu tumis menjadi remahan seperti telur orak-arik hingga keemasan. Video menyebut tahu kering dapat digunakan sesuai selera.
instruction.fil: Magdagdag ng kaunting langis ng gulay sa isang kaldero, gumuho o direktang pindutin ang matigas na tofu dito, at iprito ito sa mga mumo na parang itlog hanggang sa ginintuang. Ang video ay nagsasabi na ang matibay na tuyo na tofu ay maaaring palitan ayon sa kagustuhan.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic 16:9 vegan one-pot cooking image of firm tofu crumbled into golden egg-like bits in a pan with no eggs or meat, no text, no watermark, no logo.

title.en: Soften the cabbage and prepared ingredients
title.id: Lunakkan kol dan bahan yang telah disiapkan
title.fil: Palambutin ang repolyo at mga inihandang sangkap

instruction.zh: 將切好的高麗菜、紅蘿蔔、香菇、金針菇、菜脯和薑加入鍋中，拌炒至高麗菜變軟並釋出鮮甜湯汁。
instruction.en: Add the prepared cabbage, carrot, shiitake, enoki, preserved radish, and ginger to the pot. Stir-fry until the cabbage softens and releases sweet savory juices.
instruction.id: Masukkan kol, wortel, shiitake, enoki, lobak asin, dan jahe yang telah disiapkan ke dalam panci. Tumis hingga kol melunak dan mengeluarkan kuah gurih-manis.
instruction.fil: Idagdag ang inihandang repolyo, carrot, shiitake, enoki, preserved na labanos, at luya sa kaldero. Haluin hanggang lumambot ang repolyo at maglabas ng matamis na malasang katas.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic 16:9 vegan one-pot stir-fry image of cabbage, carrot, shiitake, enoki, preserved radish and ginger softening around golden tofu crumbles, no text, no watermark, no logo.

title.en: Fold in rice to absorb the juices
title.fil: Tiklupin ang bigas para maabsorb ang katas

instruction.zh: 蔬菜炒軟後加入熟五穀飯，拌到每一粒米都吸收鍋中的湯汁。起鍋前試味，需要時才加少量鹽，拌勻即可。
instruction.en: Once the vegetables are soft, add the cooked multigrain rice and mix until every grain absorbs the juices in the pot. Taste before serving and add a little salt only if needed, then mix evenly.
instruction.id: Setelah sayuran lunak, masukkan nasi multibiji-bijian matang dan aduk hingga setiap butir nasi menyerap kuah di panci. Cicipi sebelum disajikan dan tambahkan sedikit garam hanya bila perlu, lalu aduk rata.
instruction.fil: Kapag malambot na ang mga gulay, ilagay ang nilutong multigrain rice at haluin hanggang masipsip ng bawat butil ang katas sa kaldero. Tikman bago ihain at magdagdag lamang ng kaunting asin kung kinakailangan, pagkatapos ay ihalo nang pantay-pantay.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic 16:9 finished vegan cabbage rice in a warm bowl, distinct multigrain rice coated in savory cabbage and mushroom juices with golden tofu crumbles, no text, no watermark, no logo.

title.id: Perkedel Kentang Rendah Lemak yang Sehat

description.zh:
超簡單易做的馬鈴薯煎餅
大人小孩都會愛！！！
超酥脆又香噴噴的
當下午的零嘴也適合
大家趕快動手試試看！！！
description.en: These potato patties are extremely simple to make and loved by adults and children alike. They are wonderfully crisp and fragrant, and are perfect as an afternoon snack. Give them a try!
description.id: Perkedel kentang ini sangat mudah dibuat dan disukai orang dewasa maupun anak-anak. Teksturnya sangat renyah dan harum, juga cocok sebagai camilan sore. Yuk, coba buat!
description.fil: Ang mga potato patties na ito ay napakasimpleng gawin at minamahal ng mga matatanda at bata. Ang mga ito ay kahanga-hangang malutong at mabango, at perpekto bilang meryenda sa hapon. Subukan mo sila!

title.fil: Hiwain at asin ang mga gulay

instruction.zh: 馬鈴薯和紅蘿蔔去皮後刨成絲；加入一點鹽，讓蔬菜出水並入味。大辣椒切斜片；也可用青龍椒，留作煎餅表面裝飾。
instruction.en: Peel and shred the potatoes and carrot. Add a little salt to draw out moisture and season them. Slice the large chili on the diagonal; shishito pepper can be used instead and is reserved to decorate the patty surface.
instruction.id: Kupas lalu parut kentang dan wortel. Tambahkan sedikit garam agar sayuran mengeluarkan air dan berbumbu. Iris cabai besar secara diagonal; cabai shishito dapat digunakan sebagai pengganti dan disisihkan untuk hiasan permukaan perkedel.
instruction.fil: Balatan at gupitin ang patatas at karot. Magdagdag ng kaunting asin upang maglabas ng kahalumigmigan at timplahan ang mga ito. Hiwain ang malaking sili sa dayagonal; Ang paminta ng shishito ay maaaring gamitin sa halip at nakalaan upang palamutihan ang ibabaw ng patty.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Shred and salt the vegetables”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

title.en: Squeeze dry and mix the patty mixture
title.id: Peras hingga kering lalu campur adonan perkedel
title.fil: Pigain ang tuyo at ihalo ang pinaghalong patty

instruction.zh: 馬鈴薯和紅蘿蔔出水後擠乾，移至大碗。刨入全素起司，加入營養酵母、低筋麵粉和胡椒粉，抓拌均勻。影片說明全素起司和營養酵母都可帶來奶香，可同時使用。
instruction.en: Once the potatoes and carrot have released moisture, squeeze them dry and transfer them to a large bowl. Grate in the vegan cheese, add nutritional yeast, cake flour, and ground pepper, then mix by hand until even. The video notes that vegan cheese and nutritional yeast both bring a dairy-like aroma and may be used together.
instruction.id: Setelah kentang dan wortel mengeluarkan air, peras hingga kering lalu pindahkan ke mangkuk besar. Parut keju vegan, tambahkan ragi nutrisi, tepung terigu protein rendah, dan lada bubuk, lalu aduk dengan tangan hingga rata. Video menjelaskan bahwa keju vegan dan ragi nutrisi sama-sama memberi aroma mirip susu dan dapat digunakan bersama.
instruction.fil: Kapag ang mga patatas at karot ay naglabas ng kahalumigmigan, pisilin ang mga ito nang tuyo at ilipat ang mga ito sa isang malaking mangkok. Grate sa vegan cheese, magdagdag ng nutritional yeast, cake flour, at ground pepper, pagkatapos ay ihalo gamit ang kamay hanggang sa maging pantay. Ang video ay nagsasaad na ang vegan cheese at nutritional yeast ay parehong nagdadala ng parang dairy na aroma at maaaring gamitin nang magkasama.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Squeeze dry and mix the patty mixture”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

title.en: Pan-fry until golden on both sides
title.id: Goreng pan hingga keemasan di kedua sisi
title.fil: I-pan-fry hanggang mag-golden sa magkabilang gilid

instruction.zh: 平底鍋加入植物油，放入馬鈴薯煎餅麵糰並壓上辣椒片或青龍椒片。煎至兩面金黃、表面定型且較容易翻面後起鍋。
instruction.en: Add vegetable oil to a skillet, add the potato-patty mixture, and press chili or shishito slices on top. Fry until both sides are golden and the surface has set enough to turn easily, then remove from the pan.
instruction.id: Tambahkan minyak nabati ke wajan datar, masukkan adonan perkedel kentang, lalu tekan irisan cabai atau shishito di atasnya. Goreng hingga kedua sisi keemasan dan permukaannya cukup padat agar mudah dibalik, lalu angkat dari wajan.
instruction.fil: Magdagdag ng langis ng gulay sa isang kawali, idagdag ang pinaghalong patatas-patty, at pindutin ang mga hiwa ng sili o shishito sa itaas. Iprito hanggang sa maging ginintuang ang magkabilang gilid at ang ibabaw ay sapat na upang madaling lumiko, pagkatapos ay alisin sa kawali.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Pan-fry until golden on both sides”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

title.en: Mix the optional all-purpose dipping sauce
title.fil: Paghaluin ang opsyonal na all-purpose dipping sauce

instruction.zh: 若要搭配沾醬，將日式醬油、蘋果醋、味醂、韓式辣椒粉和白芝麻攪拌均勻。影片說明此醬也可搭配水餃、煎餅或冰鎮蕎麥麵。
instruction.en: For the dipping sauce, stir Japanese soy sauce, apple cider vinegar, mirin, Korean chili powder, and white sesame seeds together. The video says this sauce also works with dumplings, pancakes, or chilled soba noodles.
instruction.id: Untuk saus celup, aduk kecap asin Jepang, cuka apel, mirin, bubuk cabai Korea, dan biji wijen putih hingga rata. Video menyebut saus ini juga cocok untuk pangsit, perkedel, atau mi soba dingin.
instruction.fil: Para sa dipping sauce, haluin ang Japanese soy sauce, apple cider vinegar, mirin, Korean chili powder, at white sesame seeds. Sinasabi ng video na gumagana din ang sauce na ito sa mga dumpling, pancake, o pinalamig na soba noodles.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Mix the optional all-purpose dipping sauce”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

title.zh: 酸辣湯好喝秘訣簡單易學
title.id: Sup Asam Pedas Vegan Satu Panci

description.zh: 以番茄、木耳、菇類與多款豆製品熬煮，蓮藕粉勾芡並以烏醋收尾的暖胃全素酸辣湯。
description.en: A warming vegan hot-and-sour soup with tomato, mushrooms, assorted tofu, lotus-root-starch thickening, and black vinegar.
description.id: Sup asam pedas vegan hangat dengan tomat, jamur, aneka tahu, pengental pati akar teratai, dan cuka hitam.
description.fil: Isang nakakainit na vegan na mainit-at-maasim na sopas na may kamatis, mushroom, sari-saring tofu, lotus-root-starch thickening, at black vinegar.

instruction.zh: 將蔬菜與豆製品切絲或切丁；先把豆干及鮮香菇炒至金黃，再加入番茄、老薑、木耳和紅蘿蔔炒香。
instruction.en: Shred or dice the vegetables and tofu products. Sauté dried tofu and shiitake until golden, then add tomato, ginger, wood ear, and carrot.
instruction.id: Iris atau potong dadu sayur dan produk tahu. Tumis tahu kering serta shiitake hingga keemasan, lalu masukkan tomat, jahe, jamur kuping, dan wortel.
instruction.fil: Hiwain o hiwain ang mga gulay at produkto ng tofu. Igisa ang pinatuyong tofu at shiitake hanggang sa ginintuang, pagkatapos ay idagdag ang kamatis, luya, tainga ng kahoy, at karot.

instruction.zh: 加入水與嫩豆腐煮約 10 分鐘，再輕輕拌入千張細絲，形成仿蛋花的飄逸口感。
instruction.en: Add water and soft tofu and simmer for about 10 minutes, then gently stir in shredded tofu skin to create vegan egg-like ribbons.
instruction.id: Tambahkan air dan tahu lembut lalu rebus sekitar 10 menit. Masukkan kulit tahu iris perlahan agar menyerupai serabut telur vegan.
instruction.fil: Magdagdag ng tubig at malambot na tofu at kumulo ng humigit-kumulang 10 minuto, pagkatapos ay dahan-dahang ihalo ang ginutay-gutay na balat ng tofu upang lumikha ng mga laso na parang vegan na itlog.
