instruction.zh: 將蓮藕粉加水調勻後慢慢倒入湯中攪拌至滑順濃稠，最後加入烏醋與香菜調味。
instruction.en: Mix lotus root starch with water and pour it in slowly while stirring until silky and thick, then finish with black vinegar and cilantro.
instruction.id: Campur tepung akar teratai dengan air, tuang perlahan sambil diaduk hingga lembut dan kental, lalu akhiri dengan cuka hitam serta daun ketumbar.
instruction.fil: Paghaluin ang lotus root starch sa tubig at ibuhos ito ng dahan-dahan habang hinahalo hanggang malasutla at malapot, pagkatapos ay tapusin ng itim na suka at cilantro.

description.zh: 以自製韓式豆腐辣肉醬為湯底，加入黃豆芽、嫩豆腐、櫛瓜、香菇與金針菇，煮成香辣暖胃的全素嫩豆腐鍋。
description.en: A homemade spicy Korean tofu mince sauce forms the base for this warming vegan stew with soybean sprouts, soft tofu, zucchini, shiitake mushrooms, and enoki.
description.id: Saus cincang tahu pedas khas Korea buatan sendiri menjadi dasar sup vegan hangat ini, dengan tauge kedelai, tahu sutra, zukini, jamur shiitake, dan enoki.
description.fil: Isang lutong bahay na maanghang na Korean tofu mince sauce ang nagiging batayan para sa pampainit na vegan stew na ito na may soybean sprouts, malambot na tofu, zucchini, shiitake mushroom, at enoki.

instruction.zh: 將凍豆腐與板豆腐掰碎並擠乾水分；老薑和杏鮑菇切末，香菇對半切，櫛瓜切段。青龍椒分別切細圈與斜片，紅辣椒切斜片；金針菇撥小束，與黃豆芽洗淨備用。
instruction.en: Crumble the frozen tofu and firm tofu, then squeeze them dry. Mince the ginger and king oyster mushrooms; halve the shiitakes and cut the zucchini into pieces. Slice the green chili into rings and diagonal pieces, slice the red chili diagonally, and wash the enoki and soybean sprouts.
instruction.id: Remukkan tahu beku dan tahu padat, lalu peras hingga kering. Cincang jahe dan jamur king oyster; belah dua shiitake dan potong zukini. Iris cabai hijau menjadi cincin dan serong, iris cabai merah serong, lalu cuci enoki dan tauge kedelai.
instruction.fil: Durugin ang frozen tofu at firm tofu, pagkatapos ay pisilin ang mga ito upang matuyo. I-mince ang luya at king oyster mushroom; hatiin ang mga shiitake at gupitin ang zucchini. Hiwain ang berdeng sili sa mga singsing at diagonal na piraso, hiwain ang pulang sili sa pahilis, at hugasan ang enoki at soybean sprouts.

title.en: Cook the Spicy Tofu Mince Sauce
title.fil: Magluto ng Spicy Tofu Mince Sauce

instruction.zh: 炒鍋加入植物油和白芝麻油，先煸香老薑、青龍椒細圈與杏鮑菇末。加入擠乾的兩種豆腐，炒至金黃微焦、乾爽，再以鹽、糖、韓國辣椒粉和醬油調味，炒香後盛起作為辣肉醬。
instruction.en: Heat vegetable oil and white sesame oil in a wok, then sauté the ginger, green chili rings, and minced king oyster mushrooms. Add both squeezed-dry tofus and cook until golden, lightly crisp, and dry. Season with salt, sugar, Korean chili powder, and soy sauce; cook until fragrant and set aside as the spicy mince sauce.
instruction.id: Panaskan minyak sayur dan minyak wijen putih dalam wajan, lalu tumis jahe, irisan cabai hijau, dan jamur king oyster cincang. Masukkan kedua tahu yang telah diperas dan masak hingga keemasan, agak renyah, dan kering. Bumbui dengan garam, gula, bubuk cabai Korea, dan kecap asin; masak hingga harum lalu sisihkan sebagai saus cincang pedas.
instruction.fil: Init ang vegetable oil at white sesame oil sa isang kawali, pagkatapos ay igisa ang luya, berdeng sili, at tinadtad na king oyster mushroom. Idagdag ang parehong squeezed-dry tofu at lutuin hanggang sa ginintuang, bahagyang malutong, at tuyo. Timplahan ng asin, asukal, Korean chili powder, at toyo; lutuin hanggang mabango at itabi bilang spicy mince sauce.

instruction.zh: 湯鍋放入黃豆芽、嫩豆腐、水和炒好的辣肉醬。以湯匙將嫩豆腐稍微劃成塊並拌勻，煮10分鐘。
instruction.en: Place the soybean sprouts, soft tofu, water, and cooked spicy mince sauce in a soup pot. Gently break the soft tofu into chunks with a spoon, stir, and simmer for 10 minutes.
instruction.id: Masukkan tauge kedelai, tahu sutra, air, dan saus cincang pedas yang telah dimasak ke dalam panci. Pecahkan tahu sutra perlahan menjadi potongan dengan sendok, aduk, lalu didihkan selama 10 menit.
instruction.fil: Ilagay ang soybean sprouts, malambot na tofu, tubig, at nilutong maanghang na mince sauce sa isang soup pot. Dahan-dahang hatiin ang malambot na tofu gamit ang isang kutsara, haluin, at kumulo sa loob ng 10 minuto.

title.fil: Idagdag ang mga Gulay at Tapusin

instruction.zh: 加入櫛瓜、香菇和金針菇，再煮5分鐘。最後加入白胡椒粉和白芝麻油，撒上預留的青龍椒與紅辣椒斜片即可上桌。
instruction.en: Add the zucchini, shiitake mushrooms, and enoki, then simmer for 5 minutes more. Finish with white pepper and white sesame oil, and top with the reserved diagonal green and red chili slices before serving.
instruction.id: Masukkan zukini, jamur shiitake, dan enoki, lalu didihkan lagi selama 5 menit. Akhiri dengan lada putih dan minyak wijen putih, kemudian beri irisan serong cabai hijau dan merah yang disisihkan sebelum disajikan.
instruction.fil: Idagdag ang zucchini, shiitake mushroom, at enoki, pagkatapos ay kumulo ng 5 minuto pa. Tapusin na may puting paminta at puting linga langis, at itaas na may nakareserbang diagonal na berde at pulang hiwa ng sili bago ihain.

instruction.en: Place plain pea protein powder, rolled oats, chia seeds, mixed nuts, sea salt, and plant milk in a blender. Blend until slightly thick, then pour out.
instruction.id: Masukkan bubuk protein kacang polong original, oat, biji chia, kacang campur, garam laut, dan susu nabati ke blender. Haluskan hingga agak kental, lalu tuang.
instruction.fil: Ilagay ang plain pea protein powder, rolled oats, chia seeds, mixed nuts, sea salt, at plant milk sa isang blender. Haluin hanggang medyo makapal, pagkatapos ay ibuhos.

instruction.zh: 準備莓果風味豌豆蛋白粉、香蕉、奇異果、檸檬馬鞭草與植物奶。

instruction.en: Blend the prepared berry ingredients into a smoothie. If lemon verbena is unavailable, use mint; omit both if neither is available.

instruction.fil: Haluin ang mga inihandang sangkap ng berry sa isang smoothie. Kung hindi magagamit ang lemon verbena, gumamit ng mint; alisin ang pareho kung wala ang alinman.

instruction.id: Rebus sebentar bayam selama sekitar 20 detik sebelum digunakan.

description.zh: 4至5人份的純素巧達濃湯，以白花椰菜、馬鈴薯、菇類與西洋芹熬煮；一半打成濃泥再回鍋，保留濃滑與蔬菜顆粒口感。

title.en: Prepare and marinate the bean curd

instruction.zh: 煙燻豆包用手撕成不規則薄片。鮮香菇去梗，菇傘切片；菇梗對半切後用手撥開但保留相連。豆包與菇梗拌入醃料用的醬油、五香粉和孜然粉，醃 15 分鐘。
instruction.en: Tear the smoked bean-curd sheets into irregular thin pieces. Stem the shiitakes and slice the caps; split each stem lengthwise and pull it apart while leaving it partly joined. Mix the bean curd and stems with the marinade soy sauce, five-spice, and cumin, then marinate for 15 minutes.
instruction.id: Sobek lembaran tahu asap menjadi potongan tipis tak beraturan. Pisahkan batang shiitake dan iris tudungnya; belah batang memanjang lalu renggangkan tanpa memutuskannya seluruhnya. Campur tahu dan batang jamur dengan kecap asin marinasi, bubuk ngohiong, serta jintan, lalu diamkan 15 menit.
instruction.fil: Gupitin ang pinausukang bean-curd sheet sa hindi regular na manipis na piraso. Stem ang shiitake at hiwain ang mga takip; hatiin ang bawat tangkay nang pahaba at hilahin ito habang iniiwan itong bahagyang magkadugtong. Paghaluin ang bean curd at stems na may marinade soy sauce, five-spice, at cumin, pagkatapos ay i-marinate sa loob ng 15 minuto.

For the product used here, soak the preserved mustard greens for about 30 minutes; ask the seller about the soaking requirement for your product. Cut the greens into short pieces, trim and halve the mushrooms, and shred the young ginger.
instruction.id: Cuci sawi asin kering dan jamur tea tree. Untuk produk yang digunakan di sini, rendam sawi asin kering sekitar 30 menit; tanyakan kepada penjual mengenai kebutuhan perendaman produk Anda. Potong sawi asin menjadi bagian pendek, buang pangkal jamur lalu belah dua, dan iris jahe muda memanjang.
instruction.fil: Hugasan ang napreserbang mustard greens at tea tree mushroom. Para sa produktong ginamit dito, ibabad ang napreserbang mga gulay ng mustasa sa loob ng mga 30 minuto; tanungin ang nagbebenta tungkol sa kinakailangan sa pagbabad para sa iyong produkto. Gupitin ang mga gulay sa maikling piraso, gupitin at hatiin ang mga kabute, at gupitin ang batang luya.

instruction.en: Peel the taro and cut it into slices about 1 cm thick. The video recommends wearing gloves if handling taro causes itchiness. Pan-fry the taro until both sides are golden and fragrant.
instruction.id: Kupas talas lalu potong menjadi irisan setebal sekitar 1 cm. Video menyarankan memakai sarung tangan bila menangani talas menyebabkan gatal. Panggang talas di wajan hingga kedua sisinya keemasan dan harum.
instruction.fil: Balatan ang taro at gupitin ito ng mga 1 cm ang kapal. Inirerekomenda ng video ang pagsusuot ng guwantes kung ang paghawak ng taro ay nagdudulot ng pangangati. I-pan-fry ang taro hanggang sa maging ginto at mabango ang magkabilang gilid.

instruction.zh: 將梅干菜、茶樹菇、嫩薑和可選乾辣椒炒香。加入醬油、醬油膏、糖、胡椒粉和香油調味，再加一點水，不加蓋熬煮約 3 分鐘。
instruction.en: Stir-fry the preserved mustard greens, tea tree mushrooms, young ginger, and optional dried chili until fragrant. Season with soy sauce, soy sauce paste, sugar, ground pepper, and sesame oil, then add a little water and simmer uncovered for about 3 minutes.
instruction.id: Tumis sawi asin kering, jamur tea tree, jahe muda, dan cabai kering opsional hingga harum. Bumbui dengan kecap asin, pasta kecap asin, gula, lada bubuk, dan minyak wijen, lalu tambahkan sedikit air dan didihkan tanpa tutup sekitar 3 menit.
instruction.fil: Iprito ang napreserbang mustard greens, tea tree mushroom, batang luya, at opsyonal na pinatuyong sili hanggang sa mabango. Timplahan ng toyo, toyo paste, asukal, giniling na paminta, at sesame oil, pagkatapos ay magdagdag ng kaunting tubig at kumulo nang walang takip ng mga 3 minuto.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Cook the preserved-mustard-greens sauce”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

title.en: Assemble and steam in an electric cooker
title.id: Rakit lalu kukus dalam penanak nasi listrik
title.fil: Magtipon at mag-steam sa isang electric cooker

instruction.zh: 將梅干菜醬汁與煎好的芋頭放入耐熱容器，讓醬汁淋在芋頭上。放入電鍋，外鍋加入 1 杯水蒸煮；電鍋跳起後即可取出享用。
instruction.en: Put the preserved-mustard-greens sauce and browned taro in a heatproof dish, letting the sauce cover the taro. Steam in an electric cooker with 1 cup of water in the outer pot; remove and serve once the cooker switches off.
instruction.id: Masukkan saus sawi asin kering dan talas yang telah dipanggang ke dalam wadah tahan panas, lalu siramkan saus ke atas talas. Kukus dalam penanak nasi listrik dengan 1 cangkir air di panci luar; angkat dan sajikan setelah penanak nasi berhenti otomatis.
instruction.fil: Ilagay ang preserved-mustard-greens sauce at browned taro sa isang dish na hindi tinatablan ng init, hayaang masakop ng sauce ang taro. Singaw sa isang electric cooker na may 1 tasa ng tubig sa panlabas na palayok; alisin at ihain sa sandaling patayin ang kusinilya.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Assemble and steam in an electric cooker”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

title.id: Tiga Hidangan Dingin Vegan Musim Panas

description.zh: 三道全素夏日涼拌菜：越南春卷皮製成的重慶小涼皮、冰鎮干絲辣拌菜，以及以杏鮑菇和腐皮做成的素食口水雞。
description.en: Three vegan summer cold dishes: Chongqing liangpi made from Vietnamese rice paper, chilled spicy shredded tofu, and vegan mouthwatering ‘chicken’ made with king oyster mushrooms and tofu skin.
description.id: Tiga hidangan dingin vegan musim panas: liangpi Chongqing dari kulit lumpia Vietnam, tahu suwir pedas yang didinginkan, dan ‘ayam mulut berair’ vegan dari jamur king oyster serta kulit tahu.
description.fil: Tatlong vegan summer cold dish: Chongqing liangpi na gawa sa Vietnamese rice paper, chilled spicy shredded tofu, at vegan mouthwatering 'chicken' na gawa sa king oyster mushroom at tofu skin.

instruction.zh: 香菜切末備用。將香辣辣椒油、醬油、香油、芝麻水與芝麻醬拌勻。
instruction.en: Finely chop cilantro and set aside. Mix fragrant chili oil, soy sauce, sesame oil, sesame water, and sesame paste.
instruction.id: Cincang halus daun ketumbar dan sisihkan. Campurkan minyak cabai aromatik, kecap asin, minyak wijen, air wijen, dan pasta wijen.
instruction.fil: Pinong tumaga ang cilantro at itabi. Paghaluin ang mabangong chili oil, toyo, sesame oil, sesame water, at sesame paste.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Mix Chongqing liangpi sauce”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

instruction.zh: 越南春卷皮泡水至稍軟，向上摺三摺後剪成段，直接放入冰水冰鎮至口感Q彈。取出瀝乾後盛碗。
instruction.en: Soak Vietnamese rice paper until slightly soft, fold it upward three times, cut into pieces, and place directly in ice water until springy. Drain and transfer to a bowl.
instruction.id: Rendam kulit lumpia Vietnam hingga agak lunak, lipat ke atas tiga kali, potong-potong, lalu langsung masukkan ke air es hingga kenyal. Tiriskan dan pindahkan ke mangkuk.
instruction.fil: Ibabad ang Vietnamese rice paper hanggang bahagyang lumambot, tiklop ito pataas ng tatlong beses, hiwa-hiwain, at direktang ilagay sa tubig na yelo hanggang sa mabulaklak. Alisan ng tubig at ilipat sa isang mangkok.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Make the liangpi”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

instruction.zh: 淋上醬汁並撒香菜即可。
instruction.en: Pour over the sauce and top with cilantro.
instruction.id: Tuangkan saus dan beri daun ketumbar.
instruction.fil: Ibuhos ang sarsa at itaas na may cilantro.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Finish the Chongqing liangpi”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

title.fil: Gupitin ang maanghang na ginutay-gutay na sangkap ng tofu

instruction.zh: 嫩薑切絲，芹菜切段，香菜切末，辣椒切斜片，紅蘿蔔刨絲。
instruction.en: Julienne young ginger, cut celery into sections, finely chop cilantro, slice chili on the diagonal, and shred carrot.
instruction.id: Iris korek jahe muda, potong seledri, cincang halus daun ketumbar, iris cabai serong, dan serut wortel.
instruction.fil: Julienne batang luya, gupitin ang kintsay, gupitin ang cilantro, hiwain ang sili sa dayagonal, at gutayin ang karot.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Cut spicy shredded tofu ingredients”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

title.zh: 汆燙並冰鎮干絲與紅蘿蔔
title.en: Blanch and chill tofu shreds and carrot
title.id: Rebus sebentar dan dinginkan tahu suwir serta wortel
title.fil: Blanch at palamigin ang tofu shreds at carrot

instruction.zh: 滾水加少量鹽，汆燙干絲1分鐘後放入冰水；再汆燙紅蘿蔔，放涼後也冰鎮。
instruction.en: Add a little salt to boiling water, blanch shredded dried tofu for 1 minute, then place in ice water. Blanch carrot as well, let it cool, and chill it.
instruction.id: Tambahkan sedikit garam ke air mendidih, rebus tahu kering suwir selama 1 menit lalu masukkan ke air es. Rebus sebentar wortel, biarkan dingin, lalu dinginkan juga.
instruction.fil: Magdagdag ng kaunting asin sa tubig na kumukulo, blanch ang ginutay-gutay na tuyo na tofu sa loob ng 1 minuto, pagkatapos ay ilagay sa tubig na yelo. Paputiin din ang karot, hayaang lumamig, at palamigin.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Blanch and chill tofu shreds and carrot”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

title.fil: Paghaluin ang spicy shredded tofu sauce

instruction.zh: 將香辣辣椒油、醬油、味醂、香油與少量鹽拌勻。
instruction.en: Mix fragrant chili oil, soy sauce, mirin, sesame oil, and a little salt.
instruction.id: Campurkan minyak cabai aromatik, kecap asin, mirin, minyak wijen, dan sedikit garam.
instruction.fil: Paghaluin ang mabangong chili oil, toyo, mirin, sesame oil, at kaunting asin.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Mix spicy shredded tofu sauce”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

title.en: Toss and chill spicy shredded tofu
title.id: Aduk dan dinginkan tahu suwir pedas
title.fil: Ihagis at palamigin ang spicy shredded tofu

instruction.zh: 將干絲、紅蘿蔔、芹菜、香菜、嫩薑與辣椒放入保鮮盒，倒入醬汁拌勻。可冷藏至隔天，使其更入味。
instruction.en: Put shredded tofu, carrot, celery, cilantro, young ginger, and chili in a storage container; add the sauce and toss. Refrigerate until the next day for deeper flavor if desired.
instruction.id: Masukkan tahu suwir, wortel, seledri, daun ketumbar, jahe muda, dan cabai ke wadah; tambahkan saus lalu aduk. Dinginkan hingga keesokan hari untuk rasa yang lebih meresap bila diinginkan.
instruction.fil: Ilagay ang tinadtad na tokwa, karot, kintsay, cilantro, batang luya, at sili sa isang lalagyang imbakan; idagdag ang sauce at ihalo. Palamigin hanggang sa susunod na araw para sa mas malalim na lasa kung ninanais.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Toss and chill spicy shredded tofu”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

title.en: Steam and chill king oyster mushrooms
title.id: Kukus dan dinginkan jamur king oyster
title.fil: I-steam at palamigin ang king oyster mushroom

instruction.zh: 將杏鮑菇放入電鍋，以外鍋1杯水蒸煮。電鍋跳起後立刻取出放入冰水，並保留蒸出的菇汁。
instruction.en: Steam king oyster mushrooms in an electric cooker with 1 cup of water in the outer pot. As soon as it switches off, move them to ice water and reserve the mushroom juices.
instruction.id: Kukus jamur king oyster dalam penanak listrik dengan 1 cangkir air di panci luar. Segera setelah alat selesai, pindahkan ke air es dan simpan sari jamurnya.
instruction.fil: Steam king oyster mushroom sa isang electric cooker na may 1 tasa ng tubig sa panlabas na palayok. Sa sandaling mag-off ito, ilipat ang mga ito sa tubig ng yelo at ireserba ang mga katas ng kabute.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Steam and chill king oyster mushrooms”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

title.fil: Maghanda ng balat ng tofu at mushroom

instruction.zh: 腐皮在滾水中燙軟後放入冰水。從杏鮑菇側面邊滾邊切成大片，在表面劃直刀後切成三等份；將腐皮從中間剪開成大片。
instruction.en: Soften tofu skin in boiling water, then place it in ice water. Roll-cut king oyster mushrooms from the side into broad pieces, score them vertically, and cut into thirds; cut tofu skin open down the middle into large sheets.
instruction.id: Lunakkan kulit tahu dalam air mendidih lalu masukkan ke air es. Potong jamur king oyster dari sisi sambil digulirkan menjadi lembaran lebar, buat sayatan vertikal, lalu bagi menjadi tiga; gunting kulit tahu di bagian tengah hingga menjadi lembaran besar.
instruction.fil: Palambutin ang balat ng tofu sa kumukulong tubig, pagkatapos ay ilagay ito sa tubig na yelo. Roll-cut king oyster mushroom mula sa gilid sa malalawak na piraso, puntos ang mga ito patayo, at gupitin sa ikatlong bahagi; gupitin ang balat ng tofu na nakabukas sa gitna ng malalaking piraso.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Prepare tofu skin and mushrooms”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

title.fil: Paghaluin ang vegan mouthwatering mushroom sauce

instruction.zh: 將香辣辣椒油、醬油、白醋、味醂、芝麻醬、香油與保留的杏鮑菇汁拌勻。
instruction.en: Mix fragrant chili oil, soy sauce, white vinegar, mirin, sesame paste, sesame oil, and the reserved king oyster mushroom juices.
instruction.id: Campurkan minyak cabai aromatik, kecap asin, cuka putih, mirin, pasta wijen, minyak wijen, dan sari jamur king oyster yang disimpan.
instruction.fil: Paghaluin ang mabangong chili oil, toyo, puting suka, mirin, sesame paste, sesame oil, at ang nakareserbang king oyster mushroom juice.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Mix vegan mouthwatering mushroom sauce”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

instruction.zh: 盤中放上杏鮑菇與腐皮，淋上醬汁，再放香菜、青龍椒與堅果碎。
instruction.en: Arrange king oyster mushrooms and tofu skin on a plate, pour over the sauce, then top with cilantro, green dragon chili, and crushed nuts.
instruction.id: Susun jamur king oyster dan kulit tahu di piring, tuangkan saus, lalu beri daun ketumbar, cabai naga hijau, dan kacang cincang.
instruction.fil: Ayusin ang king oyster mushroom at balat ng tokwa sa isang plato, ibuhos ang sarsa, pagkatapos ay lagyan ng cilantro, berdeng dragon chili, at durog na mani.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Assemble vegan mouthwatering mushroom”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

instruction.zh: 將食用油燒至180°C後直接淋上。若要提前製作，可冷藏一夜，隔天再進行油潑並加入香菜、青龍椒與堅果碎。
instruction.en: Heat cooking oil to 180°C and pour it directly over the dish. If making ahead, refrigerate overnight, then add the hot oil, cilantro, green dragon chili, and crushed nuts the next day.
instruction.id: Panaskan minyak goreng hingga 180°C lalu tuangkan langsung ke atas hidangan. Jika dibuat lebih awal, dinginkan semalaman, kemudian tambahkan minyak panas, daun ketumbar, cabai naga hijau, dan kacang cincang pada hari berikutnya.
instruction.fil: Painitin ang mantika sa 180°C at ibuhos ito nang direkta sa ibabaw ng ulam. Kung mauna, palamigin magdamag, pagkatapos ay idagdag ang mainit na mantika, cilantro, berdeng chili ng dragon, at mga durog na mani sa susunod na araw.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Finish with hot oil”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

description.zh: 把全素冷凍水餃變化成三道料理：搭嫩薑烏醋的三杯蒸餃、拌入植物奶白醬的鮮蔬炸餃，以及用麵粉水煎出冰花的三杯煎餃。
description.en: Turn vegan frozen dumplings into three dishes: three-cup steamed dumplings with young ginger and black vinegar, vegetable dumplings tossed in plant-milk white sauce, and three-cup dumplings pan-fried with a flour-water lace.
description.id: Ubah pangsit beku vegan menjadi tiga hidangan: pangsit kukus tiga cangkir dengan jahe muda serta cuka hitam, pangsit sayur goreng dalam saus putih susu nabati, dan pangsit tiga cangkir dengan renda tepung-air dari wajan.
description.fil: Gawing tatlong dish ang vegan frozen dumplings: three-cup steamed dumplings na may batang luya at itim na suka, vegetable dumplings na inihagis sa plant-milk white sauce, at three-cup dumplings na piniritong may flour-water lace.

name.id: pangsit beku daging nabati tiga cangkir
pangsit beku daging nabati sayur segar

instruction.zh: 可放入電鍋的盤子墊烘焙紙，放上三杯植物肉冷凍水餃並彼此留間距；若一次蒸較多，可先在紙上抹少量油。外鍋加入1杯水蒸熟，跳起後再燜約10分鐘。
instruction.en: Line an electric-cooker-safe plate with baking parchment, arrange three-cup plant-meat frozen dumplings with space between them, and oil the parchment lightly if steaming a large batch. Steam with 1 cup water in the outer pot, then rest about 10 minutes after it switches off.
instruction.id: Alasi piring yang aman untuk penanak listrik dengan kertas roti, susun pangsit beku daging nabati tiga cangkir dengan jarak di antaranya, dan olesi sedikit minyak bila mengukus banyak pangsit. Kukus dengan 1 cangkir air di panci luar, lalu diamkan sekitar 10 menit setelah alat selesai.
instruction.fil: Ihanay ang isang electric-cooker-safe na plato na may baking parchment, ayusin ang tatlong-tasang plant-meat frozen dumplings na may espasyo sa pagitan ng mga ito, at langisan ng bahagya ang parchment kung magpapasingaw ng malaking batch. I-steam na may 1 tasa ng tubig sa panlabas na kaldero, pagkatapos ay magpahinga nang humigit-kumulang 10 minuto pagkatapos nitong patayin.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Steam three-cup dumplings”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

title.en: Serve with young ginger and black vinegar
title.id: Sajikan dengan jahe muda dan cuka hitam
title.fil: Ihain kasama ang batang luya at itim na suka

instruction.zh: 嫩薑切絲放入小碟，倒入少量烏醋；將蒸好的水餃搭配食用。
instruction.en: Julienne young ginger into a small dish and add a little black vinegar; serve with the steamed dumplings.
instruction.id: Iris korek jahe muda ke dalam piring kecil dan tambahkan sedikit cuka hitam; sajikan bersama pangsit kukus.
instruction.fil: Julienne batang luya sa isang maliit na ulam at magdagdag ng isang maliit na itim na suka; ihain kasama ang mga steamed dumplings.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Serve with young ginger and black vinegar”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

instruction.zh: 將油加熱至160°C，放入鮮蔬植物肉冷凍水餃炸至金黃酥脆，期間稍微翻動使上色均勻；起鍋後以餐巾紙吸油。
instruction.en: Heat oil to 160°C and fry fresh-vegetable plant-meat frozen dumplings until golden and crisp, turning them a little for even browning; drain on paper towel.
instruction.id: Panaskan minyak hingga 160°C dan goreng pangsit beku daging nabati sayur segar sampai keemasan serta renyah, balik sedikit agar warnanya merata; tiriskan di tisu dapur.
instruction.fil: Mag-init ng mantika sa 160°C at magprito ng sariwang gulay na halaman-karne ng frozen dumplings hanggang sa ginintuang at malutong, paikutin ang mga ito ng kaunti para sa pantay na browning; alisan ng tubig sa tuwalya ng papel.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Fry vegetable dumplings”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

instruction.zh: 鍋中加少量植物油，先炒香低筋麵粉，再倒入植物奶；醬汁出現濃稠狀時加少量水，攪拌至無顆粒。加入義式香料、黑胡椒、鹽與全素起司拌勻。
instruction.en: Heat a little vegetable oil, toast cake flour, then add plant milk. When the sauce thickens, add a little water and stir until smooth. Mix in Italian seasoning, black pepper, salt, and vegan cheese.
instruction.id: Panaskan sedikit minyak nabati, sangrai tepung terigu protein rendah, lalu tambahkan susu nabati. Saat saus mengental, tambahkan sedikit air dan aduk hingga halus. Campurkan bumbu Italia, lada hitam, garam, dan keju vegan.
instruction.fil: Mag-init ng kaunting langis ng gulay, toast cake flour, pagkatapos ay magdagdag ng gatas ng halaman. Kapag lumapot na ang sauce, magdagdag ng kaunting tubig at haluin hanggang makinis. Paghaluin ang Italian seasoning, black pepper, asin, at vegan cheese.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Cook plant-milk white sauce”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

instruction.zh: 將炸好的鮮蔬水餃倒入白醬拌勻後盛盤。
instruction.en: Toss the fried vegetable dumplings in the white sauce and plate.
instruction.id: Aduk pangsit sayur goreng dalam saus putih lalu sajikan.
instruction.fil: Ihagis ang piniritong gulay na dumplings sa puting sarsa at plato.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Finish creamy fried dumplings”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

title.en: Mix flour water for the lace
title.fil: Paghaluin ang tubig ng harina para sa puntas

instruction.zh: 將1大匙低筋麵粉與9大匙水拌勻成麵粉水。
instruction.en: Mix 1 tablespoon cake flour with 9 tablespoons water to make flour water.
instruction.id: Campurkan 1 sdm tepung terigu protein rendah dengan 9 sdm air untuk membuat air tepung.
instruction.fil: Paghaluin ang 1 kutsarang cake flour na may 9 na kutsarang tubig para maging tubig ng harina.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Mix flour water for the lace”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

instruction.zh: 平底鍋加少量植物油，整齊排入三杯植物肉冷凍水餃，煎至底部微黃。倒入麵粉水、蓋鍋煮至水分收乾，再開蓋煎至完全乾燥。關火後以盤子倒扣在鍋上翻出。
instruction.en: Add a little vegetable oil to a skillet and arrange three-cup plant-meat frozen dumplings. Fry until the bottoms are lightly yellow, pour in the flour water, cover and cook until the water is absorbed, then uncover and cook until fully dry. Turn off the heat and invert onto a plate.
instruction.id: Tambahkan sedikit minyak nabati ke wajan datar dan susun pangsit beku daging nabati tiga cangkir. Goreng hingga bagian bawah agak kuning, tuangkan air tepung, tutup dan masak hingga air habis, lalu buka dan masak sampai benar-benar kering. Matikan api dan balikkan ke piring.
instruction.fil: Magdagdag ng kaunting langis ng gulay sa isang kawali at ayusin ang mga frozen na dumpling na may tatlong tasa ng halaman-karne. Iprito hanggang sa bahagyang dilaw ang ilalim, ibuhos ang tubig ng harina, takpan at lutuin hanggang masipsip ang tubig, pagkatapos ay alisan ng takip at lutuin hanggang sa ganap na matuyo. Patayin ang apoy at baligtarin sa isang plato.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Pan-fry three-cup lacy dumplings”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

instruction.zh: 將香辣辣椒油與少量醬油混合，搭配冰花煎餃食用。
instruction.en: Mix fragrant chili oil with a little soy sauce and serve with the lacy pan-fried dumplings.
instruction.id: Campurkan minyak cabai aromatik dengan sedikit kecap asin dan sajikan bersama pangsit pan-goreng berenda.
instruction.fil: Paghaluin ang mabangong chili oil na may kaunting toyo at ihain kasama ang lacy pan-fried dumplings.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Make pan-fried dumpling dip”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

description.zh: 以汆燙後剪開的炸豆皮取代肉片，醃入日式醬油、胡椒與五香粉，搭配炒成洋蔥口感的白菜梗和高麗菜絲，再用山藥泥製造近似蛋液的滑口醬汁。
description.en: Blanched, split fried tofu skin replaces meat slices and is marinated with Japanese soy sauce, pepper, and five-spice. Napa cabbage stems and shredded cabbage are cooked to an onion-like texture, then Japanese yam puree creates a silky, egg-like sauce.
description.id: Kulit tahu goreng yang direbus lalu dibelah menggantikan irisan daging dan dimarinasi dengan kecap asin Jepang, lada, serta lima rempah. Batang sawi putih dan kol iris dimasak hingga menyerupai bawang, lalu puree ubi Jepang menciptakan saus lembut seperti telur.
description.fil: Pinapalitan ng blanched, split fried tofu skin ang mga hiwa ng karne at nilagyan ng Japanese soy sauce, pepper, at five-spice. Ang mga tangkay ng napa repolyo at ginutay-gutay na repolyo ay niluto sa parang sibuyas na texture, pagkatapos ang Japanese yam puree ay lumilikha ng malasutla at parang itlog na sarsa.

name.zh: 炸豆皮（語音轉錄早段作「角蘿」）
name.en: fried tofu skin (early transcript renders it as 'jiao luo')
name.id: kulit tahu goreng (bagian awal transkrip menyebut 'jiao luo')
name.fil: piniritong balat ng tokwa (ginawa ito ng maagang transcript bilang 'jiao luo')

title.zh: 汆燙、剪開並醃製炸豆皮
title.en: Blanch, split, and marinate the fried tofu skin
title.id: Rebus, belah, dan marinasi kulit tahu goreng
title.fil: Blanch, hatiin, at i-marinate ang piniritong balat ng tofu

instruction.zh: 準備滾水，將炸豆皮燙軟後從中間剪開，略擠去多餘水分。加入日式醬油、胡椒粉和五香粉抓醃，靜置20分鐘。
instruction.en: Bring water to a boil, soften the fried tofu skin, then cut it open through the middle and gently squeeze away excess water. Toss with Japanese soy sauce, ground pepper, and five-spice powder, then marinate for 20 minutes.
instruction.id: Didihkan air, lunakkan kulit tahu goreng, lalu belah di bagian tengah dan peras perlahan air berlebih. Campurkan dengan kecap asin Jepang, lada bubuk, dan lima rempah, lalu marinasi selama 20 menit.
instruction.fil: Pakuluan ang tubig, palambutin ang balat ng piniritong tofu, pagkatapos ay hiwain ito sa gitna at dahan-dahang pisilin ang labis na tubig. Ihagis ang Japanese soy sauce, ground pepper, at five-spice powder, pagkatapos ay i-marinate ng 20 minuto.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic 16:9 vegan tutorial image of blanched fried tofu skin opened into flat strips and marinated with Japanese soy sauce and spices, no animal meat, no text, no watermark, no logo.

title.zh: 切絲白菜並準備山藥泥
title.en: Shred the cabbages and prepare yam puree
title.id: Iris kol dan siapkan puree ubi Jepang
title.fil: Hiwain ang repolyo at maghanda ng yam puree

instruction.zh: 把大白菜梗和高麗菜切成絲；白菜葉可留作煮湯或其他炒菜。將日本山藥磨成山藥泥，另把青紅椒備好。
instruction.en: Shred the napa cabbage stems and cabbage; reserve the napa leaves for soup or another stir-fry. Grate the Japanese yam into a puree and prepare the green and red chili.
instruction.id: Iris batang sawi putih dan kol; simpan daun sawi untuk sup atau tumisan lain. Parut ubi Jepang menjadi puree dan siapkan cabai hijau serta merah.
instruction.fil: Hiwain ang mga tangkay ng napa repolyo at repolyo; ireserba ang dahon ng napa para sa sopas o ibang stir-fry. Grate ang Japanese yam sa isang katas at ihanda ang berde at pulang sili.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic overhead 16:9 vegan prep image with shredded napa cabbage stems, shredded cabbage, grated Japanese yam puree, and green-red chili, no text, no watermark, no logo.

title.zh: 炒出洋蔥般口感並加入薑汁
title.en: Cook to an onion-like texture and add ginger sauce
title.id: Masak hingga menyerupai bawang lalu tambahkan saus jahe
title.fil: Magluto sa parang sibuyas na texture at magdagdag ng ginger sauce

instruction.zh: 將白菜梗和高麗菜絲炒至口感近似洋蔥後，加入影片中預先調好的薑汁拌炒。
instruction.en: Cook the napa cabbage stems and shredded cabbage until their texture resembles onion, then add the pre-mixed ginger sauce mentioned in the video and stir-fry.
instruction.id: Masak batang sawi putih dan kol iris hingga teksturnya menyerupai bawang, lalu tambahkan saus jahe yang telah disiapkan seperti disebutkan dalam video dan tumis.
instruction.fil: Lutuin ang mga tangkay ng napa repolyo at ginutay-gutay na repolyo hanggang sa maging katulad ng sibuyas ang texture nito, pagkatapos ay idagdag ang pre-mixed ginger sauce na binanggit sa video at iprito.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic 16:9 vegan stir-fry image of shredded cabbage and napa stems becoming glossy and onion-like in a pan with aromatic ginger sauce, no text, no watermark, no logo.

title.zh: 以山藥泥收成滑口醬汁
title.en: Finish with yam puree for a silky sauce
title.id: Akhiri dengan puree ubi untuk saus lembut
title.fil: Tapusin sa yam puree para sa malasutla na sarsa

instruction.zh: 鍋底尚留少量薑汁時加入山藥泥拌勻，讓醬汁包住食材並形成近似生蛋液的滑口感。大火炒至收汁發亮，起鍋前加少量香油和水拌勻。
instruction.en: When a little ginger sauce remains in the pan, add the yam puree and mix so the sauce clings to the ingredients with a silky, raw-egg-like texture. Stir-fry over high heat until glossy and reduced, then mix in a little sesame oil and water before serving.
instruction.id: Saat sedikit saus jahe masih tersisa di wajan, tambahkan puree ubi dan aduk hingga saus melapisi bahan dengan tekstur lembut seperti telur mentah. Tumis dengan api besar hingga mengilap dan menyusut, lalu aduk dengan sedikit minyak wijen serta air sebelum disajikan.
instruction.fil: Kapag nananatili ang isang maliit na sarsa ng luya sa kawali, idagdag ang yam puree at ihalo upang ang sarsa ay kumapit sa mga sangkap na may malasutla, parang hilaw na texture. Haluin sa mataas na apoy hanggang sa makintab at mabawasan, pagkatapos ay ihalo sa kaunting sesame oil at tubig bago ihain.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic 16:9 vegan skillet image of glossy plant-based ginger yakiniku sauce thickened with pale Japanese yam puree around tofu-skin strips and cabbage, no egg, no meat, no text, no watermark, no logo.

title.zh: 鋪菜絲、盛上燒肉並點綴
title.id: Sajikan di atas kol dan beri hiasan
title.fil: Ilagay sa ibabaw ng repolyo at palamutihan

instruction.zh: 盤中先鋪高麗菜絲，放上純素薑汁燒肉，撒白芝麻和青紅椒即可完成。
instruction.en: Lay shredded cabbage on a plate, add the vegan ginger yakiniku, and finish with white sesame seeds and green-red chili.
instruction.id: Letakkan kol iris di piring, tambahkan yakiniku jahe vegan, lalu taburi wijen putih dan cabai hijau-merah.
instruction.fil: Ilagay ang ginutay-gutay na repolyo sa isang plato, idagdag ang vegan ginger yakiniku, at tapusin na may puting linga at berdeng pulang sili.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic 16:9 finished vegan ginger yakiniku on shredded cabbage, glossy tofu-skin strips with white sesame and green-red chili garnish, no animal meat, no egg, no text, no watermark, no logo.

description.zh: 先煎香冬瓜與老薑，再加入玉米、黃豆芽及溫補藥材熬成清甜全素湯。
description.en: Winter melon and ginger are lightly browned, then simmered with corn, soybean sprouts, and Chinese herbs into a clear sweet vegan soup.
description.id: Labu putih dan jahe ditumis kecokelatan, lalu direbus bersama jagung, tauge kedelai, dan herbal Tiongkok menjadi sup vegan bening yang manis.
description.fil: Ang winter melon at luya ay bahagyang kulay-kayumanggi, pagkatapos ay sinimulan ng mais, soybean sprouts, at Chinese herbs sa isang malinaw na matamis na vegan na sopas.

title.en: Brown the winter melon and ginger
title.fil: Brown ang winter melon at luya

instruction.zh: 將薑和冬瓜炒至微焦，以提香。
instruction.en: Sauté ginger and winter melon until lightly browned to build fragrance.
instruction.id: Tumis jahe dan winter melon hingga agak kecoklatan untuk menambah aroma.
instruction.fil: Igisa ang luya at winter melon hanggang sa bahagyang kayumanggi upang bumuo ng halimuyak.

instruction.zh: 加入玉米、黃豆芽、水、中藥（枸杞、紅棗、當歸、黃耆）。
instruction.en: Add corn, soybean sprouts, water, goji berries, red dates, Chinese angelica, and astragalus.
instruction.id: Tambahkan jagung, tauge kedelai, air, goji, kurma merah, dang gui, dan astragalus.
instruction.fil: Magdagdag ng mais, soybean sprouts, tubig, goji berries, pulang petsa, Chinese angelica, at astragalus.

instruction.zh: 小火煮 20 分鐘，然後用鹽、香菜和芝麻油調味，形成清爽甘甜的湯汁。
instruction.en: Simmer over low heat for 20 minutes, then season with salt, cilantro, and sesame oil for a refreshing sweet broth.
instruction.id: Rebus api kecil selama 20 menit, lalu bumbui dengan garam, daun ketumbar, dan minyak wijen hingga kuah terasa segar dan manis.
instruction.fil: Pakuluan sa mahinang apoy sa loob ng 20 minuto, pagkatapos ay timplahan ng asin, cilantro, at sesame oil para sa nakakapreskong matamis na sabaw.
