description.zh:
今天要來重現
小時候去八方雲集
我最愛吃的「招牌鍋貼」

究竟是加入了哪些食材
除了有肥肉的口感 
甚至還原了記憶中的懷念滋味呢？
趕快一起看影片做做看吧～～～
description.en: A vegan recreation of a childhood favorite signature potsticker, with a rich, nostalgic texture.
description.id: Rekreasi vegan potsticker andalan masa kecil dengan tekstur kaya dan nostalgia.
description.fil: Isang vegan na libangan ng isang paboritong signature potsticker noong bata pa, na may mayaman, nostalgic na texture.

instruction.zh: 油豆腐、豆包撕或切小塊；香菇、茄子和高麗菜切小塊，老薑切末。高麗菜加鹽抓勻，靜置約 20 分鐘出水。
instruction.en: Tear or cut the fried tofu and tofu sheets into small pieces; chop the shiitake, eggplant, and cabbage, and mince ginger. Salt the cabbage, mix, and rest about 20 minutes to draw out water.
instruction.id: Suwir atau potong tahu goreng dan lembaran tahu kecil-kecil; potong shiitake, terong, dan kol, lalu cincang jahe. Garami kol, aduk, dan diamkan sekitar 20 menit agar mengeluarkan air.
instruction.fil: Pilitin o gupitin ang piniritong tofu at tofu sheet sa maliliit na piraso; tagain ang shiitake, talong, at repolyo, at tinadtad na luya. Asin ang repolyo, haluin, at magpahinga ng mga 20 minuto upang makalabas ng tubig.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Chop and salt the cabbage”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

instruction.zh: 平底鍋放少量植物油，將豆包和油豆腐煸至金黃；加入薑末、香菇和茄子。加入醬油、五香粉、胡椒粉、糖、香油及少量水，大火炒至收乾。
instruction.en: Add a little vegetable oil to a skillet and brown the tofu sheets and fried tofu. Add ginger, shiitake, and eggplant, then soy sauce, five-spice, pepper, sugar, sesame oil, and a little water; cook over high heat until dry.
instruction.id: Tambahkan sedikit minyak nabati ke wajan dan kecokelatan lembaran tahu serta tahu goreng. Tambahkan jahe, shiitake, dan terong, lalu kecap asin, bubuk lima rempah, lada, gula, minyak wijen, dan sedikit air; masak dengan api besar hingga kering.
instruction.fil: Magdagdag ng kaunting langis ng gulay sa isang kawali at kayumanggi ang tofu sheet at pritong tofu. Magdagdag ng luya, shiitake, at talong, pagkatapos ay toyo, limang pampalasa, paminta, asukal, sesame oil, at kaunting tubig; lutuin sa sobrang init hanggang matuyo.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Cook the filling”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

instruction.zh: 將醃好的高麗菜擠乾，與炒好的餡料拌勻；加入玉米粉和水攪拌增加黏稠度。
instruction.en: Squeeze the salted cabbage dry and combine with the cooked filling; mix in cornstarch and water to add stickiness.
instruction.id: Peras kol yang telah digarami dan campurkan dengan isian matang; aduk tepung maizena dan air untuk menambah kekentalan.
instruction.fil: Pisilin ang inasnan na repolyo na tuyo at pagsamahin sa lutong pagpuno; ihalo sa cornstarch at tubig para malagkit.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Finish the filling”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

instruction.zh: 將水餃皮左右稍拉成長方形，包入餡料並在邊緣抹水；對摺後收兩側成鍋貼形狀。
instruction.en: Stretch the dumpling wrapper slightly into a rectangle, add filling and wet the edges; fold in half and shape the two sides into a potsticker.
instruction.id: Regangkan sedikit kulit pangsit menjadi persegi panjang, isi dan basahi pinggirnya; lipat dua lalu bentuk kedua sisi menjadi potsticker.
instruction.fil: Iunat ang dumpling wrapper nang bahagya sa isang rektanggulo, magdagdag ng pagpuno at basain ang mga gilid; tiklupin sa kalahati at hubugin ang dalawang panig sa isang potsticker.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Fold the potstickers”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

instruction.zh: 將 1 匙低筋麵粉加入 200 cc 水，攪拌至無顆粒。新鮮鍋貼的麵粉水約淹至三分之一高度；冷凍鍋貼至少淹至一半。
instruction.en: Mix 1 spoonful cake flour with 200 cc water until lump-free. For fresh potstickers, use enough to cover about one-third of their height; for frozen ones, at least halfway.
instruction.id: Campurkan 1 sendok tepung protein rendah dengan 200 cc air hingga tidak bergerindil. Untuk potsticker segar, gunakan hingga sekitar sepertiga tingginya; untuk yang beku, setidaknya setengahnya.
instruction.fil: Paghaluin ang 1 kutsarang cake flour na may 200 cc na tubig hanggang sa mabukol. Para sa mga sariwang potsticker, gumamit ng sapat upang masakop ang halos isang-katlo ng kanilang taas; para sa mga frozen, hindi bababa sa kalahati.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Mix flour water”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

title.fil: I-pan-fry na may malutong na puntas

instruction.zh: 平底鍋放少量植物油，排入鍋貼並煎至底部微黃。倒入麵粉水，先小火、蓋鍋蓋後轉中火煮至水將乾；開蓋讓麵粉水燒乾，底部形成脆冰花後關火翻盤。
instruction.en: Add a little vegetable oil to a skillet, arrange the potstickers, and cook until the bottoms are lightly golden. Add flour water; start on low heat, cover, then use medium heat until nearly dry. Uncover and cook the flour water dry to form a crisp lace, then turn off heat and invert onto a plate.
instruction.id: Tambahkan sedikit minyak ke wajan, susun potsticker, dan masak hingga bagian bawah agak keemasan. Tambahkan air tepung; mulai dengan api kecil, tutup, lalu gunakan api sedang hingga hampir kering. Buka tutup dan masak hingga air tepung kering membentuk renda renyah, lalu matikan api dan balikkan ke piring.
instruction.fil: Magdagdag ng kaunting langis ng gulay sa isang kawali, ayusin ang mga potsticker, at lutuin hanggang ang mga ilalim ay bahagyang ginintuang. Magdagdag ng tubig ng harina; simulan sa mahinang apoy, takpan, pagkatapos ay gumamit ng katamtamang init hanggang halos matuyo. Alisan ng takip at lutuin ang tubig ng harina na tuyo upang bumuo ng isang malutong na puntas, pagkatapos ay patayin ang apoy at ibalik sa isang plato.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Pan-fry with a crisp lace”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

title.en: Three Vegan Sichuan Braised Pork-Style Pouch Meals
title.id: Tiga Olahan Pouch Daging Babi Rebus Sichuan Vegan
title.fil: Tatlong Vegan Sichuan Braised Pork-Style Pouch Meal

description.zh: 一包全素川味滷肉調理包的三種快速吃法：淋在熱白飯上、加入蔬菜炒成炒飯，或直接搭配切塊嫩豆腐作夏日涼拌小菜。
description.en: Three quick ways to use a vegan Sichuan braised ‘pork’ meal pouch: pour it over hot rice, stir-fry it with vegetables and rice, or serve it over cubed silken tofu as a chilled summer side.
description.id: Tiga cara cepat memakai pouch ‘daging babi’ rebus Sichuan vegan: tuang di atas nasi panas, tumis bersama sayuran dan nasi, atau sajikan di atas tahu sutra potong sebagai lauk dingin musim panas.
description.fil: Tatlong mabilis na paraan ng paggamit ng vegan Sichuan braised 'pork' meal pouch: ibuhos ito sa mainit na kanin, iprito ito kasama ng mga gulay at kanin, o ihain ito sa ibabaw ng cubed silken tofu bilang pinalamig na tag-init.

instruction.zh: 最推薦隔水加熱：將調理包放入滾水加熱6分鐘。也可用電鍋蒸，或倒出加蓋後微波。
instruction.en: Hot-water heating is recommended: place the pouch in boiling water for 6 minutes. It may also be steamed in an electric cooker or emptied into a covered container and microwaved.
instruction.id: Pemanasan dalam air panas dianjurkan: letakkan pouch dalam air mendidih selama 6 menit. Pouch juga dapat dikukus dalam penanak listrik atau dituangkan ke wadah tertutup lalu dipanaskan dengan microwave.
instruction.fil: Inirerekomenda ang pag-init ng mainit na tubig: ilagay ang supot sa tubig na kumukulo sa loob ng 6 na minuto. Maaari rin itong i-steam sa isang electric cooker o ibuhos sa isang nakatakip na lalagyan at i-microwave.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Heat the Sichuan braised ‘pork’ pouch”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

title.en: Make the Sichuan braised ‘pork’ rice bowl
title.id: Buat nasi siram ‘daging babi’ rebus Sichuan
title.fil: Gawin ang Sichuan braised 'pork' rice bowl

instruction.zh: 將加熱好的調理包直接淋在熱白飯上。可加香菜；可食五辛者可加蔥花。想加重口味時，可自行加入醬油或香辣辣椒油調整。
instruction.en: Pour the heated pouch directly over hot white rice. Add cilantro, and scallions if suitable for your diet. Adjust a stronger flavor with soy sauce or fragrant chili oil if desired.
instruction.id: Tuangkan pouch panas langsung di atas nasi putih panas. Tambahkan daun ketumbar, serta daun bawang bila sesuai dengan pola makan Anda. Sesuaikan rasa yang lebih kuat dengan kecap asin atau minyak cabai aromatik bila diinginkan.
instruction.fil: Ibuhos ang pinainit na lagayan nang direkta sa mainit na puting bigas. Magdagdag ng cilantro, at scallion kung angkop sa iyong diyeta. Ayusin ang mas malakas na lasa na may toyo o mabangong chili oil kung ninanais.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Make the Sichuan braised ‘pork’ rice bowl”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

title.fil: Magprito ng mga gulay at kanin sa araw

instruction.zh: 熱鍋加少量植物油，先將喜歡的蔬菜炒香、炒軟；若使用豆製蛋白食材，先煎香。加入隔夜飯炒散。
instruction.en: Heat a little vegetable oil in a wok, stir-fry preferred vegetables until fragrant and tender, and sear tofu-based protein first if using. Add day-old rice and break it up while frying.
instruction.id: Panaskan sedikit minyak nabati dalam wajan, tumis sayuran pilihan hingga harum dan lunak, serta masak dahulu protein berbahan tahu bila digunakan. Tambahkan nasi semalam dan uraikan sambil ditumis.
instruction.fil: Mag-init ng kaunting mantika ng gulay sa isang kawali, magprito ng gustong gulay hanggang sa mabango at malambot, at igisa muna ang tofu-based na protina kung gagamitin. Magdagdag ng pang-araw na kanin at hiwa-hiwalayin ito habang piniprito.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Stir-fry vegetables and day-old rice”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

title.id: Selesaikan nasi goreng ‘daging babi’ rebus Sichuan
title.fil: Tapusin ang sinangag na 'pork' na sinangag ng Sichuan

instruction.zh: 加入川味滷肉調理包和1湯匙醬油，以大火炒香即可。可依喜好再加香辣辣椒油、香菜或蔥花。
instruction.en: Add the Sichuan braised ‘pork’ pouch and 1 tablespoon soy sauce, then stir-fry over high heat until fragrant. Add fragrant chili oil, cilantro, or scallions if desired.
instruction.id: Tambahkan pouch ‘daging babi’ rebus Sichuan dan 1 sdm kecap asin, lalu tumis dengan api besar hingga harum. Tambahkan minyak cabai aromatik, daun ketumbar, atau daun bawang bila diinginkan.
instruction.fil: Idagdag ang Sichuan braised 'pork' pouch at 1 kutsarang toyo, pagkatapos ay iprito sa sobrang init hanggang sa mabango. Magdagdag ng mabangong chili oil, cilantro, o scallion kung ninanais.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Finish Sichuan braised ‘pork’ fried rice”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

title.id: Buat tahu sutra dingin ‘daging babi’ rebus
title.fil: Gumawa ng chilled braised 'pork' silken tofu

instruction.zh: 嫩豆腐切塊，倒上加熱好的川味滷肉調理包即可。可依口味加入醬油、醬油膏或香辣辣椒油，最後撒香菜或蔥花。
instruction.en: Cube silken tofu and pour the heated Sichuan braised ‘pork’ pouch over it. Add soy sauce, soy sauce paste, or fragrant chili oil to taste, then top with cilantro or scallions.
instruction.id: Potong tahu sutra, lalu tuangkan pouch ‘daging babi’ rebus Sichuan yang sudah dipanaskan di atasnya. Tambahkan kecap asin, pasta kecap asin, atau minyak cabai aromatik sesuai selera, lalu beri daun ketumbar atau daun bawang.
instruction.fil: Cube silken tofu at ibuhos ang pinainit na Sichuan braised 'pork' pouch sa ibabaw nito. Magdagdag ng toyo, soy sauce paste, o mabangong chili oil ayon sa panlasa, pagkatapos ay lagyan ng cilantro o scallion.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Make chilled braised ‘pork’ silken tofu”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

title.en: Stir-Fried Ningbo Rice Cakes with Pickled Mustard Greens and Tofu
title.id: Kue Beras Ningbo Tumis dengan Sawi Asin dan Tahu Kering
title.fil: Stir-Fried Ningbo Rice Cake na may Adobong Mustard Greens at Tofu

description.zh: 以寧波年糕、雪菜、豆干、豆豉與菇類大火拌炒；先煎年糕再加水收乾，讓年糕吸收鍋中風味。
description.en: Ningbo rice cakes stir-fried over high heat with pickled mustard greens, tofu, fermented black beans, and mushrooms. The rice cakes are browned first, then simmered and reduced to absorb the pan flavors.
description.id: Kue beras Ningbo ditumis dengan api besar bersama sawi asin, tahu kering, kedelai hitam fermentasi, dan jamur. Kue beras dicokelatkan dahulu, lalu direbus dan disusutkan agar menyerap rasa wajan.
description.fil: Ang Ningbo rice cakes ay pinirito sa sobrang init na may adobo na mustard greens, tofu, fermented black beans, at mushroom. Ang mga rice cake ay pina-brown muna, pagkatapos ay simmered at binawasan upang makuha ang pan lasa.

name.fil: adobo na mga gulay ng mustasa

title.en: Soak rice cakes and prep ingredients
title.id: Rendam kue beras dan siapkan bahan
title.fil: Ibabad ang mga rice cake at paghahanda ng mga sangkap

instruction.zh: 寧波年糕以溫水或常溫水泡至稍軟。豆干與茭白筍切條；香菇與辣椒切片；老薑切絲；金針菇切段；豆豉切碎。
instruction.en: Soak Ningbo rice cakes in warm or room-temperature water until slightly soft. Cut tofu and wild rice shoots into strips, slice shiitake and chili, julienne ginger, cut enoki into sections, and chop fermented black beans.
instruction.id: Rendam kue beras Ningbo dalam air hangat atau suhu ruang hingga agak lunak. Potong tahu dan rebung padi liar menjadi strip, iris shiitake serta cabai, iris korek jahe, potong enoki, dan cincang kedelai hitam fermentasi.
instruction.fil: Ibabad ang Ningbo rice cakes sa mainit-init o room-temperature na tubig hanggang bahagyang lumambot. Gupitin ang tofu at wild rice shoots, hiwain ang shiitake at sili, julienne ginger, gupitin ang enoki, at i-chop ang fermented black beans.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Soak rice cakes and prep ingredients”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

title.fil: Maghanda ng adobo na mga gulay ng mustasa

instruction.zh: 使用市售雪菜前先試吃；若偏鹹，先泡水讓鹽分釋出後稍微沖洗。
instruction.en: Taste store-bought pickled mustard greens first. If very salty, soak to release salt, then rinse briefly.
instruction.id: Cicipi dahulu sawi asin kemasan. Jika sangat asin, rendam untuk mengurangi garam lalu bilas sebentar.
instruction.fil: Tikman muna ang adobo na mustasa na binili sa tindahan. Kung masyadong maalat, ibabad para makapaglabas ng asin, pagkatapos ay banlawan sandali.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Prepare pickled mustard greens”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

title.en: Pan-fry rice cakes over low heat
title.id: Goreng kue beras dengan api kecil
title.fil: Magprito ng mga rice cake sa mahinang apoy

instruction.zh: 泡好的年糕瀝水後，以少量油小火煎至微黃、表面略蓬鬆，取出備用。
instruction.en: Drain the soaked rice cakes and pan-fry in a little oil over low heat until lightly golden and slightly puffed, then set aside.
instruction.id: Tiriskan kue beras yang direndam, lalu goreng dengan sedikit minyak di api kecil hingga agak keemasan dan sedikit mengembang, kemudian sisihkan.
instruction.fil: Patuyuin ang binad na rice cake at i-pan-fry sa kaunting mantika sa mahinang apoy hanggang sa bahagyang ginintuang at bahagyang pumutok, pagkatapos ay itabi.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Pan-fry rice cakes over low heat”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

title.fil: Magprito ng mga aromatics at gulay

instruction.zh: 補少量植物油，將豆干煸至金黃；加入老薑、茭白筍、金針菇與香菇煸香，再加入雪菜與豆豉炒香。
instruction.en: Add a little vegetable oil and brown tofu until golden. Add ginger, wild rice shoots, enoki, and shiitake until fragrant, then add pickled mustard greens and fermented black beans.
instruction.id: Tambahkan sedikit minyak nabati dan tumis tahu hingga keemasan. Tambahkan jahe, rebung padi liar, enoki, dan shiitake hingga harum, lalu masukkan sawi asin serta kedelai hitam fermentasi.
instruction.fil: Magdagdag ng kaunting vegetable oil at brown tofu hanggang sa ginintuang. Magdagdag ng luya, wild rice shoots, enoki, at shiitake hanggang mabango, pagkatapos ay magdagdag ng adobo na mustard greens at fermented black beans.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Stir-fry aromatics and vegetables”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

instruction.zh: 加入年糕拌炒，放入醬油、香油、胡椒粉與糖後轉大火炒香；加入雪菜與辣椒，倒入約200毫升水熬煮。
instruction.en: Return rice cakes and stir-fry. Add soy sauce, sesame oil, ground pepper, and sugar, then cook over high heat until fragrant; add pickled mustard greens and chili, then pour in about 200 ml water to simmer.
instruction.id: Masukkan kembali kue beras dan tumis. Tambahkan kecap asin, minyak wijen, lada bubuk, serta gula, lalu masak dengan api besar hingga harum; tambahkan sawi asin dan cabai, kemudian tuang sekitar 200 ml air untuk direbus.
instruction.fil: Ibalik ang mga rice cake at iprito. Magdagdag ng toyo, sesame oil, giniling na paminta, at asukal, pagkatapos ay lutuin sa mataas na apoy hanggang sa mabango; magdagdag ng adobo na mustard greens at sili, pagkatapos ay ibuhos ang humigit-kumulang 200 ML ng tubig upang kumulo.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Season and simmer”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

instruction.zh: 待食材風味釋出、年糕吸收湯汁後，開大火收至完全收乾。依雪菜鹹度試味，必要時補鹽或醬油後起鍋。
instruction.en: Once the flavors release and the rice cakes absorb the liquid, increase heat and reduce until dry. Taste for the saltiness of the pickled greens; add salt or soy sauce only if needed, then serve.
instruction.id: Setelah rasa keluar dan kue beras menyerap cairan, besarkan api dan susutkan hingga kering. Cicipi sesuai tingkat asin sawi asin; tambahkan garam atau kecap asin hanya bila perlu, lalu sajikan.
instruction.fil: Kapag ang mga lasa ay lumabas at ang mga rice cake ay sumisipsip ng likido, dagdagan ang init at bawasan hanggang sa matuyo. Tikman ang kaasinan ng adobo na gulay; magdagdag lamang ng asin o toyo kung kinakailangan, pagkatapos ay ihain.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Reduce and serve”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

title.zh: 怎麼可能不用蛋竟然能做出蒸蛋

description.zh: 以板豆腐、高麗菜和三種菇類打成細緻基底，加入營養酵母、薑黃、雙胡椒與植物奶，電鍋蒸熟後撒黑鹽，做出香氣與口感近似蒸蛋的全素料理。
description.en: Firm tofu, cabbage, and three mushrooms are blended into a smooth base with nutritional yeast, turmeric, two peppers, and plant milk. Steam it in an electric cooker and finish with black salt for a vegan dish with steamed-egg-like aroma and texture.
description.id: Tahu padat, kol, dan tiga jenis jamur diblender menjadi dasar halus bersama ragi nutrisi, kunyit, dua jenis lada, dan susu nabati. Kukus dalam rice cooker lalu akhiri dengan garam hitam untuk hidangan vegan beraroma serta bertekstur seperti telur kukus.
description.fil: Ang matigas na tofu, repolyo, at tatlong mushroom ay pinaghalo sa isang makinis na base na may nutritional yeast, turmeric, dalawang paminta, at gatas ng halaman. I-steam ito sa isang electric cooker at tapusin na may itim na asin para sa isang vegan dish na may steamed-egg-like na aroma at texture.

title.fil: Maghanda ng repolyo, mushroom, at luya

instruction.zh: 高麗菜剝成小片後洗淨；鮮香菇和老薑切片，金針菇切小段，秀珍菇用手撕成條。
instruction.en: Tear the cabbage into small pieces and wash it. Slice the fresh shiitake and mature ginger, cut the enoki into short lengths, and tear the oyster mushrooms into strips by hand.
instruction.id: Sobek kol menjadi potongan kecil lalu cuci. Iris shiitake segar dan jahe tua, potong enoki pendek-pendek, lalu suwir jamur tiram menjadi serat dengan tangan.
instruction.fil: Hatiin ang repolyo sa maliliit na piraso at hugasan ito. Hiwain ang sariwang shiitake at mature na luya, gupitin ang enoki sa maikling haba, at gupitin ang mga oyster mushroom sa pamamagitan ng kamay.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic overhead 16:9 vegan recipe preparation image of washed cabbage, sliced shiitake and ginger, short enoki and torn oyster mushrooms, no text, no watermark, no logo.

title.zh: 煸香菇類並炒軟高麗菜
title.en: Brown the mushrooms and soften the cabbage
title.id: Tumis jamur hingga kecokelatan dan lunakkan kol
title.fil: Brown ang mushroom at palambutin ang repolyo

instruction.zh: 平底鍋加少量植物油，先將菇類和薑煸至焦黃酥脆並均勻上色，盛出。接著把高麗菜炒軟後，與菇類和薑放在一起。
instruction.en: Add a little vegetable oil to a skillet and brown the mushrooms and ginger until crisp and deeply golden, turning for even color, then remove. Soften the cabbage in the pan and combine it with the mushrooms and ginger.
instruction.id: Tambahkan sedikit minyak nabati ke wajan lalu tumis jamur dan jahe hingga kecokelatan serta renyah sambil dibalik agar warnanya merata, kemudian angkat. Lunakkan kol di wajan lalu campurkan dengan jamur dan jahe.
instruction.fil: Magdagdag ng kaunting langis ng gulay sa isang kawali at kayumanggi ang mga kabute at luya hanggang sa malutong at malalim na ginintuang, lumiliko para sa pantay na kulay, pagkatapos ay alisin. Palambutin ang repolyo sa kawali at pagsamahin ito sa mga mushroom at luya.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic 16:9 vegan skillet image of deeply golden mushrooms and ginger beside softened cabbage, no egg, no meat, no text, no watermark, no logo.

title.en: Blend into a smooth tofu base
title.id: Blender menjadi dasar tahu yang halus
title.fil: Haluin sa isang makinis na base ng tofu

instruction.zh: 將炒好的菇類、高麗菜和薑放入調理機或果汁機，打成細碎狀；加入板豆腐，連同盒內水分一起打至盡量綿密。
instruction.en: Put the cooked mushrooms, cabbage, and ginger into a blender or food processor and blend until finely broken down. Add the firm tofu with its container liquid and blend as smooth as possible.
instruction.id: Masukkan jamur, kol, dan jahe yang telah dimasak ke blender atau food processor lalu haluskan hingga sangat kecil. Tambahkan tahu padat beserta cairan dalam kemasannya dan blender hingga sehalus mungkin.
instruction.fil: Ilagay ang mga nilutong mushroom, repolyo, at luya sa isang blender o food processor at haluin hanggang sa makinis na masira. Idagdag ang matibay na tofu kasama ang likidong lalagyan nito at timpla nang makinis hangga't maaari.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic 16:9 vegan food processor image of a pale blended tofu, cabbage and mushroom custard base becoming smooth, no egg, no text, no watermark, no logo.

title.en: Season and pour into a steaming dish
title.id: Bumbui dan tuang ke wadah kukus
title.fil: Timplahan at ibuhos sa isang umuusok na pinggan

instruction.zh: 加入營養酵母、薑黃粉、黑胡椒、白胡椒、鹽、植物奶和少量香油，攪打均勻。沒有植物奶時可改加水。將混合物倒入可放進電鍋的深盤。
instruction.en: Add nutritional yeast, turmeric powder, black pepper, white pepper, salt, plant milk, and a little sesame oil, then blend evenly. Use water if plant milk is unavailable. Pour the mixture into a deep dish that fits an electric cooker.
instruction.id: Tambahkan ragi nutrisi, bubuk kunyit, lada hitam, lada putih, garam, susu nabati, dan sedikit minyak wijen, lalu blender hingga rata. Gunakan air bila tidak ada susu nabati. Tuang campuran ke wadah dalam yang muat di rice cooker.
instruction.fil: Magdagdag ng nutritional yeast, turmeric powder, black pepper, white pepper, asin, gatas ng halaman, at kaunting sesame oil, pagkatapos ay haluin nang pantay-pantay. Gumamit ng tubig kung hindi magagamit ang gatas ng halaman. Ibuhos ang pinaghalong sa isang malalim na pinggan na kasya sa isang electric cooker.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic 16:9 vegan recipe image of pale golden seasoned tofu custard mixture being poured into a deep ceramic steaming dish, no egg, no text, no watermark, no logo.

title.en: Steam in an electric cooker and finish with black salt
title.id: Kukus dalam rice cooker dan akhiri dengan garam hitam
title.fil: I-steam sa isang electric cooker at tapusin ng itim na asin

instruction.zh: 電鍋外鍋加入1杯水，放入蒸盤蒸煮。電鍋跳起後取出，撒上黑鹽即可享用。
instruction.en: Add 1 cup of water to the outer pot of an electric cooker and steam the dish. When the cooker switches off, remove it and sprinkle with black salt before serving.
instruction.id: Tambahkan 1 cangkir air ke panci luar rice cooker lalu kukus wadahnya. Saat rice cooker selesai, keluarkan dan taburi garam hitam sebelum disajikan.
instruction.fil: Magdagdag ng 1 tasa ng tubig sa panlabas na palayok ng electric cooker at pasingawan ang ulam. Kapag naka-off ang kusinilya, alisin ito at budburan ng itim na asin bago ihain.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic 16:9 finished vegan steamed egg-style custard in a ceramic dish, pale golden and silky with a light sprinkle of black salt, no egg, no text, no watermark, no logo.

description.zh: 以多種菇類、豆乾、豆豉和菜脯在油中慢煉，加入醬油、十三香與香油等調味，製成可拌飯、拌麵或拌菜的全素萬用 XO 醬。
description.en: Several mushrooms, dried tofu, fermented black beans, and preserved radish are slowly confited in oil, then seasoned with soy sauce, thirteen-spice blend, sesame oil, and more to make an all-purpose vegan XO sauce for rice, noodles, or vegetables.
description.id: Berbagai jamur, tahu kering, tauco hitam fermentasi, dan lobak asin dimasak perlahan dalam minyak, lalu dibumbui dengan kecap asin, campuran tiga belas rempah, minyak wijen, dan lainnya untuk membuat saus XO vegan serbaguna bagi nasi, mi, atau sayuran.
description.fil: Maraming mushroom, tuyo na tofu, fermented black beans, at preserved radish ang dahan-dahang nilagyan ng mantika, pagkatapos ay tinimplahan ng toyo, labintatlong spice blend, sesame oil, at higit pa para gawing all-purpose vegan XO sauce para sa kanin, noodles, o gulay.

title.zh: 切碎材料並研磨乾辣椒
title.en: Chop the ingredients and grind dried chili
title.id: Cincang bahan dan giling cabai kering
title.fil: Hiwain ang mga sangkap at durugin ang tuyong sili

instruction.zh: 除乾辣椒與月桂葉外，將金針菇、山茶茸、杏鮑菇、舞菇、辣椒、老薑、菜脯、豆豉、乾香菇和豆乾全部切成末。乾香菇先擠乾水分；乾辣椒打成粉，沒有時可用辣椒粉。
instruction.en: Except for the dried chili and bay leaves, finely chop the enoki, yamabushitake-style mushroom, king oyster mushrooms, maitake, chili, mature ginger, preserved radish, fermented black beans, dried shiitake, and dried tofu. Squeeze the dried shiitake dry first; grind dried chili into powder, or use chili powder if needed.
instruction.id: Selain cabai kering dan daun salam, cincang halus enoki, jamur yamabushitake, jamur king oyster, maitake, cabai, jahe tua, lobak asin, tauco hitam fermentasi, shiitake kering, dan tahu kering. Peras shiitake kering hingga tidak berair; giling cabai kering menjadi bubuk, atau gunakan bubuk cabai bila perlu.
instruction.fil: Maliban sa pinatuyong sili at bay dahon, tadtarin ng makinis ang enoki, yamabushitake-style mushroom, king oyster mushroom, maitake, sili, mature na luya, preserved na labanos, fermented black beans, dried shiitake, at dried tofu. Pigain muna ang pinatuyong shiitake; gilingin ang pinatuyong sili upang maging pulbos, o gumamit ng chili powder kung kinakailangan.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic overhead 16:9 vegan XO sauce preparation image of assorted finely chopped mushrooms, dried tofu, preserved radish, ginger, fermented black beans and ground dried chili, no seafood, no text, no watermark, no logo.

title.zh: 以400克油爆香薑、辣椒與月桂葉
title.en: Fragrance ginger, chili, and bay leaves in 400 g oil
title.id: Tumis jahe, cabai, dan daun salam dalam 400 g minyak
title.fil: Halimuyak ang luya, sili, at dahon ng bay sa 400 g langis

instruction.zh: 鍋中倒入400克植物油。先下老薑、辣椒和月桂葉爆香。
instruction.en: Pour 400 g of vegetable oil into a pot. First fry the mature ginger, chili, and bay leaves until fragrant.
instruction.id: Tuangkan 400 g minyak nabati ke dalam panci. Tumis terlebih dahulu jahe tua, cabai, dan daun salam hingga harum.
instruction.fil: Ibuhos ang 400 g ng langis ng gulay sa isang palayok. Iprito muna ang hinog na luya, sili, at dahon ng bay hanggang mabango.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic 16:9 vegan sauce-making image of mature ginger, chili and bay leaves gently frying in a generous amount of vegetable oil, no seafood, no text, no watermark, no logo.

title.zh: 慢煉豆乾、香菇、菜脯與豆豉
title.en: Slowly confit tofu, shiitake, radish, and black beans
title.id: Masak perlahan tahu, shiitake, lobak, dan tauco hitam
title.fil: Dahan-dahang i-confit ang tofu, shiitake, labanos, at black beans

instruction.zh: 香氣出來後加入豆乾、乾香菇、菜脯和豆豉，以小火慢煉至金黃；影片在豆乾金黃時約已煉20分鐘。
instruction.en: When fragrant, add the dried tofu, dried shiitake, preserved radish, and fermented black beans. Slowly confit over low heat until golden; the video says about 20 minutes had passed when the dried tofu turned golden.
instruction.id: Saat harum, masukkan tahu kering, shiitake kering, lobak asin, dan tauco hitam fermentasi. Masak perlahan dengan api kecil hingga keemasan; video menyebut sekitar 20 menit telah berlalu saat tahu kering menjadi keemasan.
instruction.fil: Kapag mabango, idagdag ang tuyo na tofu, pinatuyong shiitake, preserved na labanos, at fermented black beans. Dahan-dahang i-confit sa mababang init hanggang sa ginintuang; sabi sa video mga 20 minuto na ang lumipas nang ang tuyong tokwa ay naging ginto.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic 16:9 vegan XO sauce pot with diced dried tofu, shiitake, preserved radish and fermented black beans slowly confiting golden in oil, no seafood, no text, no watermark, no logo.

title.zh: 加入菇類繼續慢煉並調味
title.en: Add mushrooms, continue confiting, and season
title.id: Tambahkan jamur, lanjutkan memasak perlahan, lalu bumbui
title.fil: Magdagdag ng mga kabute, magpatuloy sa pag-confitting, at timplahan

instruction.zh: 取出月桂葉，加入切好的菇類繼續慢煉。菇類釋出水分時可略轉大火，之後再轉小火慢煉；影片建議全程約30至35分鐘，可抓40分鐘上下，煉至呈 XO 醬般深色。加入醬油、胡椒粉、十三香、香油、鹽和糖拌勻。
instruction.en: Remove the bay leaves and add the chopped mushrooms to continue slowly confiting. When the mushrooms release moisture, raise the heat slightly, then return to low heat. The video suggests about 30 to 35 minutes overall, roughly 40 minutes, until it reaches a dark XO-sauce-like color. Stir in soy sauce, ground pepper, thirteen-spice blend, sesame oil, salt, and sugar.
instruction.id: Angkat daun salam lalu masukkan jamur cincang untuk terus dimasak perlahan. Saat jamur mengeluarkan air, naikkan api sedikit lalu kembali ke api kecil. Video menyarankan total sekitar 30 hingga 35 menit, kira-kira 40 menit, sampai warnanya gelap seperti saus XO. Aduk dengan kecap asin, lada bubuk, campuran tiga belas rempah, minyak wijen, garam, dan gula.
instruction.fil: Alisin ang mga dahon ng bay at idagdag ang mga tinadtad na mushroom upang ipagpatuloy ang dahan-dahang pag-confiting. Kapag ang mga mushroom ay naglalabas ng kahalumigmigan, itaas ang init nang bahagya, pagkatapos ay bumalik sa mababang init. Ang video ay nagmumungkahi ng humigit-kumulang 30 hanggang 35 minuto sa pangkalahatan, humigit-kumulang 40 minuto, hanggang sa umabot ito sa isang madilim na kulay na parang XO-sauce. Haluin ang toyo, giniling na paminta, labintatlong timpla ng pampalasa, sesame oil, asin, at asukal.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic 16:9 vegan XO sauce slowly reducing in oil, dark golden mushroom and tofu relish with a rich chunky texture, absolutely no seafood, no text, no watermark, no logo.

title.zh: 裝入消毒玻璃瓶並冷藏
title.en: Jar in sterilized glass and refrigerate
title.id: Masukkan ke stoples kaca steril lalu dinginkan
title.fil: Jar sa isterilisadong baso at palamigin

instruction.zh: 將完成的醬裝入已消毒並晾乾的玻璃瓶，冷卻後冷藏。影片說明可冷藏保存約1個月。玻璃瓶可由冷水開始煮至滾後再煮10分鐘，晾乾後使用。
instruction.en: Transfer the finished sauce to a sterilized, dry glass jar and refrigerate after cooling. The video says it can keep refrigerated for about one month. To sterilize, start the jar in cold water, bring it to a boil, boil for 10 minutes, then air-dry before use.
instruction.id: Masukkan saus jadi ke dalam stoples kaca yang sudah disterilkan dan dikeringkan, lalu simpan di lemari es setelah dingin. Video menyebut saus dapat disimpan sekitar satu bulan dalam kulkas. Untuk mensterilkan, mulai dengan stoples dalam air dingin, didihkan, rebus 10 menit, lalu keringkan sebelum digunakan.
instruction.fil: Ilipat ang natapos na sarsa sa isang isterilisado, tuyo na garapon ng salamin at palamigin pagkatapos ng paglamig. Sinasabi ng video na maaari itong panatilihing pinalamig sa loob ng halos isang buwan. Upang isterilisado, simulan ang garapon sa malamig na tubig, pakuluan ito, pakuluan ng 10 minuto, pagkatapos ay tuyo sa hangin bago gamitin.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic 16:9 vegan pantry image of a sterilized clear glass jar filled with dark golden chunky vegan XO sauce, no seafood, no text, no watermark, no logo.

description.zh:
今天來分享這道 #京醬肉絲
傳說這道菜的由來
是因為以前一位四川師傅
因為想念北京烤鴨卻找不到鴨
於是用了豬肉絲來代替烤鴨
京醬肉絲就這樣誕生啦！

至於這個全素版本的食譜呢
究竟會用什麼超容易取得的食材
來代替肉絲的口感呢？
而且還有一個超關鍵的步驟..
讓這道菜更入味！絕對是白飯殺手～
快一起看影片吧～～
description.en: A vegan Beijing-style shredded-pork dish that uses wheat gluten to replace the meat texture and is served like Peking duck in spring-roll wrappers.
description.id: Hidangan 'daging' suwir gaya Beijing vegan yang memakai gluten gandum untuk menggantikan tekstur daging dan disajikan seperti bebek Peking dalam kulit lumpia.
description.fil: Isang vegan na Beijing-style na shredded-pork dish na gumagamit ng wheat gluten upang palitan ang texture ng karne at inihahain tulad ng Peking duck sa mga spring-roll wrapper.

instruction.zh: 麵腸沿紋理用手撕成不規則肉絲狀；老薑切片，紅蘿蔔與小黃瓜切絲。
instruction.en: Tear wheat gluten along its grain into irregular meat-like strips; slice ginger and cut carrot and cucumber into shreds.
instruction.id: Suwir gluten gandum mengikuti seratnya menjadi strip tak beraturan seperti daging; iris jahe dan potong wortel serta mentimun memanjang.
instruction.fil: Gupitin ang gluten ng trigo kasama ng butil nito sa hindi regular na mga piraso ng karne; hiwain ang luya at gupitin ang karot at pipino.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Prepare ingredients”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

instruction.zh: 麵腸先抓少量油，再以植物油煎至金黃酥脆後取出。補少量油，以小火煸薑片至捲曲後取出。
instruction.en: Coat the wheat gluten with a little oil, then pan-fry in vegetable oil until golden and crisp; remove. Add a little more oil and slowly fry ginger slices over low heat until curled, then remove.
instruction.id: Baluri gluten gandum dengan sedikit minyak, lalu goreng hingga keemasan dan renyah; angkat. Tambahkan sedikit minyak lagi dan goreng perlahan irisan jahe dengan api kecil hingga melengkung, lalu angkat.
instruction.fil: Pahiran ng kaunting mantika ang wheat gluten, pagkatapos ay i-pan-fry sa vegetable oil hanggang sa ginintuang at malutong; tanggalin. Lagyan ng kaunting mantika at dahan-dahang iprito ang mga hiwa ng luya sa mahinang apoy hanggang sa makulubot, pagkatapos ay alisin.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Brown gluten and ginger”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

instruction.zh: 先關火，放入甜麵醬、豆瓣醬、五香粉、糖、胡椒粉和醬油後再開小火快速拌炒出醬香。加入麵腸拌勻，倒入 100 cc 水加蓋燜約 5 分鐘。
instruction.en: Turn off the heat first, add sweet bean sauce, chili bean paste, five-spice powder, sugar, pepper, and soy sauce, then turn to low heat and stir quickly until fragrant. Add the wheat gluten, coat evenly, add 100 cc water, cover, and braise about 5 minutes.
instruction.id: Matikan api terlebih dahulu, masukkan saus kacang manis, pasta kacang cabai, bubuk lima rempah, gula, lada, dan kecap asin, lalu nyalakan api kecil dan aduk cepat hingga harum. Tambahkan gluten gandum, lumuri rata, tambahkan 100 cc air, tutup, dan masak sekitar 5 menit.
instruction.fil: Patayin muna ang apoy, ilagay ang sweet bean sauce, chili bean paste, five-spice powder, asukal, paminta, at toyo, pagkatapos ay buksan sa mahinang apoy at haluin nang mabilis hanggang sa mabango. Idagdag ang wheat gluten, balutin nang pantay-pantay, magdagdag ng 100 cc na tubig, takpan, at i-braise ng mga 5 minuto.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Cook the Beijing-style sauce”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

instruction.zh: 開蓋後開大火快炒至醬汁收乾，淋少量香油起鍋。可與春捲皮、小黃瓜絲和紅蘿蔔絲一起包食。
instruction.en: Uncover and stir-fry over high heat until the sauce reduces dry, then finish with a little sesame oil. Serve wrapped with spring-roll wrappers, cucumber shreds, and carrot shreds.
instruction.id: Buka tutup dan tumis cepat dengan api besar hingga saus menyusut kering, lalu selesaikan dengan sedikit minyak wijen. Sajikan dibungkus dengan kulit lumpia, irisan mentimun, dan wortel.
instruction.fil: Alisan ng takip at iprito sa sobrang init hanggang sa matuyo ang sarsa, pagkatapos ay tapusin ng kaunting sesame oil. Ihain na nakabalot na may mga spring-roll wrapper, cucumber shreds, at carrot shreds.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Reduce and finish”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

description.zh: 以三種豆腐、菇類、荸薺和薑製作有咀嚼感的純素丸子，加入味噌和玉米粉調味定型後，油炸至金黃；可直接食用、冷凍備用或用於湯品與火鍋。
description.en: Three kinds of tofu, mushrooms, water chestnuts, and ginger make chewy vegan meatballs. Miso and cornstarch season and bind the mixture before frying it golden; eat them directly, freeze for later, or add to soup and hot pot.
description.id: Tiga jenis tahu, jamur, bengkuang air, dan jahe membuat bakso vegan yang kenyal. Miso serta pati jagung membumbui dan mengikat adonan sebelum digoreng keemasan; nikmati langsung, bekukan untuk nanti, atau tambahkan ke sup dan hot pot.
description.fil: Tatlong uri ng tofu, mushroom, water chestnut, at luya ang gumagawa ng chewy vegan meatballs. Timplahan ng miso at gawgaw at itali ang timpla bago ito iprito na ginintuang; kainin ang mga ito nang direkta, i-freeze para sa ibang pagkakataon, o idagdag sa sopas at mainit na palayok.

title.zh: 切碎材料並壓成豆腐泥
title.en: Chop the ingredients and mash the tofu
title.fil: Hiwain ang mga sangkap at i-mash ang tofu

instruction.zh: 百葉豆腐、冷凍油豆腐、香菇、杏鮑菇、荸薺和老薑全部切成小末；荸薺先削皮。把板豆腐壓成泥狀。
instruction.en: Finely chop the thousand-layer tofu, frozen fried tofu, shiitake, king oyster mushrooms, water chestnuts, and mature ginger; peel the water chestnuts first. Mash the firm tofu into a paste.
instruction.id: Cincang halus tahu berlapis, tahu goreng beku, shiitake, jamur king oyster, bengkuang air, dan jahe tua; kupas bengkuang air terlebih dahulu. Haluskan tahu padat menjadi pasta.
instruction.fil: Pinong tumaga ang thousand-layer tofu, frozen fried tofu, shiitake, king oyster mushroom, water chestnut, at mature na luya; balatan muna ang mga water chestnut. Mash ang firm tofu sa isang paste.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic overhead 16:9 vegan meatball preparation image of finely chopped tofu products, mushrooms, peeled water chestnuts and ginger beside mashed firm tofu, no meat, no text, no watermark, no logo.

title.id: Tumis jamur dan jahe hingga harum

instruction.zh: 鍋中加少量植物油，先將老薑、香菇和杏鮑菇煸至金黃。
instruction.en: Add a little vegetable oil to a pan and fry the mature ginger, shiitake, and king oyster mushrooms until golden.
instruction.id: Tambahkan sedikit minyak nabati ke wajan lalu tumis jahe tua, shiitake, dan jamur king oyster hingga keemasan.
instruction.fil: Magdagdag ng kaunting langis ng gulay sa isang kawali at iprito ang mature na luya, shiitake, at king oyster mushroom hanggang sa maging ginintuang.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic 16:9 vegan skillet image of minced shiitake, king oyster mushrooms and ginger browning golden in a small amount of oil, no meat, no text, no watermark, no logo.

title.en: Mix the filling and rest for 5 minutes
title.fil: Paghaluin ang pagpuno at magpahinga ng 5 minuto

instruction.zh: 將板豆腐泥、油豆腐、百葉豆腐、荸薺和煸好的菇類連同鍋中油混合。加入味噌、糖、胡椒粉、五香粉、香油和玉米粉拌勻，靜置5分鐘入味。
instruction.en: Mix the mashed firm tofu, fried tofu, thousand-layer tofu, water chestnuts, and browned mushrooms along with the oil from the pan. Add miso, sugar, ground pepper, five-spice, sesame oil, and cornstarch, mix evenly, and rest for 5 minutes.
instruction.id: Campurkan tahu padat yang dihaluskan, tahu goreng, tahu berlapis, bengkuang air, dan jamur yang telah ditumis beserta minyak dari wajan. Tambahkan miso, gula, lada bubuk, lima rempah, minyak wijen, dan pati jagung, aduk rata, lalu diamkan 5 menit.
instruction.fil: Paghaluin ang mashed firm tofu, fried tofu, thousand-layer tofu, water chestnuts, at browned mushroom kasama ang mantika mula sa kawali. Magdagdag ng miso, asukal, ground pepper, five-spice, sesame oil, at cornstarch, ihalo nang pantay-pantay, at magpahinga ng 5 minuto.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic 16:9 vegan mixing bowl scene of a chunky tofu, mushroom and water-chestnut meatball mixture being combined with seasonings, no meat, no text, no watermark, no logo.

title.zh: 調整玉米粉並塑形成丸子
title.id: Sesuaikan pati jagung dan bentuk bakso
title.fil: Ayusin ang cornstarch at hugis meatballs

instruction.zh: 以手把混合物拌勻並抓成丸子。若因豆腐水分較多而難以成形，依影片建議補加玉米粉，直至可抓成球狀。
instruction.en: Mix the filling well by hand and shape it into balls. If it is too wet from the tofu to hold its shape, add more cornstarch as the video advises until it can be formed into balls.
instruction.id: Aduk adonan dengan tangan lalu bentuk menjadi bola-bola. Jika terlalu basah karena kadar air tahu dan sulit dibentuk, tambahkan lagi pati jagung sesuai saran video hingga dapat dibentuk menjadi bola.
instruction.fil: Haluing mabuti ang pagpuno gamit ang kamay at hubugin ito ng mga bola. Kung ito ay masyadong basa mula sa tofu upang hawakan ang hugis nito, magdagdag ng higit pang cornstarch gaya ng ipinapayo ng video hanggang sa mabuo ito sa mga bola.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic 16:9 vegan food preparation image of hands shaping small round tofu-mushroom meatballs on a tray, no real meat, no text, no watermark, no logo.

instruction.zh: 油鍋加熱至160°C，將丸子下鍋炸至焦黃金黃後撈出瀝油。可直接食用，也可冷凍保存，之後以氣炸、煮湯或火鍋方式使用。
instruction.en: Heat frying oil to 160°C, fry the balls until deep golden, then lift out and drain. Eat them directly or freeze them for later air-frying, soup, or hot pot.
instruction.id: Panaskan minyak goreng hingga 160°C, goreng bola-bola hingga kuning keemasan lalu angkat dan tiriskan. Nikmati langsung atau bekukan untuk nanti dimasak dengan air fryer, sup, atau hot pot.
instruction.fil: Painitin ang mantika sa 160°C, iprito ang mga bola hanggang sa malalim na ginintuang, pagkatapos ay iangat at alisan ng tubig. Direktang kainin ang mga ito o i-freeze ang mga ito para sa pagprito sa hangin, sopas, o mainit na palayok sa ibang pagkakataon.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic 16:9 vegan frying image of small plant-based tofu and mushroom meatballs frying to a deep golden color in oil, no animal meat, no text, no watermark, no logo.

title.zh: 茶樓必點素食廣式燒賣自己做
title.en: Easy Vegan Cantonese Sticky Rice Shaomai
title.fil: Madaling Vegan Cantonese Sticky Rice Shaomai

description.zh: 以糯米、菇類和油豆腐做成香濃餡料，再用水餃皮包成廣式燒賣，蒸熟即可享用。
description.en: A savory sticky-rice filling with mushrooms and fried tofu is wrapped in dumpling wrappers and steamed into Cantonese-style vegan shaomai.
description.id: Isian nasi ketan gurih dengan jamur dan tahu goreng dibungkus kulit pangsit lalu dikukus menjadi siu mai vegan gaya Kanton.
description.fil: Ang isang malasang malagkit na kanin na may laman na mushroom at pritong tofu ay nakabalot sa dumpling wrapper at pinasingaw sa Cantonese-style vegan shaomai.

instruction.zh: 把鮮香菇、杏鮑菇、紅蘿蔔和油豆腐切成小丁；老薑切末。
instruction.en: Dice the fresh shiitake, king oyster mushrooms, carrot, and fried tofu; mince the ginger.
instruction.id: Potong dadu jamur shiitake, jamur tiram raja, wortel, dan tahu goreng; cincang halus jahe.
instruction.fil: Dice ang sariwang shiitake, king oyster mushroom, carrot, at pritong tofu; hiwain ang luya.

steps.imagePrompt: Overhead vegan cooking scene, neatly diced shiitake, king oyster mushrooms, carrot and fried tofu beside minced ginger on a wooden board, natural daylight, editorial food photography, no text, no watermark, no meat or animal products

instruction.zh: 炒鍋加少許香油，先把薑末、香菇和杏鮑菇煸至金黃，再加入油豆腐、紅蘿蔔和玉米粒炒香。
instruction.en: Heat a little sesame oil in a wok. Brown the ginger and mushrooms, then add fried tofu, carrot, and corn and sauté until fragrant.
instruction.id: Panaskan sedikit minyak wijen dalam wajan. Tumis jahe dan jamur hingga kecokelatan, lalu masukkan tahu goreng, wortel, dan jagung hingga harum.
instruction.fil: Mag-init ng kaunting sesame oil sa isang kawali. I-brown ang luya at mushroom, pagkatapos ay ilagay ang pritong tokwa, carrot, at mais at igisa hanggang mabango.

steps.imagePrompt: Vegan sticky rice shaomai filling sautéing in a dark wok: golden mushrooms, diced tofu, carrot and corn, gentle steam, authentic home kitchen, appetizing natural light, no text, no watermark, no meat or animal products

title.fil: Timplahan at lagyan ng malagkit na bigas

instruction.zh: 加入醬油、醬油膏、糖、胡椒粉、五香粉和花椒粉拌勻；加少許水略煮，待湯汁收乾後拌入熟糯米飯，炒勻後取出放涼。
instruction.en: Season with soy sauce, thick soy sauce, sugar, pepper, five-spice, and ground Sichuan pepper. Add a little water and simmer; once dry, stir in cooked sticky rice, mix evenly, then remove to cool.
instruction.id: Bumbui dengan kecap asin, kecap asin kental, gula, lada, bubuk lima rempah, dan lada Sichuan. Tambahkan sedikit air dan masak sebentar; setelah saus menyusut, aduk nasi ketan matang hingga rata lalu dinginkan.
instruction.fil: Timplahan ng toyo, makapal na toyo, asukal, paminta, five-spice, at giniling na Sichuan pepper. Magdagdag ng kaunting tubig at kumulo; kapag natuyo, haluin ang nilutong malagkit na bigas, haluin nang pantay-pantay, pagkatapos ay alisin upang lumamig.

steps.imagePrompt: Close-up of glossy vegan sticky rice filling being folded through a wok with mushrooms and vegetables, warm golden tones, visible steam, refined food photography, no text, no watermark, no meat or animal products

instruction.zh: 在工作檯撒少許低筋麵粉防黏，把水餃皮邊緣擀薄。把皮放在手指形成的 C 字支撐上，填入糯米餡並向下壓實，收緊外皮，頂部壓入一顆毛豆仁。
instruction.en: Dust the work surface with cake flour and roll only the dumpling-wrapper edges thinner. Support a wrapper in a C-shape with your fingers, fill with sticky-rice filling, press it firmly down, tighten the wrapper, and press an edamame bean into the top.
instruction.id: Taburi meja dengan sedikit tepung agar tidak lengket lalu tipiskan hanya tepi kulit pangsit. Tahan kulit membentuk huruf C dengan jari, isi nasi ketan, tekan padat ke bawah, rapatkan kulit, dan tekan satu edamame di atasnya.
instruction.fil: Alikabok ang ibabaw ng trabaho ng cake flour at pagulungin lamang ang mga gilid ng dumpling-wrapper na mas manipis. Suportahan ang isang wrapper sa isang C-shape gamit ang iyong mga daliri, punuin ng sticky-rice filling, pindutin ito nang mahigpit pababa, higpitan ang wrapper, at pindutin ang isang edamame bean sa itaas.

steps.imagePrompt: Hands shaping an open-topped vegan Cantonese shaomai from a thin dumpling wrapper and mushroom sticky-rice filling, single green edamame garnish, bamboo work surface, clean natural light, no text, no watermark, no meat or animal products

instruction.zh: 如外皮變乾，蒸前先在表面抹少許水並再壓緊。放入蒸籠，水滾後蒸 6 分鐘；也可用電鍋加一杯水蒸熟。
instruction.en: If the wrappers have dried, brush them with a little water and press them closed again. Steam for 6 minutes after the water boils, or steam in an electric cooker with one cup of water.
instruction.id: Jika kulit mengering, olesi sedikit air lalu tekan kembali sebelum dikukus. Kukus 6 menit setelah air mendidih, atau gunakan rice cooker listrik dengan satu cangkir air.
instruction.fil: Kung natuyo na ang mga wrapper, lagyan ng kaunting tubig ang mga ito at pindutin muli ang mga ito sarado. I-steam sa loob ng 6 na minuto pagkatapos kumulo ang tubig, o singaw sa isang electric cooker na may isang tasa ng tubig.

steps.imagePrompt: Freshly steamed open-topped vegan Cantonese shaomai arranged in a bamboo steamer, glossy dumpling wrappers and colorful mushroom sticky-rice filling, delicate steam, elegant food photography, no text, no watermark, no meat or animal products

title.id: Tumis Kentang Renyah untuk Musim Panas
title.fil: Crisp Potato Stir-Fry para sa Tag-init

description.zh: 馬鈴薯切絲後浸洗去澱粉，再與紅蘿蔔、青椒、薑絲、乾辣椒和花椒快炒，做出爽脆開胃的家常菜。
description.en: Julienned potatoes are soaked and rinsed to remove starch, then quickly stir-fried with carrot, green pepper, ginger, dried chili, and Sichuan pepper for a crisp, appetizing dish.
description.id: Kentang iris direndam dan dibilas untuk menghilangkan pati, lalu ditumis cepat dengan wortel, paprika hijau, jahe, cabai kering, dan lada Sichuan hingga renyah dan menggugah selera.
description.fil: Ang mga julienned na patatas ay binabad at hinuhugasan upang alisin ang almirol, pagkatapos ay mabilis na pinirito na may karot, berdeng paminta, luya, pinatuyong sili, at paminta ng Sichuan para sa isang malutong at pampagana na ulam.

instruction.zh: 馬鈴薯去皮後刨成或切成細絲；紅蘿蔔、青椒和老薑同樣切絲。
instruction.en: Peel and julienne the potatoes; cut the carrot, green pepper, and ginger into thin strips as well.
instruction.id: Kupas lalu iris tipis kentang; iris tipis juga wortel, paprika hijau, dan jahe.
instruction.fil: Balatan at julienne ang mga patatas; gupitin din ang karot, berdeng paminta, at luya.

steps.imagePrompt: Overhead vegan home cooking preparation with finely julienned potatoes, carrot, green pepper and ginger on a wooden cutting board, bright natural daylight, editorial food photography, no text, no watermark, no meat or animal products

instruction.zh: 馬鈴薯絲以清水浸泡 10 分鐘，再用清水至少沖洗兩次，輕搓洗去澱粉，讓炒後口感更脆。
instruction.en: Soak the potato strips in plain water for 10 minutes. Rinse them at least twice, gently rubbing away the starch for a crisper result.
instruction.id: Rendam irisan kentang dalam air biasa selama 10 menit. Bilas sedikitnya dua kali sambil digosok perlahan untuk menghilangkan pati agar hasilnya lebih renyah.
instruction.fil: Ibabad ang mga piraso ng patatas sa plain water sa loob ng 10 minuto. Banlawan ang mga ito ng hindi bababa sa dalawang beses, dahan-dahang kuskusin ang almirol para sa isang malutong na resulta.

steps.imagePrompt: Glass bowl of julienned potatoes soaking in clear water beside a colander, clean vegan kitchen scene, emphasis on crisp preparation, soft daylight, no text, no watermark, no meat or animal products

instruction.zh: 用小火煸香花椒，待顏色變深、香氣明顯時撈起；避免火力過大以免苦味。
instruction.en: Gently heat the Sichuan peppercorns over low heat. Remove them when their color deepens and their aroma is pronounced; avoid high heat so they do not turn bitter.
instruction.id: Panaskan lada Sichuan dengan api kecil. Angkat saat warnanya menggelap dan aromanya kuat; hindari api besar agar tidak pahit.
instruction.fil: Dahan-dahang painitin ang Sichuan peppercorns sa mahinang apoy. Alisin ang mga ito kapag ang kanilang kulay ay lumalim at ang kanilang aroma ay binibigkas; iwasan ang mataas na init upang hindi sila maging mapait.

steps.imagePrompt: Small pan gently toasting Sichuan peppercorns in vegetable oil over low heat, warm aromatic kitchen scene, close-up food photography, no text, no watermark, no meat or animal products

instruction.zh: 開火爆香乾辣椒和薑絲，加入紅蘿蔔炒軟；再放入瀝乾的馬鈴薯絲和青椒絲，以大火快速翻炒。
instruction.en: Heat the pan and sauté dried chilies with ginger. Add the carrot and cook until softened, then add drained potato and green-pepper strips and stir-fry quickly over high heat.
instruction.id: Panaskan wajan dan tumis cabai kering dengan jahe. Masukkan wortel hingga agak lunak, lalu tambahkan kentang yang sudah ditiriskan dan paprika hijau, kemudian tumis cepat dengan api besar.
instruction.fil: Init ang kawali at igisa ang mga pinatuyong sili na may luya. Idagdag ang karot at lutuin hanggang lumambot, pagkatapos ay idagdag ang pinatuyo na patatas at berdeng paminta at mabilis na iprito sa mataas na init.

steps.imagePrompt: Vegan Chinese potato stir-fry in a hot wok with julienned potato, carrot, green pepper, ginger and dried chili, lively motion and steam, appetizing natural food photography, no text, no watermark, no meat or animal products

instruction.zh: 加入少許鹽拌勻後起鍋；可按個人喜好再淋少許花椒油增添麻香。
instruction.en: Season with a little salt, toss evenly, and serve. If desired, finish with a little Sichuan pepper oil for extra fragrance.
instruction.id: Tambahkan sedikit garam, aduk rata, lalu sajikan. Bila suka, tambahkan sedikit minyak lada Sichuan untuk aroma yang lebih kuat.
instruction.fil: Timplahan ng kaunting asin, ihalo nang pantay-pantay, at ihain. Kung ninanais, tapusin ng kaunting Sichuan pepper oil para sa dagdag na bango.

steps.imagePrompt: Finished vegan julienned potato stir-fry plated with carrot, green pepper and dried chilies, glossy crisp texture, simple ceramic plate, natural daylight food photography, no text, no watermark, no meat or animal products

title.zh: 白菜豆腐煲鮮香入味又下飯
title.id: Tofu dan Sawi Putih dalam Claypot

description.zh: 先把豆腐煎香，再與大白菜、木耳及辛香料放入鍋中燜煮，做成鮮甜入味的白菜豆腐煲。
description.en: Pan-fried tofu is braised with Chinese cabbage, wood ear mushrooms, and aromatics for a savory, comforting claypot dish.
description.id: Tahu yang digoreng hingga harum dimasak perlahan bersama sawi putih, jamur kuping, dan bumbu aromatik menjadi hidangan claypot yang gurih.
description.fil: Ang pan-fried tofu ay nilaga kasama ng Chinese cabbage, wood ear mushroom, at aromatics para sa masarap at nakakaaliw na claypot dish.

instruction.zh: 把豆腐切片或三角片；大白菜切小段、木耳切小塊，芹菜、老薑、香菜和大辣椒切好備用。
instruction.en: Cut tofu into slices or triangles. Cut Chinese cabbage into short pieces and wood ear mushrooms into small pieces; prepare celery, ginger, cilantro, and chili.
instruction.id: Potong tahu menjadi irisan atau segitiga. Potong sawi putih pendek dan jamur kuping kecil-kecil; siapkan seledri, jahe, daun ketumbar, dan cabai.
instruction.fil: Gupitin ang tofu sa mga hiwa o tatsulok. Gupitin ang repolyo ng Tsino sa mga maikling piraso at mga mushroom sa tainga ng kahoy sa maliliit na piraso; maghanda ng kintsay, luya, cilantro, at sili.

steps.imagePrompt: Overhead vegan cooking mise en place with tofu triangles, Chinese cabbage, wood ear mushrooms, celery, ginger, cilantro and red chili on a wooden board, natural daylight, no text, no watermark, no meat or animal products

instruction.zh: 平底鍋加少許植物油，把豆腐兩面煎至金黃色後取出。
instruction.en: Heat a little vegetable oil in a pan and fry the tofu until both sides are golden, then remove it.
instruction.id: Panaskan sedikit minyak sayur dalam wajan, goreng tahu hingga kedua sisinya keemasan, lalu angkat.
instruction.fil: Mag-init ng kaunting vegetable oil sa isang kawali at iprito ang tofu hanggang sa maging ginintuang magkabilang gilid, pagkatapos ay alisin ito.

steps.imagePrompt: Golden pan-fried tofu triangles in a clean skillet with a light sheen of oil, vegan Chinese home cooking, warm natural food photography, no text, no watermark, no meat or animal products

instruction.en: Add salt and olive oil to boiling water. Cook lasagna sheets one at a time for about 3 to 5 minutes without overcooking. Transfer to cold water, then drain so they do not stick together.
instruction.id: Tambahkan garam dan minyak zaitun ke air mendidih. Rebus lembaran lasagna satu per satu sekitar 3 hingga 5 menit tanpa terlalu lama. Pindahkan ke air dingin, lalu tiriskan agar tidak saling menempel.
instruction.fil: Magdagdag ng asin at langis ng oliba sa tubig na kumukulo. Magluto ng lasagna sheet nang paisa-isa sa loob ng mga 3 hanggang 5 minuto nang hindi nag-overcooking. Ilipat sa malamig na tubig, pagkatapos ay alisan ng tubig upang hindi sila magkadikit.

instruction.en: In an oven-safe dish, spread a thin layer of white sauce, then layer lasagna sheets, sauce, and vegan cheese; repeat. Preheat at 200°C for 10 minutes, then bake at 220°C for 20 minutes.

title.id: Tumis Cincang Vegan dengan Acar Timun

description.zh: 以油豆腐、凍豆腐、香菇和脆瓜做出全素肉燥，利用日本山藥泥煮出濃稠口感，拌飯特別適合。
description.en: Fried tofu, frozen tofu, mushrooms, and pickled cucumber make a vegan braised mince, thickened with Japanese yam for a satisfying rice topping.
description.id: Tahu goreng, tahu beku, jamur, dan acar timun dibuat menjadi cincangan semur vegan yang dikentalkan dengan ubi Jepang, cocok untuk nasi.
description.fil: Ang piniritong tofu, frozen na tofu, mushroom, at adobo na pipino ay gumagawa ng vegan braised mince, na pinalapot ng Japanese yam para sa isang kasiya-siyang rice topping.

instruction.zh: 把油豆腐和凍豆腐剝成小塊。泡軟的乾香菇和脆瓜切小丁；老薑切末，日本山藥磨成泥。
instruction.en: Tear fried tofu and frozen tofu into small pieces. Dice soaked dried shiitake and pickled cucumber; mince the ginger and grate the Japanese yam.
instruction.id: Suwir tahu goreng dan tahu beku menjadi kecil. Potong dadu shiitake kering yang sudah direndam dan acar timun; cincang jahe dan parut ubi Jepang.
instruction.fil: Hatiin ang piniritong tofu at frozen tofu sa maliliit na piraso. Binasa ng dice ang tuyo na shiitake at adobo na pipino; hiwain ang luya at gadgad ang Japanese yam.

steps.imagePrompt: Overhead vegan cooking preparation with torn fried tofu, frozen tofu, diced soaked shiitake, pickled cucumber, minced ginger and grated Japanese yam, natural daylight, no text, no watermark, no meat or animal products

instruction.zh: 炒鍋加少許植物油，以中小火把油豆腐和凍豆腐煸至金黃酥脆。
instruction.en: Add a little vegetable oil to a wok and brown the fried tofu and frozen tofu over medium-low heat until golden and crisp.
instruction.id: Tambahkan sedikit minyak sayur ke wajan dan tumis tahu goreng serta tahu beku dengan api sedang-kecil hingga keemasan dan renyah.
instruction.fil: Magdagdag ng kaunting langis ng gulay sa isang kawali at i-brown ang pritong tofu at frozen tofu sa katamtamang apoy hanggang sa maging ginintuang at malutong.

steps.imagePrompt: Golden fried tofu and torn frozen tofu crisping in a wok with a little oil, vegan Taiwanese home cooking, warm natural food photography, no text, no watermark, no meat or animal products

instruction.zh: 加入薑末、乾香菇和脆瓜炒香。加入醬油、醬油膏、糖、胡椒粉和花椒粉，拌炒均勻。
instruction.en: Add ginger, dried shiitake, and pickled cucumber and sauté until fragrant. Season with soy sauce, thick soy sauce, sugar, ground pepper, and ground Sichuan pepper, then stir evenly.
instruction.id: Tambahkan jahe, shiitake kering, dan acar timun lalu tumis hingga harum. Bumbui dengan kecap asin, kecap asin kental, gula, lada bubuk, dan bubuk lada Sichuan, lalu aduk rata.
instruction.fil: Magdagdag ng luya, tuyong shiitake, at adobo na pipino at igisa hanggang mabango. Timplahan ng toyo, makapal na toyo, asukal, giniling na paminta, at giniling na paminta ng Sichuan, pagkatapos ay haluin nang pantay-pantay.

steps.imagePrompt: Savory vegan tofu and mushroom mince being stir-fried with diced pickled cucumber and aromatics in a wok, glossy and fragrant, natural food photo, no text, no watermark, no meat or animal products

instruction.zh: 把炒好的材料轉入可燉煮的鍋，加入水、米酒、香菇水和脆瓜湯汁。蓋鍋煮滾後，以中小火燜煮 10 分鐘；不使用米酒亦可省略。
instruction.en: Transfer the sautéed ingredients to a braising pot and add water, rice wine, shiitake soaking water, and cucumber brine. Cover, bring to a boil, and braise over medium-low heat for 10 minutes; rice wine may be omitted.
instruction.id: Pindahkan bahan tumis ke panci semur dan tambahkan air, arak beras, air rendaman shiitake, serta air acar timun. Tutup, didihkan, lalu masak api sedang-kecil selama 10 menit; arak beras boleh dihilangkan.
instruction.fil: Ilipat ang sautéed ingredients sa braising pot at magdagdag ng tubig, rice wine, shiitake soaking water, at cucumber brine. Takpan, pakuluan, at i-braise sa medium-low heat sa loob ng 10 minuto; maaaring tanggalin ang rice wine.

steps.imagePrompt: Vegan Taiwanese braised tofu mince simmering in a covered pot with rich brown broth, cozy kitchen steam, rustic home-style food photography, no text, no watermark, no meat or animal products

instruction.zh: 加入山藥泥後再煮 5 分鐘，期間持續攪拌並保持小火，避免濃稠醬汁黏底。最後淋在白飯上，可撒香菜享用。
instruction.en: Add the grated yam and cook 5 more minutes, stirring continuously over low heat so the thick sauce does not stick. Spoon over rice and garnish with cilantro if desired.
instruction.id: Tambahkan ubi parut lalu masak 5 menit lagi sambil terus diaduk dengan api kecil agar saus kental tidak menempel. Sajikan di atas nasi dan tambahkan daun ketumbar bila suka.
instruction.fil: Idagdag ang gadgad na yam at lutuin ng 5 minuto pa, patuloy na hinahalo sa mahinang apoy para hindi dumikit ang makapal na sarsa. Kutsara sa ibabaw ng kanin at palamutihan ng cilantro kung gusto.

title.zh: 沒有蛋的菜脯蛋激似蛋的味道、外型

description.zh: 板豆腐與豆包碎拌入黑鹽、薑黃和菜脯，煎成外酥內嫩、帶有蛋香風味的全素菜脯蛋。
description.en: Crumpled tofu and tofu skin are seasoned with black salt, turmeric, and preserved radish, then pan-fried into a crisp vegan omelet with an egg-like aroma.
description.id: Tahu dan kulit tahu yang dihancurkan dibumbui garam hitam, kunyit, dan lobak asin, lalu digoreng menjadi telur dadar vegan renyah dengan aroma mirip telur.
description.fil: Ang gusot na tofu at balat ng tofu ay tinimplahan ng itim na asin, turmeric, at preserved na labanos, pagkatapos ay pinirito sa isang malutong na vegan omelet na may parang itlog na amoy.

title.fil: Durog na balat ng tofu at tofu

instruction.zh: 把板豆腐和豆包捏成小碎塊，保留少許口感。
instruction.en: Crumble firm tofu and tofu skin into small pieces, leaving some texture.
instruction.id: Hancurkan tahu padat dan kulit tahu menjadi potongan kecil, sisakan sedikit tekstur.
instruction.fil: Durugin ang matigas na tofu at balat ng tofu sa maliliit na piraso, na nag-iiwan ng ilang texture.

steps.imagePrompt: Overhead vegan preparation with crumbled firm tofu and tofu skin in a mixing bowl, clean wooden worktop, natural daylight food photography, no text, no watermark, no meat or animal products

instruction.zh: 加入薑黃粉、黑鹽、鹽、糖、白胡椒粉、醬油和玉米粉，拌勻後靜置 10 分鐘。薑黃粉主要用於上色，可依喜好省略；黑鹽用來帶出蛋香。
instruction.en: Add turmeric, black salt, salt, sugar, white pepper, soy sauce, and cornstarch. Mix evenly and rest for 10 minutes. Turmeric is mainly for color and may be omitted; black salt creates the egg-like aroma.
instruction.id: Tambahkan bubuk kunyit, garam hitam, garam, gula, lada putih, kecap asin, dan maizena. Aduk rata lalu diamkan 10 menit. Kunyit terutama untuk warna dan boleh dihilangkan; garam hitam memberi aroma mirip telur.
instruction.fil: Magdagdag ng turmerik, itim na asin, asin, asukal, puting paminta, toyo, at gawgaw. Haluin nang pantay-pantay at magpahinga ng 10 minuto. Pangunahing kulay ang turmerik at maaaring tanggalin; ang itim na asin ay lumilikha ng parang itlog na aroma.

steps.imagePrompt: Seasoned vegan tofu omelet mixture in a bowl with golden turmeric color and visible tofu texture, spoon stirring gently, bright kitchen daylight, no text, no watermark, no meat or animal products

title.fil: Igisa at lagyan ng preserved na labanos

instruction.zh: 平底鍋加少許香油，把菜脯煸炒至香氣散出。倒入豆腐混合物，再加入香菜拌勻。
instruction.en: Heat a little sesame oil in a pan and sauté the preserved radish until fragrant. Add it to the tofu mixture along with cilantro and mix evenly.
instruction.id: Panaskan sedikit minyak wijen dalam wajan dan tumis lobak asin hingga harum. Masukkan ke campuran tahu bersama daun ketumbar lalu aduk rata.
instruction.fil: Mag-init ng kaunting sesame oil sa kawali at igisa ang na-preserbang labanos hanggang mabango. Idagdag ito sa pinaghalong tofu kasama ng cilantro at ihalo nang pantay-pantay.

steps.imagePrompt: Fragrant preserved radish sautéing in a small skillet with sesame oil, beside a bowl of golden vegan tofu mixture and fresh cilantro, natural food photography, no text, no watermark, no meat or animal products

instruction.zh: 將混合物倒入平底鍋煎至上色。質地仍偏軟時先關火，借助盤子翻面，再把另一面煎至金黃色即可起鍋。
instruction.en: Pour the mixture into a skillet and fry until colored. Because it remains soft, turn off the heat and use a plate to flip it, then fry the second side until golden before serving.
instruction.id: Tuang campuran ke wajan dan goreng hingga berwarna. Karena teksturnya masih lembut, matikan api dan gunakan piring untuk membaliknya, lalu goreng sisi kedua hingga keemasan sebelum disajikan.
instruction.fil: Ibuhos ang timpla sa isang kawali at iprito hanggang sa kulay. Dahil ito ay nananatiling malambot, patayin ang apoy at gumamit ng isang plato upang i-flip ito, pagkatapos ay iprito ang pangalawang bahagi hanggang sa ginintuang ginintuang bago ihain.

title.id: Jamur Gaya Abalon Vegan dengan Soun
title.fil: Vegan Abalone-Style Mushroom na may Vermicelli

description.zh: 香菇劃花刀後搭配粉絲蒸熟，再淋上薑辣椒熱油醬汁，做出帶海味感的全素鮑魚粉絲。
description.en: Scored shiitake mushrooms and vermicelli are steamed, then dressed with a hot ginger-chili oil sauce for a vegan abalone-style dish with a sea-like umami note.
description.id: Jamur shiitake yang disayat dan soun dikukus, lalu disiram saus minyak panas jahe-cabai untuk hidangan vegan gaya abalon dengan cita rasa laut.
description.fil: Ang mga minarkahang shiitake mushroom at vermicelli ay pinapasingaw, pagkatapos ay binibihisan ng mainit na ginger-chili oil sauce para sa isang vegan abalone-style dish na may parang dagat na umami note.

title.fil: Ibabad ang vermicelli at maghanda ng mushroom

instruction.zh: 把粉絲泡水至變軟。去除香菇蒂，在有蒂的一面劃花刀，注意不要切斷。
instruction.en: Soak vermicelli in water until soft. Remove shiitake stems and score the stem side in a crosshatch pattern without cutting through.
instruction.id: Rendam soun dalam air hingga lunak. Buang tangkai shiitake dan buat sayatan silang pada sisi bertangkai tanpa memotongnya hingga putus.
instruction.fil: Ibabad ang vermicelli sa tubig hanggang malambot. Alisin ang mga tangkay ng shiitake at markahan ang gilid ng tangkay sa isang pattern ng crosshatch nang hindi pinuputol.

steps.imagePrompt: Overhead vegan preparation with softened vermicelli, scored shiitake mushrooms and a small knife on a wooden board, delicate crosshatch cuts visible, natural daylight, no text, no watermark, no meat or animal products

instruction.zh: 滾水加少許鹽，放入香菇汆燙約 30 秒後取出並沖冷水，讓口感更緊實。
instruction.en: Add a little salt to boiling water, blanch the mushrooms for about 30 seconds, then remove and rinse with cold water for a firmer texture.
instruction.id: Tambahkan sedikit garam ke air mendidih, rebus jamur sekitar 30 detik, lalu angkat dan bilas air dingin agar teksturnya lebih kenyal.
instruction.fil: Magdagdag ng kaunting asin sa tubig na kumukulo, paputiin ang mga kabute sa loob ng mga 30 segundo, pagkatapos ay alisin at banlawan ng malamig na tubig para sa mas matatag na texture.

steps.imagePrompt: Shiitake mushrooms being briefly blanched in a pot of boiling water, kitchen steam and a nearby bowl of cold water, clean vegan cooking photo, no text, no watermark, no meat or animal products

instruction.zh: 把香菇放入可進電鍋的深盤。將泡軟粉絲繞在手指上捲成小束，放在每朵香菇上。
instruction.en: Arrange mushrooms in a deep dish that fits an electric cooker. Wind softened vermicelli around a finger into small nests and place one on each mushroom.
instruction.id: Susun jamur dalam piring dalam yang muat di rice cooker listrik. Lilitan soun lunak pada jari menjadi sarang kecil lalu letakkan di atas setiap jamur.
instruction.fil: Ayusin ang mga mushroom sa isang malalim na ulam na kasya sa isang electric cooker. Pinalambot ng hangin ang vermicelli sa paligid ng isang daliri sa maliliit na pugad at ilagay ang isa sa bawat kabute.

steps.imagePrompt: Elegant vegan abalone-style mushroom dish being arranged in a deep steaming plate, each scored shiitake topped with a neat vermicelli nest, natural food photography, no text, no watermark, no meat or animal products

title.fil: Gawin ang mainit na sarsa ng langis

instruction.zh: 把薑末和辣椒末放入小碗，澆上熱油。加入醬油膏、醬油、糖和胡椒粉拌勻；若沒有影片中未能清楚辨識的海味調味料，可用海苔醬或海苔酥增添海味。
instruction.en: Place minced ginger and chili in a small bowl and pour hot oil over them. Stir in thick soy sauce, soy sauce, sugar, and pepper; if the video's unclear sea-flavor seasoning is unavailable, use seaweed paste or seaweed flakes for sea-like umami.
instruction.id: Masukkan jahe cincang dan cabai cincang ke mangkuk kecil lalu siram minyak panas. Aduk kecap asin kental, kecap asin, gula, dan lada; jika bumbu rasa laut dalam video tidak jelas atau tidak tersedia, gunakan pasta atau serpihan rumput laut.
instruction.fil: Ilagay ang tinadtad na luya at sili sa isang maliit na mangkok at buhusan sila ng mainit na mantika. Haluin ang makapal na toyo, toyo, asukal, at paminta; kung hindi available ang hindi malinaw na sea-flavor seasoning ng video, gumamit ng seaweed paste o seaweed flakes para sa parang dagat na umami.

steps.imagePrompt: Hot vegetable oil being poured over minced ginger and chili in a small bowl beside soy sauces and seaweed, vegan Asian sauce preparation, dramatic but natural food light, no text, no watermark, no meat or animal products

instruction.zh: 把醬汁淋在每朵香菇粉絲上，放入電鍋蒸熟。取出後按喜好撒蒜末、香菜末、蔥花或芹菜末即可享用。
instruction.en: Drizzle sauce over every mushroom and vermicelli nest, then steam in an electric cooker until cooked. Finish with minced garlic, cilantro, scallion, or celery as desired.
instruction.id: Siramkan saus pada setiap jamur dan sarang soun, lalu kukus dalam rice cooker hingga matang. Tambahkan bawang putih cincang, daun ketumbar, daun bawang, atau seledri sesuai selera.
instruction.fil: Ibuhos ang sauce sa bawat pugad ng kabute at vermicelli, pagkatapos ay pasingawan sa electric cooker hanggang maluto. Tapusin sa tinadtad na bawang, cilantro, scallion, o kintsay kung gusto mo.

steps.imagePrompt: Finished vegan abalone-style shiitake mushrooms topped with vermicelli and glossy sauce on a steaming plate, cilantro garnish, elegant Chinese home food photography, no text, no watermark, no meat or animal products

description.zh: 將板豆腐煎至金黃，再與木耳、紅蘿蔔及辣椒以紅燒醬汁燜煮，最後勾芡完成。
description.en: Firm tofu is pan-fried until golden, then braised with wood ear mushrooms, carrot, and chilies in a savory sauce and finished with a starch slurry.
description.id: Tahu padat digoreng hingga keemasan, lalu dibraise bersama jamur kuping, wortel, dan cabai dalam saus gurih, kemudian dikentalkan dengan larutan tepung.
description.fil: Ang matigas na tofu ay pinirito hanggang ginintuang, pagkatapos ay niluluto na may mga wood ear mushroom, carrot, at mga sili sa isang malasang sarsa at tinapos sa isang starch slurry.

instruction.zh: 板豆腐切片；木耳和紅蘿蔔切小片，大辣椒切斜片，青龍椒切小圈，老薑切末。
instruction.en: Slice the firm tofu. Cut wood ear mushrooms and carrot into small pieces, slice the large chili diagonally, cut green chili into rings, and mince ginger.
instruction.id: Iris tahu padat. Potong kecil jamur kuping dan wortel, iris serong cabai besar, potong cabai hijau berbentuk cincin, lalu cincang jahe.
instruction.fil: Hiwain ang matibay na tofu. Gupitin ang mga wood ear mushroom at carrot sa maliliit na piraso, hiwain ang malalaking sili nang pahilis, gupitin ang berdeng sili, at hiwain ang luya.

steps.imagePrompt: Overhead vegan Chinese cooking preparation with sliced firm tofu, wood ear mushrooms, carrot, green chili rings, red chili and minced ginger, natural daylight, no text, no watermark, no meat or animal products

instruction.zh: 平底鍋加少許植物油，把豆腐煎至外皮金黃酥脆後取出。
instruction.en: Add a little vegetable oil to a skillet and fry tofu until its exterior is golden and crisp, then remove it.
instruction.id: Tambahkan sedikit minyak sayur ke wajan dan goreng tahu hingga bagian luarnya keemasan serta renyah, lalu angkat.
instruction.fil: Magdagdag ng kaunting langis ng gulay sa isang kawali at iprito ang tofu hanggang sa maging ginintuang at malutong ang labas nito, pagkatapos ay alisin ito.

steps.imagePrompt: Golden crisp slices of firm tofu pan-frying in a skillet with a light sheen of oil, vegan Chinese home cooking, warm natural food photography, no text, no watermark, no meat or animal products

instruction.zh: 把醬油、醬油膏、香油、糖、鹽、胡椒粉、五香粉和水拌勻。另以玉米粉和水調成勾芡水備用。
instruction.en: Mix soy sauce, thick soy sauce, sesame oil, sugar, salt, pepper, five-spice, and water. Separately mix cornstarch with water to make a slurry.
instruction.id: Campurkan kecap asin, kecap asin kental, minyak wijen, gula, garam, lada, bubuk lima rempah, dan air. Secara terpisah, campurkan maizena dengan air menjadi larutan pengental.
instruction.fil: Paghaluin ang toyo, makapal na toyo, sesame oil, asukal, asin, paminta, limang pampalasa, at tubig. Hiwalay na paghaluin ang cornstarch sa tubig para maging slurry.

steps.imagePrompt: Small bowls of vegan Chinese braising sauce and cornstarch slurry with soy sauce, sesame oil and spices on a clean counter, editorial food photography, no text, no watermark, no meat or animal products

title.fil: Igisa ang mga gulay at iprito

instruction.zh: 用原鍋補少許油，爆香大辣椒和薑末，加入紅蘿蔔和木耳略炒。放回煎豆腐並倒入醬汁，稍微熬煮 5 分鐘入味。
instruction.en: In the same pan, add a little oil and sauté large chili and ginger. Add carrot and wood ear mushrooms briefly, then return the fried tofu and pour in the sauce. Braise for about 5 minutes.
instruction.id: Dalam wajan yang sama, tambahkan sedikit minyak lalu tumis cabai besar dan jahe. Masukkan wortel serta jamur kuping sebentar, kemudian masukkan kembali tahu goreng dan tuang saus. Masak perlahan sekitar 5 menit.
instruction.fil: Sa parehong kawali, magdagdag ng kaunting mantika at igisa ang malalaking sili at luya. Magdagdag ng karot at wood ear mushroom saglit, pagkatapos ay ibalik ang pritong tofu at ibuhos ang sarsa. Pakuluan ng halos 5 minuto.

steps.imagePrompt: Vegan braised tofu simmering with wood ear mushrooms, carrot and chilies in glossy brown sauce in a wok, gentle steam, appetizing Chinese home food photo, no text, no watermark, no meat or animal products

instruction.zh: 煮約 5 分鐘後倒入勾芡水，拌勻至醬汁裹住豆腐，最後撒上青龍椒即可享用。
instruction.en: After about 5 minutes, stir in the starch slurry until the sauce coats the tofu, then finish with green chili and serve.
instruction.id: Setelah sekitar 5 menit, aduk larutan tepung hingga saus melapisi tahu, lalu tambahkan cabai hijau dan sajikan.
instruction.fil: Pagkatapos ng mga 5 minuto, haluin ang starch slurry hanggang mabalot ng sauce ang tofu, pagkatapos ay tapusin ng berdeng sili at ihain.
