title.zh: 韓國街頭小吃在家輕鬆做

description.zh:
最近有很多韓劇值得追一下啦🤭
每次看到他們吃路邊攤
夾著炸物沾上炒年糕的醬汁
口水就快流出來
所以就決定來做了啦！
炸海苔冬粉捲真的要吃過才知道
真的好好吃！！！
做起來冰在冰箱
隨時拿出來吃都超方便！
趕快一起做做看吧💛💛
description.en: There are so many Korean dramas worth watching lately. Whenever I see street-food fried snacks dipped in tteokbokki sauce, my mouth waters, so I decided to make them! You have to try fried seaweed glass-noodle rolls to know how delicious they are. Keep them in the refrigerator and they are convenient to take out and eat anytime. Let's make them!
description.id: Akhir-akhir ini banyak drama Korea yang seru untuk ditonton. Setiap melihat jajanan goreng kaki lima dicelupkan ke saus tteokbokki, saya langsung mengiler, jadi saya memutuskan untuk membuatnya! Gulungan soun rumput laut goreng harus dicoba agar tahu betapa lezatnya. Simpan di lemari es dan Anda dapat mengambilnya untuk dimakan kapan saja. Yuk, buat bersama!
description.fil: Napakaraming Korean dramas na dapat panoorin lately. Sa tuwing nakakakita ako ng mga street-food fried snack na isinasawsaw sa tteokbokki sauce, naluluha ang bibig ko, kaya napagpasyahan kong gawin ito! Kailangan mong subukan ang pritong seaweed glass-noodle roll para malaman kung gaano kasarap ang mga ito. Itago ang mga ito sa refrigerator at maginhawa silang ilabas at kainin anumang oras. Gawin natin sila!

title.en: Cook and season the glass noodles
title.fil: Lutuin at timplahan ang glass noodles

instruction.zh: 滾水加一點鹽後煮熟韓式冬粉，稍微沖冷水讓口感更 Q 彈，瀝乾後用剪刀略剪短。加入醬油、糖、香油、胡椒粉和白芝麻，拌勻。
instruction.en: Add a little salt to boiling water and cook the Korean glass noodles. Rinse them briefly with cold water for a springier texture, drain, and cut them slightly shorter with scissors. Add soy sauce, sugar, sesame oil, ground pepper, and white sesame seeds, then toss evenly.
instruction.id: Tambahkan sedikit garam ke air mendidih lalu rebus soun Korea. Bilas sebentar dengan air dingin agar lebih kenyal, tiriskan, lalu gunting sedikit lebih pendek. Tambahkan kecap asin, gula, minyak wijen, lada bubuk, dan biji wijen putih, lalu aduk hingga rata.
instruction.fil: Magdagdag ng kaunting asin sa kumukulong tubig at lutuin ang Korean glass noodles. Banlawan ang mga ito saglit na may malamig na tubig para sa isang springier texture, alisan ng tubig, at gupitin ang mga ito nang bahagyang mas maikli gamit ang gunting. Magdagdag ng toyo, asukal, sesame oil, ground pepper, at white sesame seeds, pagkatapos ay ihagis nang pantay-pantay.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Cook and season the glass noodles”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

title.en: Roll the glass noodles in nori
title.fil: Igulong ang glass noodles sa nori

instruction.zh: 使用包壽司的海苔，不用韓式脆海苔。大片海苔可剪成約三等份；放上調味冬粉後捲起。捲時從兩側收緊，不要從中間下壓，以免冬粉從兩端跑出來。
instruction.en: Use sushi nori, not crispy Korean seaweed. A large nori sheet can be cut into about three portions; place the seasoned glass noodles on it and roll up. Tighten from the sides rather than pressing in the center, so the noodles do not squeeze out from the ends.
instruction.id: Gunakan nori untuk sushi, bukan rumput laut Korea yang renyah. Lembar nori besar dapat dipotong menjadi sekitar tiga bagian; letakkan soun berbumbu di atasnya lalu gulung. Kencangkan dari kedua sisi, bukan dengan menekan bagian tengah, agar soun tidak keluar dari kedua ujungnya.
instruction.fil: Gumamit ng sushi nori, hindi crispy Korean seaweed. Ang isang malaking nori sheet ay maaaring i-cut sa halos tatlong bahagi; ilagay ang seasoned glass noodles dito at i-roll up. Higpitan mula sa mga gilid sa halip na pindutin sa gitna, upang ang mga pansit ay hindi mapipiga mula sa mga dulo.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Roll the glass noodles in nori”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

instruction.zh: 將酥炸粉、水和一點鹽攪拌均勻成麵糊。
instruction.en: Mix crispy frying flour, water, and a little salt into an even batter.
instruction.id: Campurkan tepung pelapis renyah, air, dan sedikit garam hingga menjadi adonan yang rata.
instruction.fil: Paghaluin ang malutong na harina, tubig, at kaunting asin sa isang pantay na batter.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Mix the batter”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

title.id: Balut adonan lalu goreng pan hingga keemasan
title.fil: Pahiran at i-pan-fry hanggang sa ginintuang

instruction.zh: 平底鍋加入植物油。將冬粉捲沾上麵糊後下鍋，煎至金黃色後翻面；各面都金黃時取出，放在餐巾紙上吸油，再盛盤。
instruction.en: Add vegetable oil to a skillet. Coat the glass-noodle rolls in batter and pan-fry until golden, then turn them over. Once every side is golden, remove them, drain on paper towel, and plate.
instruction.id: Tambahkan minyak nabati ke wajan datar. Balut gulungan soun dengan adonan lalu goreng pan hingga keemasan, kemudian balik. Setelah semua sisi berwarna keemasan, angkat, tiriskan di atas tisu dapur, lalu sajikan.
instruction.fil: Magdagdag ng langis ng gulay sa isang kawali. Pahiran ang mga glass-noodle roll sa batter at i-pan-fry hanggang sa ginintuang, pagkatapos ay ibalik ang mga ito. Kapag ang bawat panig ay ginintuang, alisin ang mga ito, alisan ng tubig sa tuwalya ng papel, at plato.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Coat and pan-fry until golden”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

title.fil: Ihain kasama ng opsyonal na chili sauce

instruction.zh: 可搭配全素韓式辣椒醬享用。影片也說明煎好後可大量冷凍保存，需要時以氣炸方式回熱。
instruction.en: Serve with vegan Korean chili sauce if desired. The video also notes that the pan-fried rolls can be frozen in batches and reheated in an air fryer when needed.
instruction.id: Sajikan dengan saus cabai Korea vegan bila diinginkan. Video juga menjelaskan bahwa gulungan yang telah digoreng dapat disimpan beku dalam jumlah banyak dan dipanaskan kembali dengan air fryer saat diperlukan.
instruction.fil: Ihain kasama ng vegan Korean chili sauce kung ninanais. Napansin din ng video na ang mga pan-fried roll ay maaaring i-freeze sa mga batch at ipainit muli sa isang air fryer kung kinakailangan.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Serve with optional chili sauce”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

description.zh: 將麵腸攤開戳孔，裹上紅糟香料醬冷藏醃漬，再以地瓜粉酥炸，做出外酥內嫩的全素紅糟肉。
description.en: Wheat gluten is opened and pricked, marinated in a seasoned red yeast rice sauce, then coated in sweet-potato starch and fried until crisp for a tender vegan red yeast rice dish.
description.id: Gluten gandum dibuka dan ditusuk, dimarinasi dalam saus angkak berbumbu, lalu dilapisi tepung ubi jalar dan digoreng hingga renyah untuk hidangan angkak vegan yang lembut.
description.fil: Ang wheat gluten ay binubuksan at tinutusok, inatsara sa isang tinimplahan na red yeast rice sauce, pagkatapos ay binalutan ng sweet-potato starch at pinirito hanggang malutong para sa malambot na vegan red yeast rice dish.

title.en: Open and Secure the Wheat Gluten
title.fil: Buksan at I-secure ang Wheat Gluten

instruction.zh: 將麵腸從中間剖開但不要切斷，攤平後由左右各劃兩刀。用叉子在表面戳出許多小孔，再以牙籤撐開固定，讓醃料能進入層次。
instruction.en: Split the wheat gluten through the middle without cutting it apart. Open it flat, make two cuts from each side, and prick the surface with many fork holes. Hold it open with toothpicks so the marinade can reach the layers.
instruction.id: Belah gluten di bagian tengah tanpa sampai terputus. Bentangkan, buat dua sayatan dari tiap sisi, lalu tusuk permukaannya berkali-kali dengan garpu. Kunci dalam keadaan terbuka dengan tusuk gigi agar bumbu meresap ke setiap lapisan.
instruction.fil: Hatiin ang wheat gluten sa gitna nang hindi pinaghiwa-hiwalay. Buksan ito ng patag, gumawa ng dalawang hiwa mula sa bawat panig, at itusok ang ibabaw na may maraming butas ng tinidor. Hawakan itong bukas gamit ang mga toothpick upang maabot ng marinade ang mga layer.

steps.imagePrompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: 16:9 recipe tutorial step image. Close three-quarter overhead preparation photograph of a pale wheat gluten roll opened flat on a wooden cutting board, with shallow parallel scores, many fork-prick holes, and small wooden toothpicks holding its layered interior open. Constraints: strictly vegan; no sauce, cooked food, meat, egg, dairy, labels, people, text, watermark, or logos. No text.

instruction.zh: 大碗中混合紅糟醬、醬油、香油、糖、胡椒粉和五香粉。將撐開的麵腸每一面與內層都抹滿醬料並略加按摩，放入保鮮盒蓋好後冷藏醃漬一天。
instruction.en: Mix red yeast rice sauce, soy sauce, sesame oil, sugar, pepper, and five-spice in a large bowl. Coat every surface and inner layer of the opened wheat gluten, massage in the sauce, then cover in a storage container and refrigerate for one day.
instruction.id: Campurkan saus angkak, kecap asin, minyak wijen, gula, lada, dan bubuk lima rempah dalam mangkuk besar. Lumuri semua sisi serta lapisan dalam gluten yang telah dibuka, pijat dengan saus, lalu tutup dalam wadah dan marinasi di lemari es selama satu hari.
instruction.fil: Paghaluin ang red yeast rice sauce, toyo, sesame oil, asukal, paminta, at limang pampalasa sa isang malaking mangkok. Pahiran ang bawat ibabaw at panloob na layer ng nakabukas na wheat gluten, imasahe sa sarsa, pagkatapos ay takpan sa isang lalagyan ng imbakan at palamigin sa loob ng isang araw.

steps.imagePrompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: 16:9 recipe tutorial step image. Editorial close food photograph of an opened layered wheat gluten roll fully coated inside and out with deep brick-red red-yeast-rice marinade in a clear rectangular storage container. Constraints: strictly vegan; no people, hands, labels, text, watermark, logos, meat, egg, or dairy. No text.

instruction.zh: 醃好後取出麵腸上的牙籤，將每一面均勻裹上地瓜粉。靜置10分鐘，讓粉衣回潮，油炸時才不會與麵腸脫落。
instruction.en: After marinating, remove the toothpicks and coat every side of the wheat gluten evenly with sweet potato starch. Rest for 10 minutes so the coating hydrates and stays attached during frying.
instruction.id: Setelah dimarinasi, lepaskan tusuk gigi lalu baluri setiap sisi gluten secara merata dengan tepung ubi jalar. Diamkan selama 10 menit agar lapisan tepung menyatu dan tidak lepas saat digoreng.
instruction.fil: Pagkatapos mag-marinate, tanggalin ang mga toothpick at balutin ang bawat gilid ng wheat gluten nang pantay-pantay ng sweet potato starch. Magpahinga ng 10 minuto para mag-hydrate ang coating at manatiling nakakabit habang piniprito.

steps.imagePrompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: 16:9 recipe tutorial step image. Close editorial food photograph of a red-marinated opened wheat gluten cutlet resting on a shallow tray, evenly covered in a dry white sweet-potato-starch coating with its layered edges visible. Constraints: strictly vegan; no frying oil, people, labels, text, watermark, logos, meat, egg, or dairy. No text.

instruction.zh: 油加熱至170°C後，放入靜置好的麵腸油炸，炸至外皮酥脆後撈起瀝油。稍放涼後切成片狀，盛盤享用。
instruction.en: Heat the oil to 170°C, then fry the rested wheat gluten until the crust is crisp. Lift it out to drain, let it cool slightly, and slice before serving.

description.zh: 白葡萄挖空後塞入金針菇，裹上胡蘿蔔粉漿兩段油炸，再與鳳梨和全素沙拉醬拌成酸甜酥脆的全素鳳梨蝦球。
description.en: Hollowed white grapes are packed with enoki, coated in carrot batter and double-fried, then tossed with pineapple and vegan mayonnaise for a sweet-and-tangy vegan pineapple shrimp-ball dish.
description.id: Anggur putih yang dilubangi diisi enoki, dilapisi adonan wortel dan digoreng dua kali, lalu diaduk dengan nanas serta mayones vegan menjadi bola udang nanas vegan yang renyah dan manis-asam.

instruction.en: Wash seedless white grapes and use a wide straw from the stem end to make a hollow without splitting the skin. Pack enoki firmly into each hollow, leaving about one grape-length at both ends to form the vegan shrimp bases.
instruction.id: Cuci anggur putih tanpa biji, lalu gunakan sedotan lebar dari sisi tangkai untuk membuat lubang tanpa merobek kulitnya. Padatkan enoki ke setiap lubang dan sisakan kira-kira sepanjang satu anggur di kedua ujungnya untuk membentuk dasar udang vegan.
instruction.fil: Hugasan ang mga puting ubas na walang binhi at gumamit ng malawak na dayami mula sa dulo ng tangkay upang makagawa ng guwang nang hindi nahati ang balat. Siapkan sepiring tepung rendah protein untuk pelapis kering dan semangkuk air. Jumlah bahan tidak disebutkan dalam bukti yang tersedia.
instruction.fil: Grate ang karot sa isang katas at haluin ito ng harina ng cake, halo ng pagprito, at tubig sa isang makinis na basang batter; timplahan ng asin, giniling na puting paminta, at giniling na itim na paminta. instruction.en: Heat frying oil to 160°C. Dip each vegan shrimp base in water, coat it in dry flour and then wet batter; bend the enoki ends upward into a shrimp-ball shape and fry until golden. Raise the oil to 180°C, refry for about 20 seconds, then drain.
instruction.id: Panaskan minyak hingga 160°C. Celupkan setiap dasar udang vegan ke air, balut dengan tepung kering lalu adonan basah; tekuk ujung enoki ke atas hingga berbentuk bola udang dan goreng sampai keemasan. Naikkan suhu minyak ke 180°C, goreng ulang sekitar 20 detik, lalu tiriskan.
instruction.fil: Painitin ang mantika sa 160°C. Isawsaw ang bawat vegan shrimp base sa tubig, balutin ito sa tuyong harina at pagkatapos ay basang batter; ibaluktot ang dulo ng enoki paitaas upang maging hugis bola ng hipon at iprito hanggang maging ginintuang. Itaas ang mantika sa 180°C, palamigin ng halos 20 segundo, pagkatapos ay alisan ng tubig.

instruction.zh: 番茄切小丁；紅喜菇去蒂後撥成小束；老薑切末。將冷凍後稍微退冰的嫩豆腐切成細條，放入碗中與薑黃粉、黑鹽抓拌均勻，做成蛋花口感的豆腐絲。
instruction.en: Dice the tomatoes, trim and separate the red shimeji, and mince the mature ginger. Cut the frozen, slightly thawed silken tofu into thin strips, then toss it with turmeric and black salt to make egg-like tofu strands.
instruction.id: Potong tomat dadu kecil, buang pangkal shimeji merah lalu pisahkan menjadi rumpun kecil, dan cincang jahe tua. Iris tahu sutra beku yang sedikit mencair menjadi serat tipis, lalu aduk dengan bubuk kunyit dan garam hitam untuk membuat serat tahu mirip telur.
instruction.fil: Dice ang mga kamatis, gupitin at paghiwalayin ang pulang shimeji, at hiwain ang mature na luya. Gupitin ang frozen, bahagyang lasaw na silken tofu sa manipis na piraso, pagkatapos ay ihagis ito ng turmerik at itim na asin upang makagawa ng mga hibla ng tofu na parang itlog.

instruction.en: Pour sesame oil into a soup pot and gently sauté the minced ginger over low heat. Add the red shimeji and cook until golden, then add the diced tomatoes and raise the heat to soften them quickly and release their juices.
instruction.id: Tuang minyak wijen ke dalam panci sup dan tumis jahe cincang dengan api kecil hingga harum. Masukkan shimeji merah dan masak sampai keemasan, lalu tambahkan tomat dadu, besarkan api, dan tumis cepat hingga tomat lunak serta mengeluarkan sari.

Idagdag ang pulang shimeji at lutuin hanggang sa ginintuang, pagkatapos ay idagdag ang mga diced na kamatis at itaas ang apoy upang mabilis na lumambot at mailabas ang kanilang mga katas.

instruction.zh: 植物油加熱至約160°C，倒入碗中快速壓拌至咖哩塊融化。
instruction.en: Heat oil to about 160°C and pour over, stirring and pressing until the roux melts.
instruction.id: Panaskan minyak sekitar 160°C lalu tuang dan aduk hingga larut.
instruction.fil: Init ang mantika sa humigit-kumulang 160°C at ibuhos, haluin at pinindot hanggang matunaw ang roux.

instruction.zh: 豆包稍微氣炸；細麵在加鹽滾水煮熟、冰鎮後拌咖哩醬，放豆包和香菜。
instruction.en: Air-fry tofu skin briefly; cook salted noodles, chill, toss with curry sauce, and top with tofu skin and cilantro.
instruction.id: Goreng udara kulit tahu; rebus dan dinginkan mi, lalu aduk dengan saus.
instruction.fil: I-air-fry ang balat ng tofu sandali; magluto ng inasnan na noodles, palamigin, ihagis ng curry sauce, at itaas na may balat ng tofu at cilantro.

description.zh: 糙米與十穀米拌入炒香蔬菜、豆包、紫菜和枸杞，以電鍋煮成濃稠的全素五穀鹹粥。
description.en: A hearty vegan multigrain savory porridge made in an electric cooker with brown rice, vegetables, tofu skin, seaweed, and goji berries.
description.id: Bubur gurih vegan aneka biji yang dimasak dalam penanak listrik dengan beras merah, sayur, kulit tahu, rumput laut, dan goji.
description.fil: Isang nakabubusog na vegan multigrain savory porridge na ginawa sa isang electric cooker na may brown rice, gulay, balat ng tofu, seaweed, at goji berries.

instruction.zh: 糙米和十穀米泡水約30分鐘。高麗菜、紅蘿蔔、泡發乾香菇與豆包切小丁；老薑切末、紫菜撕碎，枸杞洗淨備用。
instruction.en: Soak the brown rice and ten-grain rice for about 30 minutes. Dice the cabbage, carrot, soaked dried shiitake, and tofu skin; mince the ginger, tear the seaweed, and rinse the goji berries.
instruction.id: Rendam beras merah dan beras sepuluh biji sekitar 30 menit. Potong kecil kol, wortel, shiitake kering yang telah direndam, dan kulit tahu; cincang jahe, sobek rumput laut, lalu cuci goji.
instruction.fil: Ibabad ang brown rice at ten-grain rice nang mga 30 minuto. Dice ang repolyo, karot, ibinabad na pinatuyong shiitake, at balat ng tofu; tadtarin ang luya, pilasin ang damong-dagat, at banlawan ang mga goji berries.

instruction.zh: 平底鍋或炒鍋倒入橄欖油，將豆包煎至略呈金黃；加入高麗菜、薑末、紅蘿蔔與乾香菇炒至高麗菜變軟，以鹽和胡椒粉拌勻後盛起。
instruction.en: Heat olive oil in a frying pan or wok and cook the tofu skin until lightly golden. Add the cabbage, minced ginger, carrot, and dried shiitake; stir-fry until the cabbage softens, season with salt and ground pepper, then remove from the pan.
instruction.id: Panaskan minyak zaitun dalam wajan datar atau wok, lalu masak kulit tahu hingga agak keemasan. Tambahkan kol, jahe cincang, wortel, dan shiitake kering; tumis sampai kol lunak, bumbui garam dan lada bubuk, lalu angkat.
instruction.fil: Init ang langis ng oliba sa isang kawali o kawali at lutuin ang balat ng tofu hanggang sa bahagyang ginintuang. Idagdag ang repolyo, tinadtad na luya, karot, at pinatuyong shiitake; haluin hanggang lumambot ang repolyo, timplahan ng asin at giniling na paminta, pagkatapos ay alisin sa kawali.

instruction.zh: 將泡好的兩種米淋入少許醬油、香油與亞麻籽油拌勻，放入炒料、紫菜和枸杞。每1杯米加入8杯總水量，泡香菇的水也計入這8杯內。
instruction.en: Toss the soaked rice mixture with a little soy sauce, sesame oil, and flaxseed oil, then add the sautéed ingredients, seaweed, and goji berries. Add 8 cups total liquid for every 1 cup rice, counting the shiitake soaking water within that total.
instruction.id: Aduk campuran beras yang telah direndam dengan sedikit kecap asin, minyak wijen, dan minyak biji rami, lalu masukkan bahan tumis, rumput laut, dan goji. Tambahkan total 8 cangkir cairan untuk setiap 1 cangkir beras, termasuk air rendaman shiitake.
instruction.fil: Ihagis ang pinaghalong kanin na may kaunting toyo, sesame oil, at flaxseed oil, pagkatapos ay idagdag ang mga ginisang sangkap, seaweed, at goji berries. Magdagdag ng 8 tasa ng kabuuang likido para sa bawat 1 tasa ng bigas, binibilang ang shiitake soaking water sa loob ng kabuuang iyon.

instruction.zh: 內鍋放入電鍋，外鍋加2杯水蒸煮。電鍋跳起後再燜約20分鐘，開蓋後撒上黑芝麻即可享用。
instruction.en: Place the inner pot in the electric cooker and add 2 cups water to the outer pot. When the cooker switches off, let the porridge rest for about 20 minutes; open it and sprinkle with black sesame before serving.
instruction.id: Letakkan panci dalam ke penanak listrik dan tambahkan 2 cangkir air ke panci luar. Setelah penanak berhenti, diamkan bubur sekitar 20 menit; buka lalu taburi wijen hitam sebelum disajikan.
instruction.fil: Ilagay ang panloob na palayok sa electric cooker at magdagdag ng 2 tasang tubig sa panlabas na palayok. Kapag naka-off ang kusinilya, hayaang magpahinga ang lugaw nang mga 20 minuto; buksan ito at budburan ng black sesame bago ihain.

description.zh: 以柚子皮、果肉、蘋果泥和檸檬汁熬成低糖保存醬。
description.en: A lower-sugar pomelo preserve cooked with peel, pulp, apple purée, and lemon juice.
description.id: Selai pomelo rendah gula yang dimasak dari kulit, daging buah, pure apel, dan jus lemon.
description.fil: Isang lower-sugar pomelo preserve na niluto na may balat, pulp, apple purée, at lemon juice.

instruction.zh: 取10克去除白囊的柚子皮切絲；取果肉並去除白膜。
instruction.en: Remove the white pith and finely julienne 10 g pomelo peel. Separate 600 g pulp from the membranes.
instruction.id: Buang empulur putih lalu iris halus 10 g kulit pomelo. Pisahkan 600 g daging buah dari selaputnya.
instruction.fil: Alisin ang puting pith at makinis na julienne 10 g pomelo peel. Paghiwalayin ang 600 g pulp mula sa mga lamad.

steps.imagePrompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: 16:9 recipe tutorial step image. Primary request: overhead preparation photograph of finely julienned green-yellow pomelo peel with all white pith removed, beside a bowl of clean pale pomelo pulp separated from its membranes. Constraints: strictly vegan; no sugar, apple, lemon, cooking pot, finished preserve, labels, people, text, watermark, or logos. No text.

instruction.zh: 柚子皮以鹽水煮三次，每次換水。
instruction.en: Boil the pomelo peel in salted water three times, replacing the water after each boil to remove bitterness.
instruction.id: Rebus kulit pomelo dalam air garam sebanyak tiga kali, ganti air setiap selesai merebus untuk mengurangi rasa pahit.
instruction.fil: Pakuluan ang balat ng pomelo sa inasnan na tubig ng tatlong beses, palitan ang tubig pagkatapos ng bawat pigsa upang alisin ang kapaitan.

steps.imagePrompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: 16:9 recipe tutorial step image. Primary request: close preparation photograph of fine pomelo-peel strips simmering in clear salted water in a small stainless saucepan, the first bitterness-removal boil. Constraints: strictly vegan; no fruit pulp, sugar, apple, lemon, finished preserve, labels, people, text, watermark, or logos. No text.

instruction.zh: 先煮柚子皮與200克糖至軟香，加入600克果肉、蘋果泥、檸檬汁，熬至濃稠。
instruction.en: Cook the drained peel with 200 g sugar until soft and fragrant. Add 600 g pomelo pulp, apple purée, and lemon juice, then simmer until thick.
instruction.id: Masak kulit yang telah ditiriskan bersama 200 g gula hingga lunak dan harum. Tambahkan 600 g daging pomelo, pure apel, dan jus lemon, lalu masak hingga kental.
instruction.fil: Lutuin ang pinatuyo na balat na may 200 g ng asukal hanggang malambot at mabango. Magdagdag ng 600 g pomelo pulp, apple purée, at lemon juice, pagkatapos ay kumulo hanggang lumapot.

instruction.zh: 裝入滾水殺菌的玻璃罐，趁熱鎖緊倒扣，放涼。
instruction.en: Fill boiled, sterilized glass jars while the preserve is hot. Seal tightly, invert the jars, and leave them to cool.
instruction.id: Isi stoples kaca yang telah disterilkan dengan selai selagi panas. Tutup rapat, balikkan stoples, lalu biarkan dingin.
instruction.fil: Punan ang pinakuluang, isterilisadong garapon ng salamin habang mainit ang preserba. I-seal nang mahigpit, baligtarin ang mga garapon, at hayaang lumamig.

description.zh: 杏鮑菇以豆腐乳醃漬、玉米粉煎出酥脆外皮的全素小食。
description.en: King oyster mushroom slices marinated with fermented tofu and pan-fried in cornstarch until crisp.
description.id: Irisan jamur king oyster dimarinasi tahu fermentasi lalu digoreng tepung jagung.
description.fil: King oyster mushroom slices na inatsara sa fermented tofu at pinirito sa cornstarch hanggang sa malutong.

instruction.zh: 去除杏鮑菇頭部，切成約0.3公分厚的片；菇頭保留作其他料理。
instruction.en: Trim the mushroom caps and slice the stems about 0.3 cm thick; reserve caps for another dish.
instruction.id: Potong bagian tudung jamur king oyster, lalu iris batangnya setebal sekitar 0,3 cm. Simpan bagian tudung untuk masakan lain.
instruction.fil: Gupitin ang mga takip ng kabute at hiwain ang mga tangkay na halos 0.3 cm ang kapal; magreserba ng mga takip para sa isa pang ulam.

steps.imagePrompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: 16:9 recipe tutorial step image. Primary request: overhead close food photograph of four king oyster mushroom stems on a clean wooden cutting board, their caps trimmed off and stems cut into evenly spaced 0.3 cm slices, with the reserved mushroom caps nearby for another dish. Constraints: strictly vegan; no meat, eggs, dairy, seafood, soy sauce, labels, people, text, watermark, or logos. No text.

instruction.zh: 將菇片拌醬油、豆腐乳、糖和五香粉；4條杏鮑菇使用半塊豆腐乳，醃10分鐘。
instruction.en: Toss slices with soy sauce, fermented tofu, sugar, and five-spice; use half a tofu piece for four mushrooms and marinate 10 minutes.
instruction.id: Aduk irisan jamur dengan kecap asin, tahu fermentasi, gula, dan bubuk lima rempah. Gunakan setengah potong tahu fermentasi untuk empat jamur, lalu marinasi selama 10 menit.
instruction.fil: Ihagis ang mga hiwa na may toyo, fermented tofu, asukal, at limang pampalasa; gumamit ng kalahating piraso ng tofu para sa apat na mushroom at i-marinate ng 10 minuto.

steps.imagePrompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: 16:9 recipe tutorial step image. Primary request: close food photograph of thin king oyster mushroom slices in a mixing bowl, evenly coated in a glossy marinade of soy sauce, mashed fermented tofu, sugar, and five-spice powder, resting to marinate. Constraints: strictly vegan; no meat, eggs, dairy, seafood, cornstarch coating, frying pan, labels, people, text, watermark, or logos. No text.

instruction.zh: 兩面裹玉米粉，中火以足量熱油煎至兩面金黃酥脆；油不足可補加。
instruction.en: Coat both sides in cornstarch and pan-fry over medium heat in sufficient hot oil until both sides are golden and crisp.
instruction.id: Balur kedua sisi irisan jamur dengan tepung maizena. Goreng dalam minyak panas yang cukup dengan api sedang hingga kedua sisinya keemasan dan renyah; tambahkan minyak bila perlu.
instruction.fil: Pahiran ng cornstarch ang magkabilang gilid at i-pan-fry sa katamtamang init sa sapat na mainit na mantika hanggang sa maging ginintuang at malutong ang magkabilang gilid.

Constraints: strictly vegan; no meat, eggs, dairy, seafood, finished serving plate, labels, people, text, watermark, or logos. No text.

instruction.zh: 放在餐巾紙上吸去多餘油脂後食用。
instruction.en: Drain on kitchen paper before serving.
instruction.id: Letakkan irisan jamur yang sudah renyah di atas kertas dapur untuk menyerap minyak berlebih, lalu sajikan selagi hangat.
instruction.fil: Patuyuin sa papel sa kusina bago ihain.

description.zh: 自製發酵麵皮包入豆腐、冬粉、茄子與四季豆餡，以麵粉水燜煎出金黃冰花的全素水煎包。
description.en: Homemade fermented dough wraps tofu, vermicelli, eggplant, and green bean filling, then steams and fries with flour water to form crisp golden vegan pan-fried buns.
description.id: Adonan fermentasi buatan sendiri membungkus isian tahu, soun, terong, dan buncis, lalu dikukus-goreng dengan air tepung hingga membentuk bakpao goreng vegan berkulit emas renyah.
description.fil: Binabalot ng homemade fermented dough ang tofu, vermicelli, eggplant, at green bean filling, pagkatapos ay pinapasingaw at pinirito gamit ang tubig na harina upang bumuo ng malulutong na ginintuang vegan pan-fried buns.

title.fil: Ibabad ang vermicelli at maghanda ng palaman

instruction.zh: 冬粉泡水至軟；四季豆、茄子和豆腐切小丁，冬粉剪成短段。
instruction.en: Soak vermicelli until soft. Dice green beans, eggplant, and tofu, then cut vermicelli into short lengths.
instruction.id: Rendam soun hingga lunak. Potong dadu buncis, terong, dan tahu, lalu gunting soun menjadi pendek-pendek.
instruction.fil: Ibabad ang vermicelli hanggang malambot. Dice green beans, eggplant, at tofu, pagkatapos ay gupitin ang vermicelli sa maikling haba.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic overhead food photograph of soaked vermicelli, diced tofu, eggplant, and green beans prepared for vegan bun filling, no text.

instruction.zh: 將酵母先融入水，與麵包專用粉、泡打粉、鹽、糖和溫水拌成麵絮，揉約5分鐘；醒10分鐘後再揉光滑，覆濕布發酵至兩倍大。
instruction.en: Dissolve yeast in water, combine with bread flour blend, baking powder, salt, sugar, and warm water, then knead about 5 minutes. Rest 10 minutes, knead smooth again, cover with a damp cloth, and proof until doubled.
instruction.id: Larutkan ragi dalam air, campur dengan campuran tepung roti, baking powder, garam, gula, dan air hangat, lalu uleni sekitar 5 menit. Istirahatkan 10 menit, uleni hingga halus, tutup kain lembap, dan fermentasikan hingga dua kali lipat.
instruction.fil: I-dissolve ang lebadura sa tubig, pagsamahin sa timpla ng harina ng tinapay, baking powder, asin, asukal, at maligamgam na tubig, pagkatapos ay masahin ng mga 5 minuto. Magpahinga ng 10 minuto, masahin muli ang makinis, takpan ng basang tela, at patunayan hanggang dumoble.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic food photograph of smooth proofed dough rising under a damp cloth in a mixing bowl, no text.

instruction.zh: 鍋中先把豆腐煎至金黃，加入四季豆與茄子略炒；以醬油、醬油膏、胡椒粉、花椒粉、五香粉、辣椒粉、鹽和糖調味，加入冬粉與少量水收至濕潤不乾。
instruction.en: Brown tofu in a pan, then briefly sauté green beans and eggplant. Season with soy sauce, soy paste, pepper, Sichuan pepper, five-spice, chili powder, salt, and sugar; add vermicelli and a little water, reducing until moist but not dry.
instruction.id: Tumis tahu hingga keemasan, lalu tumis sebentar buncis dan terong. Bumbui kecap asin, pasta kecap asin, merica, lada Sichuan, bubuk lima rempah, bubuk cabai, garam, dan gula; tambahkan soun serta sedikit air, masak hingga lembap namun tidak kering.
instruction.fil: Brown tokwa sa isang kawali, pagkatapos ay saglit na igisa ang green beans at talong. Timplahan ng toyo, toyo, paminta, Sichuan pepper, five-spice, chili powder, asin, at asukal; magdagdag ng vermicelli at kaunting tubig, bawasan hanggang mamasa ngunit hindi matuyo.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic food photograph of glossy vermicelli tofu filling with eggplant and green beans cooking in a skillet, no text.

instruction.zh: 發好的麵團排氣後分成8等分，擀成圓皮，包入餡料並收緊封口；放在撒粉盤上避免黏住。
instruction.en: Deflate the proofed dough and divide into 8 portions. Roll into rounds, fill, and seal tightly; place on a floured plate to prevent sticking.
instruction.id: Kempiskan adonan yang sudah mengembang lalu bagi menjadi 8 bagian. Gilas bulat, isi, dan rekatkan rapat; letakkan di piring bertabur tepung agar tidak lengket.
instruction.fil: I-deflate ang proofed dough at hatiin sa 8 bahagi. Paikot-ikot, punan, at i-seal nang mahigpit; ilagay sa isang platong may harina para hindi dumikit.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic close-up food photograph of hands wrapping and sealing vegan pan-fried buns on a floured board, no text.

title.fil: Steam-fry na may tubig na harina

instruction.zh: 麵粉與約250毫升水拌勻。平底鍋加少量油放入包子並留間隔，底部起泡後倒入麵粉水並撒芝麻，蓋鍋小火燜至水分蒸發，再煎至底部金黃。
instruction.en: Mix flour with about 250 ml water. Oil a skillet, arrange buns with space, and when bases blister, pour in flour water and scatter sesame. Cover and steam over low heat until water evaporates, then fry until bottoms are golden.
instruction.id: Campur tepung dengan sekitar 250 ml air. Olesi wajan, susun bakpao berjarak, dan saat bagian bawah bergelembung, tuang air tepung serta taburi wijen. Tutup dan kukus api kecil hingga air menguap, lalu goreng sampai bagian bawah keemasan.
instruction.fil: Paghaluin ang harina na may humigit-kumulang 250 ML ng tubig. Langis ang isang kawali, ayusin ang mga buns na may espasyo, at kapag ang mga base ay paltos, ibuhos sa tubig ng harina at ikalat ang linga. Takpan at pasingawan sa mahinang apoy hanggang sumingaw ang tubig, pagkatapos ay iprito hanggang maging ginintuang ang ilalim.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic food photograph of vegan pan-fried buns with a lacy flour-water crust and white sesame in a skillet, no text.

description.zh: 以老薑榨汁，拌入紅糖與糯米粉蒸熟，再以炒香的糯米粉防沾並切成一口大小的全素薑汁軟糖。
description.en: A vegan ginger soft candy made by juicing mature ginger, combining it with brown sugar and glutinous rice flour, steaming it, then coating and cutting it with toasted glutinous rice flour.
description.id: Permen lunak jahe vegan yang dibuat dengan memeras jahe tua, mencampurnya dengan gula merah dan tepung ketan, mengukusnya, lalu melapisi serta memotongnya dengan tepung ketan sangrai.
description.fil: Isang vegan ginger soft candy na ginawa sa pamamagitan ng pag-juicing ng mature na luya, pinagsasama ito ng brown sugar at glutinous rice flour, pinapasingaw ito, pagkatapos ay pinahiran at hinihiwa ito ng toasted glutinous rice flour.

name.fil: glutinous rice flour para sa pag-aalis ng alikabok

title.fil: I-extract ang sariwang katas ng luya

instruction.zh: 老薑去皮後切成塊，放入調理機打碎；以豆漿布或細布包住薑泥，用力擠出薑汁並備用。
instruction.en: Peel and chunk the mature ginger, then blend it until crushed. Wrap the ginger pulp in a nut-milk bag or fine cloth and squeeze firmly to collect the ginger juice.
instruction.id: Kupas dan potong jahe tua, lalu haluskan dengan blender. Bungkus ampas jahe dalam kain penyaring halus dan peras kuat-kuat untuk mengumpulkan jus jahe.
instruction.fil: Balatan at hiwain ang mature na luya, pagkatapos ay timpla ito hanggang madurog. I-wrap ang ginger pulp sa isang nut-milk bag o pinong tela at pisilin nang mahigpit upang makolekta ang katas ng luya.

Constraints: strictly vegan; raw ginger preparation only, no sugar, flour, cooked syrup, candy, labels, people, watermark, or logos. No text.

title.en: Melt brown sugar with ginger juice
title.id: Lelehkan gula merah dengan jus jahe
title.fil: Matunaw ang brown sugar na may katas ng luya

instruction.zh: 鍋中放入150克紅糖與約40克剛榨的薑汁，以小火攪拌至紅糖完全融化，隨即關火。
instruction.en: Put 150 g brown sugar and about 40 g of the freshly squeezed ginger juice in a pan. Stir over low heat until the sugar fully melts, then turn off the heat.
instruction.id: Masukkan 150 g gula merah dan sekitar 40 g jus jahe segar ke dalam panci. Aduk dengan api kecil sampai gula larut sepenuhnya, lalu matikan api.
instruction.fil: Ilagay ang 150 g brown sugar at humigit-kumulang 40 g ng sariwang kinatas na katas ng luya sa isang kawali. Haluin sa mahinang apoy hanggang sa ganap na matunaw ang asukal, pagkatapos ay patayin ang apoy.

steps.imagePrompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: 16:9 recipe tutorial step image. Primary request: close food photograph of deep brown sugar gently dissolving into freshly pressed ginger juice in a small stainless saucepan over low heat, forming a smooth glossy amber syrup with no vigorous boil. Constraints: strictly vegan; no flour, dough, finished candy, labels, people, text, watermark, or logos. No text.

title.fil: Paghaluin ang luya na malagkit na masa

instruction.zh: 大碗中放入150克糯米粉與150克薑汁攪勻，再倒入溫熱的紅糖薑汁，拌至沒有乾粉的均勻濕糰。
instruction.en: Mix 150 g glutinous rice flour with 150 g ginger juice in a large bowl, then pour in the warm brown-sugar ginger syrup and stir until an even wet dough has no dry flour.
instruction.id: Campur 150 g tepung ketan dengan 150 g jus jahe dalam mangkuk besar, lalu tuang sirup jahe gula merah hangat dan aduk hingga menjadi adonan basah merata tanpa tepung kering.
instruction.fil: Paghaluin ang 150 g glutinous rice flour na may 150 g ginger juice sa isang malaking mangkok, pagkatapos ay ibuhos ang mainit na brown-sugar ginger syrup at haluin hanggang ang pantay na basang masa ay walang tuyong harina.

steps.imagePrompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: 16:9 recipe tutorial step image. Primary request: close preparation photograph of a large mixing bowl where white glutinous rice flour and golden ginger juice are being combined with warm amber brown-sugar ginger syrup into a uniform wet pale-tan dough with no dry flour. Constraints: strictly vegan; no steamer, toasted flour, finished candy, labels, people, text, watermark, or logos. No text.

title.en: Steam the dough and toast the dusting flour
title.id: Kukus adonan dan sangrai tepung pelapis
title.fil: I-steam ang kuwarta at i-toast ang dusting flour

instruction.zh: 將麵糰放入電鍋或蒸鍋，外鍋加兩杯水蒸約30分鐘；同時以小火乾炒約50克糯米粉約5分鐘，作為手粉。
instruction.en: Steam the dough in an electric cooker or steamer with two cups of water in the outer pot for about 30 minutes. Meanwhile, dry-toast about 50 g glutinous rice flour over low heat for about 5 minutes for dusting.
instruction.id: Kukus adonan dalam rice cooker listrik atau kukusan dengan dua cangkir air pada panci luar selama sekitar 30 menit. Sementara itu, sangrai kering sekitar 50 g tepung ketan dengan api kecil selama sekitar 5 menit untuk pelapis.
instruction.fil: I-steam ang kuwarta sa isang electric cooker o steamer na may dalawang tasa ng tubig sa panlabas na palayok sa loob ng mga 30 minuto. Samantala, dry-toast ang tungkol sa 50 g glutinous rice flour sa mahinang apoy para sa mga 5 minuto para sa pag-aalis ng alikabok.

steps.imagePrompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: 16:9 recipe tutorial step image. Primary request: editorial split preparation photograph showing only two simultaneous processes: a covered electric cooker steaming the smooth ginger glutinous dough, and a separate dry skillet over low heat toasting a thin layer of white glutinous rice flour until fragrant. Constraints: strictly vegan; no cut candy, storage container, labels, people, text, watermark, or logos. No text.

title.en: Shape, cut, and coat for storage
title.id: Bentuk, potong, dan lapisi untuk penyimpanan
title.fil: Hugis, gupitin, at pahiran para sa imbakan

instruction.zh: 砧板鋪上炒熟手粉，取出蒸好的軟糖並在表面撒粉，輕揉至光滑後擀至約1公分厚；放涼後切成一口大小，每面沾滿手粉再裝入保鮮罐。
instruction.en: Cover a board with toasted dusting flour, turn out the steamed candy and dust its surface, then gently knead until smooth and roll to about 1 cm thick. Cool, cut into bite-size pieces, coat every side with flour, and store in an airtight container.
instruction.id: Taburi papan dengan tepung pelapis sangrai, keluarkan permen kukus dan taburi permukaannya, lalu uleni perlahan hingga halus dan gilas setebal sekitar 1 cm. Dinginkan, potong seukuran sekali gigit, lapisi semua sisi dengan tepung, lalu simpan dalam wadah kedap udara.
instruction.fil: Takpan ang isang board na may toasted dusting flour, patayin ang steamed candy at lagyan ng alikabok ang ibabaw nito, pagkatapos ay dahan-dahang masahin hanggang makinis at gumulong sa halos 1 cm ang kapal. Palamigin, gupitin sa laki ng kagat, balutin ng harina ang bawat panig, at iimbak sa lalagyang hindi mapapasukan ng hangin.
