description.en: Hot weather is perfect for homemade chilled mayonnaise. It is wonderful with salad or toast, and even as a white sauce for pasta. This recipe uses a Joyoung K9S self-cleaning multifunction blender to make the mayonnaise quickly and smoothly while also steaming vegetables, making a meal easy, simple, and delicious. Give it a try! #vegetarian #veganmayonnaise #JoyoungK9S
description.id: Cuaca panas sangat cocok untuk membuat mayones dingin sendiri. Mayones ini sangat pas untuk salad atau roti panggang, bahkan sebagai saus putih pasta. Resep ini menggunakan blender multifungsi Joyoung K9S yang dapat membersihkan sendiri agar mayones cepat dan lembut sekaligus dapat mengukus sayuran, sehingga satu hidangan menjadi mudah, sederhana, dan lezat. Yuk, coba buat! #vegetarian #mayonesvegan #JoyoungK9S
description.fil: Ang mainit na panahon ay perpekto para sa lutong bahay na pinalamig na mayonesa. Ito ay kahanga-hanga sa salad o toast, at kahit na bilang isang puting sarsa para sa pasta. Gumagamit ang recipe na ito ng Joyoung K9S self-cleaning multifunction blender upang gawing mabilis at maayos ang mayonesa habang nag-uusok din ng mga gulay, na ginagawang madali, simple, at masarap ang pagkain. Subukan ito! #vegetarian #veganmayonnaise #JoyoungK9S

instruction.zh: 將生腰果、檸檬汁、全素法式芥末醬、橄欖油、鹽、糖和水放入調理機，打至滑順。試吃後若覺得不夠甜，可再加少量楓糖漿；放涼後冷藏。若使用料理棒等設備，腰果需先泡水至少 4 小時或泡一晚。
instruction.en: Put raw cashews, lemon juice, vegan Dijon mustard, olive oil, salt, sugar, and water in a blender and blend until smooth. Taste it and add a little maple syrup if it is not sweet enough; cool and refrigerate. When using an immersion blender or similar equipment, soak the cashews for at least 4 hours or overnight first.
instruction.id: Masukkan kacang mete mentah, air lemon, mustard Dijon vegan, minyak zaitun, garam, gula, dan air ke dalam blender, lalu haluskan hingga lembut. Cicipi dan tambahkan sedikit sirup maple bila kurang manis; dinginkan lalu simpan di lemari es. Jika memakai blender tangan atau alat serupa, rendam kacang mete setidaknya 4 jam atau semalaman terlebih dahulu.
instruction.fil: Ilagay ang mga hilaw na kasoy, lemon juice, vegan Dijon mustard, olive oil, asin, asukal, at tubig sa isang blender at timpla hanggang makinis. Tikman ito at magdagdag ng kaunting maple syrup kung hindi ito matamis; palamig at palamigin. Kapag gumagamit ng immersion blender o katulad na kagamitan, ibabad ang mga kasoy nang hindi bababa sa 4 na oras o magdamag muna.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Blend the vegan mayonnaise”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

title.en: Soak and steam the red quinoa
title.fil: Ibabad at singaw ang pulang quinoa

instruction.zh: 紅藜麥先泡水約 10 分鐘，再放入蒸籠蒸熟。蒸好後取出、稍微拌開並放涼。
instruction.en: Soak the red quinoa for about 10 minutes, then steam it in a steamer until cooked. Remove it, fluff it lightly, and let it cool.
instruction.id: Rendam quinoa merah sekitar 10 menit, lalu kukus hingga matang. Angkat, aduk perlahan agar terurai, lalu biarkan dingin.
instruction.fil: Ibabad ang pulang quinoa ng mga 10 minuto, pagkatapos ay i-steam ito sa steamer hanggang maluto. Alisin ito, pahimulmulin ito nang bahagya, at hayaang lumamig.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Soak and steam the red quinoa”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

title.fil: Ihanda at pasingawan ang mga gulay

instruction.zh: 地瓜、南瓜和花椰菜切塊；洗淨小番茄後對半切。生菜切段並洗淨。將要蒸的蔬菜放入蒸籠，蒸 15 分鐘。
instruction.en: Cut the sweet potato, pumpkin, and broccoli into chunks. Wash and halve the cherry tomatoes. Cut and wash the lettuce. Put the vegetables to be steamed in a steamer and steam for 15 minutes.
instruction.id: Potong ubi jalar, labu kuning, dan brokoli menjadi potongan. Cuci lalu belah dua tomat ceri. Potong dan cuci selada. Masukkan sayuran yang akan dikukus ke dalam kukusan dan kukus selama 15 menit.
instruction.fil: Gupitin ang kamote, kalabasa, at broccoli sa mga tipak. Hugasan at hatiin ang cherry tomatoes. Gupitin at hugasan ang litsugas. Ilagay ang mga gulay na ipapasingaw sa isang bapor at pasingawan ng 15 minuto.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Prepare and steam the vegetables”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

instruction.zh: 盤中放入切好的生菜和蒸熟的蔬菜，加入全素美乃滋拌勻，最後放上紅藜麥和小番茄即可享用。
instruction.en: Put the cut lettuce and steamed vegetables on a plate, add the vegan mayonnaise and toss evenly, then finish with the red quinoa and cherry tomatoes.
instruction.id: Letakkan selada yang telah dipotong dan sayuran kukus di atas piring, tambahkan mayones vegan lalu aduk hingga rata, kemudian beri quinoa merah dan tomat ceri di atasnya.
instruction.fil: Ilagay ang hiwa na lettuce at steamed vegetables sa isang plato, idagdag ang vegan mayonnaise at ihagis nang pantay-pantay, pagkatapos ay tapusin ang pulang quinoa at cherry tomatoes.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Assemble the salad”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

description.zh: 高麗菜蒸軟後捲起，以兩張千張包裹並煎至金黃，最後拌入醬油、糖、香油、蘋果醋與水調成的醬燒醬汁。
description.en: Cabbage leaves are steamed until soft, rolled up, wrapped in two sheets of tofu skin, and pan-fried golden before being coated in a soy sauce, sugar, sesame oil, apple cider vinegar, and water sauce.
description.id: Daun kol dikukus hingga lunak, digulung, dibungkus dengan dua lembar kulit tahu, lalu digoreng hingga keemasan sebelum dilapisi saus dari kecap asin, gula, minyak wijen, cuka apel, dan air.
description.fil: Ang mga dahon ng repolyo ay pinapasingaw hanggang lumambot, i-roll up, ibinalot sa dalawang piraso ng balat ng tofu, at piniritong ginintuang bago pahiran ng toyo, asukal, sesame oil, apple cider vinegar, at water sauce.

name.fil: mga sheet ng balat ng tofu

title.en: Separate, wash, and steam the cabbage
title.fil: Paghiwalayin, hugasan, at singaw ang repolyo

instruction.zh: 準備一顆高麗菜，從底部根部附近略切後逐片剝下，盡量保持完整；洗淨後放入碗中，以電鍋外鍋半杯水蒸至變軟，取出放涼。
instruction.en: Prepare one head of cabbage. Make a small cut near the base and separate the leaves one by one, keeping them intact as much as possible. Wash, place in a bowl, and steam in an electric cooker with half a cup of water in the outer pot until soft; let cool.
instruction.id: Siapkan satu buah kol. Buat sedikit sayatan dekat pangkal lalu lepaskan daunnya satu per satu sambil menjaga agar tetap utuh. Cuci, taruh dalam mangkuk, dan kukus dalam penanak listrik dengan setengah cangkir air di panci luar hingga lunak; biarkan dingin.
instruction.fil: Maghanda ng isang ulo ng repolyo. Gumawa ng isang maliit na hiwa malapit sa base at paghiwalayin ang mga dahon nang paisa-isa, panatilihing buo ang mga ito hangga't maaari. Hugasan, ilagay sa isang mangkok, at singaw sa isang electric cooker na may kalahating tasa ng tubig sa panlabas na palayok hanggang malambot; hayaang lumamig.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic 16:9 vegan recipe preparation image of intact cabbage leaves being carefully separated from a whole cabbage, with clean washed leaves in a bowl beside an electric steamer; no text, no watermark, no logo.

title.fil: Pagulungin ang mga dahon ng repolyo

instruction.zh: 將放涼的高麗菜葉兩片疊在一起，先向上捲緊，再將左右兩側往內折捲，做成緊實的菜卷。
instruction.en: Stack two cooled cabbage leaves together. Roll them tightly upward, then fold and roll both sides inward to make a firm cabbage roll.
instruction.id: Tumpuk dua daun kol yang telah dingin. Gulung rapat ke atas, lalu lipat dan gulung kedua sisinya ke dalam hingga menjadi gulungan kol yang padat.
instruction.fil: Pagsamahin ang dalawang pinalamig na dahon ng repolyo. Igulong ang mga ito nang mahigpit pataas, pagkatapos ay tiklupin at igulong ang magkabilang gilid papasok upang makagawa ng isang matibay na roll ng repolyo.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic overhead 16:9 vegan preparation image of two softened cabbage leaves stacked and rolled into a compact cabbage roll on a clean board; no text, no watermark, no logo.

title.en: Wrap the roll in tofu skin
title.fil: I-wrap ang roll sa balat ng tofu

instruction.zh: 取兩張千張疊在一起，表面撒少量麵粉後放上菜卷。像包春捲般捲起並將左右兩側向內折；以麵粉和水隨意調成不太濃稠的麵糊，塗在尾端封口黏住。
instruction.en: Stack two tofu skin sheets, sprinkle on a little flour, and place the cabbage roll on top. Roll it up like a spring roll and fold both sides inward. Mix flour and water into a loose, not-too-thick slurry, then use it to seal the end.
instruction.id: Tumpuk dua lembar kulit tahu, taburi sedikit tepung, lalu letakkan gulungan kol di atasnya. Gulung seperti lumpia dan lipat kedua sisi ke dalam. Campurkan tepung dan air menjadi adonan encer yang tidak terlalu kental, lalu gunakan untuk merekatkan ujungnya.
instruction.fil: Isalansan ang dalawang balat ng tofu, budburan ng kaunting harina, at ilagay ang repolyo sa ibabaw. I-roll ito tulad ng isang spring roll at tiklupin ang magkabilang gilid papasok. Paghaluin ang harina at tubig sa isang maluwag, hindi masyadong makapal na slurry, pagkatapos ay gamitin ito upang i-seal ang dulo.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic 16:9 vegan recipe preparation image of a cabbage roll being wrapped in two pale tofu skin sheets like a spring roll, with a small bowl of thin flour slurry for sealing; no text, no watermark, no logo.

instruction.zh: 將醬油、糖、香油、少量蘋果醋與水混合，攪拌均勻成醬燒醬汁。
instruction.en: Combine soy sauce, sugar, sesame oil, a little apple cider vinegar, and water, then stir until evenly mixed for the braising sauce.
instruction.id: Campurkan kecap asin, gula, minyak wijen, sedikit cuka apel, dan air, lalu aduk hingga rata menjadi saus panggang.
instruction.fil: Pagsamahin ang toyo, asukal, sesame oil, kaunting apple cider vinegar, at tubig, pagkatapos ay haluin hanggang pantay-pantay para sa braising sauce.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic overhead 16:9 vegan preparation image of a small bowl of glossy brown soy sauce mixture being stirred with sugar, sesame oil, apple cider vinegar and water nearby; no text, no watermark, no logo.

title.fil: I-pan-fry at covered-cook ang mga roll

instruction.zh: 鍋中倒入少量植物油，將包好的菜卷煎至兩面金黃。蓋上鍋蓋燜約兩分鐘後即可起鍋。
instruction.en: Add a little vegetable oil to a pan and fry the wrapped rolls until golden on both sides. Cover and cook for about two minutes, then remove from the pan.
instruction.id: Tuang sedikit minyak nabati ke wajan lalu goreng gulungan yang telah dibungkus hingga kedua sisinya keemasan. Tutup dan masak selama sekitar dua menit, kemudian angkat dari wajan.
instruction.fil: Magdagdag ng isang maliit na langis ng gulay sa isang kawali at iprito ang mga balot na roll hanggang sa ginintuang sa magkabilang panig. Takpan at lutuin ng halos dalawang minuto, pagkatapos ay alisin sa kawali.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic 16:9 vegan skillet image of tofu-skin-wrapped cabbage rolls turning golden on both sides in a lightly oiled pan under a lid; no text, no watermark, no logo.

instruction.zh: 將菜卷切成約三公分長的段狀後上桌，搭配調好的醬燒醬汁享用。
instruction.en: Cut the cabbage rolls into pieces about 3 cm long and serve with the prepared braising sauce.
instruction.id: Potong gulungan kol menjadi bagian sepanjang sekitar 3 cm, lalu sajikan dengan saus panggang yang telah disiapkan.
instruction.fil: Gupitin ang mga roll ng repolyo sa mga piraso na humigit-kumulang 3 cm ang haba at ihain kasama ang inihandang braising sauce.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic 16:9 finished vegan dish image of golden tofu-skin cabbage roll pieces cut into about 3 cm segments and served with glossy brown dipping sauce; no text, no watermark, no logo.

description.zh: 煎香大塊豆腐，搭配青椒、青花椒、薑、辣椒和檸檬打成的青醬，收濃後淋在熱砂鍋豆腐上。
description.en: Large tofu pieces are pan-fried until golden and topped with a reduced green sauce blended from green pepper, green Sichuan pepper, ginger, chili, and lemon.
description.id: Potongan tahu besar digoreng hingga keemasan lalu disiram saus hijau kental dari paprika hijau, lada Sichuan hijau, jahe, cabai, dan lemon.
description.fil: Ang malalaking piraso ng tofu ay pinirito hanggang ginintuang at nilagyan ng pinababang berdeng sarsa na pinaghalo mula sa berdeng paminta, berdeng paminta ng Sichuan, luya, sili, at lemon.

instruction.zh: 青椒切段，老薑切片；辣椒按需要去除籽後備用。
instruction.en: Cut green pepper into sections and slice the ginger; remove chili seeds if desired and set aside.
instruction.id: Potong paprika hijau menjadi beberapa bagian dan iris jahe; buang biji cabai bila diinginkan lalu sisihkan.
instruction.fil: Gupitin ang berdeng paminta sa mga seksyon at hiwain ang luya; alisin ang mga buto ng sili kung gusto at itabi.

steps.imagePrompt: Overhead vegan mise en place with chopped green pepper, sliced ginger, fresh chili, lemon and green Sichuan peppercorns on a wooden board, bright natural daylight, no text, no watermark, no meat or animal products

instruction.zh: 炒鍋加植物油，放入豆腐後以湯匙隨意分成大塊，將每一面煎至金黃色後取出。
instruction.en: Heat vegetable oil in a wok, add tofu, and use a spoon to break it into large irregular pieces. Fry every side until golden, then remove.
instruction.id: Panaskan minyak sayur dalam wajan, masukkan tahu, lalu gunakan sendok untuk membaginya menjadi potongan besar tidak beraturan. Goreng setiap sisi hingga keemasan, lalu angkat.
instruction.fil: Mag-init ng mantika ng gulay sa isang kawali, magdagdag ng tofu, at gumamit ng kutsara para hatiin ito sa malalaking hindi regular na piraso. Iprito ang bawat panig hanggang sa ginintuang, pagkatapos ay alisin.

steps.imagePrompt: Large irregular tofu pieces pan-frying until golden in a wok, crisp browned sides and a little vegetable oil, vegan Chinese home cooking, no text, no watermark, no meat or animal products

instruction.zh: 把青椒、老薑、辣椒、青花椒、檸檬汁和少許植物油放入調理機，打碎成青醬。
instruction.en: Put green pepper, ginger, chili, green Sichuan pepper, lemon juice, and a little vegetable oil into a blender and blend into a green sauce.
instruction.id: Masukkan paprika hijau, jahe, cabai, lada Sichuan hijau, jus lemon, dan sedikit minyak sayur ke blender, lalu haluskan menjadi saus hijau.
instruction.fil: Ilagay ang berdeng paminta, luya, sili, berdeng Sichuan pepper, lemon juice, at kaunting langis ng gulay sa isang blender at timpla sa isang berdeng sarsa.

steps.imagePrompt: Vibrant green vegan pepper sauce blending in a countertop blender with ginger, chili, lemon and green Sichuan pepper, clean kitchen scene, no text, no watermark, no meat or animal products

instruction.zh: 把青醬倒入鍋中，以小火煮至原有水分幾乎收乾、呈泥狀但不全乾。加入水、鹽、糖和胡椒粉；以太白粉或蓮藕粉加水調成勾芡水，邊倒邊攪拌至微濃稠後關火。
instruction.en: Pour the green sauce into a pan and cook over low heat until its original moisture is nearly gone and it is pasty but not dry. Add water, salt, sugar, and pepper; make a slurry with potato starch or lotus-root starch and water, then stir it in until slightly thick before turning off the heat.
instruction.id: Tuang saus hijau ke wajan dan masak dengan api kecil hingga air alaminya hampir habis dan menjadi seperti pasta namun tidak kering. Tambahkan air, garam, gula, dan lada; buat larutan tepung kentang atau tepung akar teratai dengan air, lalu tuang sambil diaduk hingga sedikit mengental sebelum mematikan api.
instruction.fil: Ibuhos ang berdeng sarsa sa isang kawali at lutuin sa mahinang apoy hanggang sa ang orihinal na kahalumigmigan nito ay halos mawala at ito ay maputi ngunit hindi tuyo. Magdagdag ng tubig, asin, asukal, at paminta; gumawa ng slurry na may potato starch o lotus-root starch at tubig, pagkatapos ay haluin ito hanggang bahagyang makapal bago patayin ang apoy.

steps.imagePrompt: Thick vibrant green pepper sauce gently simmering in a wok, glossy texture with a wooden spatula stirring, vegan cooking scene, natural food photography, no text, no watermark, no meat or animal products

instruction.zh: 砂鍋稍微加熱後放入煎豆腐，淋上青椒醬即可上桌；沒有砂鍋可直接把豆腐與醬汁拌勻食用。
instruction.en: Warm a claypot gently, add the fried tofu, and pour the green pepper sauce over it. Without a claypot, simply toss tofu with sauce and serve.
instruction.id: Hangatkan claypot perlahan, masukkan tahu goreng, lalu siram saus paprika hijau di atasnya. Jika tanpa claypot, cukup aduk tahu dengan saus dan sajikan.
instruction.fil: Painitin ang isang claypot nang malumanay, idagdag ang pritong tofu, at ibuhos ang berdeng sarsa ng paminta dito. Kung walang claypot, ihagis lang ang tofu na may sarsa at ihain.

steps.imagePrompt: Finished vegan green pepper tofu in a warm claypot, golden tofu pieces covered in vibrant green sauce, fragrant steam, elegant Asian home food photography, no text, no watermark, no meat or animal products

description.zh: 以熱油激發薑、白芝麻和辣椒粉香氣，再拌入日式醬油、烏醋、香油、素蠔油和雪碧，配冰鎮細麵做成酸辣清爽拌麵。
description.en: Hot oil blooms ginger, sesame, and chili powder, then Japanese soy sauce, black vinegar, sesame oil, vegan oyster sauce, and Sprite make a tangy sauce for chilled thin noodles.
description.id: Minyak panas membangkitkan aroma jahe, wijen, dan bubuk cabai; lalu kecap Jepang, cuka hitam, minyak wijen, saus tiram vegan, dan Sprite menjadi saus asam pedas untuk mi tipis dingin.
description.fil: Ang mainit na mantika ay namumulaklak sa luya, linga, at sili, pagkatapos ay Japanese soy sauce, itim na suka, sesame oil, vegan oyster sauce, at Sprite ay gumagawa ng tangy sauce para sa pinalamig na manipis na noodles.

name.en: instant noodle cake or thin noodles
name.fil: instant noodle cake o manipis na pansit

instruction.zh: 把老薑和香菜切末，小黃瓜和紅甜椒切絲。配菜可依喜好換成豆芽菜或小白菜等。
instruction.en: Mince ginger and cilantro; julienne cucumber and red bell pepper. You may substitute toppings such as bean sprouts or bok choy as preferred.
instruction.id: Cincang jahe dan daun ketumbar; iris tipis timun serta paprika merah. Pelengkap dapat diganti dengan tauge atau pakcoy sesuai selera.
instruction.fil: Tadtarin ang luya at cilantro; julienne cucumber at red bell pepper. Maaari mong palitan ang mga toppings tulad ng bean sprouts o bok choy kung gusto mo.

steps.imagePrompt: Overhead vegan noodle topping preparation with julienned cucumber, red bell pepper, minced ginger, cilantro, lemon and sesame on a wooden board, bright natural daylight, no text, no watermark, no meat or animal products

instruction.zh: 耐熱碗中放入薑末、白芝麻和辣椒粉。植物油加熱至約 160°C 後倒入碗中激發香氣，拌入日式醬油、烏醋、香油、素蠔油和雪碧；加入檸檬片拌勻後冷藏冰鎮。
instruction.en: Place ginger, white sesame, and chili powder in a heatproof bowl. Heat vegetable oil to about 160°C and pour it over to bloom the aromatics, then stir in Japanese soy sauce, black vinegar, sesame oil, vegan oyster sauce, and Sprite. Add lemon slices, mix, and chill.
instruction.id: Masukkan jahe, wijen putih, dan bubuk cabai ke mangkuk tahan panas. Panaskan minyak sayur hingga sekitar 160°C lalu siramkan untuk mengeluarkan aroma, kemudian aduk kecap Jepang, cuka hitam, minyak wijen, saus tiram vegan, dan Sprite. Tambahkan irisan lemon, aduk, lalu dinginkan.
instruction.fil: Ilagay ang luya, puting linga, at chili powder sa isang mangkok na hindi tinatablan ng init. Painitin ang langis ng gulay sa humigit-kumulang 160°C at ibuhos ito upang mamukadkad ang mga aromatic, pagkatapos ay haluin ang Japanese soy sauce, itim na suka, sesame oil, vegan oyster sauce, at Sprite. Magdagdag ng mga hiwa ng lemon, ihalo, at palamigin.

steps.imagePrompt: Hot oil blooming ginger, white sesame and chili powder in a heatproof bowl, with lemon slices and tangy vegan noodle sauce ingredients nearby, natural food photography, no text, no watermark, no meat or animal products

instruction.zh: 煮一鍋滾水，將王子麵或任意細麵煮熟。先準備冰水，麵煮好後立刻放入冰水冰鎮，再撈出瀝乾。
instruction.en: Bring a pot of water to a boil and cook instant noodles or any thin noodles. Prepare ice water; transfer cooked noodles to it immediately, then drain well.
instruction.id: Didihkan air dan rebus mi instan atau mi tipis apa pun hingga matang. Siapkan air es; segera masukkan mi matang ke air es, lalu tiriskan hingga baik.
instruction.fil: Pakuluan ang isang palayok ng tubig at magluto ng instant noodles o anumang manipis na noodles. Maghanda ng tubig ng yelo; ilipat agad ang nilutong pansit dito, pagkatapos ay patuyuin ng mabuti.

steps.imagePrompt: Thin noodles being transferred from boiling water into a bowl of ice water, refreshing vegan noodle preparation, clean bright kitchen scene, no text, no watermark, no meat or animal products

instruction.zh: 把冰鎮瀝乾的麵放入大碗，放上小黃瓜、紅甜椒和香菜，按麵量淋入冰鎮醬汁，檸檬片一同拌入後即可享用。
instruction.en: Put chilled, drained noodles in a large bowl. Add cucumber, red bell pepper, and cilantro; pour in chilled sauce to suit the noodle amount, tossing the lemon slices through before serving.
instruction.id: Masukkan mi yang sudah dingin dan ditiriskan ke mangkuk besar. Tambahkan timun, paprika merah, dan daun ketumbar; tuang saus dingin sesuai jumlah mi, lalu aduk bersama irisan lemon sebelum disajikan.
instruction.fil: Ilagay ang pinalamig, pinatuyo na noodles sa isang malaking mangkok. Magdagdag ng pipino, pulang kampanilya paminta, at cilantro; ibuhos ang pinalamig na sarsa upang umangkop sa dami ng pansit, ihagis ang mga hiwa ng lemon bago ihain.

steps.imagePrompt: Finished chilled vegan sweet-sour Sprite noodles in a bowl with cucumber, red bell pepper, cilantro and lemon, glossy chili sesame sauce, vibrant natural food photography, no text, no watermark, no meat or animal products

description.zh: 馬鈴薯、櫛瓜、蘑菇與豆腐搭配番茄和香料油燉煮成濃郁的全素印度蔬菜咖喱，不加椰奶、酸奶或奶油。
description.en: Potato, zucchini, mushrooms, and tofu are cooked with tomato and an aromatic spiced oil into a rich vegan Indian vegetable curry, without coconut milk, yogurt, or butter.
description.id: Kentang, zukini, jamur, dan tahu dimasak bersama tomat serta minyak rempah menjadi kari sayuran India vegan yang kaya rasa, tanpa santan, yoghurt, atau mentega.
description.fil: Ang patatas, zucchini, mushroom, at tofu ay niluto na may kamatis at isang mabangong spiced oil sa isang rich vegan Indian vegetable curry, na walang gata ng niyog, yogurt, o mantikilya.

title.fil: Ihanda ang mga gulay at tofu

instruction.zh: 將馬鈴薯、櫛瓜、蘑菇與豆腐切成塊；番茄切小丁，老薑切片。影片使用的澳洲馬鈴薯皮薄可保留外皮；若使用皮較厚的馬鈴薯則削皮。
instruction.en: Cut the potatoes, zucchini, mushrooms, and tofu into chunks. Dice the tomato and slice the mature ginger. The video leaves the thin skin on Australian potatoes; peel potatoes with thicker skin.
instruction.id: Potong kentang, zukini, jamur, dan tahu menjadi potongan besar. Potong tomat dadu kecil dan iris jahe tua. Video membiarkan kulit kentang Australia yang tipis; kupas kentang dengan kulit yang lebih tebal.
instruction.fil: Gupitin ang patatas, zucchini, mushroom, at tofu sa mga tipak. Dice ang kamatis at hiwain ang mature na luya. Ang video ay umalis sa manipis na balat sa Australian patatas; alisan ng balat ang patatas na may mas makapal na balat.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Prepare the vegetables and tofu”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

title.zh: 烤香馬鈴薯、蘑菇與豆腐
title.en: Roast the potatoes, mushrooms, and tofu
title.fil: Inihaw ang patatas, mushroom, at tofu

instruction.zh: 將馬鈴薯、蘑菇與豆腐拌少量油和鹽，放入烤箱以 200°C 烤 15 分鐘至香；也可用氣炸鍋處理。
instruction.en: Toss the potatoes, mushrooms, and tofu with a little oil and salt. Roast at 200°C for 15 minutes until fragrant; an air fryer can also be used.
instruction.id: Aduk kentang, jamur, dan tahu dengan sedikit minyak dan garam. Panggang pada 200°C selama 15 menit hingga harum; penggoreng udara juga dapat digunakan.
instruction.fil: Ihagis ang patatas, mushroom, at tofu na may kaunting mantika at asin. Inihaw sa 200°C sa loob ng 15 minuto hanggang mabango; pwede ding gumamit ng air fryer.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Roast the potatoes, mushrooms, and tofu”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

instruction.zh: 鍋中倒入植物油，冷油放入芹菜、香菜和薑片，煸至金黃後撈起。接著放入月桂葉、八角、桂皮、陳皮、丁香、小茴香、孜然與花椒煸香；將可夾起的大型香料先取出，保留小茴香、丁香和花椒。
instruction.en: Add vegetable oil to a pot and, while cold, add celery, cilantro, and ginger slices. Fry until golden, then remove. Add bay leaves, star anise, cinnamon bark, dried tangerine peel, cloves, fennel, cumin, and Sichuan peppercorns until aromatic; remove the larger whole spices first, leaving the fennel, cloves, and peppercorns.
instruction.id: Masukkan minyak sayur ke dalam panci dan, saat minyak masih dingin, tambahkan seledri, daun ketumbar, serta irisan jahe. Tumis hingga keemasan lalu angkat. Tambahkan daun salam, bunga lawang, kayu manis, kulit jeruk kering, cengkih, biji adas, jintan putih, dan lada Sichuan hingga harum; angkat rempah utuh yang besar terlebih dahulu, sisakan biji adas, cengkih, dan lada Sichuan.
instruction.fil: Magdagdag ng langis ng gulay sa isang palayok at, habang malamig, magdagdag ng kintsay, cilantro, at hiwa ng luya. Iprito hanggang sa ginintuang, pagkatapos ay alisin. Magdagdag ng bay dahon, star anise, balat ng kanela, pinatuyong balat ng dalanghita, cloves, haras, kumin, at Sichuan peppercorn hanggang mabango; alisin muna ang mas malaking buong pampalasa, iwanan ang haras, cloves, at peppercorns.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Infuse the spiced oil”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

instruction.zh: 在香料油中加入番茄炒至變軟，再加入蒜頭。
instruction.en: Add the tomato to the spiced oil and cook until softened, then add the garlic.
instruction.id: Masukkan tomat ke minyak rempah dan masak hingga lunak, lalu tambahkan bawang putih.
instruction.fil: Idagdag ang kamatis sa spiced oil at lutuin hanggang lumambot, pagkatapos ay idagdag ang bawang.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Soften the tomato and garlic”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

title.fil: Tapusin ang kari na may zucchini

instruction.zh: 咖喱開蓋後，加入剩下的櫛瓜，以及先前取出的月桂葉、桂皮和煸香的香菜、芹菜，再熬煮 5 分鐘即可盛盤。
instruction.en: After uncovering the curry, add the remaining zucchini along with the reserved bay leaves, cinnamon bark, and browned cilantro and celery. Simmer for 5 more minutes, then serve.
instruction.id: Setelah kari dibuka, tambahkan sisa zukini bersama daun salam, kayu manis, serta daun ketumbar dan seledri yang telah ditumis. Didihkan lagi selama 5 menit, lalu sajikan.
instruction.fil: Pagkatapos mabuksan ang curry, idagdag ang natitirang zucchini kasama ang nakareserbang dahon ng bay, balat ng kanela, at browned cilantro at celery. Pakuluan ng 5 minuto pa, pagkatapos ay ihain.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Finish the curry with zucchini”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

description.zh: 以原粒香料、薑黃、咖哩粉與菇類堆疊香氣的全素印度風味飯；影片明確說明不加鹽。
description.en: A vegan Indian-style rice dish layered with whole spices, turmeric, curry powder, and mushrooms; the source explicitly says no salt is added.
description.id: Nasi vegan gaya India dengan rempah utuh, kunyit, bubuk kari, dan jamur; sumber secara jelas menyatakan tanpa garam.
description.fil: Isang vegan na Indian-style na rice dish na pinahiran ng buong spices, turmeric, curry powder, at mushroom; tahasang sinabi ng source na walang idinadagdag na asin.

instruction.zh: 洗淨長米，第一遍洗米水迅速倒掉；將蘑菇和老薑切片。
instruction.en: Wash the long-grain rice and discard the first rinse promptly; slice the mushrooms and mature ginger.
instruction.id: Cuci beras bulir panjang dan segera buang air cucian pertama; iris jamur dan jahe tua.
instruction.fil: Hugasan ang mahabang butil na bigas at itapon kaagad ang unang banlawan; hiwain ang mushroom at mature na luya.

steps.imagePrompt: Overhead food photograph of rinsed long-grain rice, sliced mushrooms, and sliced ginger arranged in small bowls on a warm kitchen worktop, no text, no people

title.fil: Magprito ng mga aromatics at mushroom

instruction.zh: 冷油下芹菜、香菜和薑，小火煸至焦黃後撈起；再將蘑菇煸至金黃並撈起。
instruction.en: Start celery, cilantro, and ginger in cold oil and fry gently until browned, then remove; fry mushrooms until golden and remove.
instruction.id: Masukkan seledri, daun ketumbar, dan jahe ke minyak dingin, tumis perlahan hingga kecokelatan lalu angkat; tumis jamur hingga keemasan dan angkat.
instruction.fil: Simulan ang kintsay, cilantro, at luya sa malamig na mantika at dahan-dahang iprito hanggang sa kayumanggi, pagkatapos ay alisin; iprito ang mushroom hanggang sa ginintuang at alisin.

steps.imagePrompt: Close-up food photograph of golden mushrooms and browned aromatics sizzling in a shallow pan with glistening oil, no text, no people

instruction.zh: 將月桂葉、花椒、小茴香、桂皮、八角與陳皮煸香；夾出部分大塊香料後，加入薑黃粉、印度咖哩粉和孜然粒炒香。
instruction.en: Toast bay leaves, Sichuan pepper, fennel, cinnamon, star anise, and dried citrus peel; remove some larger spices, then bloom turmeric, Indian curry powder, and cumin seeds.
instruction.id: Tumis daun salam, lada Sichuan, adas, kayu manis, bunga lawang, dan kulit jeruk kering; angkat sebagian rempah besar, lalu tumis kunyit, bubuk kari India, dan biji jintan.
instruction.fil: Toast bay dahon, Sichuan pepper, haras, kanela, star anise, at pinatuyong balat ng citrus; alisin ang ilang mas malalaking pampalasa, pagkatapos ay pamumulaklak ng turmeric, Indian curry powder, at cumin seeds.

steps.imagePrompt: Cinematic overhead food photograph of yellow turmeric rice being stirred with whole spices in a dark pan, steam and warm golden light, no text

instruction.zh: 加入水；來源說明米水比例約為 1:1.1，蓋鍋後小火煮 15 分鐘。
instruction.en: Add water; the source gives an approximate rice-to-water ratio of 1:1.1, then cover and cook over low heat for 15 minutes.
instruction.id: Tambahkan air; sumber menyebut rasio beras dan air sekitar 1:1,1, lalu tutup dan masak dengan api kecil selama 15 menit.
instruction.fil: Magdagdag ng tubig; ang pinagmulan ay nagbibigay ng tinatayang rice-to-water ratio na 1:1.1, pagkatapos ay takpan at lutuin sa mahinang apoy sa loob ng 15 minuto.

steps.imagePrompt: Food photograph of a covered pot of fragrant yellow spiced rice gently steaming on a stovetop, warm kitchen lighting, no text, no people

instruction.zh: 檢查熟度；想要鍋巴可再煮約 2 分鐘。撒回蘑菇與新鮮香菜，夾出香料後拌勻食用。
instruction.en: Check doneness; cook about 2 more minutes for crust if desired. Return mushrooms and fresh cilantro, remove whole spices, and toss before serving.
instruction.id: Periksa kematangan; masak sekitar 2 menit lagi bila menginginkan kerak nasi. Kembalikan jamur dan daun ketumbar segar, keluarkan rempah utuh, lalu aduk sebelum disajikan.
instruction.fil: Suriin ang doneness; magluto ng mga 2 minuto pa para sa crust kung gusto. Ibalik ang mga mushroom at sariwang cilantro, alisin ang buong pampalasa, at ihagis bago ihain.

steps.imagePrompt: Appetizing food photograph of fluffy golden vegan Indian spiced rice topped with browned mushrooms and fresh cilantro in a rustic bowl, no text, no people

description.zh: 烤小番茄配低溫香料橄欖油的冰箱常備品。
description.en: Roasted cherry tomatoes preserved in gently infused olive oil.
description.id: Tomat ceri panggang yang diawetkan dalam minyak zaitun berbumbu.
description.fil: Ang mga inihaw na kamatis na cherry ay napanatili sa malumanay na nilagyan ng olive oil.

instruction.zh: 番茄去蒂對半切，切面朝上，加橄欖油、鹽、胡椒、義式香料和迷迭香；160°C 烤 40 分鐘，第 30 分鐘檢查。
instruction.en: Halve stemmed tomatoes cut-side up, season, then roast at 160°C for 40 minutes; check at 30 minutes.
instruction.id: Belah tomat, bumbui, lalu panggang 160°C selama 40 menit dan periksa pada menit ke-30.
instruction.fil: Hatiin ang mga tangkay na kamatis na gupitin, timplahan, pagkatapos ay inihaw sa 160°C sa loob ng 40 minuto; suriin sa 30 minuto.

instruction.en: Start bay leaves, fennel, ginger, and dried chili in cold olive oil; heat gently until fragrant, then cool.
instruction.id: Masukkan daun salam, adas, jahe, dan cabai ke minyak dingin; panaskan perlahan lalu dinginkan.
instruction.fil: Simulan ang bay dahon, haras, luya, at pinatuyong sili sa malamig na langis ng oliba; init ng malumanay hanggang sa mabango, pagkatapos ay palamig.

instruction.zh: 玻璃罐滾水燙 10 分鐘並晾乾；放入冷卻番茄和冷卻香料油，油需高過番茄至少 1 公分，冷藏隔日食用。
instruction.en: Sterilize a glass jar in boiling water for 10 minutes; cover cooled tomatoes with cooled infused oil by at least 1 cm and refrigerate overnight.
instruction.id: Sterilkan stoples 10 menit; tutupi tomat dingin dengan minyak minimal 1 cm dan dinginkan semalaman.
instruction.fil: I-sterilize ang isang garapon ng salamin sa tubig na kumukulo sa loob ng 10 minuto; takpan ang mga pinalamig na kamatis na may pinalamig na infused oil ng hindi bababa sa 1 cm at palamigin magdamag.

無澱粉料理
讓你減脂餐也可以吃的開心
