description.en: Grilled rice balls are a staple of izakaya cuisine and a Japanese family lunchbox dish. They are quick, simple, filling, and friendly for cooking beginners.
description.id: Onigiri panggang adalah hidangan wajib di izakaya dan bekal keluarga Jepang. Hidangan ini cepat, sederhana, mengenyangkan, dan ramah bagi pemula memasak.
description.fil: Ang mga inihaw na rice ball ay isang staple ng izakaya cuisine at isang Japanese family lunchbox dish. Ang mga ito ay mabilis, simple, nakakabusog, at palakaibigan para sa mga nagsisimula sa pagluluto.

instruction.zh: 茄子切成小滾刀塊。炒鍋放少量植物油，將茄子炒軟；加入少量日式醬油嗆鍋後盛出備用。
instruction.en: Cut the eggplant into small roll-cut chunks. Add a little vegetable oil to a wok and cook until soft; splash in a little Japanese soy sauce, then set aside.
instruction.id: Potong terong menjadi potongan kecil. Tambahkan sedikit minyak nabati ke wajan dan masak hingga lunak; tambahkan sedikit kecap asin Jepang, lalu sisihkan.
instruction.fil: Gupitin ang talong sa maliliit na roll-cut chunks. Magdagdag ng kaunting langis ng gulay sa isang kawali at lutuin hanggang malambot; iwiwisik ng kaunting Japanese toyo, pagkatapos ay itabi.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Cook the eggplant filling”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

instruction.zh: 在剛煮好的熱白飯中拌入素鬆和少量鹽。可依喜好加入七味粉或芝麻調味。
instruction.en: Mix vegan meat floss and a little salt into freshly cooked hot rice. Japanese seven-spice powder or sesame may be added to taste.
instruction.id: Campurkan abon vegan dan sedikit garam ke dalam nasi panas yang baru matang. Bubuk tujuh rempah Jepang atau wijen dapat ditambahkan sesuai selera.
instruction.fil: Paghaluin ang vegan meat floss at kaunting asin sa bagong lutong mainit na kanin. Ang Japanese seven-spice powder o sesame ay maaaring idagdag sa panlasa.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Season the rice”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

instruction.zh: 將味噌、味醂、醬油、少量糖與少量熱水攪拌均勻，作為刷在飯糰上的醬料。
instruction.en: Mix miso, mirin, soy sauce, a little sugar, and a little hot water until even for the rice-ball glaze.
instruction.id: Aduk miso, mirin, kecap asin, sedikit gula, dan sedikit air panas hingga rata untuk saus oles onigiri.
instruction.fil: Paghaluin ang miso, mirin, toyo, kaunting asukal, at kaunting mainit na tubig hanggang sa maging rice-ball glaze.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Mix the miso glaze”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

instruction.zh: 在烘焙紙上鋪一層米飯，放上茄子餡，再鋪一層米飯。用烘焙紙捏成三角形；先捏緊，讓米飯的黏性帶出來。
instruction.en: Layer rice, eggplant filling, then rice on baking paper. Use the paper to shape a triangle, pressing firmly at first so the rice becomes sticky enough to hold its form.
instruction.id: Di atas kertas roti, susun nasi, isian terong, lalu nasi. Gunakan kertas untuk membentuk segitiga dan tekan rapat terlebih dahulu agar nasi cukup lengket untuk mempertahankan bentuk.
instruction.fil: Layer rice, talong filling, then rice sa baking paper. Gamitin ang papel upang hubugin ang isang tatsulok, pindutin nang mahigpit sa una upang ang bigas ay maging sapat na malagkit upang hawakan ang anyo nito.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Form triangular rice balls”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

instruction.zh: 平底鍋以中小火預熱 1 至 2 分鐘並刷少量油。放入飯糰，第一面煎約 5 分鐘且不要移動；翻面後再煎約 5 分鐘。
instruction.en: Preheat a skillet over medium-low heat for 1 to 2 minutes and brush with a little oil. Add the rice ball and cook the first side for about 5 minutes without moving it; flip and cook the other side for about 5 minutes.
instruction.id: Panaskan wajan datar dengan api sedang-kecil selama 1 hingga 2 menit dan olesi sedikit minyak. Masukkan onigiri dan masak sisi pertama sekitar 5 menit tanpa digerakkan; balik lalu masak sisi lainnya sekitar 5 menit.
instruction.fil: Painitin muna ang kawali sa katamtamang mababang init sa loob ng 1 hanggang 2 minuto at magsipilyo ng kaunting mantika. Idagdag ang rice ball at lutuin ang unang bahagi ng mga 5 minuto nang hindi ito ginagalaw; i-flip at lutuin ang kabilang panig ng mga 5 minuto.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Pan-fry both sides”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

title.fil: Igisa ang mga gilid at tapusin

instruction.zh: 關火後，以餘溫將每個側面各煎約 30 秒。飯糰煎好後撒上海苔酥或七味粉即可享用。
instruction.en: Turn off the heat and use the residual heat to sear each side for about 30 seconds. Finish with nori flakes or Japanese seven-spice powder.
instruction.id: Matikan api dan gunakan panas sisa untuk memanggang setiap sisi sekitar 30 detik. Setelah matang, taburi serpihan nori atau bubuk tujuh rempah Jepang.
instruction.fil: Patayin ang apoy at gamitin ang natitirang init upang painitin ang bawat panig nang mga 30 segundo. Tapusin gamit ang nori flakes o Japanese seven-spice powder.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Sear the sides and finish”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

description.en: Here is the electric-cooker dish you have often requested. I have loved mixed rice since childhood: one bowl is convenient and contains all the nutrition, while the vegetables' sweetness is locked into the white rice. Learn it along with the video! Ingredients: 20 edamame beans, 1/5 head cabbage, 30 g oyster mushrooms, 8 dried shiitake mushrooms, 2 tomatoes, 1 eggplant, 15 g preserved radish, 2 cups white rice, and 10 g red quinoa. Seasonings: 3 tbsp soy sauce, 2 tbsp sugar, 1 tsp ground pepper, and 2 tsp salt.
description.id: Inilah hidangan penanak nasi listrik yang sering diminta. Sejak kecil saya sangat menyukai nasi campur: satu mangkuk sangat praktis dan berisi semua gizi, sementara manis sayuran terkunci di dalam nasi putih. Yuk, pelajari bersama video! Bahan: 20 butir edamame, 1/5 bonggol kubis, 30 g jamur tiram, 8 jamur shiitake kering, 2 tomat, 1 terong, 15 g lobak asin kering, 2 cangkir beras putih, dan 10 g quinoa merah. Bumbu: 3 sdm kecap asin, 2 sdm gula, 1 sdt lada bubuk, dan 2 sdt garam.
description.fil: Narito ang electric-cooker dish na madalas mong hinihiling. Gustung-gusto ko ang pinaghalong kanin mula pagkabata: ang isang mangkok ay maginhawa at naglalaman ng lahat ng nutrisyon, habang ang tamis ng mga gulay ay naka-lock sa puting bigas. Alamin ito kasama ng video! Mga sangkap: 20 edamame beans, 1/5 ulo ng repolyo, 30 g oyster mushroom, 8 pinatuyong shiitake na mushroom, 2 kamatis, 1 talong, 15 g preserved na labanos, 2 tasang puting bigas, at 10 g pulang quinoa. Mga pampalasa: 3 kutsarang toyo, 2 kutsarang asukal, 1 kutsarang giniling na paminta, at 2 kutsarang asin.

title.fil: Ihanda ang mga gulay at mushroom

instruction.zh: 高麗菜、秀珍菇、茄子和泡好的乾香菇切絲。番茄底部劃十字但不切斷。從毛豆莢取出毛豆；若使用已剝好的毛豆可直接使用。
instruction.en: Shred the cabbage, oyster mushrooms, eggplant, and soaked dried shiitake mushrooms. Score a cross in the bottom of each tomato without cutting through it. Remove the edamame from the pods, or use already-shelled edamame.
instruction.id: Iris tipis kubis, jamur tiram, terong, dan jamur shiitake kering yang telah direndam. Buat sayatan silang pada bagian bawah setiap tomat tanpa memotongnya hingga putus. Keluarkan edamame dari polongnya, atau gunakan edamame yang sudah dikupas.
instruction.fil: Hiwain ang repolyo, oyster mushroom, talong, at babad na tuyo na shiitake mushroom. Mag-iskor ng krus sa ilalim ng bawat kamatis nang hindi pinuputol ito. Alisin ang edamame mula sa mga pods, o gumamit ng may shell na edamame.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Prepare the vegetables and mushrooms”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

title.en: Wash the rice and reserve the soaking liquid
title.id: Cuci beras dan simpan air rendaman
title.fil: Hugasan ang bigas at ireserba ang soaking liquid

instruction.zh: 白米和紅藜麥洗淨；洗紅藜麥時可用小篩網擋住，避免瀝水時流失。保留泡香菇的水，煮飯時加入使用。
instruction.en: Wash the white rice and red quinoa. Use a small sieve when draining the quinoa so it does not escape. Reserve the shiitake soaking liquid to use when cooking the rice.
instruction.id: Cuci beras putih dan quinoa merah. Gunakan saringan kecil saat meniriskan quinoa agar tidak ikut terbuang. Simpan air rendaman shiitake untuk digunakan saat memasak nasi.
instruction.fil: Hugasan ang puting bigas at pulang quinoa. Gumamit ng maliit na salaan kapag pinatuyo ang quinoa upang hindi ito makalabas. Ireserba ang shiitake soaking liquid na gagamitin sa pagluluto ng bigas.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Wash the rice and reserve the soaking liquid”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

title.zh: 煸香菇類和菜脯並調味
title.en: Brown the mushrooms and preserved radish, then season
title.id: Tumis jamur dan lobak asin hingga harum lalu bumbui
title.fil: Kayumanggi ang mga mushroom at napreserbang labanos, pagkatapos ay timplahan

instruction.zh: 炒鍋加入植物油，將乾香菇、秀珍菇和菜脯煸至金黃。加入醬油、糖、胡椒粉和鹽調味。
instruction.en: Add vegetable oil to a wok and brown the dried shiitake mushrooms, oyster mushrooms, and preserved radish until golden. Season with soy sauce, sugar, ground pepper, and salt.
instruction.id: Tambahkan minyak nabati ke wajan dan tumis jamur shiitake kering, jamur tiram, serta lobak asin kering hingga keemasan. Bumbui dengan kecap asin, gula, lada bubuk, dan garam.
instruction.fil: Magdagdag ng langis ng gulay sa isang kawali at kayumanggi ang pinatuyong shiitake mushroom, oyster mushroom, at napreserbang labanos hanggang sa ginintuang kulay. Timplahan ng toyo, asukal, giniling na paminta, at asin.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Brown the mushrooms and preserved radish, then season”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

title.en: Cook the mixed rice in an electric cooker
title.id: Masak nasi campur dalam penanak nasi listrik
title.fil: Iluto ang pinaghalong bigas sa isang electric cooker

instruction.zh: 將洗好的白米和紅藜麥與備好的食材放入電鍋，加入保留的香菇水後煮熟。影片說明只有電鍋時，也可將所有食材一起放入蒸煮。
instruction.en: Put the washed white rice and red quinoa with the prepared ingredients into an electric cooker, add the reserved shiitake soaking liquid, and cook until done. The video notes that, when only an electric cooker is available, all ingredients may be put in together to steam-cook.
instruction.id: Masukkan beras putih dan quinoa merah yang sudah dicuci bersama bahan yang telah disiapkan ke dalam penanak nasi listrik, tambahkan air rendaman shiitake yang disimpan, lalu masak hingga matang. Video menjelaskan bahwa bila hanya tersedia penanak nasi listrik, semua bahan dapat dimasukkan bersama untuk dikukus.
instruction.fil: Ilagay ang hinugasang puting bigas at pulang quinoa na may mga inihandang sangkap sa isang electric cooker, idagdag ang nakareserbang shiitake soaking liquid, at lutuin hanggang maluto. Ang video ay nagsasaad na, kapag electric cooker lang ang available, lahat ng sangkap ay maaaring pagsama-samahin sa steam-cook.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Cook the mixed rice in an electric cooker”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

instruction.zh: 炊飯完成後撒上芝麻即可享用。
instruction.en: Once the mixed rice is cooked, sprinkle with sesame seeds and serve.
instruction.id: Setelah nasi campur matang, taburi dengan biji wijen lalu sajikan.
instruction.fil: Kapag naluto na ang pinaghalong kanin, budburan ng sesame seeds at ihain.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Finish with sesame and serve”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

description.zh:
全素披薩自己來真的很簡單
從麵團、醬料到椒鹽粉
全部都可以一起搞定
這次因為百靈的料理機
讓整個過程輕鬆不少
甚至醬料跟椒鹽粉
都可以變成家裡的常備調味料
趕快一起學起來吧！！
description.en: This vegan pizza makes the dough, sauce, and pepper salt from scratch; the sauce and seasoning can also be kept as pantry staples.
description.id: Pizza vegan ini membuat adonan, saus, dan garam lada dari awal; saus serta bumbunya juga dapat disimpan sebagai stok dapur.
description.fil: Ginagawa ng vegan pizza na ito ang kuwarta, sarsa, at paminta na asin mula sa simula; ang sarsa at pampalasa ay maaari ding itago bilang pantry staples.

instruction.zh: 乾酵母與約35°C的一杯溫水拌勻。高筋麵粉、鹽、糖和少量橄欖油混合後加入酵母水，攪拌約2分鐘，整形成圓團並發酵約1.5小時至2至3倍大。
instruction.en: Mix dry yeast with 1 cup warm water at about 35°C. Combine bread flour, salt, sugar, and a little olive oil, add the yeast water, mix about 2 minutes, shape into a ball, and proof about 1.5 hours until 2 to 3 times larger.
instruction.id: Campurkan ragi kering dengan 1 cangkir air hangat sekitar 35°C. Campurkan tepung roti, garam, gula, dan sedikit minyak zaitun, tambahkan air ragi, aduk sekitar 2 menit, bentuk bulat, lalu fermentasikan sekitar 1,5 jam hingga 2–3 kali lebih besar.
instruction.fil: Paghaluin ang tuyong lebadura na may 1 tasa ng maligamgam na tubig sa humigit-kumulang 35°C. Pagsamahin ang harina ng tinapay, asin, asukal, at isang maliit na langis ng oliba, idagdag ang lebadura ng tubig, paghaluin ng mga 2 minuto, hugis ng bola, at patunayan ng mga 1.5 oras hanggang 2 hanggang 3 beses na mas malaki.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Make and proof the dough”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

instruction.zh: 番茄對半切，蘑菇與杏鮑菇切小丁。以少量植物油將兩種菇煸至金黃，加入番茄炒出茄紅素，以鹽、糖和黑胡椒調味；加入番茄糊和義式香料後打勻。
instruction.en: Halve the tomatoes and dice the mushrooms and king oyster mushrooms. Brown both mushrooms in a little oil, add tomatoes and cook until their color develops, season with salt, sugar, and black pepper, then blend with tomato paste and Italian seasoning.
instruction.id: Belah tomat, lalu potong dadu jamur dan jamur tiram raja. Kecokelatan kedua jamur dengan sedikit minyak, tambahkan tomat dan masak hingga warnanya keluar, bumbui garam, gula, dan lada hitam, lalu haluskan bersama pasta tomat dan bumbu Italia.
instruction.fil: Hatiin ang mga kamatis at hiwain ang mga mushroom at king oyster mushroom. I-brown ang parehong mushroom sa kaunting mantika, magdagdag ng mga kamatis at lutuin hanggang sa lumaki ang kulay nito, timplahan ng asin, asukal, at itim na paminta, pagkatapos ay timpla ng tomato paste at Italian seasoning.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Make the red sauce”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

instruction.zh: 乾鍋炒香花椒、小茴香、白芝麻和黑胡椒粒；加入鹽炒至微黃。平鋪放涼後研磨成粉。
instruction.en: Dry-toast Sichuan peppercorns, cumin, white sesame, and black peppercorns. Add salt and toast until lightly yellow; spread out to cool, then grind to a powder.
instruction.id: Sangrai lada Sichuan, jintan, wijen putih, dan merica hitam. Tambahkan garam dan sangrai hingga sedikit kuning; ratakan hingga dingin, lalu giling menjadi bubuk.
instruction.fil: Dry-toast Sichuan peppercorns, cumin, white sesame, at black peppercorns. Magdagdag ng asin at toast hanggang bahagyang dilaw; ikalat upang lumamig, pagkatapos ay gilingin hanggang sa isang pulbos.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Make the pepper salt”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

instruction.zh: 麵團排氣後拉至約直徑25公分，邊緣向內捲，放在鋪烘焙紙的烤盤上並以叉子戳洞。抹紅醬、放素起司和秀珍菇、青椒、黑橄欖等配料；邊緣塗橄欖油。
instruction.en: Deflate the dough, stretch to about 25 cm in diameter, roll the edges inward, place on a parchment-lined tray, and prick with a fork. Spread red sauce, add vegan cheese and oyster mushrooms, green bell pepper, black olives, and other toppings; brush the edge with olive oil.
instruction.id: Keluarkan udara dari adonan, rentangkan hingga diameter sekitar 25 cm, gulung tepi ke dalam, letakkan di loyang berlapis kertas roti, lalu tusuk dengan garpu. Olesi saus merah, tambahkan keju vegan serta jamur tiram, paprika hijau, zaitun hitam, dan topping lain; olesi tepi dengan minyak zaitun.
instruction.fil: I-deflate ang kuwarta, iunat hanggang humigit-kumulang 25 cm ang lapad, igulong ang mga gilid papasok, ilagay sa isang tray na may linyang parchment, at tusukin ng tinidor. Ikalat ang pulang sarsa, magdagdag ng vegan cheese at oyster mushroom, green bell pepper, black olives, at iba pang mga toppings; lagyan ng olive oil ang gilid.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Shape and top”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

instruction.zh: 烤箱上下火200°C預熱10分鐘後，披薩烤15分鐘。烤好切成8等份，撒上自製椒鹽粉。
instruction.en: Preheat the oven with top and bottom heat at 200°C for 10 minutes, then bake the pizza for 15 minutes. Cut into 8 pieces and sprinkle with the homemade pepper salt.
instruction.id: Panaskan oven dengan panas atas-bawah 200°C selama 10 menit, lalu panggang pizza 15 menit. Potong menjadi 8 bagian dan taburi garam lada buatan sendiri.
instruction.fil: Painitin muna ang oven na may init sa itaas at ibaba sa 200°C sa loob ng 10 minuto, pagkatapos ay i-bake ang pizza sa loob ng 15 minuto. Gupitin sa 8 piraso at budburan ng homemade pepper salt.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Bake and finish”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

description.en: A warm bowl of wonton soup recalls childhood. This recipe develops a vegan wonton with a satisfying texture.
description.id: Semangkuk sup pangsit hangat mengingatkan pada masa kecil. Resep ini mengembangkan pangsit vegan dengan tekstur yang memuaskan.
description.fil: Isang mainit na mangkok ng wonton soup ang nagpapaalala sa pagkabata. Ang recipe na ito ay bumubuo ng isang vegan wonton na may kasiya-siyang texture.

instruction.zh: 鮮香菇、節瓜、茄子、芹菜和木耳切小丁；老薑切末。油豆腐剝成小碎塊。
instruction.en: Dice the fresh shiitake, zucchini, eggplant, celery, and wood ear mushrooms; mince the ginger. Tear the fried tofu into small pieces.
instruction.id: Potong dadu shiitake segar, zucchini, terong, seledri, dan jamur kuping; cincang jahe. Suwir tahu goreng menjadi potongan kecil.
instruction.fil: Dice ang sariwang shiitake, zucchini, talong, kintsay, at wood ear mushroom; hiwain ang luya. Hatiin ang piniritong tofu sa maliliit na piraso.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Prepare the filling”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

instruction.zh: 先煸油豆腐上色，撥至鍋邊後加入其餘切好的食材炒香。出水後加入鹽、胡椒粉、五香粉、醬油和水；加入味噌並煮約 1 分鐘，讓水分略收乾。
instruction.en: Brown the fried tofu first, push it to the side, and sauté the remaining chopped ingredients. Once they release water, add salt, ground pepper, five-spice powder, soy sauce, and water; add miso and cook about 1 minute until the moisture reduces slightly.
instruction.id: Kecokelatan tahu goreng terlebih dahulu, sisihkan ke tepi wajan, lalu tumis bahan cincang lainnya. Setelah mengeluarkan air, tambahkan garam, lada bubuk, bubuk lima rempah, kecap asin, dan air; tambahkan miso dan masak sekitar 1 menit hingga cairan sedikit menyusut.
instruction.fil: Palamutin muna ang pritong tokwa, itulak ito sa gilid, at igisa ang natitirang tinadtad na sangkap. Kapag naglabas na sila ng tubig, magdagdag ng asin, giniling na paminta, five-spice powder, toyo, at tubig; magdagdag ng miso at lutuin ng halos 1 minuto hanggang sa bahagyang mabawasan ang kahalumigmigan.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Cook and season the filling”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

instruction.zh: 關火後拌入低筋麵粉至均勻，作為餛飩餡。
instruction.en: Turn off the heat and mix in cake flour evenly to make the wonton filling.
instruction.id: Matikan api dan campurkan tepung protein rendah hingga rata untuk membuat isian pangsit.
instruction.fil: Patayin ang apoy at ihalo sa harina ng cake nang pantay-pantay upang gawing pang-puno ang wonton.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Mix in flour”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

instruction.zh: 在餛飩皮中央放少量餡料，四周抹水後對半折，壓出空氣並封緊；兩側向中間折，再用食指與拇指在中間捏緊。
instruction.en: Place a little filling in the center of a wrapper, wet the edges, fold in half, press out air and seal. Fold both sides inward, then pinch the center with index fingers and thumbs.
instruction.id: Letakkan sedikit isian di tengah kulit pangsit, basahi pinggirnya, lipat dua, keluarkan udara dan rekatkan. Lipat kedua sisi ke tengah, lalu cubit bagian tengah dengan telunjuk dan ibu jari.
instruction.fil: Maglagay ng kaunting pagpuno sa gitna ng isang pambalot, basain ang mga gilid, tiklupin sa kalahati, pindutin ang hangin at i-seal. Tiklupin ang magkabilang gilid papasok, pagkatapos ay kurutin ang gitna gamit ang mga hintuturo at hinlalaki.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Fold the wontons”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

instruction.zh: 若要冷凍，盤底先撒麵粉，將包好的餛飩冷凍約 1 小時定型後再放入保鮮袋；現包現煮則不需要撒粉。
instruction.en: For freezing, dust the tray with flour, freeze the folded wontons about 1 hour to set, then transfer to a storage bag; flour is unnecessary when cooking immediately.
instruction.id: Untuk dibekukan, taburi loyang dengan tepung, bekukan pangsit yang telah dilipat sekitar 1 jam hingga set, lalu pindahkan ke kantong penyimpanan; tepung tidak diperlukan bila langsung dimasak.
instruction.fil: Para sa pagyeyelo, lagyan ng alikabok ng harina ang tray, i-freeze ang mga nakatuping wonton nang humigit-kumulang 1 oras upang itakda, pagkatapos ay ilipat sa isang storage bag; ang harina ay hindi kailangan kapag nagluluto kaagad.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Optionally freeze”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

instruction.zh: 湯中加入紫菜、喜歡的蔬菜（來源使用小白菜）、鹽與胡椒粉，再放入餛飩。餛飩浮起後加入腐皮，淋少量香油，關火盛盤並撒芹菜末。
instruction.en: Add nori, preferred vegetables (the source uses bok choy), salt, and ground pepper to the soup, then add the wontons. When they float, add tofu skin, drizzle with a little sesame oil, turn off the heat, and finish with chopped celery.
instruction.id: Tambahkan nori, sayuran pilihan (sumber memakai pakcoy), garam, dan lada bubuk ke dalam sup, lalu masukkan pangsit. Saat pangsit mengapung, tambahkan kulit tahu, beri sedikit minyak wijen, matikan api, dan taburi seledri cincang.
instruction.fil: Magdagdag ng nori, mga ginustong gulay (ang pinagmulan ay gumagamit ng bok choy), asin, at giniling na paminta sa sopas, pagkatapos ay idagdag ang mga wonton. Kapag lumutang na sila, ilagay ang balat ng tofu, lagyan ng kaunting sesame oil, patayin ang apoy, at tapusin sa tinadtad na kintsay.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Cook the wonton soup”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

description.zh: 以燕麥奶、低筋麵粉、香草精、泡打粉及營養酵母調製，靜置10分鐘後煎成濃香鬆軟的無蛋奶早餐鬆餅。
description.en: Oat milk, cake flour, vanilla, baking powder and nutritional yeast make these rich, fluffy egg-free and dairy-free breakfast pancakes after a 10-minute batter rest.
description.id: Susu oat, tepung rendah protein, vanila, baking powder, dan ragi nutrisi menghasilkan panekuk sarapan tanpa telur dan susu yang lembut setelah adonan didiamkan 10 menit.
description.fil: Ang oat milk, cake flour, vanilla, baking powder at nutritional yeast ay ginagawa itong mayaman, malambot na walang itlog at dairy-free na pancake sa almusal pagkatapos ng 10 minutong batter rest.

instruction.zh: 混合100g低筋麵粉、1小匙泡打粉、3大匙營養酵母及1小匙鹽；加入2大匙香草精和80g燕麥奶拌勻，再按濃稠度逐少加入約80g水，攪至順滑無顆粒。
instruction.en: Combine 100 g cake flour, 1 tsp baking powder, 3 tbsp nutritional yeast and 1 tsp salt. Mix in 2 tbsp vanilla extract and 80 g oat milk, then gradually add up to about 80 g water as needed for a smooth, lump-free batter.
instruction.id: Campurkan 100 g tepung rendah protein, 1 sdt bubuk pengembang, 3 sdm ragi nutrisi, dan 1 sdt garam. Masukkan 2 sdm ekstrak vanila serta 80 g susu oat, lalu tambahkan hingga sekitar 80 g air sedikit demi sedikit sampai adonan halus tanpa gumpalan.
instruction.fil: Pagsamahin ang 100 g cake flour, 1 tsp baking powder, 3 tbsp nutritional yeast at 1 tsp salt. Paghaluin ang 2 kutsarang vanilla extract at 80 g oat milk, pagkatapos ay unti-unting magdagdag ng hanggang 80 g ng tubig kung kinakailangan para sa makinis, walang bukol na batter.

steps.imagePrompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: 16:9 recipe tutorial step image. Primary request: overhead-close preparation photograph of smooth pale vegan pancake batter being whisked in a ceramic bowl, with a thick but pourable ribbon and no dry flour lumps. Constraints: strictly vegan; no cooked pancakes, syrup, fruit, labels, people, text, watermark, or logos. No text.

instruction.zh: 讓麵糊靜置10分鐘，使泡打粉作用並讓成品更蓬鬆。
instruction.en: Rest the batter for 10 minutes so the baking powder can act and the pancakes become fluffier.
instruction.id: Diamkan adonan 10 menit agar baking powder bekerja dan panekuk lebih mengembang.
instruction.fil: Ipahinga ang batter sa loob ng 10 minuto upang kumilos ang baking powder at maging malambot ang mga pancake.

steps.imagePrompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: 16:9 recipe tutorial step image. Primary request: close preparation photograph of vegan pancake batter resting undisturbed in a clean bowl, with small baking-powder bubbles forming across the smooth surface. Constraints: no skillet, cooked pancakes, toppings, labels, people, text, watermark, or logos. No text.

instruction.zh: 平底鍋抹極少植物油，以圓湯匙從約5至10公分高度將麵糊垂直倒入，讓鬆餅自然成圓形；表面冒泡、邊緣定型後翻面，煎至兩面金黃熟透。
instruction.en: Wipe a flat pan with only a trace of vegetable oil. Pour the batter straight down from a round ladle held about 5–10 cm above the pan so it forms a circle. Flip when bubbles appear and the edge sets, then cook until both sides are golden.
instruction.id: Olesi wajan datar dengan sangat sedikit minyak nabati. Tuang adonan lurus dari sendok bulat setinggi sekitar 5–10 cm agar membentuk lingkaran. Balik saat muncul gelembung dan pinggirannya mengeras, lalu masak hingga kedua sisi keemasan.
instruction.fil: Punasan ang isang flat pan na may lamang ng isang bakas ng langis ng gulay. Ibuhos ang batter nang diretso pababa mula sa isang bilog na sandok na hawak ng humigit-kumulang 5-10 cm sa itaas ng kawali upang ito ay bumuo ng isang bilog. I-flip kapag lumitaw ang mga bula at ang gilid ay nagtakda, pagkatapos ay lutuin hanggang ang magkabilang panig ay ginintuang.

steps.imagePrompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: 16:9 recipe tutorial step image. Primary request: appetizing close food photograph of round vegan pancakes cooking in a lightly oiled flat skillet, one pancake covered in set bubbles ready to flip and one showing an evenly golden underside. Constraints: no egg, dairy, syrup, fruit, labels, people, text, watermark, or logos. No text.

title.zh: 全素韓式辣炒年糕泡麵
title.en: Vegan Korean Spicy Rice Cakes with Ramen
title.fil: Vegan Korean Spicy Rice Cake na may Ramen

description.zh: 一鍋到底的全素韓式辣炒年糕泡麵：豆包煎至金黃後與香菇、蔬菜、年糕和韓式辣醬同煮，最後加入青龍椒與全素王子麵。
description.en: A one-pot vegan Korean spicy rice-cake ramen: tofu puffs are browned, then simmered with shiitake, vegetables, rice cakes and Korean chili paste before green chilies and vegan instant noodles are added.
description.id: Tteokbokki mi instan Korea vegan satu panci: tahu puff digoreng keemasan, lalu direbus bersama shiitake, sayuran, kue beras, dan pasta cabai Korea sebelum cabai hijau serta mi instan vegan ditambahkan.
description.fil: Isang one-pot na vegan na Korean spicy rice-cake ramen: ang tofu puffs ay browned, pagkatapos ay simmered na may shiitake, mga gulay, rice cake at Korean chili paste bago idagdag ang green chilies at vegan instant noodles.

title.fil: Hiwain ang mga gulay at tofu puff

instruction.zh: 將乾香菇與紅蘿蔔切片；高麗菜洗淨後剝成小片；豆包切成粗條再切小段。
instruction.en: Slice the dried shiitake and carrot, wash and tear the cabbage into small pieces, then cut the tofu puffs into thick strips and short pieces.
instruction.id: Iris shiitake kering dan wortel, cuci lalu sobek kol menjadi potongan kecil, kemudian potong tahu puff menjadi strip tebal dan potongan pendek.
instruction.fil: Hiwain ang pinatuyong shiitake at karot, hugasan at punitin ang repolyo sa maliliit na piraso, pagkatapos ay gupitin ang tofu puffs sa makapal na piraso at maiikling piraso.

steps.imagePrompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: 16:9 recipe tutorial step image. Primary request: overhead close food photograph of raw preparation on a wooden board: sliced rehydrated shiitake, thin carrot slices, torn bite-size cabbage leaves, and tofu-puff sheets cut first into thick strips then short pieces. Constraints: strictly vegan; raw mise en place only, no rice cakes, noodles, sauce, cooking pot, finished dish, meat, eggs, dairy, seafood, labels, people, watermark, or logos. No text.

title.fil: Mga brown tofu puff at gulay

instruction.zh: 湯鍋中倒入少量香油，先把豆包煎至金黃酥脆；再加入香菇與紅蘿蔔炒香，最後放入高麗菜炒軟。
instruction.en: Warm a little sesame oil in a soup pot and fry the tofu puffs until golden and crisp; sauté the shiitake and carrot, then add cabbage last and cook until soft.
instruction.id: Panaskan sedikit minyak wijen dalam panci sup dan goreng tahu puff hingga keemasan serta renyah; tumis shiitake dan wortel, lalu masukkan kol terakhir hingga layu.
instruction.fil: Mag-init ng kaunting sesame oil sa isang sopas pot at iprito ang tofu puffs hanggang maging ginintuang at malutong; igisa ang shiitake at carrot, pagkatapos ay ilagay ang repolyo sa huli at lutuin hanggang malambot.

description.zh: 用客家桔醬與香茅冬炎醬完成四道全素料理：桔醬燴豆腐、菠菜捲佐桔醬、泰式炒河粉與泰式酸辣湯。

name.fil: mga sheet ng balat ng tofu

name.en: enoki, shimeji, and dried tofu skin
name.id: enoki, shimeji, dan kulit tahu kering
name.fil: enoki, shimeji, at pinatuyong balat ng tofu

instruction.zh: 板豆腐切片煎至金黃。炒香薑末與辣椒末，加入客家桔醬、醬油、糖、少許鹽與200毫升水煮滾；放回豆腐熬煮至收汁，最後撒香菜。
instruction.en: Slice and brown firm tofu. Sauté minced ginger and chili, add Hakka kumquat sauce, soy sauce, sugar, a little salt, and 200 ml water; return tofu and simmer until reduced, then top with cilantro.
instruction.id: Iris dan kecokelatan tahu padat. Tumis jahe cincang dan cabai, tambahkan saus kumquat Hakka, kecap asin, gula, sedikit garam, dan 200 ml air; masukkan kembali tahu dan rebus hingga menyusut, lalu beri daun ketumbar.
instruction.fil: Hiwain at brown firm na tofu. Igisa ang tinadtad na luya at sili, idagdag ang Hakka kumquat sauce, toyo, asukal, kaunting asin, at 200 ML na tubig; ibalik ang tokwa at kumulo hanggang mabawasan, pagkatapos ay lagyan ng cilantro.

title.fil: Spinach roll na may kumquat sauce

instruction.zh: 菠菜汆燙至軟後放入冰水冰鎮，擠去水分，取約三小撮扭轉成捲並切成一口大小；擺盤後點上客家桔醬。
instruction.en: Blanch spinach until soft, chill in ice water, squeeze dry, twist about three small pinches into rolls and cut into bite-size pieces; plate and dot with Hakka kumquat sauce.
instruction.id: Rebus sebentar bayam hingga lunak, dinginkan dalam air es, peras, pilin sekitar tiga cubitan kecil menjadi gulungan dan potong sekali makan; tata lalu beri saus kumquat Hakka.
instruction.fil: Paputiin ang spinach hanggang malambot, palamigin sa tubig ng yelo, pisilin patuyuin, i-twist ang mga tatlong maliliit na kurot sa mga rolyo at gupitin sa kagat-laki ng mga piraso; plato at tuldok na may Hakka kumquat sauce.

title.en: Cook noodles and prepare Pad Thai ingredients
title.id: Masak mi dan siapkan bahan Pad Thai
title.fil: Magluto ng pansit at maghanda ng mga sangkap ng Pad Thai

instruction.zh: 豆包切條，小白菜與香菜切段，杏鮑菇和紅蘿蔔切絲。河粉在加鹽滾水中煮至約八分熟後撈起；菜脯先泡水後瀝乾。
instruction.en: Cut tofu skin into strips, bok choy and cilantro into sections, and king oyster mushroom and carrot into shreds. Cook rice noodles in salted boiling water until about 80% done, then drain; soak and drain preserved radish first.
instruction.id: Potong kulit tahu menjadi strip, pakcoy dan daun ketumbar menjadi potongan, serta jamur king oyster dan wortel menjadi serutan. Masak mi beras dalam air mendidih bergaram hingga sekitar 80% matang lalu tiriskan; rendam dan tiriskan lobak asin terlebih dahulu.
instruction.fil: Gupitin ang balat ng tofu, gupitin ang bok choy at cilantro, at gupitin ang king oyster mushroom at carrot. Magluto ng rice noodles sa inasnan na tubig na kumukulo hanggang 80% tapos na, pagkatapos ay alisan ng tubig; ibabad at alisan ng tubig ang preserved na labanos.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Cook noodles and prepare Pad Thai ingredients”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

instruction.zh: 煎香豆包與菜脯，加入杏鮑菇、紅蘿蔔和荷蘭豆炒至出水；加入河粉、小白菜和由香茅冬炎醬、醬油、水、白胡椒、檸檬汁與辣椒粉調成的醬汁拌炒。搭配豆芽、香菜與花生碎。
instruction.en: Brown tofu skin and preserved radish, add king oyster mushroom, carrot, and snow peas until they release moisture; add noodles and bok choy and toss with a sauce of lemongrass tom-yum sauce, soy sauce, water, white pepper, lemon juice, and chili powder. Serve with bean sprouts, cilantro, and crushed peanuts.
instruction.id: Tumis kulit tahu dan lobak asin hingga harum, tambahkan jamur king oyster, wortel, dan kacang kapri hingga mengeluarkan air; masukkan mi serta pakcoy dan aduk dengan saus dari tom yum serai, kecap asin, air, lada putih, air lemon, dan bubuk cabai. Sajikan dengan tauge, daun ketumbar, dan kacang tanah cincang.
instruction.fil: Kayumangging balat ng tofu at napreserbang labanos, magdagdag ng king oyster mushroom, carrot, at snow peas hanggang sa maglabas sila ng moisture; magdagdag ng pansit at bok choy at ihagis ng sarsa ng tanglad na tom-yum sauce, toyo, tubig, puting paminta, lemon juice, at chili powder. Ihain kasama ng bean sprouts, cilantro, at durog na mani.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Finish vegan Pad Thai”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

instruction.zh: 番茄炒至出汁後加入娃娃菜，加入香茅冬炎醬、辣椒粉與水；放入絲瓜、豆腐和腐竹熬煮10分鐘。加入金針菇、鴻喜菇、椰奶、檸檬汁與胡椒粉，盛盤後撒香菜。
instruction.en: Cook tomatoes until juicy, add baby napa cabbage, then lemongrass tom-yum sauce, chili powder, and water. Add luffa, tofu, and dried tofu skin and simmer for 10 minutes. Add enoki, shimeji, coconut milk, lemon juice, and pepper; top with cilantro.
instruction.id: Masak tomat hingga berair, tambahkan sawi putih mini, lalu saus tom yum serai, bubuk cabai, dan air. Tambahkan oyong, tahu, dan kulit tahu kering lalu rebus 10 menit. Masukkan enoki, shimeji, santan, air lemon, dan lada; beri daun ketumbar.
instruction.fil: Magluto ng kamatis hanggang makatas, ilagay ang baby napa repolyo, pagkatapos ay tanglad na tom-yum sauce, chili powder, at tubig. Magdagdag ng luffa, tofu, at tuyong balat ng tofu at kumulo ng 10 minuto. Magdagdag ng enoki, shimeji, gata ng niyog, lemon juice, at paminta; tuktok na may cilantro.

title.fil: Kayumanggi ang parehong uri ng tofu

instruction.zh: 炒鍋中將板豆腐與油豆腐煸至表面金黃，讓雙豆腐先帶出香氣與口感。
instruction.en: Brown the firm tofu and fried tofu puffs in a wok until their surfaces turn golden, building fragrance and texture before adding the sauce.
instruction.id: Tumis tahu padat dan tahu puff goreng dalam wajan hingga permukaannya keemasan untuk membangun aroma dan tekstur sebelum saus ditambahkan.
instruction.fil: Palamutin ang matigas na tofu at pritong tofu na puffs sa isang kawali hanggang sa maging ginintuang kulay ang mga ibabaw nito, na bumubuo ng halimuyak at texture bago idagdag ang sauce.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic close-up food photograph of crumbled firm tofu and torn fried tofu puffs browning in a wok, no text.

instruction.zh: 將兩塊純素咖哩塊放入碗中，沖入300毫升熱水並攪拌至均勻融化。
instruction.en: Place the two vegan curry roux blocks in a bowl, pour in 300 ml hot water, and stir until the roux dissolves evenly.
instruction.id: Masukkan dua blok roux kari vegan ke dalam mangkuk, tuang 300 ml air panas, lalu aduk hingga roux larut merata.
instruction.fil: Ilagay ang dalawang vegan curry roux block sa isang mangkok, ibuhos ang 300 ML ng mainit na tubig, at haluin hanggang matunaw nang pantay ang roux.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic overhead food photograph of two curry roux blocks dissolving into a glossy brown sauce in a bowl, no text.

instruction.zh: 將咖哩湯汁倒入金黃豆腐中，加入四季豆與冬粉，以小火持續攪拌炒約3分鐘；再加入咖哩粉和胡椒鹽炒約1分鐘至餡料收乾。
instruction.en: Pour the curry sauce over the golden tofu, add green beans and vermicelli, and stir continuously over low heat for about 3 minutes. Add curry powder and pepper salt, then cook about 1 minute more until the filling is dry.
instruction.id: Tuang saus kari ke tahu yang telah keemasan, tambahkan buncis dan soun, lalu aduk terus dengan api kecil sekitar 3 menit. Masukkan bubuk kari dan garam lada, masak sekitar 1 menit lagi sampai isian mengering.
instruction.fil: Ibuhos ang curry sauce sa ginintuang tofu, magdagdag ng green beans at vermicelli, at patuloy na haluin sa mahinang apoy ng mga 3 minuto. Magdagdag ng curry powder at pepper salt, pagkatapos ay lutuin ng mga 1 minuto pa hanggang sa matuyo ang laman.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic food photograph of thick curry vermicelli filling with tofu and green beans being stirred in a wok, no text.

title.en: Fold in basil and cool the filling
title.fil: Tiklupin ang basil at palamig ang pagpuno

instruction.zh: 餡料收乾後關火，拌入九層塔末約10秒，保留塔香的清新香氣，再放至可包餡的溫度。
instruction.en: When the filling is dry, turn off the heat and fold in minced Thai basil for about 10 seconds to preserve its fresh aroma, then cool until safe to fill.
instruction.id: Saat isian mengering, matikan api dan aduk kemangi cincang sekitar 10 detik agar aromanya tetap segar, lalu dinginkan sampai aman untuk diisi.
instruction.fil: Kapag tuyo na ang pagpuno, patayin ang apoy at tiklupin ang tinadtad na Thai basil sa loob ng mga 10 segundo upang mapanatili ang sariwang aroma nito, pagkatapos ay palamig hanggang ligtas na mapuno.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic close-up food photograph of fresh minced Thai basil being folded into a finished curry tofu filling, no text.

title.fil: Takpan at i-pan-fry ang mga pie

instruction.zh: 每張水餃皮放入咖哩餡，外圈沾水後蓋上第二張皮並壓緊，以叉子壓出花邊；平底鍋煎至兩面金黃。
instruction.en: Place curry filling on one dumpling wrapper, wet the edge, cover with a second wrapper, seal firmly, and crimp with a fork; pan-fry until both sides are golden.
instruction.id: Letakkan isian kari di atas satu kulit pangsit, basahi tepinya, tutup dengan kulit kedua, rekatkan rapat, dan tekan dengan garpu; goreng hingga kedua sisi keemasan.
instruction.fil: Ilagay ang curry filling sa isang dumpling wrapper, basain ang gilid, takpan ng pangalawang wrapper, i-seal nang mahigpit, at i-crimp gamit ang isang tinidor; iprito hanggang sa maging ginto ang magkabilang gilid.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic plated food photograph of golden vegan curry dumpling pies with fork-crimped edges on a ceramic plate, no text.

description.zh: 以韓式冬粉、蔬菜與煎豆腐拌製，熱吃或冷藏後食用皆可。
description.en: Korean glass noodles tossed with vegetables and seared tofu, suitable warm or chilled.
description.id: Soun Korea dengan sayuran dan tahu tumis, nikmat disajikan hangat atau dingin.
description.fil: Korean glass noodles na hinahagis ng mga gulay at seared tofu, angkop na mainit o pinalamig.

instruction.zh: 將香菇、木耳、胡蘿蔔與甜椒切細絲，薑切末，菠菜切段，豆腐切條。
instruction.en: Slice mushrooms, wood ear, carrot, and pepper; mince ginger; cut spinach and tofu into strips.
instruction.id: Iris jamur, jamur kuping, wortel, dan paprika; cincang jahe; potong bayam dan tahu memanjang.
instruction.fil: Hiwain ang mga mushroom, kahoy na tainga, karot, at paminta; tinadtad na luya; gupitin ang spinach at tofu.

instruction.zh: 水滾加少許鹽，煮韓式冬粉約八分鐘後沖冷水，剪短並拌少量香油防沾。
instruction.en: Boil Korean glass noodles in lightly salted water for about eight minutes, rinse cold, cut shorter, and toss with sesame oil.
instruction.id: Rebus soun Korea dalam air sedikit asin sekitar delapan menit, bilas dingin, gunting pendek, lalu aduk dengan minyak wijen.
instruction.fil: Pakuluan ang Korean glass noodles sa bahagyang inasnan na tubig sa loob ng mga walong minuto, banlawan ng malamig, gupitin nang mas maikli, at ihalo sa langis ng linga.

instruction.zh: 豆腐煎至金黃，再炒薑與蔬菜至胡蘿蔔變軟；加入冬粉與調好的醬汁拌勻後熄火。
instruction.en: Sear tofu golden, then stir-fry ginger and vegetables until carrot softens; add noodles and prepared sauce, toss, and turn off heat.
instruction.id: Goreng tahu hingga keemasan, tumis jahe dan sayuran hingga wortel lunak; masukkan soun dan saus, aduk, lalu matikan api.
instruction.fil: Sear tofu golden, pagkatapos ay iprito ang luya at mga gulay hanggang sa lumambot ang karot; magdagdag ng noodles at handa na sarsa, ihalo, at patayin ang apoy.

title.en: Vegan Dragon Fruit Snow Skin Mooncakes
title.id: Kue Bulan Kulit Salju Buah Naga Vegan
title.fil: Vegan Dragon Fruit Snow Skin Mooncake

description.zh: 火龍果、嫩豆腐與糯米粉揉成粉紅冰皮，包入蒸地瓜後壓模蒸熟，完全不加糖與油的全素月餅。
description.en: Dragon fruit, silken tofu, and glutinous rice flour become a pink snow skin wrapped around steamed sweet potato, then molded and steamed into vegan mooncakes without added sugar or oil.
description.id: Buah naga, tahu sutra, dan tepung ketan menjadi kulit merah muda yang membungkus ubi kukus, lalu dicetak dan dikukus menjadi kue bulan vegan tanpa gula atau minyak tambahan.
description.fil: Ang dragon fruit, silken tofu, at glutinous rice flour ay nagiging kulay-rosas na balat ng niyebe na nakabalot sa steamed kamote, pagkatapos ay hinulma at i-steam sa vegan mooncake na walang idinagdag na asukal o mantika.

instruction.zh: 地瓜去皮切塊，放入電鍋，外鍋加1杯水蒸熟備用。
instruction.en: Peel and cube the sweet potato, place it in an electric cooker, and steam it with 1 outer-pot cup of water until tender.
instruction.id: Kupas dan potong ubi jalar, masukkan ke penanak listrik, lalu kukus dengan 1 cangkir air di panci luar hingga empuk.
instruction.fil: Balatan at i-cube ang kamote, ilagay ito sa isang electric cooker, at pasingawan ito ng 1 outer-pot cup ng tubig hanggang lumambot.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic overhead food photograph of peeled sweet potato cubes in a steaming dish beside an electric cooker, no text.

title.fil: Haluin ang dragon fruit at tofu

instruction.zh: 火龍果與嫩豆腐切小塊，將約四分之一顆火龍果和半盒嫩豆腐放入大碗拌勻。
instruction.en: Cut the dragon fruit and silken tofu into small pieces, then combine about one quarter of the dragon fruit with half a box of silken tofu in a large bowl.
instruction.id: Potong buah naga dan tahu sutra menjadi kecil, lalu campurkan sekitar seperempat buah naga dengan setengah kotak tahu sutra di dalam mangkuk besar.
instruction.fil: Gupitin ang dragon fruit at silken tofu sa maliliit na piraso, pagkatapos ay pagsamahin ang halos isang-kapat ng dragon fruit na may kalahating kahon ng silken tofu sa isang malaking mangkok.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic overhead food photograph of vivid pink dragon fruit cubes and silken tofu pieces in a large mixing bowl, no text.

title.en: Knead the snow-skin dough in stages
title.fil: Masahin ang kuwarta ng balat ng niyebe sa mga yugto

instruction.zh: 糯米粉分兩次加入火龍果豆腐糊；第一次拌勻後再加入第二次，揉到不黏手，若水果或豆腐水分較多再少量補粉。
instruction.en: Add the glutinous rice flour to the dragon fruit tofu mixture in two additions. Mix the first addition evenly before the second, then knead until no longer sticky, adding a little more flour only if the fruit or tofu is wetter.
instruction.id: Tambahkan tepung ketan ke campuran buah naga dan tahu dalam dua tahap. Aduk tahap pertama hingga rata sebelum tahap kedua, lalu uleni sampai tidak lengket; tambahkan sedikit tepung hanya bila buah atau tahu lebih berair.
instruction.fil: Idagdag ang glutinous rice flour sa dragon fruit tofu mixture sa dalawang karagdagan. Paghaluin ang unang karagdagan nang pantay-pantay bago ang pangalawa, pagkatapos ay masahin hanggang sa hindi na malagkit, magdagdag ng kaunting harina lamang kung ang prutas o tofu ay mas basa.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic close-up food photograph of pink glutinous rice dough being kneaded by hand in a mixing bowl, no text.

instruction.zh: 工作面撒少量糯米粉防沾，取約45至50克冰皮壓扁，包入一塊蒸地瓜，收口朝上搓成微橢圓形。
instruction.en: Dust the work surface with a little glutinous rice flour. Flatten about 45 to 50 g of snow-skin dough, wrap it around a piece of steamed sweet potato, seal side up, and shape it into a slightly oval ball.
instruction.id: Taburi permukaan kerja dengan sedikit tepung ketan. Pipihkan sekitar 45 hingga 50 g adonan kulit, bungkus sepotong ubi kukus, rapatkan dengan sambungan di atas, lalu bentuk agak oval.
instruction.fil: Alikabok ang ibabaw ng trabaho ng kaunting glutinous rice flour. I-flatte ang humigit-kumulang 45 hanggang 50 g ng snow-skin dough, balutin ito sa isang piraso ng steamed kamote, seal side up, at hugis ito ng bahagyang hugis-itlog na bola.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic overhead food photograph of a pink dragon fruit dough round being wrapped around a yellow sweet potato cube on a floured board, no text.

title.fil: Amag at singaw ang mga mooncake

instruction.zh: 月餅模具內薄薄抹橄欖油，將收口朝上的麵糰放入壓出花紋；排在盤上，電鍋外鍋加1杯水蒸熟後取出。
instruction.en: Lightly coat a mooncake mold with olive oil, place the dough seam-side up inside, and press out the pattern. Arrange on a plate and steam in an electric cooker with 1 outer-pot cup of water, then remove.
instruction.id: Olesi cetakan kue bulan tipis dengan minyak zaitun, masukkan adonan dengan sambungan menghadap atas, lalu tekan hingga berpola. Tata di piring dan kukus dalam penanak listrik dengan 1 cangkir air di panci luar, lalu angkat.
instruction.fil: Bahagyang balutin ng langis ng oliba ang mooncake mol, ilagay ang pinagtahian ng kuwarta sa gilid, at pindutin ang pattern. Ayusin sa isang plato at singaw sa isang electric cooker na may 1 outer-pot cup ng tubig, pagkatapos ay alisin.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic plated food photograph of pink dragon fruit vegan mooncakes with pressed floral patterns on a ceramic plate, no text.

description.zh: 把炒香的泡菜香菇與米飯、素鬆和海苔拌勻後捏成一口大小飯糰。
description.en: Stir-fried kimchi and mushrooms are mixed with rice, vegan floss, and seaweed, then shaped into bite-size rice balls.
description.id: Kimchi dan jamur tumis dicampur dengan nasi, abon vegan, dan rumput laut lalu dibentuk menjadi bola nasi kecil.
description.fil: Ang piniritong kimchi at mushroom ay hinaluan ng kanin, vegan floss, at seaweed, pagkatapos ay hinuhubog sa kagat-laki ng mga rice ball.

instruction.zh: 將香菇切丁，泡菜擠乾切碎並保留泡菜汁；炒香香菇與泡菜，加入醬油和胡椒後關火。
instruction.en: Dice mushrooms; squeeze and chop kimchi while reserving its juice. Stir-fry mushrooms and kimchi, season with soy sauce and pepper, then turn off heat.
instruction.id: Potong dadu jamur; peras dan cincang kimchi sambil menyimpan airnya. Tumis jamur dan kimchi, bumbui kecap asin dan lada, lalu matikan api.
instruction.fil: Mga dice mushroom; pisilin at tagain ang kimchi habang inilalaan ang katas nito. Igisa ang mga mushroom at kimchi, timplahan ng toyo at paminta, pagkatapos ay patayin ang apoy.

instruction.en: Combine cooked rice, vegan floss, corn, seaweed flakes, sesame, and the stir-fry in a bowl; mix in sesame oil, mayonnaise, and reserved kimchi juice.

description.zh: 茄子、菇類、秋葵、青椒和南瓜裹上保留顆粒的冰水麵糊炸至酥脆，搭配酸香的日式沾醬。
description.en: Eggplant, mushrooms, okra, green peppers, and squash are coated in a lumpy ice-water batter, fried crisp, and served with a bright Japanese dipping sauce.
description.id: Terong, jamur, okra, cabai hijau, dan labu dilapisi adonan air es yang masih berbutir, digoreng renyah, lalu disajikan dengan saus cocol Jepang yang segar.
description.fil: Ang talong, mushroom, okra, berdeng paminta, at kalabasa ay pinahiran ng bukol na ice-water batter, pinirito na malutong, at inihahain kasama ng matingkad na Japanese dipping sauce.

title.fil: Gupitin ang mga gulay ng tempura

instruction.zh: 將茄子切成扇形；金針菇撥成小束，並把香菇、秋葵、青龍椒與南瓜切成適合油炸的大小。
instruction.en: Cut the eggplant into a fan shape, separate enoki into small bundles, and cut the shiitake, okra, green chilies, and squash into frying-size pieces.
instruction.id: Potong terong berbentuk kipas, pisahkan enoki menjadi ikatan kecil, lalu potong shiitake, okra, cabai hijau, dan labu seukuran untuk digoreng.
instruction.fil: Gupitin ang talong sa hugis pamaypay, paghiwalayin ang enoki sa maliliit na bundle, at gupitin ang shiitake, okra, berdeng sili, at kalabasa sa laki ng pinirito.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic overhead food photograph of fan-cut eggplant, enoki bundles, okra, green peppers, mushrooms, and squash on a wooden board, no text.

title.fil: Pahiran ng tuyong harina ang mga gulay

instruction.zh: 所有蔬菜先均勻沾上低筋麵粉，再拍掉多餘乾粉，讓後續麵糊更容易附著。
instruction.en: Coat every vegetable evenly with cake flour, then tap off the excess so the wet batter will adhere more securely.
instruction.id: Balut semua sayuran secara merata dengan tepung rendah protein, lalu tepuk kelebihan tepung agar adonan basah melekat lebih kuat.
instruction.fil: Pahiran ang bawat gulay nang pantay-pantay ng harina ng cake, pagkatapos ay i-tap ang labis para mas madikit ang basang batter.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic close-up food photograph of assorted vegetables being dusted with white flour on a shallow tray, no text.

title.fil: Paghaluin ang isang bukol na ice-water batter

instruction.zh: 將100克低筋麵粉、50克酥炸粉、鹽、白胡椒粉與300克冰塊水輕輕拌勻；保留小顆粒，不要攪拌到產生筋性。
instruction.en: Gently combine 100 g cake flour, 50 g crispy frying flour, salt, white pepper, and 300 g ice water; leave small lumps and do not overmix into a glutenous batter.
instruction.id: Aduk perlahan 100 g tepung rendah protein, 50 g tepung goreng renyah, garam, lada putih, dan 300 g air es; sisakan butiran kecil dan jangan mengaduk berlebihan hingga berstruktur gluten.
instruction.fil: Dahan-dahang pagsamahin ang 100 g cake flour, 50 g crispy frying flour, asin, puting paminta, at 300 g ice water; mag-iwan ng maliliit na bukol at huwag mag-overmix sa isang glutenous batter.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic overhead food photograph of a pale lumpy tempura batter with ice water in a metal mixing bowl, no text.

title.en: Test the oil and fry in batches
title.fil: Subukan ang mantika at iprito sa mga batch

instruction.zh: 油鍋加熱後，以少量麵糊測試：麵糊入油後立刻浮起約為170°C；蔬菜沾麵糊後分批下鍋，每次約4件，避免油溫下降。
instruction.en: Heat the frying oil and test it with a little batter: when it floats immediately, the oil is about 170°C. Dip the vegetables in batter and fry in batches of about four pieces to avoid lowering the oil temperature.
instruction.id: Panaskan minyak dan uji dengan sedikit adonan: bila langsung mengapung, minyak sekitar 170°C. Celupkan sayuran ke adonan lalu goreng bertahap sekitar empat potong agar suhu minyak tidak turun.
instruction.fil: Init ang mantika at subukan ito ng kaunting batter: kapag lumutang kaagad, ang mantika ay humigit-kumulang 170°C. Isawsaw ang mga gulay sa batter at iprito sa mga batch ng halos apat na piraso upang maiwasan ang pagbaba ng temperatura ng langis.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic close-up food photograph of battered vegetable tempura pieces entering hot oil with bubbles in a deep frying pan, no text.

title.fil: Iprito hanggang sa malutong at ginintuang

instruction.zh: 蔬菜表面略呈金黃色先撈出；完成第一輪後再回鍋搶酥，炸至外皮金黃酥脆後瀝油。
instruction.en: Lift the vegetables out once the surface is lightly golden; after the first round, return them to the oil briefly to crisp the coating, then drain when deep golden and crisp.
instruction.id: Angkat sayuran saat permukaannya mulai keemasan; setelah putaran pertama, kembalikan sebentar ke minyak untuk membuat lapisan renyah, lalu tiriskan saat berwarna keemasan dan garing.
instruction.fil: Iangat ang mga gulay sa sandaling ang ibabaw ay bahagyang ginintuang; pagkatapos ng unang pag-ikot, ibalik ang mga ito sa langis saglit upang malutong ang patong, pagkatapos ay alisan ng tubig kapag malalim na ginintuang at malutong.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic food photograph of crisp golden vegetable tempura draining on a wire rack above a tray, no text.

title.en: Stir together the Japanese dipping sauce

instruction.zh: 將日式醬油、味醂、蘋果醋、白芝麻與少量芥末攪拌均勻，作為天婦羅沾醬。
instruction.en: Stir Japanese soy sauce, mirin, apple cider vinegar, white sesame seeds, and a little wasabi together for the tempura dipping sauce.
instruction.id: Aduk kecap asin Jepang, mirin, cuka apel, wijen putih, dan sedikit wasabi hingga rata sebagai saus cocol tempura.
instruction.fil: Haluin ang Japanese soy sauce, mirin, apple cider vinegar, white sesame seeds, at kaunting wasabi para sa tempura dipping sauce.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic overhead food photograph of a small bowl of dark tempura dipping sauce with sesame and wasabi beside golden vegetables, no text.

description.zh: 將醋飯鋪在海苔外側，捲入煎香豆包、茄子、玉米筍、小黃瓜及紅蘿蔔，切片後配上酪梨，做成餐廳級全素花壽司。
description.en: Vinegared rice is spread outside the nori and rolled around seared tofu skin, eggplant, baby corn, cucumber and carrot, then sliced and topped with avocado.
description.id: Nasi cuka diratakan di sisi luar nori lalu digulung bersama kulit tahu, terong, jagung muda, mentimun, dan wortel, kemudian dipotong serta diberi alpukat.
description.fil: Ang vinegared rice ay ikinakalat sa labas ng nori at ini-roll around seared tofu skin, eggplant, baby corn, cucumber at carrot, pagkatapos ay hiniwa at nilagyan ng avocado.

instruction.zh: 煮熟壽司米，趁熱加入壽司醋，以切拌方式輕輕拌勻，攤開放涼備用。
instruction.en: Cook the sushi rice, add sushi vinegar while hot, and fold gently with cutting motions. Spread the rice out and leave it to cool.
instruction.id: Masak beras sushi, tambahkan cuka sushi selagi panas, lalu aduk perlahan dengan gerakan memotong. Ratakan dan biarkan nasi dingin.
instruction.fil: Lutuin ang bigas ng sushi, magdagdag ng suka ng sushi habang mainit, at dahan-dahang tiklupin gamit ang mga galaw ng pagputol. Ikalat ang kanin at hayaang lumamig.

instruction.zh: 豆包、茄子及小黃瓜切長條，玉米筍縱切；以少量油煎香豆包、玉米筍和茄子，紅蘿蔔切條後汆燙，酪梨切片。
instruction.en: Cut the tofu skin, eggplant and cucumber into long strips and halve the baby corn lengthwise. Sear the tofu skin, baby corn and eggplant in a little oil; blanch carrot strips and slice the avocado.
instruction.id: Potong kulit tahu, terong, dan mentimun memanjang, lalu belah jagung muda. Tumis kulit tahu, jagung muda, dan terong dengan sedikit minyak; rebus singkat wortel yang dipotong memanjang dan iris alpukat.
instruction.fil: Gupitin ang balat ng tokwa, talong at pipino sa mahabang piraso at hatiin ang baby corn nang pahaba. Igisa ang balat ng tofu, baby corn at talong sa kaunting mantika; blanch carrot strips at hiwain ang avocado.

instruction.zh: 竹簾鋪上海苔及醋飯後翻面，把內餡放在下方三分之一處並捲緊。靜置2分鐘定型，以醋水沾濕刀身後切片，最後鋪上酪梨。
instruction.en: Place nori and vinegared rice on a bamboo mat, then flip it over. Arrange the fillings across the lower third and roll tightly. Rest for 2 minutes, slice with a knife moistened with vinegar water, and top with avocado.
instruction.id: Letakkan nori dan nasi cuka di atas tikar bambu lalu balikkan. Susun isian pada sepertiga bagian bawah dan gulung rapat. Diamkan 2 menit, potong dengan pisau yang dibasahi air cuka, lalu beri irisan alpukat.
instruction.fil: Ilagay ang nori at vinegared rice sa bamboo mat, pagkatapos ay i-flip ito. Ayusin ang mga palaman sa ibabang ikatlong bahagi at igulong nang mahigpit. Magpahinga ng 2 minuto, hiwain gamit ang kutsilyo na binasa ng tubig ng suka, at itaas ng avocado.

description.zh: 煮熟冰鎮的義大利麵搭配小黃瓜、紅蘿蔔、黃甜椒與可選辣椒，拌入白芝麻醬、花生醬、日式醬油與檸檬調成的清爽全素麻醬。
description.en: Fully cooked and chilled spaghetti is paired with cucumber, carrot, yellow bell pepper, and optional chili, then dressed in a refreshing vegan sauce of white sesame paste, peanut butter, Japanese soy sauce, and lemon.
description.id: Spageti yang dimasak matang lalu didinginkan dipadukan dengan mentimun, wortel, paprika kuning, dan cabai opsional, kemudian diberi saus vegan segar dari pasta wijen putih, selai kacang, kecap asin Jepang, dan lemon.
description.fil: Ang ganap na luto at pinalamig na spaghetti ay ipinares sa cucumber, carrot, yellow bell pepper, at opsyonal na sili, pagkatapos ay binibihisan ng nakakapreskong vegan sauce ng white sesame paste, peanut butter, Japanese soy sauce, at lemon.

instruction.zh: 小黃瓜、紅蘿蔔、黃甜椒與可選辣椒全部切成細條，分開備好。
instruction.en: Cut the cucumber, carrot, yellow bell pepper, and optional chili into fine strips and keep them ready separately.
instruction.id: Iris mentimun, wortel, paprika kuning, dan cabai opsional menjadi batang tipis, lalu sisihkan secara terpisah.
instruction.fil: Gupitin ang pipino, karot, dilaw na kampanilya, at opsyonal na sili sa mga pinong piraso at panatilihing nakahanda ang mga ito nang hiwalay.

Constraints: strictly vegan; no noodles, sauce, meat, eggs, dairy, seafood, labels, people, text, watermark, or logos. No text.

instruction.zh: 混合白芝麻醬、花生醬、日式醬油、黑麻油、花椒粉、味醂、果醋、檸檬汁、少許鹽和開水，拌至濃滑均勻後冷藏。
instruction.en: Mix white sesame paste, peanut butter, Japanese soy sauce, black sesame oil, Sichuan pepper powder, mirin, fruit vinegar, lemon juice, a little salt, and boiling water until smooth, then chill the sauce.
instruction.id: Campurkan pasta wijen putih, selai kacang, kecap asin Jepang, minyak wijen hitam, bubuk lada Sichuan, mirin, cuka buah, air lemon, sedikit garam, dan air mendidih hingga lembut, lalu dinginkan sausnya.
instruction.fil: Paghaluin ang white sesame paste, peanut butter, Japanese soy sauce, black sesame oil, Sichuan pepper powder, mirin, fruit vinegar, lemon juice, kaunting asin, at kumukulong tubig hanggang sa makinis, pagkatapos ay palamigin ang sauce.

instruction.zh: 滾水加少許鹽後放入義大利麵；這道冷麵將麵煮至全熟，約依包裝時間九分鐘，撈起放入冰水約一分鐘至冰涼後瀝乾。
instruction.en: Add a little salt to boiling water and cook the spaghetti fully for this cold noodle dish, about nine minutes according to the package; transfer it to ice water for about one minute until cold, then drain.
instruction.id: Tambahkan sedikit garam ke air mendidih lalu masak spageti hingga matang penuh untuk hidangan mi dingin ini, sekitar sembilan menit sesuai petunjuk kemasan; pindahkan ke air es sekitar satu menit hingga dingin, lalu tiriskan.
instruction.fil: Magdagdag ng kaunting asin sa kumukulong tubig at lutuin nang buo ang spaghetti para sa malamig na pansit na ito, mga siyam na minuto ayon sa pakete; ilipat ito sa tubig ng yelo nang halos isang minuto hanggang lumamig, pagkatapos ay alisan ng tubig.

Constraints: strictly vegan; no sauce, vegetables, finished bowl, meat, eggs, dairy, seafood, labels, people, text, watermark, or logos. No text.

instruction.zh: 使用剛煮麵的熱水，將切細的紅蘿蔔汆燙約30秒，保留半生熟的爽脆口感後撈起。
instruction.en: Use the hot pasta water to blanch the finely cut carrot for about 30 seconds, then remove it while it remains pleasantly crisp-tender.
instruction.id: Gunakan air panas bekas memasak pasta untuk memblansir wortel yang telah diiris tipis sekitar 30 detik, lalu angkat saat masih renyah lembut.
instruction.fil: Gamitin ang mainit na tubig ng pasta upang paputiin ang pinong hiwa na karot sa loob ng mga 30 segundo, pagkatapos ay alisin ito habang ito ay nananatiling malutong na malambot.

instruction.zh: 將冰鎮義大利麵與各種蔬菜條放入碗中，淋上冷藏麻醬；喜辣可再加辣椒，拌勻即可享用。
instruction.en: Place chilled spaghetti and the prepared vegetable strips in a bowl, pour over the chilled sesame sauce, and add chili if desired before mixing to serve.
instruction.id: Masukkan spageti dingin dan potongan sayuran ke dalam mangkuk, tuangkan saus wijen dingin, lalu tambahkan cabai bila suka dan aduk sebelum disajikan.
instruction.fil: Ilagay ang pinalamig na spaghetti at ang mga inihandang piraso ng gulay sa isang mangkok, ibuhos ang pinalamig na sarsa ng linga, at magdagdag ng sili kung nais bago ihalo upang ihain.

description.zh: 嫩豆腐先鹽水燙過並以日式醬油醃製，再依乾粉、麵糊、麵包粉三關裹衣，兩次油炸成外酥內嫩的純素炸豆腐。
description.en: Silken tofu is salted-water blanched and marinated in Japanese soy sauce, then coated in flour, batter, and breadcrumbs before a double fry for a crisp vegan tofu.
description.id: Tahu sutra diblansir dalam air garam dan dimarinasi kecap asin Jepang, lalu dilapisi tepung, adonan, serta tepung roti sebelum digoreng dua kali hingga renyah.
description.fil: Ang silken tofu ay salted-water blanched at inatsara sa Japanese soy sauce, pagkatapos ay pinahiran ng harina, batter, at breadcrumbs bago i-double fry para sa malutong na vegan tofu.

name.id: tepung rendah protein untuk lapisan kering
name.fil: cake flour para sa pag-aalis ng alikabok

title.en: Blanch the silken tofu in salt water
title.id: Blansir tahu sutra dalam air garam
title.fil: Blanch ang silken tofu sa tubig na asin

instruction.zh: 嫩豆腐先對半切開，放入加少許鹽的滾水煮約1分鐘，讓蛋白質凝結、後續裹粉時較不易破。
instruction.en: Cut the silken tofu in half and cook it in lightly salted boiling water for about 1 minute so its proteins set and it is less likely to break during coating.
instruction.id: Potong tahu sutra menjadi dua, lalu masak dalam air mendidih yang diberi sedikit garam sekitar 1 menit agar proteinnya mengeras dan tidak mudah hancur saat dilapisi.
instruction.fil: Gupitin ang silken tofu sa kalahati at lutuin ito sa bahagyang inasnan na tubig na kumukulo nang humigit-kumulang 1 minuto upang ang mga protina nito ay itakda at mas malamang na masira ito habang binabalutan.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic food photograph of silken tofu halves blanching gently in a pot of lightly salted boiling water, no text.

title.en: Marinate the tofu in soy sauce

instruction.zh: 將燙好的嫩豆腐撈起放入碗中，加入日式醬油後以輕搖方式讓醬油均勻包覆，稍微醃製。
instruction.en: Lift out the blanched tofu, place it in a bowl, add Japanese soy sauce, and gently shake the bowl to coat it evenly before a brief marinade.
instruction.id: Angkat tahu yang sudah diblansir, masukkan ke mangkuk, tambahkan kecap asin Jepang, lalu goyangkan mangkuk perlahan agar terlapisi rata sebelum dimarinasi sebentar.
instruction.fil: Iangat ang blanched tofu, ilagay ito sa isang mangkok, magdagdag ng Japanese soy sauce, at dahan-dahang iling ang mangkok upang mabalot ito nang pantay-pantay bago ang isang maikling marinade.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic close-up food photograph of tender tofu pieces gently coated in dark Japanese soy sauce in a shallow bowl, no text.

instruction.zh: 將120克低筋麵粉與200克水拌至無顆粒，再加入1小匙鹽、少許黑胡椒粉和少許五香粉調味。
instruction.en: Whisk 120 g cake flour with 200 g water until lump-free, then season the batter with 1 teaspoon salt, a little black pepper, and a little five-spice powder.
instruction.id: Kocok 120 g tepung rendah protein dengan 200 g air hingga tidak bergerindil, lalu bumbui adonan dengan 1 sendok teh garam, sedikit lada hitam, dan sedikit bubuk lima rempah.
instruction.fil: Paghaluin ang 120 g na harina ng cake na may 200 g ng tubig hanggang sa walang bukol, pagkatapos ay timplahan ang batter na may 1 kutsarita ng asin, isang maliit na itim na paminta, at isang maliit na pulbos na limang pampalasa.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic overhead food photograph of smooth pale batter being whisked with pepper and five-spice beside a bowl, no text.

instruction.zh: 嫩豆腐依序沾乾低筋麵粉、麵糊與麵包粉，完成乾粉、濕糊、麵包粉的三層外衣。
instruction.en: Coat each tofu piece in dry cake flour, then the batter, and finally breadcrumbs to form the three-layer crust of flour, wet batter, and crumbs.
instruction.id: Balut setiap potong tahu dengan tepung rendah protein kering, lalu adonan basah, dan terakhir tepung roti untuk membentuk tiga lapisan kulit.
instruction.fil: Pahiran ang bawat piraso ng tofu sa tuyong harina ng cake, pagkatapos ay ang batter, at panghuli ay mga breadcrumb upang mabuo ang tatlong-layer na crust ng harina, basang batter, at mga mumo.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic overhead food photograph of tofu pieces being coated in flour, pale batter, and breadcrumbs in three separate bowls, no text.

instruction.zh: 裹好的豆腐分開下鍋，第一次炸至蛋黃色即可撈出，不要炸到深金黃，避免彼此黏住。
instruction.en: Lower the coated tofu into oil with space between pieces and fry only until pale egg-yellow on the first pass; do not fry it deep golden yet, and keep pieces from sticking.
instruction.id: Masukkan tahu berlapis ke minyak dengan jarak antarpotong, lalu goreng pertama hanya hingga kuning pucat; jangan sampai cokelat tua dan cegah potongan saling menempel.
instruction.fil: Ibaba ang pinahiran na tofu sa mantika na may espasyo sa pagitan ng mga piraso at iprito lamang hanggang sa maputlang dilaw na itlog sa unang pass; huwag iprito ito ng malalim na ginintuang pa, at huwag dumikit ang mga piraso.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic close-up food photograph of pale golden breaded tofu pieces frying separately in bubbling oil, no text.

title.fil: Itaas ang init, malutong, at timplahan

instruction.zh: 第一輪全數炸完後將油溫升至約180°C，再次下鍋搶酥至金黃，瀝油後趁熱沾芥末椒鹽粉享用。
instruction.en: After every piece has been fried once, raise the oil to about 180°C and fry again until golden and crisp; drain well, then season with wasabi pepper salt while hot.
instruction.id: Setelah semua potong selesai digoreng pertama, naikkan suhu minyak hingga sekitar 180°C lalu goreng lagi sampai keemasan dan renyah; tiriskan baik-baik, kemudian bumbui garam lada wasabi saat masih panas.
instruction.fil: Matapos ang bawat piraso ay pinirito nang isang beses, itaas ang mantika sa humigit-kumulang 180°C at iprito muli hanggang sa ginintuang at malutong; alisan ng tubig na mabuti, pagkatapos ay timplahan ng wasabi pepper asin habang mainit.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic plated food photograph of crisp golden vegan fried silken tofu dusted with wasabi pepper salt, no text.

description.zh: 嫩豆腐、凍豆腐與豆乾以自製花椒油、辣豆瓣和香料燉煮，再分次勾芡，呈現麻香濃郁的全素麻婆豆腐。
description.en: Silken tofu, frozen tofu, and pressed tofu are simmered with homemade Sichuan pepper oil, chili bean paste, and spices, then thickened in stages for a fragrant vegan mapo tofu.
description.id: Tahu sutra, tahu beku, dan tahu padat direbus dengan minyak lada Sichuan buatan sendiri, pasta kacang cabai, serta rempah, lalu dikentalkan bertahap untuk mapo tofu vegan yang harum.
description.fil: Ang silken tofu, frozen tofu, at pressed tofu ay pinaluluto ng lutong bahay na Sichuan pepper oil, chili bean paste, at mga pampalasa, pagkatapos ay pinalapot nang sunud-sunod para sa isang mabangong vegan mapo tofu.

instruction.zh: 凍豆腐退冰洗淨後反覆擠水並剝小塊；嫩豆腐與豆乾切塊，薑和辣椒切末，青龍椒切細圈。
instruction.en: Thaw and rinse the frozen tofu, squeeze out water repeatedly, and tear it into small pieces. Cube the silken tofu and pressed tofu, mince ginger and chili, and slice the green chili into thin rings.
instruction.id: Cairkan dan bilas tahu beku, peras airnya berulang kali lalu sobek kecil. Potong tahu sutra dan tahu padat, cincang jahe serta cabai, lalu iris cabai hijau tipis-tipis.
instruction.fil: I-thaw at banlawan ang frozen tofu, pisilin ang tubig nang paulit-ulit, at gupitin ito sa maliliit na piraso. I-cube ang silken tofu at pinindot na tofu, hiwain ang luya at sili, at hiwain ang berdeng sili sa manipis na singsing.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic overhead food photograph of three prepared tofu textures with minced ginger, chili, and sliced green pepper on a board, no text.

title.en: Blanch silken tofu in salt water
title.id: Blansir tahu sutra dalam air garam
title.fil: Paputiin ang silken tofu sa tubig na asin

instruction.zh: 煮一鍋加鹽的滾水，將嫩豆腐煮1分鐘後撈起，減少豆腥味並讓豆腐較不易燉碎。
instruction.en: Bring salted water to a boil and cook the silken tofu for 1 minute, then lift it out to reduce beaniness and help it hold together while braising.
instruction.id: Didihkan air bergaram dan masak tahu sutra selama 1 menit, lalu angkat untuk mengurangi aroma kacang serta membuatnya tidak mudah hancur saat direbus.
instruction.fil: Pakuluan ang inasnan na tubig at lutuin ang silken tofu sa loob ng 1 minuto, pagkatapos ay iangat ito para mabawasan ang beaniness at tulungan itong magkadikit habang nagluluto.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic close-up food photograph of silken tofu cubes blanching gently in a pot of salted water, no text.

instruction.zh: 以小火用較平常多的香油煸花椒，聞到濃郁香氣後再煸1至2分鐘，濾出花椒並將花椒油留在鍋中；花椒切碎備用。
instruction.en: Over low heat, fry the Sichuan peppercorns in a little more sesame oil than usual. Once fragrant, continue 1 to 2 minutes, strain out the peppercorns while keeping the oil in the wok, and finely chop the peppercorns for later.
instruction.id: Dengan api kecil, tumis lada Sichuan dalam minyak wijen sedikit lebih banyak dari biasanya. Setelah harum, lanjutkan 1 hingga 2 menit, saring lada sambil menyisakan minyak di wajan, lalu cincang halus lada untuk nanti.
instruction.fil: Sa mahinang apoy, iprito ang Sichuan peppercorns sa kaunting sesame oil kaysa karaniwan. Sa sandaling mabango, magpatuloy ng 1 hanggang 2 minuto, salain ang mga peppercorn habang pinapanatili ang mantika sa kawali, at makinis na tumaga ang mga peppercorn para sa ibang pagkakataon.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic close-up food photograph of Sichuan peppercorns infusing in golden sesame oil in a small wok, no text.

title.en: Brown tofu and fry the chili paste
title.fil: Brown tokwa at iprito ang chili paste

instruction.zh: 將凍豆腐與豆乾放入花椒油煸至金黃酥脆，加入薑末和辣椒末炒香；加入辣豆瓣醬、辣椒粉、花椒粉、胡椒粉與醬油炒出醬香。
instruction.en: Brown frozen tofu and pressed tofu in the Sichuan pepper oil until golden and crisp, then sauté ginger and chili. Add chili bean paste, chili powder, Sichuan pepper powder, pepper, and soy sauce, frying until the sauce smells fragrant.
instruction.id: Tumis tahu beku dan tahu padat dalam minyak lada Sichuan hingga keemasan serta renyah, lalu tumis jahe dan cabai. Tambahkan pasta kacang cabai, bubuk cabai, bubuk lada Sichuan, merica, dan kecap asin hingga saus harum.
instruction.fil: Brown frozen tofu at pinindot na tofu sa Sichuan pepper oil hanggang sa ginintuang at malutong, pagkatapos ay igisa ang luya at sili. Magdagdag ng chili bean paste, chili powder, Sichuan pepper powder, pepper, at toyo, iprito hanggang sa mabango ang sarsa.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic food photograph of golden tofu pieces and red chili bean paste sizzling in a wok with aromatic spices, no text.

instruction.zh: 加入300克水與糖，以中火熬煮約5分鐘；放入燙好的嫩豆腐和一半花椒碎，中火燉煮10分鐘。
instruction.en: Add 300 g water and sugar, then simmer over medium heat for about 5 minutes. Add the blanched silken tofu and half the chopped Sichuan peppercorns, then braise over medium heat for 10 minutes.
instruction.id: Tambahkan 300 g air dan gula, lalu rebus api sedang sekitar 5 menit. Masukkan tahu sutra yang sudah diblansir dan setengah lada Sichuan cincang, lalu masak api sedang selama 10 menit.
instruction.fil: Magdagdag ng 300 g ng tubig at asukal, pagkatapos ay kumulo sa katamtamang init ng mga 5 minuto. Idagdag ang blanched silken tofu at kalahati ng tinadtad na Sichuan peppercorns, pagkatapos ay igisa sa katamtamang init sa loob ng 10 minuto.

title.fil: Palapot sa mga yugto at tapusin

instruction.zh: 蓮藕粉與3大匙水調成勾芡水，分3次倒入，每次推勻後再加下一次；最後從鍋邊淋白醋，盛盤後放青龍椒圈與剩餘花椒碎。
instruction.en: Mix lotus root starch with 3 tablespoons water. Add the slurry in 3 additions, stirring smooth before each next addition; drizzle white vinegar around the pan edge, then top with green chili rings and remaining chopped Sichuan peppercorns.
instruction.id: Campur pati akar teratai dengan 3 sendok makan air. Tambahkan larutan pengental dalam 3 tahap sambil mengaduk rata sebelum tahap berikutnya; tuang cuka putih di tepi wajan, lalu taburi cabai hijau dan sisa lada Sichuan cincang.
instruction.fil: Paghaluin ang lotus root starch na may 3 kutsarang tubig. Idagdag ang slurry sa 3 karagdagan, pagpapakilos ng makinis bago ang bawat susunod na karagdagan; ibuhos ang puting suka sa paligid ng gilid ng kawali, pagkatapos ay itaas na may berdeng chili rings at natitirang tinadtad na Sichuan peppercorns.

description.zh: 猴頭菇先煸至金黃，再以黑麻油、薑、醬油和素蠔油燒煮吸飽醬汁，最後以九層塔提香的全素三杯料理。
description.en: Lion’s mane mushrooms are browned first, then braised in black sesame oil, ginger, soy sauce, and vegan oyster sauce until juicy, with Thai basil added for a vegan three-cup dish.
description.id: Jamur surai singa ditumis hingga keemasan, lalu dibraise dalam minyak wijen hitam, jahe, kecap asin, dan saus tiram vegan hingga berair, dengan kemangi Thailand sebagai penutup.
description.fil: Ang mga kabute ng mane ng leon ay unang pina-brown, pagkatapos ay niluluto sa itim na sesame oil, luya, toyo, at vegan oyster sauce hanggang sa makatas, na may idinagdag na Thai basil para sa isang vegan na tatlong-tasang ulam.

name.fil: mga kabute ng kiling ng leon

title.fil: Maghanda ng mga mushroom at aromatics

instruction.zh: 猴頭菇退冰後剝成小塊；老薑與大辣椒切片，九層塔去梗備用。
instruction.en: Thaw the lion’s mane mushrooms and tear them into small pieces. Slice the mature ginger and large chili, then remove the Thai basil stems.
instruction.id: Cairkan jamur surai singa lalu sobek kecil-kecil. Iris jahe tua dan cabai besar, kemudian petiki daun kemangi Thailand dari batangnya.
instruction.fil: I-thaw ang mane mushroom ng leon at gupitin ang mga ito sa maliliit na piraso. Hiwain ang mature na luya at malalaking sili, pagkatapos ay alisin ang mga tangkay ng Thai basil.

instruction.zh: 炒鍋倒入植物油，將猴頭菇煸至金黃後先取出；這一步讓菇體後續更能吸收醬汁。
instruction.en: Heat vegetable oil in a wok and brown the lion’s mane mushrooms until golden, then set them aside; this helps the mushrooms absorb more sauce later.
instruction.id: Panaskan minyak sayur dalam wajan dan tumis jamur surai singa hingga keemasan, lalu sisihkan; langkah ini membantu jamur menyerap lebih banyak saus nantinya.
instruction.fil: Init ang langis ng gulay sa isang kawali at i-brown ang mga mushroom ng lion's mane hanggang sa ginintuang, pagkatapos ay itabi ang mga ito; nakakatulong ito sa mga mushroom na sumipsip ng mas maraming sarsa mamaya.

instruction.zh: 原鍋倒入黑麻油，以小火慢慢爆香薑片，避免麻油過熱發苦；薑片捲曲後加入煸好的猴頭菇稍微拌炒。
instruction.en: Pour black sesame oil into the same wok and gently fry the ginger over low heat so the oil does not turn bitter. When the ginger curls, return the browned lion’s mane mushrooms and toss briefly.
instruction.id: Tuang minyak wijen hitam ke wajan yang sama dan tumis jahe perlahan dengan api kecil agar minyak tidak pahit. Saat jahe melengkung, masukkan kembali jamur surai singa yang sudah ditumis lalu aduk sebentar.
instruction.fil: Ibuhos ang black sesame oil sa parehong kawali at dahan-dahang iprito ang luya sa mahinang apoy para hindi maging mapait ang mantika. Kapag ang luya ay kulot, ibalik ang browned lion's mane mushroom at ihagis sandali.

instruction.zh: 加入醬油、素蠔油、胡椒粉和糖炒香，再倒入約250毫升水，以中火燒煮，讓猴頭菇吸飽湯汁。
instruction.en: Add soy sauce, vegan oyster sauce, ground pepper, and sugar and cook until fragrant, then pour in about 250 ml water and braise over medium heat so the mushrooms absorb the sauce.
instruction.id: Tambahkan kecap asin, saus tiram vegan, merica bubuk, dan gula lalu masak hingga harum; tuang sekitar 250 ml air dan braise dengan api sedang agar jamur menyerap saus.
instruction.fil: Magdagdag ng toyo, vegan oyster sauce, giniling na paminta, at asukal at lutuin hanggang mabango, pagkatapos ay ibuhos ang humigit-kumulang 250 ML ng tubig at igisa sa katamtamang init upang masipsip ng mga mushroom ang sarsa.

instruction.zh: 水量可略蓋過猴頭菇，先以大火收汁；醬汁濃稠時轉小火拌入大部分九層塔，最後再放剩餘九層塔和辣椒片，保留香氣。
instruction.en: The water may nearly cover the mushrooms; first reduce it over high heat. Once the sauce thickens, switch to low heat and fold in most of the Thai basil, then add the remaining basil and chili slices at the end to preserve their aroma.
instruction.id: Air boleh hampir menutupi jamur; mula-mula susutkan dengan api besar. Saat saus mengental, kecilkan api dan aduk sebagian besar kemangi Thailand, lalu tambahkan sisa kemangi serta irisan cabai di akhir agar aromanya tetap segar.
instruction.fil: Maaaring halos takpan ng tubig ang mga kabute; bawasan muna sa sobrang init. Kapag lumapot na ang sauce, lumipat sa mahinang apoy at tiklupin ang karamihan sa Thai basil, pagkatapos ay idagdag ang natitirang basil at mga hiwa ng sili sa dulo upang mapanatili ang kanilang aroma.

description.fil: Ang all-purpose na harina at tubig sa one-to-two ratio ay bumubuo sa batter para sa kimchi at mga gulay, pinirito hanggang ginintuang may malulutong na mga gilid sa vegan Korean pancake na ito.

instruction.zh: 將鮮香菇、紅蘿蔔、小黃瓜和甜椒切成絲；節瓜切片，辣椒切片備用。
instruction.en: Julienne the fresh shiitake, carrot, cucumber, and bell pepper; slice the zucchini and chili for arranging later.
instruction.id: Iris memanjang shiitake segar, wortel, mentimun, dan paprika; iris zucchini serta cabai untuk ditata kemudian.
instruction.fil: Julienne ang sariwang shiitake, karot, pipino, at kampanilya; hiwain ang zucchini at sili para ayusin mamaya.

instruction.en: Whisk 100 g all-purpose flour with 200 g water until no lumps remain, making an elastic batter suited for Korean pancakes.
instruction.id: Kocok 100 g tepung serbaguna dengan 200 g air hingga tidak ada gumpalan, menghasilkan adonan elastis untuk pajeon Korea.
instruction.fil: Paghaluin ang 100 g na all-purpose na harina na may 200 g na tubig hanggang sa walang matitirang bukol, na ginagawang isang nababanat na batter na angkop para sa mga Korean pancake.

instruction.zh: 將泡菜、紅蘿蔔、小黃瓜和甜椒絲拌入麵糊，使配料均勻分布。
instruction.en: Fold kimchi, carrot, cucumber, and bell-pepper strips into the batter so the ingredients are evenly distributed.
instruction.id: Aduk kimchi, wortel, mentimun, dan irisan paprika ke dalam adonan agar bahan tersebar merata.
instruction.fil: I-fold ang kimchi, carrot, cucumber, at bell-pepper strips sa batter para pantay-pantay ang paghahati ng mga sangkap.

instruction.zh: 平底鍋倒入適量香油，舀兩大匙蔬菜麵糊攤平；趁麵糊未凝固時，在表面擺上節瓜、辣椒和香菇。
instruction.en: Pour sesame oil into a flat pan and spread two tablespoons of vegetable batter thinly. Before it sets, arrange zucchini, chili, and mushrooms across the surface.
instruction.id: Tuang minyak wijen ke wajan datar lalu ratakan dua sendok makan adonan sayuran. Sebelum mengeras, susun zucchini, cabai, dan jamur di permukaannya.
instruction.fil: Ibuhos ang sesame oil sa isang flat pan at ikalat ang dalawang kutsara ng vegetable batter nang manipis. Bago ito magtakda, ayusin ang zucchini, sili, at mushroom sa ibabaw.

instruction.zh: 待底部定型後先掀起小角確認上色再翻面，將兩面煎至金黃，讓邊緣呈現酥脆焦香即可起鍋。
instruction.en: Once the bottom sets, lift a small corner to check the color before flipping. Cook both sides until golden with crisp, lightly browned edges, then serve.
instruction.id: Setelah bagian bawah mengeras, angkat sedikit sudut untuk memeriksa warna sebelum dibalik. Masak kedua sisi hingga keemasan dengan tepi yang renyah dan kecokelatan, lalu sajikan.
instruction.fil: Kapag nakatakda na ang ibaba, iangat ang isang maliit na sulok upang tingnan ang kulay bago i-flip. Lutuin ang magkabilang panig hanggang sa ginintuang may malutong, bahagyang kayumanggi na mga gilid, pagkatapos ay ihain.
