description.zh: 高麗菜、香菇、豆乾、豆包和冬粉炒香後調味成餡，一半拌入剝皮辣椒，包成原味與微辣兩種純素水餃。
description.en: Cabbage, mushrooms, pressed tofu, tofu puffs, and vermicelli are sautéed and seasoned for a filling; half is mixed with peeled chili for two vegan dumpling flavors.
description.id: Kol, jamur, tahu padat, tahu puff, dan soun ditumis serta dibumbui sebagai isian; separuh isian dicampur cabai kupas untuk dua rasa pangsit vegan.
description.fil: Ang repolyo, mushroom, pinindot na tofu, tofu puff, at vermicelli ay iginisa at tinimplahan para sa isang palaman; kalahati ay halo-halong may binalatan na sili para sa dalawang vegan dumpling flavors.

title.fil: Pinong tumaga ang pagpuno ng dumpling

instruction.zh: 泡軟冬粉切成細短段；香菇、豆乾和豆包切小丁，薑切末，剝皮辣椒切末。
instruction.en: Cut soaked vermicelli into fine short lengths; dice the mushrooms, pressed tofu, and tofu puffs, mince the ginger, and finely chop the peeled chili peppers.
instruction.id: Potong soun yang sudah direndam menjadi pendek dan halus; dadu jamur, tahu padat, serta tahu puff, cincang jahe, dan cincang halus cabai kupas.
instruction.fil: Gupitin ang binabad na vermicelli sa maliliit na maikling haba; hiwain ang mga mushroom, pinindot na tofu, at tofu puffs, hiwain ang luya, at tadtarin ng pino ang binalatan na sili.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic overhead food photograph of finely chopped vermicelli, mushrooms, tofu puffs, pressed tofu, ginger, and peeled chili on a board, no text.

instruction.zh: 高麗菜切細後加鹽抓醃，靜置出水後擠乾，讓餡料不會過濕。
instruction.en: Finely chop the cabbage, massage it with salt, let it release water, then squeeze it dry so the filling will not become wet.
instruction.id: Cincang halus kol, remas dengan garam, diamkan hingga mengeluarkan air, lalu peras kering agar isian tidak basah.
instruction.fil: Hiwain ng pino ang repolyo, imasahe ng asin, hayaang maglabas ng tubig, pagkatapos ay pigain upang hindi mabasa ang laman.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic close-up food photograph of shredded cabbage being squeezed dry by hand over a bowl, no text.

title.id: Tumis tahu dan jamur hingga harum
title.fil: Mga produktong brown tofu at mushroom

instruction.zh: 炒鍋放油，先將豆乾與豆包煎至金黃，再加入薑末與香菇炒香，淋少量醬油拌炒後盛入大碗。
instruction.en: Heat oil in a wok, brown the pressed tofu and tofu puffs, then sauté ginger and mushrooms. Add a little soy sauce, toss until fragrant, and transfer to a large bowl.
instruction.id: Panaskan minyak dalam wajan, tumis tahu padat dan tahu puff hingga keemasan, lalu tumis jahe serta jamur. Tambahkan sedikit kecap asin, aduk hingga harum, lalu pindahkan ke mangkuk besar.
instruction.fil: Mag-init ng mantika sa kawali, kayumanggi ang pinindot na tofu at tofu puffs, pagkatapos ay igisa ang luya at mushroom. Magdagdag ng kaunting toyo, ihalo hanggang mabango, at ilipat sa isang malaking mangkok.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic food photograph of golden diced tofu puffs, pressed tofu, mushrooms, and ginger sautéing in a wok, no text.

title.en: Mix plain and chili dumpling fillings
title.fil: Paghaluin ang plain at chili dumpling fillings

instruction.zh: 將擠乾高麗菜與冬粉加入炒料，拌入香油、醬油、糖、鹽和胡椒粉。取一半餡料加入剝皮辣椒末，另一半保留原味。
instruction.en: Add squeezed cabbage and vermicelli to the sautéed filling, then mix in sesame oil, soy sauce, sugar, salt, and pepper. Mix chopped peeled chili into half of the filling and keep the other half plain.
instruction.id: Tambahkan kol peras dan soun ke isian tumis, lalu campur minyak wijen, kecap asin, gula, garam, serta merica. Campurkan cabai kupas cincang ke separuh isian dan sisakan separuh lainnya polos.
instruction.fil: Lagyan ng piniga na repolyo at vermicelli ang ginisang palaman, pagkatapos ay ihalo sa sesame oil, toyo, asukal, asin, at paminta. Paghaluin ang tinadtad na binalatan na sili sa kalahati ng palaman at panatilihing plain ang kalahati.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic overhead food photograph of two bowls of vegan dumpling filling, one plain and one mixed with chopped peeled chili, no text.

instruction.zh: 水餃皮外圈沾水，放入適量餡料後對折，再沿邊緣以打褶方式壓緊封口，避免餡料外漏。
instruction.en: Wet the edge of a wrapper, add a suitable amount of filling, fold it in half, then pleat and firmly seal the edge to prevent filling from escaping.
instruction.id: Basahi tepi kulit pangsit, isi secukupnya, lipat menjadi dua, lalu lipat-lipat dan tekan rapat pinggirannya agar isian tidak keluar.
instruction.fil: Basain ang gilid ng isang wrapper, magdagdag ng isang angkop na dami ng pagpuno, tiklupin ito sa kalahati, pagkatapos ay lagyan ng pleat at mahigpit na selyuhan ang gilid upang maiwasan ang pagpuno mula sa pagtakas.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic close-up food photograph of hands pleating a vegan dumpling with a cabbage and tofu filling, no text.

title.fil: Pakuluan ang parehong lasa ng dumpling

instruction.zh: 鍋中水滾後放入包好的水餃，煮約5至8分鐘至餃皮熟透、餡料熱透，即可撈起享用。
instruction.en: Bring a pot of water to a boil, add the wrapped dumplings, and cook for about 5 to 8 minutes until the wrappers and filling are fully cooked, then serve.
instruction.id: Didihkan air dalam panci, masukkan pangsit yang sudah dibungkus, lalu masak sekitar 5 hingga 8 menit sampai kulit dan isi matang sepenuhnya, kemudian sajikan.
instruction.fil: Pakuluan ang isang palayok ng tubig, idagdag ang nakabalot na dumplings, at lutuin ng mga 5 hanggang 8 minuto hanggang sa ganap na maluto ang mga balot at palaman, pagkatapos ay ihain.

description.zh:
大家對於＃台灣小吃第一個會想到什麼呢？

並且充滿著濃濃家鄉味

description.en: Compared with braised pork rice, the creator prefers sticky rice for its simple, nostalgic Taiwanese character. This version cooks with white sesame oil for a light fragrance.
description.id: Dibanding nasi babi kecap, pembuat resep lebih menyukai ketan karena kesan Taiwan yang sederhana dan nostalgik. Versi ini dimasak dengan minyak wijen putih untuk aroma yang ringan.
description.fil: Kung ikukumpara sa nilagang pork rice, mas gusto ng creator ang sticky rice para sa simple, nostalgic na karakter na Taiwanese. Ang bersyon na ito ay niluluto na may puting linga langis para sa isang magaan na halimuyak.

jamur shiitake kering yang telah direndam

instruction.zh: 香菇切絲；豆乾、金針菇與芋頭切小段。
instruction.en: Slice the shiitake; cut the firm tofu, enoki mushrooms, and taro into small pieces.
instruction.id: Iris shiitake; potong tahu padat, enoki, dan talas menjadi bagian kecil.
instruction.fil: Hiwain ang shiitake; gupitin ang matigas na tofu, enoki mushroom, at taro sa maliliit na piraso.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Prepare the ingredients”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

instruction.zh: 炒鍋放適量白麻油，放入芋頭和豆乾煸至金黃；加入金針菇、香菇和菜脯炒香。
instruction.en: Heat an appropriate amount of white sesame oil in a wok. Brown the taro and firm tofu, then add enoki, shiitake, and preserved radish and sauté until fragrant.
instruction.id: Panaskan minyak wijen putih secukupnya dalam wajan. Masak talas dan tahu padat hingga keemasan, lalu tambahkan enoki, shiitake, dan lobak asin hingga harum.
instruction.fil: Mag-init ng angkop na dami ng puting linga langis sa isang kawali. Brown ang taro at firm tofu, pagkatapos ay ilagay ang enoki, shiitake, at preserved na labanos at igisa hanggang mabango.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Sauté the fillings”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

instruction.zh: 加入醬油、素蠔油、糖、胡椒粉、五香粉與白麻油炒香。倒入水和香菇水，蓋鍋煮約 10 分鐘。
instruction.en: Add soy sauce, vegetarian oyster sauce, sugar, ground pepper, five-spice powder, and white sesame oil, then stir-fry until fragrant. Add the water and mushroom-soaking liquid, cover, and cook for about 10 minutes.
instruction.id: Tambahkan kecap asin, saus tir vegetarian, gula, lada bubuk, bubuk lima rempah, dan minyak wijen putih, lalu tumis hingga harum. Tambahkan air dan air rendaman jamur, tutup, dan masak sekitar 10 menit.
instruction.fil: Magdagdag ng toyo, vegetarian oyster sauce, asukal, ground pepper, five-spice powder, at white sesame oil, pagkatapos ay iprito hanggang mabango. Idagdag ang tubig at mushroom-soaking liquid, takpan, at lutuin ng mga 10 minuto.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Season and simmer”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

instruction.zh: 來源最後建議淋上甜辣醬，放上素鬆、香菜和醃製小黃瓜後享用。
instruction.en: The source finishes by drizzling sweet chili sauce and adding vegan meat floss, cilantro, and pickled cucumber.
instruction.id: Sumber menyelesaikan hidangan dengan saus cabai manis, abon vegan, ketumbar daun, dan mentimun acar.
instruction.fil: Tinatapos ang source sa pamamagitan ng pag-drizzling ng matamis na chili sauce at pagdaragdag ng vegan meat floss, cilantro, at adobo na pipino.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Finish with toppings”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

description.zh: 三道可冷藏備用的全素涼拌菜：橄欖油素蠔油芥蘭、日式醬油蘋果醋大頭菜，及薑香雲耳。
description.en: Three make-ahead vegan cold dishes: Chinese kale with olive oil and vegetarian oyster sauce, kohlrabi with Japanese soy sauce and apple vinegar, and ginger cloud ear mushrooms.
description.id: Tiga hidangan dingin vegan yang dapat disiapkan sebelumnya: kailan dengan minyak zaitun serta saus tiram vegetarian, kohlrabi dengan kecap asin Jepang dan cuka apel, serta jamur kuping awan beraroma jahe.
description.fil: Tatlong make-ahead vegan cold dish: Chinese kale na may olive oil at vegetarian oyster sauce, kohlrabi na may Japanese soy sauce at apple vinegar, at ginger cloud ear mushroom.

instruction.zh: 芥蘭洗淨，粗梗可削去外皮。滾水加少許鹽，放入芥蘭煮滾後約30秒取出，切段。與橄欖油和素蠔油拌勻後冷藏。
instruction.en: Wash Chinese kale and peel tough stems if desired. Add a little salt to boiling water, cook the kale for about 30 seconds after it returns to a boil, then cut into sections. Toss with olive oil and vegetarian oyster sauce, then chill.
instruction.id: Cuci kailan dan kupas batang keras bila diinginkan. Tambahkan sedikit garam ke air mendidih, masak kailan sekitar 30 detik setelah mendidih kembali, lalu potong. Aduk dengan minyak zaitun dan saus tiram vegetarian, kemudian dinginkan.
instruction.fil: Hugasan ang Chinese kale at balatan ang matigas na tangkay kung ninanais. Magdagdag ng kaunting asin sa tubig na kumukulo, lutuin ang kale nang humigit-kumulang 30 segundo matapos itong bumalik sa pigsa, pagkatapos ay i-cut sa mga seksyon. Ihagis ang olive oil at vegetarian oyster sauce, pagkatapos ay palamigin.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Make Chinese kale salad”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

instruction.zh: 大頭菜洗淨後深削去較粗纖維的外皮，先切薄片再切絲。加鹽抓醃20分鐘至出水，倒掉水分。
instruction.en: Wash kohlrabi and peel deeply to remove coarse outer fibers, then slice thinly and cut into shreds. Toss with salt for 20 minutes until it releases water, then drain.
instruction.id: Cuci kohlrabi dan kupas dalam untuk menghilangkan serat luar yang kasar, lalu iris tipis dan potong serut. Aduk dengan garam selama 20 menit hingga mengeluarkan air, lalu tiriskan.
instruction.fil: Hugasan ang kohlrabi at alisan ng balat nang malalim upang maalis ang mga magaspang na panlabas na hibla, pagkatapos ay hiwain ng manipis at gupitin. Ihagis ang asin sa loob ng 20 minuto hanggang sa lumabas ang tubig, pagkatapos ay alisan ng tubig.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Prepare kohlrabi”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

instruction.zh: 將香菜切末、辣椒切斜段，與日式醬油、香油、蘋果醋和味醂加入大頭菜拌勻後冷藏。
instruction.en: Chop cilantro, slice chili diagonally, and toss with kohlrabi, Japanese soy sauce, sesame oil, apple cider vinegar, and mirin; chill.
instruction.id: Cincang daun ketumbar, iris cabai serong, lalu aduk dengan kohlrabi, kecap asin Jepang, minyak wijen, cuka apel, dan mirin; dinginkan.
instruction.fil: I-chop ang cilantro, hiwain ang sili nang pahilis, at ihagis sa kohlrabi, Japanese soy sauce, sesame oil, apple cider vinegar, at mirin; chill.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Dress the kohlrabi”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

title.fil: Paputiin ang mga cloud ear mushroom

instruction.zh: 雲耳放入滾水，煮滾後再煮1分鐘。
instruction.en: Place cloud ear mushrooms in boiling water; once it returns to a boil, cook 1 more minute.
instruction.id: Masukkan jamur kuping awan ke air mendidih; setelah mendidih kembali, masak 1 menit lagi.
instruction.fil: Ilagay ang cloud ear mushroom sa kumukulong tubig; sa sandaling bumalik ito sa pigsa, magluto ng 1 minuto pa.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Blanch cloud ear mushrooms”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

title.fil: Bihisan at palamigin ang mga tainga ng ulap

instruction.zh: 將香油、味醂、日式醬油、白醋和白芝麻加入保鮮盒；放入薑絲與雲耳拌勻後冷藏。白醋可依個人口味調整。
instruction.en: Put sesame oil, mirin, Japanese soy sauce, white vinegar, and white sesame in a storage container. Add ginger shreds and cloud ear mushrooms, toss, and chill. Adjust white vinegar to taste.
instruction.id: Masukkan minyak wijen, mirin, kecap asin Jepang, cuka putih, dan wijen putih ke wadah. Tambahkan serutan jahe serta jamur kuping awan, aduk, lalu dinginkan. Sesuaikan cuka putih menurut selera.
instruction.fil: Ilagay ang sesame oil, mirin, Japanese soy sauce, white vinegar, at white sesame sa isang storage container. Magdagdag ng mga ginger shreds at cloud ear mushroom, ihagis, at palamigin. Ayusin ang puting suka sa panlasa.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic vegan recipe-step image for “Dress and chill cloud ears”; no meat, dairy, text, watermark, or logo.

title.en: Vegan Hong Kong-Style Stir-Fried Rice Noodles
title.id: Kwetiau Goreng Gaya Hong Kong Vegan
title.fil: Vegan Hong Kong-Style Stir-Fried Rice Noodles

description.zh: 板條先煎上色，豆包泥替代雞蛋、麵腸煎脆，再與芥蘭、豆芽及沙茶醬汁拌炒完成的全素港式炒河粉。
description.en: Flat rice noodles are seared, tofu-skin mince replaces egg, and crisp wheat gluten joins Chinese kale, bean sprouts, and satay sauce in this vegan Hong Kong-style stir-fry.
description.id: Kwetiau ditumis, cincangan kulit tahu menggantikan telur, dan gluten gandum renyah dipadukan dengan kailan, tauge, serta saus sate dalam tumisan gaya Hong Kong vegan.
description.fil: Ang mga flat rice noodles ay sinira, ang tofu-skin mince ay pinapalitan ang itlog, at ang malutong na wheat gluten ay sumasama sa Chinese kale, bean sprouts, at satay sauce sa vegan na Hong Kong-style stir-fry na ito.

title.fil: Gupitin ang mga sangkap ng pansit stir-fry

instruction.zh: 麵腸切斜片，芥蘭斜切段，老薑與紅蘿蔔切絲，辣椒切小段。
instruction.en: Slice the wheat gluten rolls on a diagonal, cut Chinese kale into diagonal segments, julienne the ginger and carrot, and cut the chili into short pieces.
instruction.id: Iris gulungan gluten gandum secara serong, potong kailan serong, iris jahe serta wortel memanjang, dan potong cabai pendek-pendek.
instruction.fil: Hiwain ang wheat gluten roll sa isang dayagonal, gupitin ang Chinese kale sa diagonal na mga segment, julienne ang luya at karot, at gupitin ang sili sa maikling piraso.

title.en: Sear and season the rice noodles
title.fil: Sear at timplahan ng rice noodles

instruction.zh: 炒鍋倒入適量香油，放入板條煎至微黃，再加入部分醬油拌炒至均勻上色後盛出備用。
instruction.en: Heat sesame oil in a wok, sear the flat rice noodles until lightly yellowed, then add part of the soy sauce and toss until evenly colored before setting aside.
instruction.id: Panaskan minyak wijen dalam wajan, tumis kwetiau hingga agak kekuningan, lalu tambahkan sebagian kecap asin dan aduk sampai warnanya merata sebelum disisihkan.
instruction.fil: Init ang sesame oil sa isang kawali, igisa ang flat rice noodles hanggang sa bahagyang manilaw, pagkatapos ay ilagay ang bahagi ng toyo at ihalo hanggang sa maging pantay ang kulay bago itabi.

title.en: Crisp the tofu-skin mince and wheat gluten

instruction.zh: 將豆包泥煸炒至焦脆後取出；麵腸放入鍋中以小火慢慢煎至焦脆，盡量少翻動後取出。
instruction.en: Stir-fry the tofu-skin mince until crisp and set it aside. Cook the wheat gluten over low heat until crisp, turning it as little as possible, then remove.
instruction.id: Tumis cincangan kulit tahu hingga renyah lalu sisihkan. Masak gluten gandum dengan api kecil hingga renyah, sesedikit mungkin membaliknya, lalu angkat.
instruction.fil: Igisa ang tofu-skin mince hanggang sa malutong at itabi. Lutuin ang wheat gluten sa mababang init hanggang sa malutong, paikutin ito hangga't maaari, pagkatapos ay alisin.

instruction.zh: 鍋中炒香薑絲和紅蘿蔔，加入煎好的麵腸、醬油、醬油膏、糖、沙茶醬、烏醋和胡椒粉，倒入約200毫升水煮滾。
instruction.en: Sauté ginger and carrot until fragrant, then add the crisp wheat gluten, soy sauce, soy paste, sugar, satay sauce, black vinegar, and pepper. Pour in about 200 ml water and bring to a boil.
instruction.id: Tumis jahe dan wortel hingga harum, lalu tambahkan gluten gandum renyah, kecap asin, pasta kecap asin, gula, saus sate, cuka hitam, dan merica. Tuang sekitar 200 ml air lalu didihkan.
instruction.fil: Igisa ang luya at karot hanggang mabango, pagkatapos ay idagdag ang malutong na wheat gluten, toyo, toyo, asukal, satay sarsa, itim na suka, at paminta. Ibuhos sa humigit-kumulang 200 ML ng tubig at pakuluan.

instruction.zh: 醬汁煮滾後加入芥蘭炒勻，再放回板條、豆芽和豆包泥快速拌炒，讓河粉均勻吸附醬汁後起鍋。
instruction.en: Once the sauce boils, add Chinese kale and toss, then return the rice noodles and add bean sprouts plus tofu-skin mince. Stir-fry quickly until the noodles are evenly coated, then serve.

instruction.fil: Kapag kumulo na ang sauce, ilagay ang Chinese kale at ihagis, pagkatapos ay ibalik ang rice noodles at ilagay ang bean sprouts plus tofu-skin mince. Mabilis na iprito hanggang sa maging pantay ang pansit, pagkatapos ay ihain.

instruction.en: Slice tofu skin and firm tofu. Julienne ginger and Napa cabbage, cut eggplant and okra into small pieces, and remove the shimeji bases before separating the clusters.
instruction.id: Iris kulit tahu dan tahu padat. Iris memanjang jahe serta sawi putih, potong terong dan okra kecil-kecil, lalu buang pangkal shimeji dan pisahkan gerombolannya.
instruction.fil: Hiwain ang balat ng tofu at patigasin ang tofu. Julienne ginger at Napa repolyo, gupitin ang talong at okra sa maliliit na piraso, at alisin ang mga base ng shimeji bago paghiwalayin ang mga kumpol.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic overhead food photograph of sliced tofu skin, firm tofu, Napa cabbage, eggplant, okra, and shimeji arranged on a board, no text.

instruction.zh: 炒鍋倒入適量香油，將板豆腐兩面煎至金黃後取出備用。
instruction.en: Heat sesame oil in a wok and pan-fry the firm tofu until both sides are golden, then set it aside.
instruction.id: Panaskan minyak wijen dalam wajan dan goreng tahu padat hingga kedua sisi keemasan, lalu sisihkan.
instruction.fil: Init ang sesame oil sa isang kawali at iprito ang matigas na tofu hanggang sa maging ginintuang ang magkabilang panig, pagkatapos ay itabi.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic food photograph of golden firm tofu slices searing in a wok with a crisp browned surface, no text.

title.fil: Magluto ng repolyo, talong, at mushroom

instruction.zh: 原鍋煸香薑絲，先加入大白菜梗炒至半透明，利用其甜味取代洋蔥；再放茄子與鴻禧菇以大火快炒。
instruction.en: In the same wok, sauté ginger, then cook the Napa cabbage stems until partly translucent to replace onion sweetness. Add eggplant and shimeji mushrooms and stir-fry over high heat.
instruction.id: Di wajan yang sama, tumis jahe, lalu masak batang sawi putih hingga agak transparan untuk menggantikan rasa manis bawang. Tambahkan terong dan jamur shimeji, lalu tumis dengan api besar.
instruction.fil: Sa parehong kawali, igisa ang luya, pagkatapos ay lutuin ang mga tangkay ng repolyo ng Napa hanggang bahagyang maging translucent upang mapalitan ang tamis ng sibuyas. Magdagdag ng talong at shimeji mushroom at iprito sa sobrang init.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic food photograph of Napa cabbage stems, eggplant, and shimeji mushrooms stir-frying with julienned ginger in a wok, no text.

instruction.zh: 加入日式醬油、味醂、糖、胡椒粉、七味粉和足量水，水量約蓋過食材；放入秋葵與白菜葉，蓋鍋以小火熬煮10分鐘。
instruction.en: Add Japanese soy sauce, mirin, sugar, pepper, seven-spice chili powder, and enough water to nearly cover the ingredients. Add okra and cabbage leaves, cover, and simmer over low heat for 10 minutes.
instruction.id: Tambahkan kecap asin Jepang, mirin, gula, merica, bubuk shichimi, dan air hingga hampir menutupi bahan. Masukkan okra serta daun sawi, tutup, lalu rebus api kecil selama 10 menit.
instruction.fil: Magdagdag ng Japanese soy sauce, mirin, asukal, paminta, pitong pampalasa na sili, at sapat na tubig upang halos masakop ang mga sangkap. Magdagdag ng okra at dahon ng repolyo, takpan, at kumulo sa mahinang apoy sa loob ng 10 minuto.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic food photograph of vegan Japanese donburi vegetables and tofu simmering in a light brown broth with bright green okra, no text.

title.en: Fold in tofu skin for egg-drop texture
title.id: Masukkan kulit tahu untuk tekstur telur
title.fil: Tiklupin ang balat ng tofu para sa egg-drop texture

instruction.zh: 試味後依個人口味補少許鹽，將千張撕成小片放入鍋中輕拌，讓它形成蛋花般滑順口感後關火。
instruction.en: Taste and add a little salt if needed. Tear tofu skin into small pieces, fold it gently into the pot to create an egg-drop-like silky texture, then turn off the heat.
instruction.id: Cicipi lalu tambahkan sedikit garam bila perlu. Sobek kulit tahu kecil-kecil, aduk perlahan ke dalam panci hingga membentuk tekstur lembut seperti telur orak-arik, lalu matikan api.
instruction.fil: Tikman at magdagdag ng kaunting asin kung kinakailangan. Hatiin ang balat ng tofu sa maliliit na piraso, dahan-dahang itupi ito sa kaldero upang lumikha ng parang malasutla na texture, pagkatapos ay patayin ang apoy.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic close-up food photograph of torn tofu skin ribbons folded through a silky vegan Japanese vegetable broth, no text.

title.en: Assemble and garnish the rice bowls
title.fil: Ipunin at palamutihan ang mga rice bowl

instruction.zh: 兩碗白飯分別盛入碗中，淋上日式豆腐燴料與湯汁，放上煎豆腐，最後以海苔絲和白芝麻點綴。
instruction.en: Divide cooked white rice between two bowls, spoon over the tofu and vegetable stew with its broth, add the pan-fried tofu, then garnish with shredded nori and white sesame.
instruction.id: Bagi nasi putih matang ke dua mangkuk, sendokkan rebusan tahu serta sayuran bersama kuahnya, tambahkan tahu goreng, lalu hias dengan nori iris dan wijen putih.
instruction.fil: Hatiin ang nilutong puting bigas sa pagitan ng dalawang mangkok, sandok ang tokwa at nilagang gulay kasama ang sabaw nito, idagdag ang piniritong tokwa, pagkatapos ay palamutihan ng ginutay-gutay na nori at puting linga.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic plated food photograph of a vegan Japanese tofu rice bowl topped with tofu, vegetables, shredded nori, and white sesame, no text.

description.zh: 以茄子模擬肥肉滑潤、煸脆豆乾模擬瘦肉，和青江菜包入千張，氣炸成薄脆的全素鮮肉餛飩。
description.en: Eggplant supplies a rich fatty texture while crisp pressed tofu mimics lean meat; both are wrapped with bok choy in tofu skin and air-fried into crunchy vegan wontons.
description.id: Terong memberi tekstur lembut seperti lemak, sedangkan tahu padat renyah meniru daging tanpa lemak; keduanya dibungkus dengan pakcoy dalam kulit tahu dan dimasak air fryer menjadi pangsit vegan renyah.
description.fil: Ang talong ay nagbibigay ng isang masaganang matabang texture habang ang malutong na pinindot na tofu ay ginagaya ang walang taba na karne; parehong binalot ng bok choy sa balat ng tofu at pinirito sa hangin sa malutong na vegan wonton.

name.fil: mga sheet ng balat ng tofu

title.en: Chop ingredients and salt the bok choy
title.fil: Hiwain ang mga sangkap at asin ang bok choy

instruction.zh: 千張與青江菜洗淨後切小段，青江菜加鹽抓醃至出水；薑切末，茄子和豆乾切小丁。
instruction.en: Wash and cut the tofu skin and bok choy into small pieces, then massage the bok choy with salt until it releases water. Mince the ginger and dice the eggplant and pressed tofu.
instruction.id: Cuci lalu potong kulit tahu dan pakcoy kecil-kecil, kemudian remas pakcoy dengan garam hingga mengeluarkan air. Cincang jahe dan potong dadu terong serta tahu padat.
instruction.fil: Hugasan at gupitin ang balat ng tokwa at bok choy sa maliliit na piraso, pagkatapos ay imasahe ng asin ang bok choy hanggang sa lumabas ang tubig. Hiwain ang luya at hiwain ang talong at pinindot na tokwa.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic overhead food photograph of chopped bok choy, diced eggplant, pressed tofu, ginger, and tofu skin sheets on a wooden board, no text.

instruction.zh: 將30克麵粉與20克水攪拌成濃稠麵粉糊，放在一旁作為封口黏著劑。
instruction.en: Stir 30 g flour with 20 g water into a thick paste and set it aside as the wrapper-sealing adhesive.
instruction.id: Aduk 30 g tepung dengan 20 g air hingga menjadi pasta kental, lalu sisihkan sebagai perekat penutup kulit.
instruction.fil: Haluin ang 30 g harina na may 20 g tubig sa isang makapal na i-paste at itabi ito bilang wrapper-sealing adhesive.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic close-up food photograph of thick flour paste being stirred in a small bowl beside tofu skin wrappers, no text.

title.en: Crisp the tofu and season the eggplant
title.fil: Crisp ang tofu at timplahan ng talong

instruction.zh: 炒鍋加少量油，將豆乾煸至金黃酥脆；加入薑末和茄子炒香，再放醬油、胡椒粉與少許五香粉，補少量水燒至收乾後放涼。
instruction.en: Heat a little oil in a wok and brown the pressed tofu until crisp. Add minced ginger and eggplant, then season with soy sauce, pepper, and a little five-spice; add a small amount of water and cook until dry, then cool.
instruction.id: Panaskan sedikit minyak dalam wajan dan tumis tahu padat hingga keemasan serta renyah. Tambahkan jahe cincang dan terong, lalu bumbui kecap asin, merica, serta sedikit bubuk lima rempah; tambahkan sedikit air dan masak hingga kering, lalu dinginkan.
instruction.fil: Mag-init ng kaunting mantika sa kawali at i-brown ang pinindot na tofu hanggang sa malutong. Magdagdag ng tinadtad na luya at talong, pagkatapos ay timplahan ng toyo, paminta, at kaunting limang pampalasa; magdagdag ng kaunting tubig at lutuin hanggang matuyo, pagkatapos ay palamig.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic food photograph of diced eggplant and crisp pressed tofu cooking in a savory brown sauce in a wok, no text.

title.fil: Paghaluin ang parang vegan na palaman

instruction.zh: 將出水青江菜擠乾，與放涼的茄子豆乾餡拌勻；豆乾提供瘦肉般嚼感，茄子提供滑潤口感。
instruction.en: Squeeze the water from the bok choy and mix it with the cooled eggplant-tofu filling. The crisp tofu adds a lean-meat chew while eggplant provides a rich silky texture.
instruction.id: Peras air dari pakcoy lalu campurkan dengan isian terong dan tahu yang sudah dingin. Tahu renyah memberi gigitan seperti daging tanpa lemak, sedangkan terong memberi tekstur lembut kaya rasa.
instruction.fil: Pigain ang tubig mula sa bok choy at ihalo ito sa pinalamig na eggplant-tofu filling. Ang malutong na tofu ay nagdaragdag ng lean-meat chew habang ang talong ay nagbibigay ng isang rich silky texture.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic overhead food photograph of a mixed vegan wonton filling with bok choy, diced eggplant, and crisp pressed tofu in a bowl, no text.

title.en: Fill and seal the tofu-skin wontons
title.id: Isi dan tutup pangsit kulit tahu
title.fil: Punan at selyuhan ang tofu-skin wontons

instruction.zh: 取一張千張，周圍抹麵粉糊，放入適量餡料後折起封緊；若使用大張千張，可先剪成正方形。
instruction.en: Take one tofu skin sheet, brush flour paste around the edge, add a suitable amount of filling, and fold tightly to seal. Cut larger tofu skin sheets into squares first if needed.
instruction.id: Ambil satu lembar kulit tahu, olesi tepinya dengan pasta tepung, isi secukupnya, lalu lipat dan rekatkan rapat. Jika menggunakan lembar besar, potong menjadi persegi terlebih dahulu bila perlu.
instruction.fil: Kumuha ng isang tofu skin sheet, i-brush ang flour paste sa paligid ng gilid, magdagdag ng angkop na dami ng filling, at tiklupin nang mahigpit upang ma-seal. Gupitin muna ang mas malalaking balat ng tofu sa mga parisukat kung kinakailangan.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic close-up food photograph of hands folding a tofu skin wonton around a vegetable and tofu filling, no text.

title.id: Masak air fryer hingga renyah keemasan
title.fil: Air-fry hanggang sa malutong at ginintuang

instruction.zh: 氣炸鍋底部薄抹植物油，放入餛飩以160°C氣炸8分鐘；小心翻面後再以160°C氣炸5分鐘，至外皮金黃酥脆。
instruction.en: Lightly oil the air-fryer basket, add the wontons, and air-fry at 160°C for 8 minutes. Turn them carefully, then air-fry at 160°C for 5 more minutes until golden and crisp.
instruction.id: Olesi tipis keranjang air fryer dengan minyak sayur, masukkan pangsit, lalu masak pada 160°C selama 8 menit. Balik dengan hati-hati dan masak lagi pada 160°C selama 5 menit hingga keemasan serta renyah.
instruction.fil: Langis ng bahagya ang air-fryer basket, idagdag ang wontons, at i-air-fry sa 160°C sa loob ng 8 minuto. Maingat na paikutin ang mga ito, pagkatapos ay i-air-fry sa 160°C para sa 5 pang minuto hanggang sa maging ginintuang at malutong.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic plated food photograph of crisp golden vegan tofu-skin wontons with a thin crunchy wrapper on a ceramic plate, no text.

description.zh: 以氣炸定型的杏鮑菇搭配酸菜、薑絲與酸香醬汁的全素客家菜。
description.en: A vegan Hakka dish of air-fried king oyster mushrooms with pickled mustard greens, ginger, and tangy sauce.
description.id: Hidangan Hakka vegan dari jamur tiram raja air fryer, sawi asin, jahe, dan saus asam.
description.fil: Isang vegan Hakka dish ng air-fried king oyster mushroom na may adobo na mustard greens, luya, at tangy sauce.

name.fil: adobo na mga gulay ng mustasa

instruction.zh: 杏鮑菇切 0.3–0.5 公分薄片，加鹽與味醂抓醃；電鍋外鍋加一杯水蒸熟，保留菇汁並放涼捲起。
instruction.en: Slice mushrooms 0.3–0.5 cm thick, season with salt and mirin, steam with one cup water, reserve the juices, cool, and roll.
instruction.id: Iris jamur setebal 0,3–0,5 cm, bumbui garam dan mirin, kukus dengan satu cangkir air, simpan sarinya, dinginkan, lalu gulung.
instruction.fil: Hiwain ang mga mushroom na 0.3–0.5 cm ang kapal, timplahan ng asin at mirin, singaw na may isang tasang tubig, ireserba ang mga juice, palamig, at pagulungin.

instruction.en: Mist mushroom rolls with a little oil and air-fry at 160°C for eight minutes, then cool.

instruction.fil: Mist mushroom roll na may kaunting mantika at i-air-fry sa 160°C sa loob ng walong minuto, pagkatapos ay palamig.

instruction.en: Stir-fry ginger and pickled greens in sesame oil; add bean paste, mushroom juices, vinegar, sugar, and salt. Add rolls and chili, stir-fry over high heat, then thicken and serve.
instruction.id: Tumis jahe dan sawi asin dengan minyak wijen; tambahkan pasta kacang, sari jamur, cuka, gula, dan garam. Masukkan gulungan dan cabai, tumis api besar, lalu kentalkan dan sajikan.
instruction.fil: Igisa ang luya at adobo na gulay sa sesame oil; magdagdag ng bean paste, mushroom juice, suka, asukal, at asin. Magdagdag ng mga roll at sili, haluin sa mataas na apoy, pagkatapos ay kumapal at ihain.

description.zh: 茄子以覆蓋水與少量油加蓋燜熟保留紫色，再與煸脆素雞、辣豆瓣醬和四季豆快速拌炒，做成少油的素食魚香茄子。
description.en: Eggplant is covered with water and a little oil, then steamed in a covered wok to preserve its purple color before a quick stir-fry with crisp vegetarian chicken, chili bean paste, and green beans creates a lighter vegan fish-fragrant dish.
description.id: Terong dikukus tertutup dengan air dan sedikit minyak untuk menjaga warna ungunya, lalu ditumis cepat bersama ayam vegetarian renyah, pasta kacang cabai, dan buncis menjadi hidangan yu xiang vegan yang lebih ringan.
description.fil: Ang talong ay natatakpan ng tubig at kaunting mantika, pagkatapos ay i-steam sa isang natatakpan na kawali upang mapanatili ang lilang kulay nito bago ang mabilis na pagprito na may malulutong na vegetarian na manok, chili bean paste, at ang berdeng bean ay lumilikha ng mas magaan na vegan na mabangong ulam.

title.fil: Ihanda ang mga sangkap ng Yu Xiang

instruction.zh: 茄子切約5公分段再對半切；素雞與香菇切小丁，薑切末，大辣椒切斜片，四季豆去梗洗淨。
instruction.en: Cut eggplant into roughly 5 cm pieces and halve them. Dice vegetarian chicken and shiitake, mince ginger, slice the chili on a diagonal, and trim the green beans.
instruction.id: Potong terong sekitar 5 cm lalu belah dua. Potong dadu ayam vegetarian dan shiitake, cincang jahe, iris cabai serong, lalu buang ujung buncis.
instruction.fil: Gupitin ang talong sa humigit-kumulang 5 cm na piraso at hatiin ang mga ito sa kalahati. Dice vegetarian chicken at shiitake, hiwain ang luya, hiwain ang sili sa pahilis, at gupitin ang green beans.

instruction.zh: 將太白粉與4大匙水攪拌均勻成勾芡水，放在一旁備用。
instruction.en: Stir potato starch with 4 tablespoons water until smooth to make a slurry, then set it aside.
instruction.id: Aduk pati kentang dengan 4 sendok makan air hingga rata untuk membuat larutan pengental, lalu sisihkan.
instruction.fil: Haluin ang potato starch na may 4 na kutsarang tubig hanggang sa makinis upang makagawa ng slurry, pagkatapos ay itabi ito.

title.en: Steam eggplant to preserve its color
title.id: Kukus terong agar warnanya tetap ungu
title.fil: singaw ng talong para mapanatili ang kulay nito

instruction.zh: 炒鍋中讓茄子外皮朝下，倒入剛蓋過茄子的水與少量植物油，蓋上鍋蓋燜煮5分鐘；關火後立刻取出並倒掉水分。
instruction.en: Place eggplant skin-side down in a wok, add water just to cover it and a little vegetable oil, cover, and steam 5 minutes. Turn off the heat, remove it immediately, and pour off the water.
instruction.id: Letakkan terong dengan kulit menghadap bawah di wajan, tambahkan air hingga terendam dan sedikit minyak sayur, tutup, lalu kukus 5 menit. Matikan api, segera angkat terong, dan buang airnya.
instruction.fil: Ilagay ang balat ng talong sa gilid pababa sa isang kawali, magdagdag ng tubig para lang masakop ito at kaunting mantika ng gulay, takpan, at singaw ng 5 minuto. Patayin ang apoy, alisin ito kaagad, at ibuhos ang tubig.

title.en: Crisp vegetarian chicken and fry the sauce
title.id: Renyahkan ayam vegetarian dan tumis saus
title.fil: Crisp vegetarian chicken at iprito ang sauce

instruction.zh: 原鍋開小火倒入香油，將薑末與素雞煸至帶焦脆，再加入香菇炒香；放辣豆瓣醬、醬油、胡椒粉、糖、白醋與花椒粉炒出香氣。
instruction.en: Over low heat in the same wok, add sesame oil and crisp the ginger plus vegetarian chicken, then sauté shiitake. Add chili bean paste, soy sauce, pepper, sugar, white vinegar, and Sichuan pepper powder and fry until aromatic.
instruction.id: Dengan api kecil di wajan yang sama, tambahkan minyak wijen lalu renyahkan jahe dan ayam vegetarian, kemudian tumis shiitake. Masukkan pasta kacang cabai, kecap asin, merica, gula, cuka putih, dan bubuk lada Sichuan hingga harum.
instruction.fil: Sa mababang init sa parehong kawali, magdagdag ng sesame oil at malutong ang luya at vegetarian na manok, pagkatapos ay igisa ang shiitake. Magdagdag ng chili bean paste, toyo, paminta, asukal, puting suka, at Sichuan pepper powder at iprito hanggang mabango.

Constraints: strictly vegan; no eggplant, green beans, fresh chili, starch slurry, meat, eggs, dairy, seafood, labels, people, watermark, or logos. No text.

instruction.zh: 倒入100克水煮滾後轉大火，放回茄子、辣椒和四季豆快速拌炒；倒入勾芡水炒至醬汁附著即刻起鍋，避免久炒令茄子出油。
instruction.en: Pour in 100 g water and bring to a boil, then turn to high heat and quickly toss in eggplant, chili, and green beans. Add the slurry and cook only until the sauce clings, serving immediately to avoid the eggplant releasing oil.
instruction.id: Tuang 100 g air lalu didihkan, kemudian gunakan api besar dan aduk cepat terong, cabai, serta buncis. Tambahkan larutan pengental dan masak hanya sampai saus melekat, lalu segera sajikan agar terong tidak mengeluarkan minyak.
instruction.fil: Ibuhos ang 100 g ng tubig at pakuluan, pagkatapos ay buksan sa mataas na init at mabilis na ihagis ang talong, sili, at berdeng beans. Idagdag ang slurry at lutuin lamang hanggang sa kumapit ang sarsa, ihain kaagad upang maiwasan ang paglabas ng mantika ng talong.

instruction.zh: 豆乾切片、豆包切段；杏鮑菇與芹菜切長條，其中杏鮑菇保留約8毫米粗度；香菇與薑切絲，辣椒切斜片。
instruction.en: Slice the pressed tofu and cut tofu puffs into sections. Cut king oyster mushrooms and celery into long strips, keeping mushrooms about 8 mm thick; julienne shiitake and ginger, and slice chili diagonally.
instruction.id: Iris tahu padat dan potong tahu puff. Potong jamur king oyster serta seledri memanjang, jaga ketebalan jamur sekitar 8 mm; iris shiitake dan jahe memanjang, lalu iris cabai serong.
instruction.fil: Hiwain ang pinindot na tofu at gupitin ang tofu puffs sa mga seksyon. Gupitin ang mga king oyster mushroom at kintsay sa mahabang piraso, pinapanatili ang mga mushroom na humigit-kumulang 8 mm ang kapal; julienne shiitake at luya, at hiwain ang sili pahilis.

instruction.en: Heat sesame oil in a wok and slowly brown the pressed tofu and tofu puffs until golden and crisp, then set aside so they retain texture after saucing.
instruction.id: Panaskan minyak wijen dalam wajan dan tumis perlahan tahu padat serta tahu puff hingga keemasan dan renyah, lalu sisihkan agar tetap bertekstur setelah diberi saus.
instruction.fil: Init ang sesame oil sa isang kawali at dahan-dahang kayumanggi ang pinindot na tofu at tofu puffs hanggang maging ginintuang at malutong, pagkatapos ay itabi upang mapanatili ang texture pagkatapos ng sauce.

title.fil: Igisa ang mga mushroom at aromatics

instruction.zh: 原鍋放入薑絲、香菇絲和粗切杏鮑菇炒香，讓杏鮑菇略縮水但仍保有Q彈咬感。
instruction.en: In the same wok, sauté ginger, shiitake, and thick-cut king oyster mushrooms until fragrant, letting the king oyster shrink slightly while retaining chew.
instruction.id: Di wajan yang sama, tumis jahe, shiitake, dan jamur king oyster potong tebal hingga harum; biarkan jamur sedikit menyusut tetapi tetap kenyal.
instruction.fil: Sa parehong kawali, igisa ang luya, shiitake, at makapal na king oyster mushroom hanggang sa mabango, hayaang bahagyang lumiit ang king oyster habang nananatili ang ngumunguya.

title.fil: Magdagdag ng Hakka sauce at bawasan

instruction.zh: 放回豆乾與豆包，加入素蠔油、素沙茶醬、五香粉、烏醋、胡椒粉、糖與100克水，拌炒至醬汁被食材吸附。
instruction.en: Return the pressed tofu and tofu puffs, then add vegan oyster sauce, vegan satay sauce, five-spice, black vinegar, pepper, sugar, and 100 g water. Toss until the sauce coats and is absorbed.
instruction.id: Masukkan kembali tahu padat dan tahu puff, lalu tambahkan saus tiram vegan, saus sate vegan, bubuk lima rempah, cuka hitam, merica, gula, dan 100 g air. Aduk hingga saus melapisi dan terserap.
instruction.fil: Ibalik ang pinindot na tofu at tofu puff, pagkatapos ay idagdag ang vegan oyster sauce, vegan satay sauce, five-spice, black vinegar, paminta, asukal, at 100 g tubig. Ihagis hanggang sa matuyo ang sarsa at ma-absorb.

instruction.zh: 最後加入芹菜段與辣椒斜片快速拌炒至芹菜剛熟，立即盛盤，保持蔬菜爽脆和豆製品焦香。
instruction.en: Add celery segments and diagonal chili slices last, stir-fry quickly until celery is just cooked, and plate immediately to preserve crisp vegetables and browned tofu flavor.
instruction.id: Masukkan seledri dan irisan cabai serong terakhir, tumis cepat hingga seledri baru matang, lalu segera sajikan agar sayuran tetap renyah dan tahu tetap harum.
instruction.fil: Lagyan ng celery segments at diagonal chili slices last, stir-fry fast until celery is just cooked, at plato agad para mapanatili ang malulutong na gulay at browned tofu flavor.

description.zh: 杏鮑菇與金針菇低溫煉成濃香菇油，蒸熟的杏鮑菇撕條鋪在白飯上，搭配醬汁與小黃瓜的全素雞肉飯。
description.en: King oyster and enoki mushrooms are slowly infused into a deeply savory mushroom oil, while steamed shredded king oyster tops rice with sauce and cucumber in this vegan chicken-rice-style bowl.
description.id: Jamur king oyster dan enoki dimasak perlahan menjadi minyak jamur yang gurih, sedangkan king oyster kukus suwir disajikan di atas nasi bersama saus dan mentimun sebagai nasi gaya ayam vegan.
description.fil: Ang king oyster at enoki mushroom ay dahan-dahang inilalagay sa isang napakasarap na mushroom oil, habang ang steamed shredded king oyster ay nangunguna sa kanin na may sauce at cucumber sa vegan na chicken-rice-style bowl na ito.

title.fil: Maghanda ng mga mushroom at pipino

instruction.zh: 將金針菇與一部分杏鮑菇切小丁；另一部分杏鮑菇用手撕成粗條，小黃瓜切薄片。
instruction.en: Dice the enoki and part of the king oyster mushrooms. Tear the remaining king oyster mushrooms into thick strips and slice the cucumber thinly.
instruction.id: Potong dadu enoki dan sebagian jamur king oyster. Suwir sisa king oyster menjadi strip tebal dan iris mentimun tipis-tipis.
instruction.fil: Dice ang enoki at bahagi ng king oyster mushroom. Hatiin ang natitirang king oyster mushroom sa makapal na piraso at hiwain ng manipis ang pipino.

title.fil: I-steam ang ginutay-gutay na king oyster

instruction.zh: 將撕成條的杏鮑菇以鹽和味醂調味後蒸熟，保留蒸出的鮮甜湯汁備用。
instruction.en: Season the shredded king oyster mushrooms with salt and mirin, then steam until tender, reserving the savory liquid released during steaming.
instruction.id: Bumbui suwir jamur king oyster dengan garam dan mirin, lalu kukus hingga empuk sambil menyimpan cairan gurih yang keluar saat dikukus.
instruction.fil: Timplahan ng asin at mirin ang ginutay-gutay na king oyster mushroom, pagkatapos ay pasingawan hanggang lumambot, na inilalaan ang malasang likido na inilabas habang pinapasingaw.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic food photograph of shredded king oyster mushrooms steaming in a heat-safe bowl with clear savory juices, no text.

instruction.zh: 冷鍋倒入較多植物油，放入切丁的杏鮑菇和金針菇，以小火慢慢煉至菇丁轉深褐色，濾出菇油和酥香菇丁。
instruction.en: Pour a generous amount of vegetable oil into a cold wok, add the diced king oyster and enoki, and cook slowly over low heat until deeply brown; strain out the mushroom oil and crisp mushroom bits.
instruction.id: Tuang cukup banyak minyak sayur ke wajan dingin, masukkan king oyster dan enoki potong dadu, lalu masak perlahan dengan api kecil hingga cokelat tua; saring minyak jamur dan remah jamur renyah.
instruction.fil: Ibuhos ang isang masaganang halaga ng langis ng gulay sa isang malamig na kawali, idagdag ang diced king oyster at enoki, at lutuin nang dahan-dahan sa mahinang apoy hanggang sa malalim na kayumanggi; salain ang mushroom oil at malulutong na mushroom bits.

instruction.zh: 小碗中混合醬油、醬油膏、糖、胡椒粉與少許五香粉，攪拌成鹹甜醬汁。
instruction.en: In a small bowl, mix soy sauce, soy paste, sugar, ground pepper, and a little five-spice powder into a savory-sweet sauce.
instruction.id: Dalam mangkuk kecil, campurkan kecap asin, pasta kecap asin, gula, merica bubuk, dan sedikit bubuk lima rempah menjadi saus gurih manis.
instruction.fil: Sa isang maliit na mangkok, paghaluin ang toyo, toyo, asukal, giniling na paminta, at isang maliit na five-spice powder sa isang malasang-matamis na sarsa.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic overhead food photograph of dark glossy vegan rice-bowl sauce being stirred in a small bowl with spices, no text.

instruction.zh: 兩碗白飯各放上蒸杏鮑菇條，淋少量蒸汁、菇香油和調製醬汁，再撒上酥香菇丁並搭配小黃瓜片。
instruction.en: Top two bowls of rice with steamed king oyster strips, drizzle with some steaming liquid, mushroom oil, and sauce, then add crisp mushroom bits and cucumber slices.
instruction.id: Tata dua mangkuk nasi dengan suwir king oyster kukus, siram sedikit cairan kukusan, minyak jamur, dan saus, lalu tambahkan remah jamur renyah serta irisan mentimun.
instruction.fil: Itaas ang dalawang mangkok ng kanin na may steamed king oyster strips, lagyan ng kaunting steaming liquid, mushroom oil, at sauce, pagkatapos ay idagdag ang malulutong na mushroom bits at cucumber slices.

title.zh: 三機植物腳肉 經典系列

description.zh: 醃漬植物絞肉包住牛蒡條冷凍定型，裹千張兩次炸脆，再以照燒醬收汁的全素棒棒腿年菜。
description.en: Marinated plant mince wraps burdock sticks and freezes firm, then tofu skin creates a twice-fried crisp shell before a teriyaki glaze finishes these vegan drumsticks.
description.id: Cincangan daging nabati yang dimarinasi membungkus batang burdock lalu dibekukan, kemudian kulit tahu membentuk lapisan renyah goreng dua kali sebelum diselesaikan dengan glasir teriyaki.
description.fil: Binabalot ng adobong halaman na mince ang mga burdock stick at nagyeyelo, pagkatapos ay lumilikha ang balat ng tofu ng dalawang beses na piniritong malutong na shell bago natapos ng teriyaki glaze ang mga vegan drumstick na ito.

name.fil: mga sheet ng balat ng tofu

instruction.zh: 退冰後的植物絞肉加入糖、半顆檸檬汁、孜然粉和少許五香粉拌勻備用。
instruction.en: Mix thawed plant-based mince with sugar, juice of half a lemon, cumin powder, and a little five-spice powder, then set aside.
instruction.id: Campur cincangan daging nabati yang sudah dicairkan dengan gula, perasan setengah lemon, bubuk jintan, dan sedikit bubuk lima rempah, lalu sisihkan.
instruction.fil: Paghaluin ang lasaw na plant-based mince na may asukal, juice ng kalahating lemon, cumin powder, at isang maliit na five-spice powder, pagkatapos ay itabi.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic overhead food photograph of seasoned plant-based mince with lemon and spices in a glass bowl, no text.

title.fil: Hugis ang mga hawakan ng buto ng burdock

instruction.zh: 牛蒡去皮後切約10公分段，修成略方正再一分為三，製成6條適合當棒棒腿骨柄的牛蒡條。
instruction.en: Peel the burdock, cut it into about 10 cm lengths, square the sides slightly, then split each length into thirds to make six bone-handle sticks.
instruction.id: Kupas burdock, potong sekitar 10 cm, rapikan sisi agar agak persegi, lalu belah tiap potong menjadi tiga untuk membuat enam batang pegangan tulang.
instruction.fil: Balatan ang burdock, gupitin ito ng humigit-kumulang 10 cm ang haba, kuwadrado nang bahagya ang mga gilid, pagkatapos ay hatiin ang bawat haba sa ikatlo upang makagawa ng anim na stick ng bone-handle.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic overhead food photograph of peeled burdock root cut into six neat rectangular sticks on a wooden board, no text.

instruction.zh: 麵粉與75克水調成無顆粒麵糊。醃肉分6份，每根牛蒡條先抹麵糊，再以一份植物肉包住前端二分之一，冷凍至少2小時。
instruction.en: Mix flour with 75 g water until smooth. Divide the marinated mince into six portions; brush each burdock stick with paste, wrap one portion around the front half, and freeze at least 2 hours.
instruction.id: Campur tepung dengan 75 g air hingga halus. Bagi cincangan termarinasi menjadi enam; olesi tiap batang burdock dengan pasta, bungkus setengah bagian depan dengan satu porsi, lalu bekukan minimal 2 jam.
instruction.fil: Paghaluin ang harina na may 75 g ng tubig hanggang sa makinis. Hatiin ang adobong mince sa anim na bahagi; lagyan ng paste ang bawat burdock stick, balutin ang isang bahagi sa harap na kalahati, at i-freeze nang hindi bababa sa 2 oras.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic food photograph of six plant-meat drumsticks with burdock handles arranged on a tray ready for freezing, no text.

instruction.zh: 油溫加熱至140°C，將冷凍定型的植物肉棒棒腿炸至焦黃後取出。
instruction.en: Heat frying oil to 140°C and fry the frozen, shaped plant-meat drumsticks until browned, then remove.
instruction.id: Panaskan minyak goreng hingga 140°C lalu goreng drumstick daging nabati beku yang sudah berbentuk sampai kecokelatan, kemudian angkat.
instruction.fil: Painitin ang mantika sa pagprito sa 140°C at iprito ang frozen, hugis plant-meat drumsticks hanggang sa mag-brown, pagkatapos ay alisin.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic close-up food photograph of plant-meat drumsticks with burdock handles frying at low temperature in bubbling oil, no text.

title.en: Wrap in tofu skin and fry again
title.id: Balut kulit tahu lalu goreng lagi
title.fil: Balutin sa balat ng tofu at iprito muli

instruction.zh: 炸好的棒棒腿再沾麵粉糊，以剪成長條的千張包裹，回鍋炸至金黃酥脆後取出。
instruction.en: Dip the fried drumsticks in flour paste again, wrap them with tofu skin cut into strips, and return them to the oil until golden and crisp.
instruction.id: Celupkan kembali drumstick yang sudah digoreng ke pasta tepung, balut dengan kulit tahu yang dipotong memanjang, lalu goreng lagi sampai keemasan serta renyah.
instruction.fil: Isawsaw muli ang piniritong drumstick sa flour paste, balutin ito ng balat ng tofu na hiniwa-hiwa, at ibalik sa mantika hanggang sa ginintuang at malutong.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic food photograph of tofu skin strips wrapping a crisp plant-meat drumstick before the second fry, no text.

title.en: Glaze with teriyaki sauce and serve
title.fil: Pahiran ng teriyaki sauce at ihain

instruction.zh: 炒鍋放醬油、糖、味醂、番茄醬與5大匙水煮滾收濃，放入炸棒棒腿拌至均勻裹醬；撒白芝麻，搭配汆燙花椰菜與檸檬上桌。
instruction.en: Bring soy sauce, sugar, mirin, ketchup, and 5 tablespoons water to a boil and reduce until thick. Toss in the fried drumsticks until glazed; finish with sesame, blanched broccoli, and lemon.
instruction.id: Didihkan kecap asin, gula, mirin, saus tomat, dan 5 sendok makan air lalu susutkan hingga kental. Aduk drumstick goreng hingga terlapisi glasir; akhiri dengan wijen, brokoli blansir, dan lemon.
instruction.fil: Pakuluan ang toyo, asukal, mirin, ketchup, at 5 kutsarang tubig at bawasan hanggang lumapot. Ihagis ang pritong drumsticks hanggang makintab; tapusin sa linga, blanched broccoli, at lemon.

steps.imagePrompt: Photorealistic plated food photograph of glossy teriyaki vegan drumsticks with broccoli, lemon wedges, and white sesame, no text.

title.en: Vegan Ten-Herb Buddha Jumps Over the Wall
title.id: Buddha Jumps Over the Wall Vegan Sepuluh Rempah
title.fil: Ang Vegan Ten-Herb Buddha ay Tumalon sa Pader

description.zh: 根莖蔬菜、菇類、豆製品與十全中藥材分層放入電鍋蒸煮，成為湯頭濃郁清甜的全素佛跳牆。
description.en: Root vegetables, mushrooms, tofu products, and ten Chinese herbs are layered in an electric cooker to create a rich yet sweet vegan Buddha Jumps Over the Wall soup.
description.id: Sayuran akar, jamur, produk tahu, dan sepuluh herbal Tiongkok disusun dalam penanak listrik untuk membuat sup Buddha Jumps Over the Wall vegan yang kaya namun manis.
description.fil: Ang mga ugat na gulay, kabute, mga produkto ng tofu, at sampung halamang Tsino ay pinagpatong sa isang electric cooker upang lumikha ng isang mayaman ngunit matamis na vegan na Buddha Jumps Over the Wall na sopas.

title.fil: Ihanda ang mga sangkap ng sopas

instruction.zh: 玉米、白蘿蔔、芋頭、南瓜與杏鮑菇切塊；薑與蓮藕切片，芹菜切段，高麗菜切小片，泡軟乾香菇切絲，油豆腐切小塊。
instruction.en: Cut corn, daikon, taro, pumpkin, and king oyster mushroom into chunks. Slice ginger and lotus root, cut celery into sections and cabbage into small pieces, slice soaked shiitake, and cut fried tofu small.
instruction.id: Potong jagung, lobak putih, talas, labu, dan jamur king oyster menjadi potongan. Iris jahe serta akar teratai, potong seledri dan kol, iris shiitake yang direndam, lalu potong kecil tahu goreng.
instruction.fil: Gupitin ang mais, daikon, taro, kalabasa, at king oyster mushroom. Hiwain ang luya at ugat ng lotus, gupitin ang kintsay at hiwain ng maliliit ang repolyo, hiwain ang babad na shiitake, at gupitin ng maliit ang pritong tofu.

title.fil: Brown taro at king oyster mushroom

instruction.zh: 炒鍋倒入適量植物油，先將芋頭煎至焦黃取出，再把杏鮑菇煎至焦黃，增加湯頭焦香。
instruction.en: Heat vegetable oil in a wok, brown taro until golden and remove it, then brown the king oyster mushroom to build roasted flavor for the broth.
instruction.id: Panaskan minyak sayur dalam wajan, tumis talas hingga keemasan lalu angkat, kemudian tumis jamur king oyster hingga keemasan untuk memberi rasa panggang pada kuah.
instruction.fil: Init ang mantika ng gulay sa isang kawali, brown taro hanggang sa ginintuang at alisin ito, pagkatapos ay i-brown ang king oyster mushroom para magkaroon ng inihaw na lasa para sa sabaw.

title.en: Sauté ginger and shiitake in sesame oil
title.id: Tumis jahe dan shiitake dengan minyak wijen
title.fil: Igisa ang luya at shiitake sa sesame oil

instruction.zh: 原鍋倒入適量麻油，放入薑片和泡軟後切絲的乾香菇爆香；再加入醬油、烏醋與胡椒粉炒香。上述調味料份量在現有證據中未標明。
instruction.en: Add an unspecified amount of sesame oil to the same wok and sauté the ginger slices with soaked, sliced dried shiitake until fragrant. Add soy sauce, black vinegar, and ground pepper and stir-fry until aromatic; the available evidence does not specify their amounts.
instruction.id: Tuang minyak wijen dalam jumlah yang tidak disebutkan ke wajan yang sama, lalu tumis irisan jahe dan shiitake kering yang telah direndam serta diiris hingga harum. Tambahkan kecap asin, cuka hitam, dan lada bubuk, lalu tumis hingga harum; jumlah ketiga bumbu tersebut tidak disebutkan dalam bukti yang tersedia.
instruction.fil: Magdagdag ng hindi tiyak na dami ng sesame oil sa parehong kawali at igisa ang mga hiwa ng luya na may babad, hiniwang tuyo na shiitake hanggang sa mabango. Magdagdag ng toyo, itim na suka, at giniling na paminta at iprito hanggang mabango; hindi tinukoy ng magagamit na ebidensya ang kanilang mga halaga.

title.en: Layer ingredients and seal the pot
title.fil: I-layer ang mga sangkap at i-seal ang palayok

instruction.zh: 將所有蔬菜、煎香食材、腰果、鴻禧菇、油豆腐與豆皮放入內鍋，上層放十全中藥材，倒入900克水至約八分滿；以紗布或豆漿布覆蓋，再用盤子倒扣壓緊。
instruction.en: Layer all vegetables, browned ingredients, cashews, shimeji, fried tofu, and tofu skin in the inner pot, place the ten herbs on top, and add 900 g water to about 80 percent full. Cover with cloth and press it closed with an inverted plate.
instruction.id: Susun semua sayuran, bahan yang ditumis, kacang mete, shimeji, tahu goreng, dan kulit tahu di panci dalam, letakkan sepuluh herbal di atasnya, lalu tambahkan 900 g air hingga sekitar 80 persen penuh. Tutup dengan kain dan tekan rapat memakai piring terbalik.
instruction.fil: Ilagay ang lahat ng gulay, browned ingredients, cashews, shimeji, pritong tofu, at balat ng tofu sa inner pot, ilagay ang sampung herbs sa ibabaw, at magdagdag ng 900 g tubig sa halos 80 porsiyentong puno. Takpan ng tela at pindutin ito sarado gamit ang isang baligtad na plato.

title.en: Steam in the electric cooker and season
title.id: Kukus dengan penanak listrik lalu bumbui
title.fil: Singaw sa electric cooker at season

instruction.zh: 外鍋加入4杯水蒸煮，電鍋跳起後續燜20分鐘；開蓋試味，依個人口味加入適量鹽巴即可上桌。
instruction.en: Add 4 cups of water to the outer pot and cook. After the electric cooker switches off, rest it for 20 minutes; taste and add salt to preference before serving.
instruction.id: Tambahkan 4 cangkir air ke panci luar lalu masak. Setelah penanak listrik mati, diamkan 20 menit; cicipi dan tambahkan garam sesuai selera sebelum disajikan.
instruction.fil: Magdagdag ng 4 na tasa ng tubig sa panlabas na palayok at lutuin. Matapos patayin ang electric cooker, ipahinga ito ng 20 minuto; tikman at magdagdag ng asin sa kagustuhan bago ihain.
